name: Pray Cards
description:
Carry the words of the Quran into your day with Pray Cards, a quiet companion for reading, reflecting, and remembering.

EXPLORE BY INTENTION
Discover 144 distinct Quranic passages, organized into 101 topics across 9 collections. Browse essentials, prophetic duas, family and community, forgiveness and mercy, guidance and knowledge, protection and hardship, provision and gratitude, worship and reflection, and the Hereafter.

READ WITH CLARITY
Read Arabic in Amiri on the front of each card, then reveal the supplied transliteration and English meaning. Choose a topic and enter Swipe cards to move left or right through its passages, tap to flip, bookmark, share, or close whenever you like. Adjust Arabic text size, choose light or dark appearance, and find the surah and verse reference on each card.

BUILD A GENTLE PRACTICE
Review new and due cards with a simple spaced-review schedule. Choose Again, Hard, Good, or Easy after revealing each card. Set a daily review target that fits your pace.

KEEP DUAS CLOSE
Bookmark meaningful passages, search Arabic or English, and share a dua with its reference through your device's share sheet.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The complete collection works offline. No account, ads, tracking, or subscription is required. Bookmarks and review progress stay on your device.

The 468 topic entries include repeated passages across topics; they represent 144 distinct Arabic passages. Transliteration is a reading aid. No recorded recitation is included.

Support: support@grcy.org

name: Afi Driver: Route Planner
description:
Afi Driver is the driver app for companies that plan their routes with Afi Planner.

Your dispatcher sends you a route link or QR code. Open it in the app and you get:
• Today's stops in order, with time windows, notes and packages
• One tap to navigate with Google Maps, Waze or Apple Maps
• Proof of delivery: photos, signature and barcode scan
• Messages and voice notes to your dispatcher
• Works offline: updates are saved on the phone and sent when you are back online
• Live location while you have deliveries, so your dispatcher and customers know when you are close
• A practice route to learn the app before your first day

Afi Driver needs a route from a company that uses Afi Planner. It is free for drivers.

name: AI Resume Builder - c-v.ai
description:
Build a resume you're ready to send, from your real experience.

c-v.ai helps you create, improve and tailor your resume on iPhone. Start from scratch with a guided six-step flow, or import the resume you already have. Edit it, choose a design and download a clean PDF.

START YOUR WAY
• Guided creation: answer questions one step at a time, pause and pick up later. There's a route for people without work experience too.
• Import a PDF or Word file, or paste text. Scanned PDF pages are read on your device.
• You review the imported sections before anything is added to your resume.

EDIT AND DESIGN
• Edit contact details, summary and every section; add, reorder or remove entries.
• Choose a Classic or Modern design, an accent color and an optional photo.
• US Letter or A4 page size.
• Download and share a PDF. Each export is saved as a dated version you can reopen later.

TAILOR FOR A JOB
• Paste a job ad and create a separate job version of your resume. Your main resume stays as it is.
• AI tailoring suggests wording that fits the role, using only facts from your resume. When something is missing, it asks you instead of making it up.

AI REVIEW
• Get suggestions to improve your wording. Answer any questions, then pick the revised wording you want to keep.
• Nothing changes until you approve it.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
AI features only run after you allow your resume text to be shared for that request. AI features use Sign in with Apple, so your free review and purchases stay with your Apple Account. Your resumes are stored on your device.

FREE AND PAID
Free: creating and editing resumes, designs, PDF downloads, AI import (with a daily limit) and one AI review.
Plus: AI review and AI tailoring for all your resumes. A 3-month subscription that renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
One resume: a one-time purchase that unlocks AI review and tailoring for a single resume. No subscription.
AI features are subject to fair-use limits.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://c-v.ai/privacy

name: Auralis Neuro Audio
description:
AURALIS Neuro Audio - Sleep, Calm & Focus Neuro-Acoustic Experience
Ideato e progettato dal compositore e ricercatore elettroacustico BjM Mario Bajardi.

AURALIS trasforma il tuo iPhone e iPad in uno studio neuro-acustico ad alta precisione con sintesi nativa in tempo reale a 48 kHz Stereo (AVAudioEngine), progettato per accompagnare il rilassamento profondo, il sonno, la meditazione e la concentrazione lucida. Funziona al 100% sul dispositivo, senza pubblicita e senza alcun tracciamento dei dati.

PERCHE AURALIS E DIVERSA: ORGANIC BINAURAL ENGINE
A differenza delle comuni app con toni statici che causano assuefazione uditiva dopo pochi minuti, AURALIS integra un generatore binaurale organico guidato in 3 semplici passi:
- Ciclo Respiratorio Coerente a 0.05 Hz: modulazione morbida e naturale dell'ampiezza su cicli respiratori di 20 secondi.
- Drift Stocastico Anti-Assuefazione (ogni 3 secondi): micro-variazione continua della portante armonica con blocco di fase interaurale rigoroso su 3 livelli armonici (L1 Fondamentale, L2 Quinta, L3 Sub-Ottava).

PASSO 1 - 5 PROTOCOLLI NEURO-ACUSTICI GUIDATI
1. NOCTURNE (da 8.5 a 1.8 Hz Delta): accompagna dolcemente la mente verso il sonno profondo e rigenerativo, sfumando automaticamente negli ultimi 90 secondi.
2. RESET (da 14.0 a 5.5 Hz Theta): spegne il sovraccarico mentale, rallenta i pensieri veloci e scioglie la tensione accumulata in 15 minuti.
3. FOCUS (da 9.5 a 14.0 Hz SMR): favorisce attenzione lucida, studio, lettura e lavoro creativo senza fatica mentale.
4. UNITY (oscillazione morbida tra 10.5 e 8.0 Hz Alpha): armonizza il respiro e l'umore rigenerando serenita e presenza interiore.
5. CONTROL (da 12.0 a 7.83 Hz Risonanza di Schumann): radicamento corporeo profondo sulla frequenza naturale della Terra.
Include anche 5 selettori rapidi diretti (Delta 2.5 Hz, Theta 6.0 Hz, Schumann 7.83 Hz, Alpha 10.0 Hz, SMR 14.0 Hz).

PASSO 2 - 10 SUONI RILASSANTI, DRONI ARMONICI BJM E QUINTA VERDE
- BjM 5-String Warm Violin and Osmose Pad
- AURA Deep Velvet Drone (Sub-Harmonic)
- White Noise (Rumore Bianco Puro Neuro-Acustico)
- Pink and Brown Velvet Noise (Cascata Morbida)
- Tibetan Crystal and Harmonic Fifths (Quinte Pure)
- Gustavo ROL - Quinta Musicale Colore Verde (264 Hz, 396 Hz e 528 Hz)
- Celestial Choir and Shimmering Octaves
- Schumann Earth Pulse (7.83 Hz Warm Organ)
- Kubrick Analog Tape Drone
- Nocturne Sub-Silk and Air Whisper

PASSO 3 - CERCHIO DEL RESPIRO, SPETTROGRAMMA LIVE E RIVERBERO AURA
- Timer sessione da 10, 15, 20 o 30 minuti con ascolto attivo anche a schermo spento.
- Regolazione immediata dell'Intensita Neurale (Delicato 40%, Consigliato 70%, Profondo 95%), del Volume e del Riverbero Spaziale AURA.
- Spettrogramma delle onde cerebrali in tempo reale (L1, L2, L3) e rampa temporale interattiva scorrevole col tocco.
- Guida Utente PDF illustrata integrata ed esportazione di tracce Master WAV Stereo 16-bit condivisibili.

Nota d'uso: Indossare cuffie o auricolari stereo per percepire correttamente il battimento binaurale. AURALIS e destinata al rilassamento, alla meditazione, allo studio e al benessere acustico; non e un dispositivo medico.

name: barcelona taxi es
description:
A taxi for your Barcelona journey, with Samad at the wheel.

Book an official Barcelona taxi to or from Josep Tarradellas Barcelona–El Prat Airport, or request another journey. Barcelona taxi es connects you directly with Samad, an independent driver who personally checks and confirms each request.

PLAN YOUR JOURNEY
• Choose a pick-up address and destination, including BCN Terminal 1 or Terminal 2.
• Search for addresses, hotels and landmarks in Spain, or use your location for pick-up.
• Select your date and time in Barcelona local time.
• Review an estimated fare and your journey details before sending your request, when an estimate is available.
• Book without creating a customer account.

KEEP YOUR PLANS AT HAND
• Find your saved requests in My journeys.
• Receive confirmation and journey updates by email.
• Enable optional push notifications for booking updates.
• Review and accept a proposed new time, or cancel your request.
• Add a confirmed journey to your calendar.
• Restore a website booking using the private link from your email.

A PERSONAL SERVICE
Samad drives an official Barcelona taxi with room for up to four passengers. Pay by card or cash in the taxi. He works every day except Thursday. Each journey is subject to his availability and confirmation; sending a request does not immediately confirm a taxi.

Estimates are indicative, not fixed or maximum prices. The applicable taximeter tariff determines the final fare. Traffic, waiting, tolls and applicable supplements may affect the amount. Some journeys may not have an estimate and require a fare discussion with Samad.

The app is available in English and Spanish. It serves journeys around Barcelona and the airport; requests involving other locations in Spain are reviewed individually.

Thank you for choosing my taxi. You’re supporting a local dad and his family.

Questions? Email samad@barcelona-taxi.es or visit barcelona-taxi.es.

name: Besh Kashtan
Bonrseap
description: BonrseapThis is a fully offline tool for composing ambient soundscapes. You can combine elements—such as light rain, wind, rustling leaves, water droplets, or gentle tapping—to craft your own auditory environment. Each sound can be assigned a specific role, such as a foundational layer, a detail, or a dynamic element, with customizable settings for volume, interval, probability, and duration. Features like audio ducking and limits on the number of simultaneous details ensure the composition retains a sense of "breathing room," while seamless crossfading allows one soundscape to transition into another, all while maintaining a continuous, underlying base layer. If you particularly enjoy a specific iteration, you can save it to replay the exact sequence, generate new variations based on the original rules, or extract segments to serve as the foundation for a fresh composition. Soundscape versions, drafts, and playback sessions are stored locally on your device; the app requires no account or internet connection, and it does not access your camera or photo library. Items in your collection can be deleted with a single tap, while your own creations remain preserved.

name: BowlSheet
description:
BowlSheet on iPhonen keilailun pistelaskuri, jolla kirjaat kymmenen ruudun sarjan suoraan radan äärellä. Et tarvitse päässälaskua, käyttäjätiliä tai yhteyttä keilahallin järjestelmään.

Aloita sarja pelaajan nimellä. Keilahallin ja radan tiedot ovat valinnaisia, ja päivämääräksi tulee oletuksena kuluva päivä. Voit tutustua käyttöön myös selvästi merkityllä esimerkkisarjalla. Syötä jokaisella heitolla kaatuneiden keilojen määrä 0–10 tai kirjaa kaato yhdellä napautuksella. Ruutunäkymä on jaettu kahteen viiden ruudun riviin, ja siinä näkyvät heitot sekä kertyneet pisteet. Nykyinen ruutu ja heitto erottuvat selvästi. Jäljellä olevien keilojen määrän ylittäviä arvoja ei voi valita, ja viimeisen heiton voi perua. Keskeneräinen sarja säilyy, vaikka poistut kirjausnäkymästä.

Kaadon tai paikon jälkeen lisäheitoista riippuvat pisteet näytetään keskeneräisinä, kunnes tulos voidaan laskea. Kymmenes ruutu noudattaa lisäheittosääntöjä: kaadon jälkeen saat kaksi lisäheittoa ja paikon jälkeen yhden, yhteensä enintään kolme heittoa. Sarjan lopuksi näet kokonaispisteet, kaatojen, paikkojen ja avoimien ruutujen määrät sekä koko pistetaulukon. Tallenna sarja historiaan tai aloita uusi.

Historiasta löydät tallennetut sarjat päivämäärineen, pelaajineen, keilahalli- ja ratatietoineen sekä kokonaispisteineen. Avaa sarja nähdäksesi koko pistetaulukon. Poistaminen vaatii vahvistuksen.

Tilastot perustuvat tallennettuihin, loppuun pelattuihin sarjoihin. Näet sarjojen määrän, keskiarvon, parhaan tuloksen, kaato-, paikka- ja avoimien ruutujen osuudet sekä viimeisimmät tulokset. Esimerkkisarjoja ja keskeneräisiä sarjoja ei lasketa tilastoihin. Asetuksissa voit valita vaalean tai tumman ulkoasun tai seurata järjestelmän asetusta. Mukana on myös 12 englannin- ja kiinankielistä sääntökorttia esimerkkeineen. Kaikkien tulosten poistaminen vaatii erillisen vahvistuksen.

Sovellus toimii kokonaan offline-tilassa. Se ei edellytä käyttäjätiliä, verkkoyhteyttä tai järjestelmän käyttöoikeuksia. Ei mainoksia, analytiikkaa, seurantaa tai käytönaikaista tekoälyä. Sarjat ja asetukset tallennetaan vain laitteeseen. Sovelluksen poistaminen poistaa sen paikalliset tiedot; laitteen varmuuskopioinnista vastaa käyttöjärjestelmä.

BowlSheet toimii iPhonessa pystyasennossa ja vaatii iOS 17:n tai uudemman. Käyttöliittymän kielet ovat englanti ja yksinkertaistettu kiina. Sovelluksen käyttöliittymä ei ole suomenkielinen.

name: Circlr: Round Video Circles
description:
Circlr is a social network where everything is a round video.

• Record circles up to 60 seconds right in the app and post them to your profile.
• Follow friends and creators, react and reply — replies are circles too.
• Stories: circles that disappear after 24 hours.
• Direct messages only in live circles: no text spam, no links, no fake accounts copy-pasting the same message.
• Your archive lives on your device; posts stay on our servers for a limited time.
• Report and block in one tap. Zero tolerance for abuse: reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

Circlr is for adults 18+.
Say it with a circle.

name: ContractPro
description:
ContractPro helps residential contractors turn a job walk into a professional proposal, using their own crews and their own prices.

BUILD A QUOTE FROM YOUR OWN NUMBERS
Save your subcontractors and what each one charges, by the foot, by the square foot or by the job. Pick the crews for a job, enter your measurements, and the math is done. ContractPro never makes up a price.

KEEP YOUR COSTS PRIVATE
Your customer sees the proposal and the price. They never see your crew costs or your profit.

SEND IT AND GET IT SIGNED
Email a proposal your customer can open and sign on their phone. Or download a PDF and share it your own way.

KEEP SIGNED JOBS MOVING
See what's signed, what's waiting and what's next, with a checklist and sticky notes on each job.

BUILT FOR THE WORK YOU QUOTE
Patio covers, pergolas, concrete, outdoor kitchens, pools, bathrooms and more.

Before you send anything, check your measurements, prices, tax and contract terms. ContractPro is not legal advice.

name: Crew Clash: Party Games
description:
Crew Clash turns your friend group into a daily arena.

Create a room, invite your crew with a link or QR code, and every day a new mini game unlocks at the time you choose. Warm up with two practice runs, then take your one real shot. That's the score that counts.

HOW IT WORKS
• One room, one game a day: everyone plays the same game
• 2 practice runs + 1 real shot. Make it count
• Daily and monthly leaderboards
• Monthly seasons: the top player takes the crown
• Group chat with live score updates and emoji reactions
• A daily reminder at your room's play time

13 QUICK GAMES
Bouncy Chicken, Drift!, Jetpack Robot, Black Hole, Piano Keys, Ninja Climb, Cups & Balls, Hop Hop, Shot Clock, Color Reflex, Quick Math, Dice Target and Memory Cards. Each takes about a minute.

MADE FOR FRIENDS
• Rooms for 2 to 6 players
• Join with an invite link, QR code or room code
• Sign in with Apple
• Report messages, block players, and room owners can remove members
• Free to play, no ads

name: Egypt Gold: أسعار الذهب في مصر
description:
Gold and silver prices in Egypt, clear and without ads.

PRICES
• 24k, 21k, 18k and the gold pound: buy and sell prices
• Silver 999, 925 and 800
• Gold ounce in dollars and the official dollar rate
• Price chart: day, week, month, year
• Bars and coins by brand, making fee included
• Every price shows where it comes from and when it was updated. If the local price is late, the app says so and the world price is one tap away

TOOLS
• What's my gold worth
• Wedding shabka planner: how many grams your budget buys, or what a set of grams costs
• Zakat: nisab and the zakat due on your gold
• Is this shop quote fair? Compare a shop's price with the market and the making fee
• What if I'd bought gold: compare with a bank certificate, dollars and cash
• Bank certificates: monthly and yearly income

ALERTS
• Get notified when the price goes above or below your number
• A daily summary at the hour you pick
• No account, no sign-up

Prices are for guidance. A shop's price can differ with the making fee and location.

name: Ekibris Partner
description:
Ekibris Partner is for the taxi drivers, couriers and restaurants who work on the Ekibris platform.

• Go online, see ride requests near you and send a price offer.
• Pick up the rider and run the trip step by step; your location is shared only while you are online and during an active job.
• As a courier, claim orders and deliver them.
• As a restaurant, accept and prepare orders and manage your menu.
• Track your earnings and request payouts.

Registration needs identity details, vehicle details and the partner agreement. You can take work once the Ekibris team approves your account.

name: Falcon Rush: Football Clash
description:
Kick off in two ways to play!

RUSH 1v1 — you control a big-head striker in fast, physical duels. Jump, volley, head the ball and fire SUPER SHOTS: fireball, ice, tornado, thunder, meteor and the legendary Falcon.

CLASH 11v11 — build a club from collectible player cards from 111 nations. Your cards play the match on their own; you're the coach:
• 15 formations, player roles (Poacher, Playmaker, Wing-back, Sweeper Keeper…) and a captain
• TEAM CHEMISTRY — link players from the same country or continent for a stronger team
• live coach calls: PRESS and COUNTER, tactics, FALCON FURY and half-time subs
• keep your players fit — rotate your squad between matches

COMPETE — 8 leagues from Sand to Legend, a world ranking, a club season with promotion, a daily Cup Run and the WEEKEND CUP every Friday to Sunday.
SKILL LAB — train with drills, including a PENALTY SHOOTOUT and PENALTY SAVES, and earn up to 5 stars on each.
INSTANT REPLAY — every goal gets a slow-motion replay with a broadcast look; the crowd goes wild and your goal dance plays.
PACKS & CHESTS — open card packs with walkout animations and chests with light, sparkle and a big reveal for Legendary finds. All drop odds are shown in the game.
MAKE IT YOURS — avatars for 211 countries including Elite looks, balls, boots, super shots, trails, goal celebrations and stadiums. Seasonal events with limited items.
PLAY ONLINE — ranked matches against real players, or a private match with a friend using a 4-digit code. Also 2 players on one device.
CLOUD SAVE — move your progress to a new phone or tablet with a one-time code.

Safe by design: no chat (only friendly emotes), generated player names, no ads, no personal information needed.

Free to play with optional in-app purchases. Helpful items (Energy Drink, Physio Kit, Team Talk, Quick Start) are earned by playing — never sold.

name: FishingPass
seller_name: ALLAN ROBSON RAMALHO DE CAMPOS SABINO CONSULTORIA EM TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO LTDA
description:
Pescaria boa é pescaria em dupla. Com o FishingPass, você paga só a sua entrada e leva um acompanhante sem pagar a entrada dele nos pesqueiros parceiros.

COMO FUNCIONA
• Escolha seu passe no app: avulso, para uma pescaria só, ou um plano para pescar com frequência.
• Veja os pesqueiros parceiros, com informações, modalidades e contatos.
• Chegou no pesqueiro? Mostre o QR code do seu passe na portaria.
• Você paga a sua entrada direto no pesqueiro, e o seu acompanhante entra de graça.

NO APP VOCÊ TAMBÉM PODE
• Reservar quiosques e lugares nos pesqueiros que oferecem reserva.
• Acompanhar seu passe e suas reservas.
• Receber avisos antes do passe vencer e quando surgir novidade nos pesqueiros.
• Pagar com cartão de crédito ou Pix.

PARA QUEM É
Para quem pesca com o pai, o filho, a esposa ou aquele parceiro de sempre, e quer fazer a pescaria do fim de semana render mais.

Dúvidas? Fale com a gente no WhatsApp (11) 99694-4626 ou no Instagram @fishingpassbr.

name: Flip & Furnish
description:
Flip & Furnish is an offline puzzle about making a room livable. Looking tidy is not enough. Someone has to be able to walk in from the door, reach a seat, and actually use the furniture.

Each puzzle is one room lived in more than one way. It might need to become a reading nook, then a bedroom, then a place to eat, work, or store things. The furniture stays where you left it. Turns and unused points carry forward, so the next life is built on the room you already made.

How to play Pick a chapter and an unlocked room, then reveal the order of lives for that room. Each order is equally likely, and each one can be solved. The first room is a guided lesson with a fixed order.

Once you are inside, roll the die once per turn. That roll, plus up to 3 points saved from last turn, is all you can spend. Leftover points do not pile up past 3.

Select a piece, preview the change, then confirm it. Moving one square costs 1 point. Turning 90 degrees costs 1. Opening or folding a sofa bed or table costs 2. Putting an item into a cabinet, or taking it out, costs 1. A long route is several one-square steps. Tap the floor to preview a path. Points are spent only when you confirm. Undo puts both the room and the points back.

When the resident can reach the place they need, validate the room. They must really be able to reach the seat, bedside, table, or cabinet. A pretty layout that blocks the way does not pass.

After one life is ready, keep that layout and change it for the next. When every life is done, you can replay what you did or return to an earlier step and try another idea.

Ordinary rooms have no timer and no turn limit. Challenges tell you the dice and the turn limit before you start.

There are four chapters of eight rooms, plus eight preset challenges. The free studio is a place to try layouts with no turns and no reward. The first time you finish a room, you can change its floor color. The grid and the rules stay the same. Replaying a room does not pay again.

The game is offline, with no ads and no purchases.

name: Florida DMV Test 2026
description:
Updated for 2026. Since February 2026, the Florida DMV knowledge test (Class E) is given in English only, without an interpreter. This app is built for Spanish speakers: you practice with questions in English, in the exam's format, and every rule is explained in Spanish.

HOW YOU PRACTICE
• Answer each question in English. Tap any underlined word to see it in Spanish.
• Read why the answer is right, in plain Spanish, next to the matching line from the Florida Driver Handbook.
• Listen to each question and answer in English, also at a slower speed, and to each explanation in Spanish.
• Each rule comes back with different wording, so you recognize it when the exam phrases it another way.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 508 questions across 10 handbook topics: speed limits, right of way, signs, alcohol, school buses and more.
• A 50-question practice exam (45 rules, 5 signs). You pass with 40 of 50, the same 80% the state asks for.
• Review of your mistakes and your readiness by topic.
• 79 exam words with spaced review and trap words.
• Road signs with their English text and what to do.
• Works offline. No account needed.

FREE AND FULL ACCESS
Free: 50 questions (5 per topic), all vocabulary and one practice exam with review. Full access is a one-time in-app purchase, with no subscription, and unlocks all 508 questions and unlimited practice exams. The app has no ads.

NOTICE
Independent app, not affiliated with FLHSMV or the State of Florida. Practice questions are written from the Florida Driver Handbook and are not the state's exam questions. Check current requirements at flhsmv.gov. Audio uses an AI-generated voice.

name: FriEren - Story Collage Maker
description:
FriEren turns a handful of photos into a clean, balanced collage for your Story, feed or cover in a few taps.

• 128 templates: grids, diagonals, golden ratio, circles, hearts, hexagons, polaroids, arches and more, for 1 to 20 photos.
• Five ratios: Story 9:16, portrait 3:4 and 4:5, square 1:1, landscape 16:9.
• Add text and see it live on the photo: 10 fonts, line breaks, alignment, two-finger rotate and pinch to resize.
• 25 color filters, including 17 inspired by Vietnam: Da Lat, Hoi An, Saigon, Hanoi, Hue, Sa Pa, Phu Quoc, Ha Long… Apply to one photo or all of them.
• Pick photos and get a layout that fits; switch layouts right below the canvas.
• Drag to pan, pinch to zoom, tap two cells to swap, or tap Shuffle to try a new order.
• Adjust spacing, corner radius and background color, with full undo and redo.
• Drafts save automatically, so you can leave and pick up where you left off.
• Save crisp PNG or JPEG, at double size for prints if you like. No watermark, no ads, free.
• Five app icons to choose from.
• Built for iPhone, foldable iPhone (cover and inner screens) and iPad.

Privacy: FriEren needs no account, collects no data and never uploads your photos. Photos are read only when you pick them and saved only when you tap save.

name: IBITGO-PRO
description: We also hope that the product maintains a gentle and orderly visual appearance. Not too eye-catching, not causing visual fatigue, and not making you feel oppressed or cluttered when you open it. Color and white space serve the purpose of "comfortable viewing and clear use", rather than displaying for the sake of display. Because we believe that long-term companion products ultimately compete for durability and longevity.

name: KRP Workspace
description:
KRP Workspace is the companion app of the KRP client portal (krp.hk) for clients of KRP, the IT consulting firm based in Hong Kong.

CALLS THAT RING LIKE A PHONE CALL
KRP Workspace rings on your iPhone like a regular call, even when it is locked, through the native iOS call screen. Answer, mute, switch to speaker or Bluetooth, and see the call in your Recents.

END-TO-END ENCRYPTED
Audio and video are encrypted end to end. Our servers relay them but cannot see or hear them.

YOUR CONTACTS, YOUR COMPANY
Call or message KRP and the colleagues of your own company from one address book, with favourites, search and presence (online, do not disturb, offline).

MESSAGES
The same conversations as on krp.hk: your company and KRP, your team, private chats, photos, read receipts.

MEETINGS
See your upcoming meetings, join with one tap, wait in the lobby until the host starts, and follow the countdown in the “Next meeting” widget.

DYNAMIC ISLAND
During a call, the duration and microphone status stay in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, with Mute and End buttons.

SECURE BY DESIGN
Sessions are bound to your device, can be signed out remotely, and can be locked with Face ID. No ads, no tracking.

KRP Workspace requires a krp.hk account provided by KRP.

name: Lịch Âm, Lịch Vạn Niên - Mèo
seller_name: BAO LAM INVESTMENT CONSULTING AND MANAGEMENT COMPANY LIMITED
description:
LỊCH ÂM KHÔNG QUẢNG CÁO. Mở app là xem ngày, không chờ, không bấm tắt quảng cáo.

Lịch Mèo là lịch âm, lịch vạn niên của người Việt, gọn gàng, dễ đọc, dùng hằng ngày cho cả nhà.

VÌ SAO TÊN LÀ "MÈO"?
Trong 12 con giáp của người Việt, tuổi Mão là con Mèo. Người Trung Quốc cầm tinh con Thỏ. Chú mèo trong tên app là cách tụi mình giữ một nét riêng của lịch Việt.
Lịch Mèo cũng tính âm lịch theo giờ Việt Nam (múi giờ +7), đúng cách lịch nhà nước Việt Nam vẫn dùng. Nhờ vậy, những năm Tết ta lệch Tết Trung Quốc, Lịch Mèo vẫn cho ngày đúng. Ví dụ năm 1985, người Việt ăn Tết ngày 21/1, sớm hơn Trung Quốc gần một tháng.

KHÔNG QUẢNG CÁO, TRỌN VẸN
Không quảng cáo bật lên, không quảng cáo chen giữa màn hình, không quảng cáo trên widget. Mọi chức năng đều dùng được ngay. Lịch Mèo không thu thập dữ liệu cá nhân và vẫn chạy khi không có mạng.

LỊCH ÂM DƯƠNG, LỊCH VẠN NIÊN
• Lịch tháng có ngày âm dưới từng ngày dương, mùng 1 và rằm tô màu dễ thấy
• Can chi ngày, tháng, năm; giờ hoàng đạo; 24 tiết khí; tuần trăng
• Ngày lễ, Tết Việt Nam theo cả âm lịch và dương lịch
• Tra lịch vạn niên từ năm 1900 đến 2100, chạm vào ngày nào cũng thấy đủ âm lịch, can chi

WIDGET MÀN HÌNH CHÍNH VÀ MÀN HÌNH KHOÁ
• Widget nhỏ xem ngày âm, widget vừa có giờ hoàng đạo và ngày nhớ sắp tới, widget lớn xem cả tháng
• Widget màn hình khoá: ngày âm ngay cạnh ngày dương phía trên đồng hồ, chưa mở khoá đã biết hôm nay âm lịch ngày mấy
• Tự sang ngày mới lúc nửa đêm

NGÀY GIỖ, SINH NHẬT THEO ÂM LỊCH
• Ghi ngày giỗ, sinh nhật theo âm lịch, tự nhắc hằng năm
• Tính đúng cả những năm có tháng nhuận
• Nhắc mùng 1 và rằm từ hôm trước để kịp chuẩn bị hoa quả
• Ghi sẵn ngày giỗ vào Lịch của iPhone cho 10 năm tới, cả nhà cùng thấy
• Văn khấn mùng 1, ngày rằm và ngày giỗ, tự điền ngày âm và người được giỗ

LỊCH THUẾ
• Hạn nộp tờ khai, nộp thuế cho hộ kinh doanh và doanh nghiệp
• Hạn rơi vào ngày nghỉ, lễ Tết thì tự lùi sang ngày làm việc kế tiếp
• Nhắc trước 3 ngày
• Bật hoặc tắt trong Cài đặt, ai không cần thì ẩn đi

THẺ NGÀY
Tạo thẻ ngày đẹp có ngày âm dương, lưu vào Ảnh hoặc gửi lời chúc cho người thân qua Zalo, Facebook.

Lịch Mèo do người Việt làm cho người Việt. Có góp ý, bạn gửi trong mục Góp ý của app, tụi mình đọc hết.

name: LMS Team
description:
LMS Team is the staff app for Lockout Music Studios employees and contractors. It is not for the public: your login is created by our office.

DOORS
- Open the building entrances, studios and restrooms you are assigned to.
- Get a temporary keypad code when a door can't be reached.
- See lock battery levels at a glance.

TEAM CHAT
- Channels for each team, photos, @mentions and reactions.
- Notifications when someone messages you.

CUSTOMER INBOX
- Staff with Studio Manager access can answer customer texts from the app.
- Notifications for new customer texts and urgent threads while you are on shift.

YOUR WORK
- Clock in and out, take breaks and send punch fix requests.
- Tasks, tours, building walk-throughs and maintenance.

SHIFT LOCATION
For W-2 employees, the app records location only while you are clocked in, pauses during your unpaid lunch and stops when you clock out. It is never collected for contractors. See our privacy policy for details.

Questions? Call or text (562) 600-6117.

name: LYA — Aircraft Load Planner
description:
LYA — Aircraft Load Planner is a restricted-access aircraft loading and mass-and-balance calculation aid for invited adult users. It is not approved operational aviation software. A signed personal licence determines access and whether beta notices apply.

Use fictional, synthetic or properly sanitised historical scenarios only. Do not use the app or its outputs for an actual aircraft, flight, dispatch, operational loadsheet or company decision.

Features available with an issued licence:
• Aircraft and crew-configuration selection.
• Passenger totals and seating groups, baggage, cargo and fuel inputs.
• Mass-and-balance calculations, a compact loadsheet view and exports.
• Take-off and landing calculation screens for supported aircraft and applicable source data.
• Airport and runway references, weather import and local reference corrections.
• Input locks, light and dark themes, and offline calculations with a valid stored licence.

ACCESS
Downloading the app is free. Access is restricted and requires a licence issued personally by the administrator, at no charge. There are no paid subscriptions, in-app purchases or external licence sales. Submit a request from the app; access is not granted automatically to every applicant.

EXISTING USERS
Keep the previous LYA app installed while checking your transition. An existing licence can be restored automatically if the same protected device key remains available. Enter your previous name and contact if a request is needed. A new device key requires administrator verification. Recovery preserves the original licence expiry and rights.

PRIVACY
Calculation scenarios stay on your device unless you deliberately share them. Connected features handle licence requests, access checks and attributed airport-reference corrections as described in the Privacy Notice. A valid local licence can be used offline.

No airline, aircraft manufacturer or aviation authority endorses or approves this app. Reference coverage and calculations have limitations; availability is subject to the issued licence and the displayed applicability conditions.

name: ORVO – Job Photo Report
description:
ORVO turns job-site photos into professional reports.

Built for contractors, technicians, inspectors and anyone who needs to show what was done, ORVO keeps your photos, notes and signatures organized by job — and exports them as a branded PDF you can send straight to your customer.

CAPTURE
• Create a report for each job: customer, site address, technician and date
• Add items and attach Before and After photos from the camera or gallery
• Add notes and a status (Pending, Fixed, Follow-up) to every item
• Record quick voice notes instead of typing

MARK UP
• Draw arrows, boxes, circles, freehand lines and text on any photo to point out problems
• Compare before and after side by side
• Revert to the original photo at any time

SIGN & SHARE
• Collect the customer's signature on screen
• Export a clean PDF report with your company name and contact details
• Choose 1, 2 or 3 photos per row; include or hide notes
• Share via email, messaging apps, or print

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account required
• Reports and photos are stored only on your device
• Works offline — no signal needed on site
• Back up everything to one file and keep it in Files, iCloud Drive or Google Drive

ORVO supports English and Simplified Chinese, and Light and Dark mode.

name: Photo Air: Image Tools
description:
Make room for your photos.

Photo Air is an on-device image toolkit for iPhone and iPad. Adjust batches of pictures, preview the actual output and save new copies while keeping the originals by default. No account, ads or in-app purchases. Your pictures are not uploaded to our servers.

NINE PRACTICAL TOOLS
Compress batches, resize proportionally, convert HEIC/JPEG/PNG, rotate, crop each image, remove location or personal metadata, set a file-size limit, create GIFs and assemble silent 1080p MP4 videos.

CHOOSE YOUR INPUT
Use the system photo picker or import files. With photo-library permission, filter by date, file size, format, album and more. Keep common settings as local presets.

SEE THE RESULT
Preview real output, follow progress, pause, cancel or retry failed items. Save copies to Photos, share with the system sheet or export to Files. A lightweight share extension handles up to 20 images, with a 1920-pixel long-edge limit.

KEEP CONTROL OF ORIGINALS
Original cleanup is a separate action with saved-copy checks and system confirmation. Special assets such as Live Photos, RAW and HDR are protected by default. If you confirm conversion, the app exports a static SDR copy; motion, RAW editing latitude and HDR brightness are not preserved.

KNOW THE LIMITS
Compression tiers target roughly 70%, 40% or 10% of the original file size, not a guaranteed result or a quality score. Converted and combined files may be larger. File sizes do not measure storage actually reclaimed on your device. Metadata removal does not hide faces or text visible in a picture.

iCloud downloads, syncing and deletions follow your system settings. Sharing to another service occurs only when you choose it. All processing tools and task history operate locally.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese. Three visual themes with light and dark appearance.

name: PriceEasy Intelligence
description:
PriceEasy Intelligence is the pricing and operations app for fuel retailers and convenience store operators. Set the right price at every site, monitor competitor pricing, and push changes directly to the pump without leaving the forecourt.

COMPETITOR PRICE SURVEYS
Capture competitor pricing on site using your phone camera, verify it against the last recorded price, and submit surveys directly from the field. Surveys queue and upload in the background, so poor network connectivity at the station never costs you a visit.

PRICE BOOK AND PRICE UPDATES
Manage your price book by product and site. Review proposed prices, approve changes, and publish them directly to fuel pumps and electronic shelf labels. Every change is validated before publishing.

PRICING RULES
Build intelligent pricing rules to maintain your competitive position against selected competitors. Review historical performance and simulate how rules would have performed before activating them.

FUEL ANALYTICS AND RECONCILIATION
Track margins, volumes, and fuel-grade performance across your network. Reconcile fuel deliveries against tank readings and identify variances early.

INVENTORY AND MERCHANDISE
Manage inventory counts, merchandise, purchase orders, deliveries, and vendor carts from one centralized platform.

CORTEX ASSISTANT
Ask questions about your sites in plain language and get answers powered by your own business data. Cortex supports both typed questions and hands-free voice interactions, allowing you to access insights while travelling between stores. Available to accounts with Cortex access.

SITE TRAFFIC
Count vehicles at a site using a live camera view and save sessions to analyse and compare traffic against competitor locations.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
Designed for real-world operations with biometric sign-in, single sign-on, offline-tolerant uploads, and push notifications for important approvals and alerts.

PriceEasy Intelligence requires an active account from your organisation. Contact your administrator or visit priceeasy.com to get started.

name: Puzzle Time Together
description:
Small games. Shared moments.

Puzzle Time Together brings six compact puzzles and mathematical discoveries to iPhone and iPad. Play on your own or sit across from a family member or friend and share one screen.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Choose English, Simplified Chinese, or follow your device language. Menus, rules, discoveries and results are translated. Read-aloud uses the corresponding system voice.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY
• Schulte grids: find numbers in order, solo or in a two-player race.
• Dots and Boxes: connect adjacent dots and claim boxes. Play against the computer or another person.
• Mini Sudoku: solve 4x4 and 6x6 puzzles solo or race on identical, independent boards.
• Euler trails: use each edge once and discover a graph theory idea. Take turns in cooperative play.
• Take the stones: remove 1, 2 or 3 stones; taking the last stone wins.
• Memory pairs: match hidden symbols, solo or in a turn-based game.

MADE FOR THE SAME TABLE
Face-to-face play turns each player's controls and timer toward them, in portrait and landscape. Choose beginner, standard or challenge difficulty. No separate accounts or internet matchmaking are needed.

DISCOVER THE IDEA
Each game includes rules, an explanation and a question to discuss. System speech can read the text aloud in English or Chinese, with a slower read-along pace. This does not record or assess your voice.

A QUIET SPACE
No ads, in-app purchases or login. The latest 100 completed rounds stay on the device and can be cleared in settings. There are no online chats or public leaderboards. Voice availability depends on the device's system resources.

For family time and adult puzzle breaks. This app does not assess intelligence or promise changes in IQ, reading ability or attention disorders.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose Forest, Ocean or Sand. The introduction appears on the first launch, then folds away unless you explicitly choose to keep it expanded. Language and theme choices are saved on your device.

Both players tap Ready to start together. Schulte and Sudoku wait for both players to finish. Compact results face each player, and both confirm a rematch. Solo games also wait for Start.

name: QRコーズ
description:
「QRコーズ」は、カメラに映る複数のQRコードを同時に一括読み取りできる高速QRコードリーダーアプリです。

【主な特徴】
・複数QRコードの同時スキャン：1つずつカメラを向け直す手間なく、画面内の複数のQRコードをまとめて瞬時に認識・読み取りします。
・見やすいリスト表示：読み取った複数のQRコードの内容（URLやテキスト）を一覧でわかりやすく整理して表示します。
・メールやコピーで簡単共有：読み取り後、一覧や各データをワンタップでコピーしたり、そのままメールで送信・共有したりできます。
・安心のプライバシー設計：カメラ映像や読み取り処理はすべてiPad端末内のみで完結し、外部サーバーへの自動送信は一切行いません。

【こんなシーンに便利】
・書類や資料に並んだ複数のQRコードをまとめてデータ化したいとき
・読み取ったQRコードの一覧をそのままメールで自分やチームに送りたいとき
・イベント受付や在庫管理、教材のURL共有などを効率よく行いたいとき

シンプルな操作で、日々のQRコード読み取りとデータ共有をスピーディにします。

name: Rondeo: Padel Americano
description:
Rondeo runs your padel Americano or Mexicano and turns every matchday into a season table.

• Fair rotations: equal matches, no back-to-back rests, a fairness report for every player
• Scores in seconds: type one side, the other fills in
• Share standings and the season table to WhatsApp as images

Works offline. No accounts. Single events are free forever.

RUN THE EVENT
• Run a social padel tournament as an Americano round robin, or let Mexicano pair players by the standings
• Americano, Mixed Americano, Team Americano and Mexicano
• 4 to 40 players on as many courts as you have
• Check players in, preview the whole schedule, then start
• Round timer with an alarm, and a big court view for every round
• Someone arrives late or leaves early? Only future rounds change. Played rounds stay exactly as they were

FAIR FOR EVERYONE
Every player gets the same number of matches and sit-outs as evenly as possible, with new partners and opponents each round. The fairness report shows it, so nobody has to argue about the draw.

SHARE WITH YOUR GROUP
Send the rules, each round, the standings and the final results to your group chat as clean images. Everyone sees the same table, and no one needs to install anything.

A SEASON TABLE FOR YOUR LEAGUE
Add each matchday to a season and Rondeo keeps the running leaderboard: points, matchdays played and clear tie-breaks.

FREE, NO SIGN-UP
• Unlimited single events, all formats, up to 40 players
• Every share image and the fairness report
• One season of up to 3 events

SEASON PRO
For organizers who run a league:
• Unlimited seasons and matchdays
• Season history and CSV export
• Your club logo on shared images
• Unlimited event templates
Monthly, yearly (7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Terms of Use: https://rondeoapp.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://rondeoapp.com/privacy/

name: Sachunterricht kompakt
description:
Sachunterricht verbindet die Fragen von Kindern mit dem Wissen unterschiedlicher Fachdisziplinen. Sachunterricht kompakt bündelt den Perspektivrahmen der GDSU, den österreichischen Lehrplan der Volksschule und die Fachdidaktik an einem Ort – zum Nachschlagen und Üben fürs Studium und mit Werkzeugen zum Planen für die Praxis.

VERSTEHEN
• Grundlagen: Bildungsauftrag, Kind und Sache, Geschichte des Fachs
• Prinzipien: didaktische Leitideen mit Praxis-Tipps
• Perspektivrahmen: fünf Perspektiven und ihre Denk-, Arbeits- und Handlungsweisen, auch als interaktives Rad
• Lehrplan Volksschule: sechs Kompetenzbereiche, 13 zentrale fachliche Konzepte, übergreifende Themen
• Querverbindungen: wie Perspektiven, Konzepte und Themen zusammenhängen

PLANEN UND PRÜFEN – 13 WERKZEUGE
• Jahresplanung: Vorschläge für jede Schulstufe, anpassbar, zum Kopieren und Drucken
• Themennetz, Didaktische Analyse nach Klafki und Suchraster: Themen vielperspektivisch erschließen und ihren Bildungsgehalt prüfen
• Lernaufgabe planen: in vier Phasen nach dem Lehr-Lern-Modell
• Sprachkarten erstellen: Wortspeicher, Satzmuster und Fragekarten auf drei Stufen
• Lernmaterialien prüfen nach dem Modell der Didaktischen Rekonstruktion
• Bewertungskriterien festlegen und einen Einschätzungsbogen drucken
• RANG-Check: den Medieneinsatz nach dem RANG-Modell prüfen
• Erklärtext-Planer, Hörtext-Check, Breakout-Planer und Rätsel-Generator für Erklärvideos, akustische Sachgeschichten und EduBreakouts

UMSETZEN
• Umsetzungsbeispiele: Arbeitsmittel, Erklärvideos, akustische Sachgeschichten mit Hörbeispielen, EduBreakouts
• Medien im Sachunterricht sowie Rückmeldung und Leistung

ÜBEN
• Wissens-Check mit elf Spielrunden
• Fallvignetten-Labor: 14 Unterrichtsszenen didaktisch analysieren
• Sach-Flug: ein Geschicklichkeitsspiel
• Entdeckungspass mit Punkten, Stufen und Abzeichen

NACHSCHLAGEN
• Glossar mit 62 Fachbegriffen
• Quellenverzeichnis mit 92 Einträgen

AUF IPHONE UND IPAD
• Widget „Fachbegriff des Tages“ für Home- und Sperrbildschirm
• Kapitel und Fachbegriffe direkt aus der Suche des Geräts öffnen
• Siri und Kurzbefehle: Wissens-Check starten, Fachbegriff des Tages, Fachbegriff nachschlagen, Kapitel öffnen
• Schnellaktionen am App-Symbol
• Drucken und als PDF sichern, Arbeitsstand in „Dateien“ sichern und wieder laden
• Die Schrift folgt der Textgröße von iOS
• iPad: Menüleiste und Tastaturkürzel

GUT ZU WISSEN
• Lehrplan-Texte im Wortlaut, alle übrigen Inhalte mit Quellenangabe
• Funktioniert ohne Internetverbindung
• Keine Anmeldung, keine Werbung, kein Tracking
• Ihre Eingaben bleiben auf Ihrem Gerät. Den Arbeitsstand können Sie als Datei sichern.
• Heller und dunkler Modus
• Lizenz: CC BY 4.0

Sachunterricht kompakt ist ein nicht kommerzielles Lernangebot von Stefan Meller. Jahresplanungen und Zuordnungen sind Vorschläge; sie ersetzen nicht die Lektüre der Originalquellen.

name: Skip to Simmer
description:
Skip to Simmer turns supported recipe pages into clean recipe cards in Safari. Open a card to see ingredients, steps, servings, and cooking times without scrolling through the whole page.

• Adjust servings and switch between cups and grams where a conversion is available.
• Follow the steps in Cook mode and start timers from supported instructions.
• Save recipes on your device, search your library, and archive or share your favorites.
• On compatible devices, use Apple Intelligence to find prep steps you can do ahead. The checklist quotes and links to the original steps.

To get started, open the app and follow the instructions to enable the Safari extension. The app includes a sample recipe you can use to try it. No account is required.

name: Sniff & Seek
description:
Sniff & Seek is a cozy puzzle game where you follow visual scent clues to find the right food hidden in four picnic boxes. Choose a puppy, rabbit, or fox, point your nose in different directions, and use what you discover to decide which box to open.

Scents appear as trails, symbols, and numbered rings. You do not need to smell anything in real life.

HOW TO PLAY

1. Find a trail
Choose north, east, south, or west, then tap Sniff. A matching trail narrows your search. A quiet direction helps you rule out boxes, too.

2. Clear the air
Move the strong-smelling plant that is masking the finer scents.

3. Compare the boxes
Tap at least two different boxes to read their scent rings. Keep track of directions and readings in your field notebook, and add reversible notes to rule out boxes.

4. Play a field card
Each chapter gives you a tool card that costs no stars. Map the evidence you have found or light a lantern to clear a misleading scent.

5. Make your choice
Combine the clues, select a box, and open it. Find the requested treat to earn stars, add its illustrated card to your collection, and unlock the next mystery.

THREE WOODLAND CHAPTERS

Daisy Meadow
Learn the basics of scent trails and strength. Compare your readings to find the strongest match.

Pebble Brook
River echoes can make two boxes smell equally strong. Cross matching and quiet direction clues until only one box remains.

Moonlit Grove
Moonlight creates a false strong reading. Compare two boxes, then play your Firefly Lantern card to reveal the true scent rings.

A PICNIC WORTH COLLECTING

Explore 18 mysteries with Biscuit the puppy, Clover the rabbit, or Maple the fox. Discover six picnic treats, from lemon cookies to mushroom pie, and earn a meadow, brook, and moonlight stamp for every food card.

Return for a fresh daily puzzle, or replay earlier mysteries to improve your stars. Sniffing, comparing, field cards, and personal notes do not cost stars. Hints and wrong guesses reduce your score for that attempt, while your best result stays saved.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

There is no countdown. Your current mystery saves automatically, including its clues, readings, notes, and used card, so you can take a break and continue later.

Enjoy illustrated woodland scenes, expressive animal companions, gentle sound effects, optional haptics, and calm animation settings.

Play offline. No account, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: SobaChat
description:
SobaChat lets you talk with people near you, offline.
No internet and no servers: iPhones connect to each other directly over Bluetooth.

Use it where there is no signal, at events, in classrooms or while travelling — whenever you want to talk with the people around you.

■ Features
• Find and join nearby rooms: rooms created nearby appear in a list
• Create rooms: open to everyone, protected with a passphrase, or private (hidden from the list)
• Temporary chats: rooms that leave no history — the chat disappears when you leave
• Invite with a QR code or a room code
• Stickers: SobaChat character stamps and emoji stickers
• Send photos, voice memos, files (up to 10 MB) and your location
• Profiles: nickname, icon and a short introduction
• Chat history: saved per room, only on this device
• Delivery receipts show who received your message
• Available in 9 languages (Japanese, English, Chinese Simplified/Traditional, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German)

■ Completely free
No in-app purchases and no ads.

■ Privacy and safety
• No account needed
• Messages never pass through the developer's servers; they travel only between nearby participants' devices
• Passphrase rooms and private rooms are encrypted so that only participants can read them
• Messages in open rooms can be received by anyone nearby — do not send anything you want to keep private
• You can block people and report inappropriate use to the developer from the app
• You agree to the Terms of Use before you start

■ Please note
• You can only chat with people within Bluetooth range; the range depends on the devices and surroundings
• Photos and files are sent over Bluetooth, so large ones take time
• Nearby rooms are found while the app is on screen

name: Stika
description:
Stika is the app for drivers at coach and tour companies. Your fleet manager offers you a trip, you answer in the app, and everything you need for the trip is in one place.

• Trip offers: see meeting time, departure, destinations, vehicle and contact, and answer yes or no.
• Ready check: confirm before a trip that you are ready, or let the office know right away if something comes up.
• Calendar: your week and month at a glance.
• Availability and absences: tell the office when you can drive and when you can't.
• Navigate: open the route to the pick-up point and each destination in your maps app.
• Driving report: file your report after the trip straight from your phone.
• My month: hours and kilometres for the month.
• One app for all your driving: drive for more than one company? All your trips show up in the same place.
• Notifications for new offers and changes, and the app keeps showing the latest state when you are offline.

You need an account from the company you drive for. Companies interested in Stika: stikafleet.com.

name: STR Field
description:
STR Field is the phone app for cleaning crews at short-term rental management companies. Your manager schedules the cleans. You open the app and see your day.

Your company sets up your account and gives you a setup code. There is no public sign-up.

For each clean you get:

• The property, its address and the arrival instructions from your manager.
• A check-in at the door. Scan the code on the property's sticker, or check in without scanning.
• The checklist for that house, ticked off as you go.
• Photos that send on their own. Take them and keep going, even where there is no signal.
• A way to report a problem, with photos, that goes straight to maintenance.

You can also see your week ahead, join a clean you were sent to help with, and record laundry shifts.

Location is checked twice per clean, at check-in and at check-out, so your manager can see the visit happened at the property. It is never tracked in the background, and the app works normally if you say no. Work photos are kept inside the app and never added to your photo library.

STR Field is made by Cyber Ink LLC and works with the Cyber Ink property operations platform. You need an account from your employer to use it.

name: SuperVistaPlay
description:
Place videos around your space.

SuperVistaPlay opens up to five independent video windows. Arrange, resize and control each video separately. Choose one window to hear and keep that audio choice while using the others.

• Import local videos from Files
• Browse SMB / FTP storage and shared folders
• Open HTTP(S) video and HLS URLs you are authorized to use
• Repeat an entire video or an A–B range
• Rotate each video independently in 90° steps
• Local thumbnail caching speeds up repeat browsing
• Simplified Chinese and English, following the system or your choice

Supports common containers and codecs, including MP4, MOV, MKV, FLV and AV1 / VP9 in MP4 / WebM. Playback capability and simultaneous performance depend on the source and device. This version does not extract social-platform share pages. Play only content you are authorized to access and use.

name: Surf Wiki: Spots & Conditions
description:
Surf Wiki answers your surf questions in plain words, from a curated wiki of real spots around the world.

ASK ANYTHING ABOUT SURFING
Where to surf in Bali as a beginner, when Peniche works best, which break suits your board. Every spot comes from the wiki, with its level, best season and a map link.

TODAY'S CONDITIONS
Tap "Surf conditions near me" or ask about any spot: waves, swell, wind, tide times and official warnings, with a verdict for your level.

ASK BY VOICE
Hold the microphone and ask. Turn on spoken replies to hear the answer.

THE LINEUP
Meet other surfers, share sessions and plan trips together. Get a notification when someone replies or joins your plan.

NO ACCOUNT
No sign-up, no e-mail. Surf Wiki remembers what you tell it (your level, your board, your plans), and you can see and delete it anytime.

Available in English and French.

name: Tante Hildes Dänemark-Helfer
description:
Dein Dänemark-Urlaub – ganz entspannt. Tante Hildes Dänemark-Helfer ist der praktische Begleiter für alle, die ihren Urlaub im Ferienhaus an Nordsee oder Ostsee verbringen. Mit dem gesammelten Wissen aus vielen Jahren Dänemark-Urlaub von tante-hilde.info – kostenlos, ohne Werbung und ohne Anmeldung.

HEUTE – ALLES AUF EINEN BLICK
• Haben die Supermärkte gerade offen? Ist morgen ein Feiertag?
• Rechtzeitige Erinnerung vor Schließtagen wie Christi Himmelfahrt, Pfingsten oder Weihnachten
• Wetter am Ferienort, Leinenpflicht am Strand für Hundebesitzer
• Anreise-Check: Ist der Elbtunnel frei? Geplante Sperrungen, Wetterwarnungen und Ferienbeginn

ESSEN & EINKAUFEN
• Dolmetscher mit über 200 Begriffen für den Supermarkt – mit Aussprache
• Einkaufsliste mit dänischen Wörtern zum Zeigen im Laden, auch zum Teilen
• Welche Supermarktkette ist was? Märkte in der Nähe, Angebote der Woche
• Öffnungszeiten, Feiertage und Kronen-Rechner
• Essen gehen: typisch dänische Gerichte, Frokost erklärt, Tipps zu Trinkgeld und Bezahlen
• Restaurant-Dolmetscher: bestellen, Allergien, Rechnung, Speisekarte verstehen

TANKEN & LADEN
• Aktuelle Spritpreise der Tankstellen in deiner Nähe – günstigste zuerst
• Ladesäulen für das E-Auto mit Preis pro kWh und freien Ladepunkten
• Karte, Kostenrechner und die wichtigsten Wörter an der Zapfsäule

GESUNDHEIT – FÜR DICH UND DEINEN HUND
• Notruf 112 und der ärztliche Bereitschaftsdienst (Lægevagt) deiner Region mit einem Fingertipp
• Apotheke, Giftnotruf und Polizei
• Sätze für Arzt, Apotheke und Notfall auf Dänisch – vorlesen lassen oder groß zeigen
• Tierarzt, Tierklinik und Sätze für den Tierarzt

FERIENHAUS-MAPPE
• Adresse, Schlüsselcode, WLAN und Vermieter griffbereit
• Zählerstände für Strom, Wasser und Gas mit Foto und Kostenrechnung
• Müll richtig trennen nach dänischem System
• Packliste passend zur Jahreszeit, mit Hund und E-Auto
• Abreise-Checkliste, damit nichts vergessen wird

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Deine Urlaubsangaben, Listen und die Ferienhaus-Mappe werden nur auf deinem Handy gespeichert.

ÜBER TANTE HILDE
Hinter Tante Hilde steckt Andreas Lerg. Auf tante-hilde.info und im YouTube-Kanal @tantehilde gibt es noch viel mehr Tipps rund um den Urlaub in Dänemark.

Hav en god ferie – schönen Urlaub!

Hinweis: Preise, Öffnungszeiten und Verkehrsdaten stammen aus öffentlichen Quellen und werden ohne Gewähr angezeigt.

name: Tricor: test Guardia Civil
description:
Tricor es la app para preparar la oposición a la Escala de Cabos y Guardias de la Guardia Civil. Entrenas con preguntas escritas al estilo del examen real y con el texto de la ley delante, no con resúmenes de segunda mano.

LOS 25 TEMAS, SIN HUECOS
Más de 6.800 preguntas repartidas por los cuatro niveles de dificultad, de lo que se pregunta siempre a los matices que deciden una plaza. Cada pregunta lleva su explicación y la cita del artículo del que sale, para que puedas comprobarlo tú.

EXÁMENES OFICIALES Y SIMULACROS
Los exámenes oficiales de convocatorias anteriores, completos y por años, y simulacros de 100 y 50 preguntas con el tiempo y la penalización de verdad: cada tres fallos, un acierto menos.

PSICOTÉCNICOS
1.400 ejercicios de cálculo, series numéricas, figuras, atención, memoria y aptitud verbal, con la explicación de cómo se resuelve cada uno. Sin calculadora, como en el examen.

ORTOGRAFÍA Y GRAMÁTICA
En el formato oficial: cuatro palabras subrayadas y tú eliges la que está mal escrita.

INGLÉS
Preguntas de nivel A2-B1 con la corrección y la nota mínima del examen.

BIBLIOTECA
El texto literal del BOE de 55 normas, más de 7.000 artículos, dentro de la app. De cualquier pregunta puedes saltar al artículo que la respalda.

SABER POR DÓNDE FALLAS
Tus estadísticas por tema y «dónde te la cuelan»: los fallos que repites, para que dejes de repetirlos. Guarda con la estrella las preguntas que quieras repasar y la app te las devuelve cuando toca.

TU SESIÓN DE HOY
Dinos cuánto tiempo tienes —15, 30 o 60 minutos— y la app monta la sesión: lo que peor llevas, lo que toca repasar y algo nuevo.

Tricor es de Nova Romulus, los de BluCop.

Tricor no está asociada a la Guardia Civil ni al Ministerio del Interior. El contenido legal procede del Boletín Oficial del Estado.

name: TruckProof: Food Truck Logs
description:
Every log your health inspector asks for — done in seconds and ready in one tap.

TruckProof is built for food truck, trailer and cart owners who do the work themselves. It replaces the clipboard of paper logs with quick checks you can do with gloves on.

TEMPERATURE CHECKS ON TIME
• Reminders when each cooler, freezer, steam table or hot holding unit is due
• Big keypad: log a reading in 3 taps and see Pass or Fail right away
• Corrective actions with a photo and a 30-minute recheck reminder
• Cooking, reheating and receiving temps with FDA Food Code presets

COOLING LOGS THAT WATCH THE CLOCK
• Two-stage cooling timer: 135 °F to 70 °F in 2 hours, 41 °F within 6 hours total
• Live Activity on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island

COMMISSARY VISITS, SIGNED
• Log arrival, departure, water and wastewater in two taps
• Commissary staff sign right on your phone
• Optional reminder when you arrive at your commissary

PERMITS THAT NEVER EXPIRE BY SURPRISE
• Scan your health permit, food manager certificate, insurance and more
• Reminders 90, 60, 30 and 7 days before they expire

INSPECTOR MODE
• One tap shows your permits, today's logs and the last 7 days in large, high-contrast type
• Handover lock: Face ID is needed to leave Inspector mode
• Commissary log and temperature log PDFs, plus a full inspection packet

CLEAR FDA-STYLE LOGS
Temperature, cooling, checklist and commissary logs in a clean layout based on the FDA Food Code 2022, wherever you operate. County-specific layouts are added as each one is checked against its health department's form.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no servers, no ads. Your logs stay on your devices and sync through your own iCloud. In English and Spanish.

FREE AND PRO
Free: all log types, reminders, Inspector mode and the last 14 days of history, 3 documents in your binder, PDFs with a watermark. Older logs are kept safely, never deleted.
TruckProof Pro: your full history, PDFs without a watermark, the inspection packet, unlimited documents, custom checklist items and CSV export.
Pro is $12.99/month or $99.99/year, each with a 14-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (after the trial, if eligible). Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://truckproof-app.web.app/terms · Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ · Privacy Policy: https://truckproof-app.web.app/privacy
TruckProof is a record-keeping tool. Your health department sets the requirements; ask your inspector which forms they accept.

name: Vinvaro
description:
VINVARO is the operating system for car dealerships. The app takes your team's workspace onto the shop floor, into the workshop and out on the lot: vehicles, workflows, customer conversations and tasks, all in one place.

CAPTURE WHERE THE WORK HAPPENS
• Run intake, inspection, detailing, photography and delivery step by step
• Photos, video, documents and signatures right at the right step
• Deviations automatically become findings, with the original photo attached
• Works without signal: everything is sent as soon as you're back online

THE WHOLE VEHICLE DOSSIER IN YOUR POCKET
• Registration, VIN, specifications, MOT, photos and documents per car
• See which stage a car is in and what still needs to happen
• Search by registration, VIN or model

CUSTOMERS AND INBOX
• WhatsApp Business, Gmail and Outlook in one shared inbox
• Quick replies and AI suggestions in your tone of voice
• Conversations linked to the customer and the vehicle

TASKS, CALENDAR AND NOTIFICATIONS
• Your priorities for the day on one screen
• Push notifications for new tasks, assigned steps and customer messages
• Test drives, deliveries and appointments in the calendar

SALES AND CONTRACTS
• View and follow up deals, contracts and invoices
• Customers sign digitally through a personal link

PERMISSIONS PER ROLE
Every colleague only sees what belongs to their role, just like on the web.

VINVARO is for staff of car dealerships that work with VINVARO. Create your account at vinvaro.com or accept an invitation from your employer.

name: YCT Online Test
description:
Learn Chinese and practice for YCT 1, 2 and 3, one step at a time. YCT Online Test brings vocabulary, reading and exam practice together for learners, families and teachers.

LEARN AND REVIEW
Explore illustrated flashcards with Chinese characters, pinyin, meanings and word audio. Practice recognition, sentence building and comprehension. Return to vocabulary with spaced review and a daily practice routine.

READ IN CONTEXT
Read short stories and answer questions using the vocabulary from each level. Continue an unfinished learning session and follow your progress.

PRACTICE EXAMS
Practice listening and reading with timed exams. Resume an unfinished attempt, view your score and review your answers. Each level includes one complete free exam.

FOR FAMILIES AND TEACHERS
Use separate learner profiles on the same device and view a family activity report. Learning progress is stored on the device. It does not automatically sync between devices.

FREE CONTENT AND PURCHASES
Start with the free exam and selected learning content at each level. Buy an exam pack for YCT 1, 2 or 3, or choose the complete pack. Exam packs are one-time purchases.

The auto-renewing monthly subscription unlocks the full YCT 1–3 learning content for one learner profile while active. Paid exam packs are sold separately and are not included in the subscription. The price and billing period are shown before purchase. Manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple account settings. Restore eligible purchases using the app’s restore option.

No app account is required and there are no ads. The interface and learning support are available in English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Indonesian, Thai and Vietnamese.

YCT Online Test is an independent practice app, not affiliated with or endorsed by the YCT examination organizer. It does not guarantee an exam result.

Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/yct-online-test-privacy/home
Terms of use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: أكواد للصيانة
description:
أكواد للصيانة يساعد محلات صيانة الأجهزة على متابعة العمل من الاستلام حتى التسليم، بواجهة عربية مختصرة للفنيين وصاحب المحل.

• استلام الجهاز والبحث عن العميل من الخانة نفسها.
• متابعة مراحل الإصلاح والملاحظات والقطع المستخدمة والضمان.
• التسعير بالدولار أو الليرة السورية، والعربون والدفعات والمتبقي.
• صور اختيارية للجهاز عند الاستلام والتسليم.
• عمل محفوظ دون اتصال، مع مزامنة عند عودة الاتصال ومراجعة التعارضات الجماعية.
• إيصالات ورموز لمتابعة الطلب، ومسح باركود الجهاز لفتح طلبه.
• سوق مشترك لقطع الصيانة مع مراجعة العروض والإبلاغ والحظر، دون محفظة أو تحصيل داخل السوق.
• فحص بلاغات الأجهزة ومحادثة الدعم الفني.

يتطلب التطبيق حساب محل قائمًا لدى أكواد للحلول التقنية، وتبقى بيانات الصيانة معزولة بين المحلات. فحص البلاغات والسوق والدعم والمزامنة تحتاج اتصالًا؛ يتاح العمل دون اتصال بعد تسجيل الدخول وتجهيز البيانات. الطباعة على iPhone تتطلب وسيلة متوافقة مع AirPrint.

name: القرآن الكريم | رفيق التلاوة
description:
ابدأ وردك، وارجع إليه متى شئت. يعرض لك التطبيق القرآن الكريم على صفحات المصحف بالرسم العثماني، ويجمع القراءة والتلاوة والتفسير في مكان واحد.

• تصفّح المصحف كاملًا عبر فهارس السور والأجزاء والأحزاب والأرباع.
• ابحث باسم السورة أو بكلمة من الآية، وافتح النتيجة في موضعها من المصحف.
• استمع إلى سورة كاملة أو آية تختارها، بأصوات مجموعة من القرّاء.
• افتح التفسير من الآية مباشرة، واختر من عدة تفاسير عربية.
• احفظ علامة واحدة لموضعك، وتابع القراءة أو التلاوة من الآية التي توقفت عندها.
• اختر المظهر الفاتح أو الداكن، أو دع التطبيق يتّبع إعداد جهازك.

صُمّم التطبيق ليكون القرآن رفيقك أينما كنت.

name: 人间一趟
description:
《人间一趟》是一款以文字和选择展开的人生模拟游戏。

从出生出发，经历求学、工作、收入与开支、住房、恋爱、婚姻和家庭。在不同国家与年代中，面对各自的生活条件和人生际遇，让每一次选择串成属于你的一生。

你可以加快时间，也可以随时暂停，慢慢读完发生的故事。游戏自动保存进度，离开后仍可继续未完的人生。

主要特色
• 不同国家与年代的人生起点
• 从童年到晚年的完整人生经历
• 工作、生活开支、住房与家庭的连动变化
• 随机事件与选择带来的不同际遇
• 自动存档与离线游玩

本版本免费提供，无广告、无应用内购买，无需注册账号。界面和游戏内容目前为简体中文。

游戏中的人物、事件与数值用于娱乐和模拟。

name: Munus Note
description:
Munus Note è un blocco note gratuito per iPad, iPhone e Mac. Le tue note sono file di testo normali nella cartella che scegli (di serie iCloud Drive › Munus Note): li puoi aprire con qualsiasi altra app, oggi e fra vent'anni. Niente account, niente pubblicità, niente abbonamenti. Funziona senza Internet e non raccoglie nessun dato.

SCRIVERE
• Editor veloce, anche con file molto grandi (fino a 50 MB).
• Salvataggio automatico continuo: se l'app si chiude di colpo, il testo che avevi scritto si recupera.
• Riprende da dove eri: stessa cartella, stessa nota, stesso punto del testo.
• Pulsanti Annulla e Ripeti sempre a portata, anche per le azioni della lista.
• Dimensione del testo a scelta, separata per le note e per la lista: con due dita, con la tastiera o nelle Impostazioni.
• Conteggio di parole, caratteri e tempo di lettura, anche della selezione.
• Concentrazione: solo il testo, con il paragrafo o la frase in luce; riga del cursore sempre a metà.
• Testo semplice, Markdown, codice, JSON, CSV e molti altri formati; codifiche e a capo dei file vecchi rispettati byte per byte.

MARKDOWN
• Vista Formattato senza simboli mentre scrivi: titoli, elenchi, attività da spuntare, tabelle, citazioni, codice, link e immagini. La vista Testo mostra il file com'è.
• Barra di formattazione e scorciatoie; tabelle comode con Tab e a capo; note a piè di pagina.
• Indice dei titoli e sezioni che si piegano.
• Trasforma una nota di testo in Markdown e viceversa, con l'anteprima e Annulla.
• Immagini trascinate o incollate nella nota; testo formattato incollato dalle pagine web diventa Markdown.
• Esporta in PDF o in pagina web, copia come testo formattato, stampa con nome e numeri di pagina.

CODICE E TABELLE
• Colori della sintassi, numeri di riga, riga corrente, rientri e parentesi automatici.
• Righe da spostare, duplicare, commentare e ordinare; più cursori su Mac e iPad.
• I file CSV e TSV si leggono come tabella, anche con centinaia di migliaia di righe; copia di celle e righe.

ORDINE
• Un pulsante rotondo per la nota nuova, sempre a portata di pollice.
• Scorri una nota verso destra per fissarla, verso sinistra per eliminarla o per gli altri comandi; c'è sempre «Annulla».
• Cartelle e sottocartelle, note fissate in alto, etichette.
• Sotto il nome due righe di anteprima, oppure solo i nomi per vedere più note.
• Barra del tempo: vedi a colpo d'occhio quando hai scritto e filtra per oggi, questa settimana, questo mese; se vuoi, un pallino colorato su ogni nota.
• Cerca nella nota (anche con espressioni regolari) e in tutte le note.
• Scegli più note per spostarle, fissarle o eliminarle insieme; trascinale in altre app come file.
• Chiudi la nota quando hai finito, anche dal menu File del Mac.

CON IL SISTEMA
• Widget «Nota» e «Note di oggi» per la schermata Home e la scrivania del Mac.
• Comandi rapidi e Siri, ricerca di Spotlight, Handoff fra i tuoi dispositivi.
• Condividi testo e link dalle altre app in una nota nuova; sul Mac menu del Dock e Servizi.

NIENTE SI PERDE
• Versioni delle note: torni a come erano ore o giorni fa.
• Eliminate di recente: le note cancellate si recuperano per 30 giorni.
• Se due dispositivi modificano la stessa nota, nessuna delle due versioni va persa.

PER TUTTI
• Modalità giorno e notte, testo grande, VoiceOver con i rotori dei titoli, scorciatoie da tastiera.
• Aiuto completo dentro l'app, con ricerca e spiegazioni di ogni pulsante, in italiano e inglese, anche senza Internet.

Nessun acquisto: la stessa app gratuita su iPad, iPhone e Mac.

name: SlipGrove: School Forms
description:
Keep the next school form from getting lost in the pile.

SlipGrove is a local desk for paperwork, supplies and other school requests. Record what arrived, who it is for, what still needs preparation and when it is due. Mark an item ready only after its preparation steps are complete.

- Keep separate child labels, request types and due dates with a specific time.
- Add preparation steps and see what is still outstanding.
- Find overdue and upcoming items, or filter the desk by child.
- Attach selected PDF, image or plain-text files and preview them locally.
- Record a hand-in method, date and reference after you have handed something in yourself.
- Keep an archive and history of those local hand-in records.
- Optionally request a local reminder; its status distinguishes permission and scheduling outcomes.
- Preview a school-week or item PDF, and share CSV records.

SlipGrove works offline without a school account. It does not connect to school systems, send forms or messages, or confirm that a school has received anything. A hand-in status is your own recorded note. Notification delivery depends on iOS settings.

name: HoofCadence: Farrier Log
description:
Keep hoof-service records organized for each horse and each hoof. HoofCadence brings together actual services, your chosen interval, appointment plans, dated photos and recorded costs.

Record trimming, shoeing or other work for the hoof positions actually serviced. A partial service updates those hooves only; the other hoof dates still come from their own history. Add observations and selected photos, then review dated records for a chosen hoof.

Choose the interval you want to track and see the dates calculated from recorded services. Keep appointment plans separate from completed work. Recording actual completion links a service to its plan; deleting a service makes a linked plan pending again.

Keep an unknown cost distinct from a recorded zero. Supported two-decimal currencies stay in separate totals without currency conversion. Filter service history by horse and date, preview a PDF with saved photos, and share CSV records through the iPhone share sheet.

Intervals are chosen by you. HoofCadence does not assess gait, diagnose hoof conditions or recommend treatment. Photos are personal records, not an automatic health assessment.

Works offline without an app account. Records and selected photos stay in local app storage. No ads or tracking are included. You choose where exported copies go.

name: Bolt Slapshot: Robot Hockey
description:
Lace up your steel skates and hit the ice! Bolt Slapshot is fast, friendly 3-on-3 robot arcade hockey for iPhone, iPad and Mac, and the hockey companion to Bolt Bowl.

Steer your robots across the ice, string passes together to supercharge the puck, and rattle the boards with glass-shattering body checks. It is easy to pick up in seconds and packed with real hockey action.

CHARGE THE PUCK & SCORE
• Pass to Power Up: Every completed pass charges the puck one level, up to level 3. Watch the puck glow brighter and fire faster, harder shots!
• Live Rebounds: A goalie save or a shot off the post drops the charge by one level. Losing the puck drains it completely.
• Bank Passes: Use the dotted aiming line to bounce clever passes off the boards.
• Shots, One-Timers & Fakes: Tap SHOOT for a quick wrist shot, or hold SHOOT to wind up a booming slapshot (just don't get hit while winding up!). Press SHOOT while a pass is coming your way for an instant one-timer.
• Smart Touch Controls: Skate with the left thumb stick and hit TURBO for a burst of speed that always stays in the same spot. Hold PASS and slide onto SHOOT to fake out the defense, or slide your thumb off any button to cancel.

CRUSHING DEFENSE
• Big Robot Hits: Press CHECK to knock rival robots flat on the ice and crack or shatter the arena glass.
• Active Sticks: Tap POKE to knock the puck loose and SWITCH to jump to the best defender.

32 ORIGINAL ROBOT TEAMS & FULL GAMES
• 32 Robot Squads: Pick from 32 original city robot teams, each with its own Home, Away and Alternate kits.
• THIS WEEK: Choose from this week's matchups, with a new list every week of the season.
• Full Match Rules: Win timing-tap faceoffs and battle through three periods of 2, 3 or 4 minutes. Watch the robots skate off and back on as the arena turns at every break!
• Overtime & Shootouts: Settle tied games in sudden-death overtime, then take control in a one-on-one shootout you shoot yourself.
• Smart Computer Opponents: Play on Easy, Medium or Hard. Harder teams play smarter hockey, not faster.
• 4 Practice Drills: Earn 1 to 3 stars in Skate, Shoot, Pass and Defense drills.
• Big Arena Moments: Celebrate with spinning goal lamps, blasting goal horns, cheering and booing robot crowds, multi-angle goal replays, slow-motion big hits, and highlight cards like BIG SAVE and HAT TRICK!

PLAY YOUR WAY
• iPhone, iPad and Mac.
• Touch, keyboard or game controller. On Mac: arrows or WASD to skate, E to pass, Space to shoot, Shift for turbo, Q to switch.
• No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases, and no internet needed.

Bolt Slapshot is a parody. Its teams are fictional robots and are not connected to or approved by any sports league or team.

name: TD Farm: Phòng thủ nông trại
description:
Lũ sâu, quạ, nhím và cả vua chuột chũi đang kéo tới phá ruộng nhà bạn! TD Farm là game thủ thành nông trại: xây trụ, gộp trụ, trồng cây và giữ nông trại qua 40 wave quái.

XÂY TRỤ NGẪU NHIÊN, GỘP LÊN BẬC CAO
• Bấm nút búa, chọn ô đất trống và xây trụ: mỗi lần xây ra một trụ ngẫu nhiên.
• Gộp 2 trụ giống nhau, cùng cấp để ra trụ bậc cao hơn: Cơ bản → Nâng cao → Chuyên gia → Huyền thoại → Thần tướng.
• 35 trụ nông trại đáng yêu: gà con, ngỗng, bò tót, bù nhìn, cối xay gió, rồng ớt, phượng hoàng lúa, thần mưa…

4 HỆ KHẮC NHAU
• Lửa, Nước, Mộc, Đất: Nước khắc Lửa, Lửa khắc Mộc, Mộc khắc Đất, Đất khắc Nước.
• Mỗi wave quái thuộc một hệ, xem trước để xếp trụ đúng hệ, đánh mạnh gấp rưỡi.
• Nâng sát thương từng hệ ở nhà kho.

TRỒNG CÂY, KIẾM GỖ, BÁN NÔNG SẢN
• Trồng cà rốt, bí ngô, nho để thu nông sản mỗi wave.
• Giá nông sản đổi theo wave: giữ lại và bán lúc giá cao.
• Thả boss phụ ở nhà kho để kiếm thêm gỗ.

40 WAVE, 4 TRẬN BOSS
• Wave 10, 20, 30, 40 là round boss. Mỗi 5 wave có sự kiện chọn phần thưởng: tăng sát thương, tăng giá nông sản hoặc nhận trụ miễn phí.
• Vật phẩm huyền thoại gắn cho trụ Thần tướng: hoá băng, chí mạng, lông phượng hoàng…
• Nhiệm vụ thưởng gỗ, Vườn trụ và Sổ tay quái để sưu tầm.

CHƠI DỄ TRÊN ĐIỆN THOẠI
• Chạm trụ để gộp hay bán, giữ nút để xem thông tin.

name: BeeBall: Spelling Hoops
description:
See the picture. Spell the word. Sink the shot.

BeeBall turns every letter into a shot. A picture pops up, its letters scatter across the court, and you shoot them into the hoops in the right order before the clock runs out. Miss a letter and the defenders will happily remind you.

Pick your game: 60, 90 or 120 seconds, from Rookie four-letter warm-ups to Career mode, which climbs as you play. Choose word packs from animals to world landmarks. Stuck? Grab a hint or skip and keep your streak alive.

Earn XP, chase medals, and unlock new balls, nets and courts in your Locker. Every word comes with a real picture, and scores stay on your device.

Short rounds, big swishes, and a very determined bee. Lace up. The words are waiting.

name: StaffIQ
description:
StaffIQ منصة عراقية تربط موظفي المطاعم والكافيهات بالمطاعم التي تبحث عنهم.

بدل ما تدور على الشواغر وحدك، تسجّل ملفك مرة واحدة — خبرتك ومهاراتك ومنطقتك والدوام اللي يناسبك — ويوصلك العرض المناسب.

للموظفين
• سجّل ملفك بخطوات بسيطة: الوظيفة المطلوبة، الخبرة، المهارات، المنطقة، وأوقات الدوام.
• تصفّح الشواغر المفتوحة وقدّم عليها مباشرة.
• استلم عروض عمل من المطاعم، وقرّر بنفسك.
• تابع حالة كل تقديم: قيد المراجعة، مرشّح، مقبول.
• رقمك ما ينعطي لأي مطعم. التواصل يمر عبر فريق StaffIQ.

للمطاعم
• انشر شاغراً وحدّد الراتب والدوام والمنطقة والخبرة المطلوبة.
• استلم مرشّحين مطابقين بدل ما تفرز مئات الطلبات.
• ارسل عرض عمل مباشرة لمن يناسبك.
• ملف مطعمك يظهر للباحثين عن عمل بموقعه وتخصصاته.

كيف يشتغل
1. سجّل ملفك — دقائق قليلة.
2. فريق StaffIQ يراجع البيانات ويتأكد أنها واضحة وجاهزة للترشيح.
3. يوصلك العرض المناسب، والفريق يساعد بالتواصل.

ليش StaffIQ
• مطابقة حسب الخبرة والمنطقة والتوفر، مو مجرد قائمة إعلانات.
• كل مطعم يمر بتوثيق قبل ما ينشر.
• تقييمات من الطرفين بعد انتهاء العمل.
• خصوصية الموظف أولاً: رقمك يبقى عندنا.
• التطبيق بالعربية والإنكليزية.

StaffIQ — مطابقة ذكية. كوادر موثوقة.

التسجيل والتصفّح مجاني للموظفين. للمطاعم باقات اشتراك، والتفاصيل داخل التطبيق.
