name: 말이되네
description:
과학이 말이 되는 순간

말이되Ne(말이되네)는 과학의 기호를 언어처럼 배우는 앱이에요. 화학어, 생명어, 물리어를 오가며 알파벳·단어·문법·문장·의미의 다섯 단계를 차근차근 배워요.

화학어: 원소 기호에서 반응식까지
• 원소 기호와 화학식을 읽고 만들어요
• 아는 화학식에서 규칙을 찾고 반응식의 계수를 맞춰요
• 원자핵의 양성자·중성자를 하나씩 보고, 원자·분자·결정 모형을 돌려 봐요
• 반응 전후에 원자들이 어떻게 다시 연결되는지 살펴봐요
• 새로 배운 원소가 카드로 모여요. 주기율표 탐험까지 하면 118개 원소를 모두 만나요

생명어: DNA의 글자에서 유전 정보 읽기까지
• A·T·G·C와 RNA의 U를 구별해요
• 코돈표를 찾아 아미노산을 읽고 상보 서열을 만들어요
• DNA를 읽어 RNA를 만들고, 코돈에 따라 아미노산 사슬을 연결해 봐요
• 서열이 바뀐 전후를 비교하고, 짧은 자료로 단정할 수 없는 범위도 배워요
• 새로 배운 아미노산이 Met·Gly 같은 세 글자 카드로 모여요

물리어: 기호와 단위에서 말이 되는 답까지
• 기울인 양의 기호와 바로 세운 단위 기호를 구별해 읽어요
• 식을 필요한 모양으로 옮겨 쓰고, 단위로 맞는지 검사해요
• 그래프의 높이·기울기·넓이를 읽고, 힘을 화살표로 놓아 봐요
• 낙하, 충돌, 에너지 모형을 움직여 보고 답이 말이 되는지 따져요
• 새로 배운 물리량이 카드로 모여요

짧게 배우고 다시 꺼내 봐요
• 하루 5분, 짧은 레슨으로 시작해요
• 틀린 문제는 한 줄 해설로 확인하고, 최근 오답과 개념 연습으로 다시 익혀요
• 오늘의 복습과 오늘의 도전으로 배운 내용을 다시 봐요
• 화학어와 생명어는 교과서 코스에서 궁금한 주제를 찾아 배워요
• 생활 속 사진과 짧은 이야기로 배운 내용을 이어 봐요
• 이미 아는 내용은 유닛마다 하루 한 번 건너뛰기 테스트로 확인해요
• 홈 화면 위젯과 주간 돌아보기로 오늘 할 일과 지난주를 살펴봐요
• 무작위 뽑기 없이 배운 개념으로 카드를 모아요
• 휴대폰 설정에 맞춰 어두운 화면으로도 볼 수 있어요

친구와 함께 풀어요
• 같은 문제를 나란히 풀거나, 함께 칸을 채워요
• 문제를 보내거나 한 휴대폰으로 번갈아 풀어요
• 같은 자리에서는 같은 Wi-Fi나 핫스팟으로 방을 만들어 둘이서 풀어요
• 서버와 가입 없이, 앱에 있는 이름표만 써요

Apple Watch에서도 풀어요
• 하루 한 판 '오늘의 세 문제'를 워치에서 풀어요. 문제마다 보기 두 개 중에서 골라요
• 시계 화면의 컴플리케이션을 누르면 바로 열려요
• iPhone에서 배운 개념으로 문제가 오고, 워치에서 푼 날도 연속 학습에 들어가요
• iPhone에 말이되Ne가 있어야 해요. watchOS 10 이상(Apple Watch Series 4 이후)에서 쓸 수 있어요

무료로 시작해요
• 가입 없이 시작하고 광고 없이 배워요
• 언어마다 하루 새 레슨 다섯 개를 무료로 배워요
• 복습과 지난 레슨 다시 하기는 제한이 없어요
• 학습 기록은 기기에 저장하고, iCloud를 쓰면 앱을 다시 설치해도 이어서 배워요. 기록 파일로 내보낼 수도 있어요

언어팩
만 14세 이상은 원하는 언어의 팩을 한 번 사면 그 언어에서 이렇게 이용할 수 있어요.
• 새 레슨을 하루에 몇 개든 배워요
• 약점 집중 연습으로 헷갈린 개념을 다져요
• 학습 리포트로 익힌 개념과 진도를 봐요
• 앞으로 나올 단계와 레슨도 함께 열려요
화학어 팩, 생명어 팩, 물리어 팩은 각각 구매하거나 세 팩 묶음으로 한 번에 구매할 수 있으며 구독이 아니에요. 구매한 Apple 계정으로 구매를 복원할 수 있어요.

모형은 이해를 돕기 위해 단순화한 그림이에요. 생명어의 합성 서열과 가상 유전 모형은 개인의 건강·능력·가족관계를 판단하는 도구가 아니에요.

개인정보
학습 기록은 기기에 저장해요. 만 14세 이상이 동의하면 레슨 이용 기록을 Google Analytics로 보내고, 설정에서 언제든 끌 수 있어요. 결제는 App Store에서 처리해요.

name: Offline Dictation Keyboard
description:
Offline dictation keyboard: speak and your words appear in any app. Speech recognition runs entirely on your iPhone — nothing is uploaded.

HOW IT WORKS
• Download the speech model once (about 465 MB). After that, dictation works with no connection.
• Add the Dictation keyboard in Settings and turn on dictation in the app.
• In any app, switch to the keyboard, tap the microphone, talk and tap Stop. Your words appear at the cursor.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Speech recognition runs on your iPhone or iPad, using NVIDIA's Parakeet model.
• No account, no cloud, no analytics.
• Audio is deleted as soon as it has been turned into text.
• Every dictation is saved on your device in Transcripts, ready to copy or share.
• What you type stays in the keyboard. Full Access only lets the keyboard talk to the app, which does the listening.

A KEYBOARD YOU CAN TYPE ON TOO
• Letters, numbers and symbols, with autocorrect, word suggestions and your own iOS text replacements.
• Dictate in the app itself when you just want the text.

MORE MODELS, IF YOU WANT THEM
• Under Advanced models: Parakeet Unified, Parakeet Ultra and Redux (English and 24 European languages), Whisper Large v3 Turbo and Apple's built-in speech recognition. Each one downloads only when you choose it.

7-DAY FREE TRIAL, THEN $9.99 ONCE
Try everything free for 7 days, counted from your first dictation. The trial never charges you and there is nothing to cancel. Then unlock once for $9.99. No subscription. If you don't unlock, dictation stops and your saved transcripts stay readable.

Requires iOS 26 or later.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://alexmorris10x.github.io/dictation-keyboard-app/privacy.html

name: TDown
description:
Your channels are full of files you need. Finding them again is the hard part.

TDown turns the files in the channels and groups you already joined into a sorted, searchable library on your iPhone and iPad.

HOW IT WORKS
• Sign in with your own account and pick a channel or group.
• See what it holds: how many files, how much space, and which types.
• Choose file types, a date range and a size limit, or pick files one by one.
• TDown downloads them into folders. Hashtags in a post become sections.

WHY TDOWN
• One library. PDFs, Word and Excel files, books, audio and video, each in its place.
• Search across everything you saved.
• Keeps up. Swipe down to check your channels for new files, and get them with one tap.
• Star the files you come back to, and sort any channel your way.
• Read and play inside the app, with search inside PDFs, playback speeds, background audio and a floating video window.
• Pick up where you stopped, in any PDF, book, audio or video. Audio plays on to the next file in the series.
• Your files, your device. They live in the Files app, and you can also save photos and videos to your library.
• Keep going. Downloads can continue after you leave the app, on devices that support it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
TDown has no server. Your session, your library and your files stay on your device. We never see your messages or files. Crash reports and usage counts contain no file names, channel names or phone numbers.

TDown saves only what you can already access. Channels whose owners turned off saving stay off limits.

FREE, WITH ADS
Every feature is free. Ads keep it that way.

TDown Plus removes TDown's ads. Telegram's own sponsored messages, which it requires in public channels, can still appear there. It is a yearly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tdown.h93lab.com/en/privacy

TDown is an independent app that uses the Telegram API. It is not made by, or affiliated with, Telegram.

name: Pitchwood
description:
Pitchwood is a camping gear organizer that treats your equipment as the
physical objects it is — not a to-do list of checkboxes.

Every tent, sleeping bag and stove in your kit gets its own record: weight,
quantity, purchase price, brand, condition, photo and notes. You can browse
it by category, see the running total of what you carry, and build a packing
list for each trip you actually plan.

• Suivi des congés, des déclarations et des heures

Vous êtes médecin ? Connectez-vous avec le compte reçu de votre établissement.
Vous gérez un planning ? Créez le compte de votre service sur gardeo.be : 30 jours d'essai gratuit, sans engagement.

name: Padel Bros
description:
Less admin. More game.

Padel Bros helps you get your four together and keep the story of every match.

YOUR CREW, READY TO PLAY
Save your regular squad, share a game invitation and see who has confirmed their place. Squad games stay private to invited players.

FIND A TIME, THEN BOOK
Offer a few dates and times in an availability poll. Your players vote Yes, Maybe or No. Choose a time, book your court on Playtomic, then add the confirmed booking to Padel Bros. Booking links open Playtomic; Padel Bros does not check live availability or reserve courts.

PLAY FIRST. SCORE LATER.
Enter the final set scores after the match. A player from the opposing team confirms the result before it counts towards your stats. Your weekly and monthly table keeps played, won, lost, sets and win rate together.

TAKE TURNS
Record who covered the court and the optional cost. Your squad can see the payment history and suggested next payer. No payments are processed by Padel Bros.

MAKE THE WIN COUNT
Play for pride, the beers or a friendly forfeit. Celebrate confirmed winners and share the scorecard with your group.

QUICK SCORE, EVEN OFFLINE
Use the bundled iPhone scorer for games, sets, tie breaks, service order and undo. Local Quick score records stay on that iPhone and are separate from online Clubhouse results.

Online Clubhouse stays inside the iPhone app and requires internet and native Sign in with Apple. Existing verified email accounts can also sign in. Existing browser players can explicitly link their records during onboarding. The separate browser version continues to use ChatGPT sign-in. Offline Quick score does not require an online account. This release does not include the development Apple Watch companion.

name: Hourleaf: Life Reminders
description:
Hourleaf keeps the small, important things in your life on time — in one calm place.

Medicines, bills, renewals, deadlines, sleep, and habits each get a live countdown and a gentle reminder before they matter. Open the app and Today shows exactly what needs you now, ranked by urgency, so you can tick it off in one tap.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Medicines — dose schedule, "take / snooze/skip", 7-day adherence, and a warning before you run out
• Bills & subscriptions — what's left to pay this month, where the money goes, and a nudge before a free trial starts charging
• Important dates — birthdays, car checks, passports, renewals, with countdowns
• Study & focus — a focus timer, deadlines and day 1-3-7 revision reminders
• Sleep — bedtime countdown, a wind-down routine, and your last 7 nights
• Fitness & water — a weekly plan, streaks and a simple glass-by-glass water tracker
• Balance — mood check-ins, a good-things journal, and reminders to keep in touch with people
• Warranties — keep track of what's covered and until when

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no Hourleaf servers
• Everything you enter stays on your phone
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Back up to a file you control, and restore it any time
• Discreet reminders: your lock screen says "Time for your medicine", never the name

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• Light and dark mode
• Amounts in your own currency
• Share an adherence report with a carer or doctor
• Undo on every delete
• Reminders only when you turn them on

Hourleaf is a personal organiser, not a medical device, and does not give medical advice. Always follow your doctor's or pharmacist's instructions.

Questions or ideas?  Write to info@nordicdesh.com — we read every message.

name: Tactile Gravity Picker
description:
Small decisions deserve a little fun.

Tactile Gravity Picker turns everyday choices into playful moments. Choose what to eat, pick your next activity, or gather friends around one screen. Create your own lists and explore four different ways to let chance decide.

FOUR WAYS TO FIND YOUR ANSWER

• Gravity Chits
Shake your iPhone or iPad and watch wooden chits move with your device. Draw one to discover your next choice.

• Touch Spark
Bring 2–6 people together on one screen. Place your fingers down, hold steady, and let the countdown select one lucky participant.

• Blind Tiles
Shuffle your options into hidden cards, then turn one over. Enable draws without repeats when you want every option to get its turn.

• Textile Scratcher
Scratch away the silver surface to uncover a hidden answer. Take your time and enjoy the reveal.

MAKE IT YOURS

Start with ready-made lists or create your own. Add food ideas, weekend plans, names, activities, or anything else you need to choose between. Edit your lists whenever inspiration strikes.

KEEP YOUR FAVORITE MOMENTS

Review previous results in your history. Export your lists, history, and preferences as a backup, then restore them when needed.

DESIGNED TO FEEL GOOD

Warm textures, gentle sounds, and haptic feedback on supported devices make each choice feel satisfying. Adjust sound and haptics to suit your preferences.

FREE AND PRIVATE

• Completely free, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases
• No advertising, accounts, or analytics
• Works offline
• Lists and history stay on your device
• Exported backups go where you choose

Made for portrait use on iPhone and iPad.

From “What should we eat?” to “Who goes first?”, give your next small decision a playful twist.

name: Pagetide
description:
Pagetide 是一款为阅读设计的浏览器。从打开网页，到读完一篇文章或一组长图，都可以在同一个 App 里完成。

在底部地址栏输入网址或搜索词，随时前进、后退、刷新。用标签总览切换网页，也可以从浏览历史回到读过的页面。

遇到想细读的文章，点一下地址栏旁的阅读图标，就能将正文、配图和图注整理到同一页。字号、行距和主题都能调整，还能划线记笔记，或让系统朗读文章。

看漫画或长图时，可以纵向连续翻阅，用图片目录跳转，点开单张图片放大，也能隐藏不想看的图片。

把文章和长图加入稍后读，下次从上次的位置继续。保存内容并下载所需图片后，也能离线阅读。你还可以从 Safari 等 App 的分享菜单，把网页交给 Pagetide 稍后读。

name: MatTrack
description:
MatTrack is an AI powered lawn bowls practice assistant. Pick your drills, score every end bowl by bowl on the green, and see clearly how your game is moving over the season. Built for players who want their practice to matter, whether you train every day or once a week.

PRACTICE WITH A PURPOSE
• Start with the starter drills, choose from the Drill Library, or build your own: your own scoring options, misses with reasons (short, long, wide, narrow, or your own), forehand or backhand, and an optional jack roll.
• Score each bowl as you play, with the hand you used and why a bowl missed. Big buttons, quick to use between deliveries.
• Drills rotate through your session in the order you choose. Record the green speed, surface (grass, synthetic or indoor) and a short note.
• Interrupted? Your session is saved as you go, so you can carry on where you left off.
• Leave yourself a reminder on any drill, and it shows the next time that drill comes up.

PRESSURE GAMES AND SKILL CHECKS
• Pressure games give a short session a shape: one drill, a few ends, and a target set from your own recent results.
• Skill Check is a fixed test, the same every time, so you can measure your progress over the months. Draw Check 40 is included.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Results by day: every session, with green speed, surface and your notes.
• Results by drill: your percentage, recent form, forehand against backhand, where your misses go, and a trend chart.
• Personal bests and milestones to mark the way.
• Season review: add up any period you choose and share a picture of your year.
• Share a day's results as an image with your coach, club or friends.

AI COACH (FREE, NEEDS INTERNET)
• Insights reads your results and suggests what to focus on, a plan for your next session, and drills from the library that suit you.
• Describe a drill, or take a photo of one written down, and the coach drafts it for you.
• Compared with other bowlers (beta): on library drills, see a rough guide for your level and how others do.
• Nothing is sent to the AI until you agree, and you can turn it off at any time. Use is limited each week to keep it free.

CLUBS AND BACKUP (OPTIONAL)
• Sign in with Apple, Google or an email link to back up your results and move them to a new phone.
• Join your club or coaching group, follow a friend, share drills, and run a group session with a simple code.
• Coaches can see their players' results and leave comments and drill reminders.
• No account needed for everything else. Your results stay on your phone unless you choose to sign in.

DESIGNED FOR THE GREEN
• Light and dark themes.
• Works with large text sizes.
• No ads.

Players aged 13 to 17 can join their club with a junior account.

Questions or ideas? Visit https://mattrack-ai-7078c.web.app/support.html

name: Cbox ID
description:
Approve sign-ins and requests from apps and agents with your Cbox ID account.

See which app is asking, which account the request concerns, and the action you are approving. Compare the description with the one shown on your other device, then confirm with Face ID or your iPhone passcode. Deny unwanted requests or choose “This wasn't me” to deny and report an unexpected request.

Connect several Cbox ID accounts and see their pending requests together. Enable notifications to hear when a request arrives. Open the notification to review it, or open the app to check for requests at any time.

Keep TOTP verification codes for other services, too. Scan a setup QR code or enter a setup key, then use your codes offline without a Cbox account. Save an encrypted backup with your own password and import it on a new phone. There is no automatic sync. Cbox cannot recover a forgotten backup password.

Cbox approvals require an existing account on a supported Cbox ID host. Connect through Trusted devices on your Cbox ID website using its QR code or a link.

name: Tonewick
description:
Tonewick is a small practice room for people who play or sing.

BEAT
A click that holds its tempo to the sample, from 20 to 300 beats per minute. Turn the big dial or tap the tempo, choose how many beats make a bar, and tap each beat to make it loud, normal or silent. Play straight beats, eighths, triplets or sixteenths with a woodblock, rim shot, pure beep or brush tick. A speed builder can nudge the tempo up every few bars until you reach the ceiling you set.

TUNE
Pick Chromatic, Guitar, Bass, Ukulele, Violin or Cello and play a note. A needle shows how many cents sharp or flat you are, with the nearest note name and frequency. Concert A can sit at 415, 440 or 442 Hz, or anywhere in between.

DRONE
Choose a root note and let it sustain, then stack a fifth, fourth, third or octave above it. Switch between just ratios, which ring without beating, and equal temperament to hear the difference for yourself. Sing or play against it to settle your intonation.

EAR
Three short drills: name the interval, name the note you heard, or sing a note back and see how close you landed. Choose which intervals to practise, ascending, descending or together, and keep an eye on your streak and accuracy.

YOUR AUDIO STAYS PUT
Tonewick listens only on the Tune screen and the Sing back drill, to find the pitch. Sound is analysed live on your device and is never recorded, stored or sent anywhere. Everything else works without microphone access, and the whole app works offline.

FREE, WITH CHOICES
Every tool is free. Ads (Google AdMob) appear as banners and the occasional full-screen ad. Watch short optional videos to earn quiet time, up to 100 a month, or subscribe to Ad-free monthly for US$2.99 per month to remove ads. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions, at least 24 hours before renewal. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-tonewick.html

name: MultiMovie: Multi-View Browser
description:
A split-screen browser for anyone who wants to follow several live streams at once.

Paste a URL to line up pages from video sites like YouTube and other live streams. Play pages from the sites you choose on up to four screens at the same time. Follow several sports broadcasts, watch races side by side, or keep up with multiple streams.

AUDIO FOCUS
Only one tile plays sound at a time. Tap to switch: the other tiles are muted automatically and keep playing. A yellow border shows which tile has sound.

TV OUTPUT
Connect with an HDMI adapter or AirPlay. The TV shows only the full-screen video grid, and your phone becomes the remote: switch sound, zoom, swap tiles, and change layouts from your hand. Power Saving dims the phone's screen.

ADD FROM THE SHARE MENU
In Safari or a video app, tap Share and choose MultiMovie to put the page in a tile.

SAVE AND SYNC LAYOUTS
Name a combination of tiles and bring it back at any time. Layouts sync between your iPhone and iPad with iCloud.

MORE FEATURES
- Video Mode: fills the tile with only the page's video
- Desktop Site: switch per tile
- Auto Reload: set an interval per tile
- Blocks jumps to other apps
- Keeps the screen on during playback
- Warns when your device gets hot, and pauses tiles other than the one with sound

PRICING
Free to use, with ads. The free version offers up to 2 splits and 3 saved layouts. Watch an ad to use 4-split for 3 hours.

MultiMovie Pro (auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly): no ads, 4-split, unlimited saved layouts, Video Mode on every tile, and Auto Reload.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel in your App Store account settings.

PLEASE NOTE
MultiMovie shows only the pages you enter. It has no download, save, or recording features. Please follow the terms of each site. Some sites may not support simultaneous playback or embedding.

YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of these services.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fukusefeb-dev.github.io/multimovie/en/privacy.html

name: Sand Gallery: Block Puzzle
description:
Turn sand paintings into satisfying puzzles!

Every level is a picture made of thousands of colored sand grains. Drag blocks into the grid below — each block pulls sand of its own color from the bottom of the picture. Watch the sand tumble, slide and pour away. Clear the whole picture to win!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Real falling-sand physics — every grain moves
• 300 levels, from easy to brain-burning
• 25 famous masterpieces to clear, from the Mona Lisa to The Starry Night
• A new Daily Challenge every day
• Extreme Challenges: only 1%, 0.1% and 0.01% of random tries win
• Mystery blocks, rocks, frozen blocks and two-color blocks keep every level fresh
• Hints, Undo, Hammer and Magnet boosters when you get stuck
• 7 sand styles and 3 themes, including a cozy night theme
• No timer — play at your own pace

Collect every picture in your gallery and become a sand master!

name: Mutara: Cell Evolution
description:
Mutara is a cell colony strategy game set on a microscope slide. Stretch tentacles from your cell, send your units, and take over neutral cells and rival colonies.

RULE-BREAKING MUTATIONS
After every slide, pick one of three genes. Some change the numbers, some break the rules: units jump from cell to cell, full cells overflow into their neighbours, captured cells start full.

GENE SPLICING
Collect the right two mutations and splice them into a new gene. Every run grows a different creature.

GHOST COLONIES
When you finish a run, your evolved creature appears as a ghost rival in other players' games. You will meet theirs too.

20 EXPERIMENTS
The lab's protocol has 20 experiments. Each adds a new rule, and on the seventh slide the Scientist is waiting.

DAILY SLIDE
Everyone plays the same map. See where you stand on the world and country leaderboards.

ALSO
• Weekly Mutant, Endless and Living Slide modes
• Slide Notebook: every card and species you have met
• Save and share your creature card as an image
• Plays offline; progress syncs to the cloud when you are back online
• No sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases
• Delete your data from inside the game with one tap

name: PixelQuota
description:
A form asks for a JPEG under 200 KB. PixelQuota lets you enter that limit, prepare the image and see the actual byte count before you upload it yourself.

Set a maximum in KB or MB. Keep the original proportions, or request exact pixel dimensions with white padding or a crop. Confirm the framing when prompted. Add up to ten images and generate a batch on your iPhone.

Each result shows its dimensions, file size and whether it meets your settings. Inspect the image before exporting. If an exact-size image is still too large, try a different size or limit. Only passing files can be shared as JPEGs or grouped in a ZIP; the limit applies per JPEG.

Save frequently used specifications as local presets. No account or upload service is required. Getting an original from iCloud Photos may need a connection.

name: Rock Paper Scissor Shoot Block
description:
Play Rock Paper Scissor Shoot Block solo against a bot, head to head on one phone, or together over a shared Wi-Fi network or hotspot.

Choose from twelve characters and play first-to-three matches. Matching moves can launch SHOOT!, a rapid tapping battle, or BLOCK!, a timed defense challenge. Host a Survival room with a challenger queue, or organize a tournament with simultaneous matches and a best-of-three-games final.

Friends can join your room in a browser by scanning its QR code, without installing an app. iPhone players can also join through the native app. Everyone must share a network that allows local connections, and the host app must stay open. Internet matchmaking and background hosting are not included.

The initial iPhone edition has no advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

name: Universal Scanner – Scan & Act
description:
Scan anything. Do something with it.

Point your iPhone at a poster, flyer, business card, receipt or screen. Universal Scanner finds the useful details and highlights them right on your camera view. Tap one, choose what to do, and you're done. No photos to take, no text to select, no copying and pasting.

WHAT IT RECOGNISES
• Websites: open, copy or share
• Phone numbers: call, message or save as a contact
• Email addresses: write an email or save as a contact
• Addresses: open in Maps or get directions
• Dates and times: add to your calendar or create a reminder
• QR codes: links, contacts, Wi-Fi details and more
• Barcodes: look up products
• Flight numbers, parcel tracking numbers and printed Wi-Fi details

SCAN PHOTOS AND SCREENSHOTS TOO
Saved a screenshot of an event or a menu? Open it in Universal Scanner and tap the details, just like with the camera.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything is recognised on your iPhone. Your camera feed and photos are never uploaded, and there's no account to create.

FREE AND PRO
QR codes and barcodes are free. Universal Scanner Pro unlocks everything else: websites, phone numbers, emails, addresses, dates, flights, parcels and printed Wi-Fi details, from the camera and from photos.

Pro is available as a yearly subscription with a free trial for new subscribers, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://universalscanner.app/privacy

name: Lumis - Chụp Ảnh Chuẩn Dáng AI
description:
Lumis is an on-device AI camera companion designed to guide camera angles, framing, and natural posing in real time at smooth 60FPS.

Lumis provides visual overlays and sensor feedback to help both the photographer and the subject achieve well-balanced portraits and level horizons without frustration.

KEY FEATURES:

1. REAL-TIME 60FPS POSE GUIDANCE
- Curated Pose Library: Practical poses for portraits, full-body shots, street fashion, casual lifestyle, and travel.
- Intuitive Silhouette & Skeleton Overlays: Clear visual outlines help subjects position arms, legs, and posture naturally.
- Visual Match Feedback: Responsive visual indicators assist users in aligning with the selected pose template.

2. CAMERA TILT COACHING AND HORIZON LEVELING
- 3D Gyro Angle Guidance: Interactive reminders for a flattering 15-degree camera tilt that creates natural, well-proportioned perspectives.
- Smart Horizon Stabilizer: Built-in virtual level keeps background horizons straight and eliminates unintentional tilt.
- Distance Guidance: On-screen prompts suggest moving closer or stepping back to maintain balanced subject-to-frame ratios.

3. INTELLIGENT AUTO-SHUTTER
- Touchless Smart Capture: Automatically triggers the shutter when pose alignment and camera stability meet steady conditions, reducing shake from manual button presses.

4. COMPOSITION GUIDES AND CINEMATIC TONES
- Composition Grid Overlays: Rule of Thirds and Golden Ratio guides help establish clear focal points and balanced framing.
- Refined Color Tones: Subtle color profiles crafted to preserve natural skin texture and authentic lighting ambiance.

5. PRIVACY-FIRST ON-DEVICE ARCHITECTURE
- Local Processing: Pose detection and computer vision run entirely on your device hardware without requiring an internet connection.
- Zero Cloud Image Uploads: Your photos, camera feed, and biometric features are never sent to external servers. Your personal photos remain solely in your device library.

DESIGNED FOR:
- Casual photographers taking portraits of family and friends.
- Solo travelers and creators seeking pose inspiration for outdoor shoots.
- Anyone looking to improve framing, alignment, and photo composition.

Experience Lumis and capture more thoughtful, well-balanced portraits in every setting.

name: 字段检查
description: 字段检查面向整理活动名册和小型业务表格的人。你可以粘贴或选择CSV文件，正确解析引号内的逗号、换行及双引号，再在带行列坐标的资料网格逐格编辑。每列可以组合必填、文本、整数、小数、有效日期、数值边界、允许值枚举和跨行唯一键。检查单会指出具体单元格、原值和失败原因；空值不会被误当作数字，重复键的每个位置都会列出。修正策略只负责首尾空白、数值规范化和大小写统一，必须先生成逐格原值与候选值的预演，选择后才确认修改，并重新计算剩余问题。每次保存检查或确认修正都会保留原表、结果表、规约、问题及差异。检查册可恢复原表复查或复用结果继续整理，并保留父版本来源。实际CSV结果可导出到文件。检查通过只代表已设定约束通过，不替代资料真实性核对。最多支持500行、30列的小型资料；无需账号。

name: Vela Drivers
description: Vela Driver helps grease-trap service drivers record each pump-out with a location check, time-stamped before and after photos, volume, trap condition and an on-screen signature. Records can't be submitted incomplete, and they send automatically once the phone has signal.

name: 1Order: Restaurant Ordering
description:
1Order runs a restaurant's orders from the table to the kitchen and the bar, on the phones and tablets you already have.

Guests scan the QR code on their table, browse the menu and order together; servers can add to the same check. The moment an order is sent, food goes to the kitchen screen and drinks to the bar screen — you decide where each category or item is made — and the right devices get a notification with their own tone and vibration.

FOR THE KITCHEN AND BAR
• Live tickets with timers, Start → Ready → Served, and undo
• Each screen shows only its own tickets: soft drinks to the kitchen, beer and cocktails to the bar, or however you like
• Mark items sold out in two taps; guests can't order them until they're back
• The screen stays on during service, and a red banner says if the connection drops

FOR SERVERS AND THE HOST
• The whole floor at a glance: who's seated, what's cooking, what's ready, who's calling
• "Food's ready" and "drinks are ready" notifications for your own tables
• Staff PIN, or a server's own phone that opens straight to their tables
• Host stand with tables and the waitlist

FOR OWNERS
• Menus with categories, specials and happy hour, and where each item is made
• Pair a new device with a code or by scanning a QR code — nobody signs in on the shared tablet
• Several locations, staff, reports and online ordering from one dashboard

Each device chooses its own alert: 1Order chime, bell, alarm, soft or the phone's sound, with strong, single or no vibration.

1Order is made by 0101 Inc.

name: 48 AI Radio
description:
48 AI Radio is a live radio station run by the 48 AI crew in Perth, Western Australia.

LIVE — a 24/7 stream of original tracks made by the crew, 72 Donna PRO recordings in rotation, DJ SAV on the desk. Every track is royalty-free and made in-house.

SHOWS — The 48 AI Crew Podcast: three minutes, three times a week, on what the crew actually did running a real Aussie business. Jane, Daisy and DJ SAV on the desk.

ASK JANE — Jane, the crew's receptionist and voice of the station, answers in her own voice.

No accounts. No sign-in. Tap play and listen.

name: 5 Travel
description:
5 Travel يجمع كل ما تحتاجه لرحلتك في تطبيق واحد: من حجز الطيران والفنادق، إلى الفيزا وشريحة الإنترنت والنشاطات السياحية.

حجز الطيران
ابحث عن الرحلات، وقارن بين الأسعار والأوقات، واحجز رحلتك خلال دقائق.

الفنادق
اختر فندقك حسب المدينة والتاريخ وعدد الأشخاص، واطّلع على التفاصيل وشروط الإلغاء قبل الحجز.

الشاليهات والمزارع
اكتشف شاليهات ومزارع وأماكن خاصة لعطلتك مع العائلة والأصدقاء، واحجزها من التطبيق مباشرة.

النشاطات والجولات السياحية
أضف إلى رحلتك جولات ونشاطات مميزة في وجهتك.

الفيزا
قدّم طلب الفيزا من التطبيق، وارفع مستنداتك، وتابع حالة طلبك خطوة بخطوة.

eSIM للسفر
اشترِ باقة إنترنت لوجهتك، وثبّتها بسهولة، وتابع بياناتك المتبقية، واشحن باقتك عند الحاجة، بدون البحث عن شريحة عند الوصول.

الدفع والمحفظة
ادفع بالبطاقة أو من محفظتك داخل التطبيق، وتابع جميع عملياتك في مكان واحد.

حجوزاتك دائماً معك
اطّلع على تفاصيل كل حجز في أي وقت، واستلم إشعارات فورية عند تحديث حالته.

دعم مباشر
تحدث مع فريق الدعم من داخل التطبيق عندما تحتاج إلى مساعدة.

بلغتك
يتوفر التطبيق باللغات العربية والإنجليزية والتركية والروسية والجورجية، ويمكنك التبديل بينها في أي وقت.

لأصحاب الأماكن
إذا كنت تملك فندقاً أو شاليهاً أو مزرعة، يمكنك إدارة حجوزات مكانك من خلال حساب الشريك في التطبيق.

حمّل 5 Travel وابدأ التخطيط لرحلتك القادمة.

name: 5x5 Roadmap
description:
Free forever. Stronger, one workout at a time.

5x5 Roadmap gives you a clear plan in the gym and a useful record of what happens next. Follow Classic 5×5, build your own training, and see your progress—all without subscriptions, paywalls, ads, or an account.

KNOW WHAT TO LIFT NEXT
Start with alternating Workout A and Workout B, suggested starting weights, and your preferred training days. Your next workout stays ready even when life changes your schedule. Add accessories without disrupting the main program.

MAKE EVERY SET COUNT
Tap to log your sets, adjust missed reps, and edit the weight you actually lifted. Track weighted, bodyweight, timed, and distance exercises. Pause when you need to and pick up an unfinished workout after reopening the app. A completion summary shows what you did and what comes next.

PROGRESS WITH A PLAN
Let successful sessions move your targets forward. Configure linear or double progression, increments, rep ranges, and deloads. Keep separate targets for the same exercise in different custom workouts, while the Classic program shares progression across Workout A and B.

BUILD TRAINING THAT FITS YOU
Create custom workouts, choose exercises from the searchable library, save favorites, and add your own exercises. Reusable accessory templates make it easier to keep groups such as Arms or Core consistent across workouts. Customize equipment and train in pounds or kilograms.

SPEND LESS TIME DOING GYM MATH
Use rest timers and optional alerts, plan warm-up sets, and calculate plates for the bar and denominations you have available. Equipment-aware rounding helps you choose weights you can actually load.

SEE THE STRENGTH YOU ARE BUILDING
Review workout history, personal records, top sets, estimated one-rep max, training volume, and consistency. Filter progress to explore your lifts over time, and chart body weight alongside your strength.

CONNECT APPLE HEALTH—IF YOU WANT
Optionally import body-weight measurements and save completed strength workouts, estimated active energy, and body weight to Apple Health. The app works without Health access.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR RECORDS
Your app database stays on your iPhone. Export workout history as CSV or save a JSON copy of your app data. No developer backend, advertising, or tracking. Apple Health and device backups follow their own settings. JSON restore is not included in this version.

FREE FOREVER
Every included feature is available without a subscription, in-app purchase, or paywall.

5x5 Roadmap is a training log and planning tool. Calorie and one-rep-max values are estimates. Train within your abilities.

Support: cp@roadmap.golf

name: 842Games
description:
842Games is a party game hub for a room full of people. Put one screen on the TV, a laptop or an iPad, and everybody else joins from their phone with a four-letter room code or by scanning the QR code. No accounts, no sign-ups.

THE GAMES
• Quiz Blitz: ten questions, fastest correct answer scores most, streaks multiply and the last question pays double. Over 7,000 questions across 14 categories, from football and Afrobeats to science, film and history.
• Charades: the room splits into small groups and every group acts at once, racing through prompts.
• Karaoke Clash: a song goes up and somebody carries the hook from memory. The room scores it.
• Tic Tac Toe: a duel on the big screen, or one player against the computer.
• 18+ night: Filthy Cards and Truth or Dare, for adults only, when the host picks the 18+ room.

BUILT FOR A FULL HOUSE
• Up to 100 players in one room.
• Your phone is your controller: a private answer pad, your score and your turn.
• Quiz seasons: ten quizzes make a season, with a running table and a champion.
• All-time leaderboard: every scored game counts. See where you rank and share it.

MADE FOR PHONES
• Scan the QR code on the big screen with the built-in scanner to join instantly.
• Haptic feedback for right and wrong answers.
• Your screen stays awake while you play, so you never drop out mid-round.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open 842Games on the big screen and tap Start a room. Pick Chill or 18+.
2. Everyone else joins on their phone with the room code.
3. The first player picks a game, and the night begins.

The host chooses the content rating. Chill rooms are clean enough for the family; 18+ games only appear in rooms the host marks as 18+.

name: 87 Family
description:
87 Family is a private, invitation-only home for one family. Only people the family approves can sign in, and nothing you share is ever public.

Stay in touch
• Family and private chats with photos, videos, files, voice messages and reactions
• Voice and video calls, and Family Meetings everyone can join from home
• Family news and announcements, with comments

Remember together
• A family tree you can explore generation by generation
• The family Archive: meeting recordings with transcripts, documents and stories
• The family calendar with birthdays, reunions and meetings

Built for families
• Parents and family administrators set who can see and do what
• Posting rules everyone agrees to before posting
• Report messages, posts or people to the family's administrators, and block anyone you don't want to hear from
• Delete your account at any time from the app

Private by design
• No ads, no tracking, no selling of data
• Your family's information stays on the family's own server
• The family's AI helper runs on that server too; your questions are not sent to outside AI companies

87 Family needs an account from your family. If your family uses 87 Family, ask your family administrator for an invitation.

name: A2 Takeoff Calc
description:
A construction calculator that speaks feet, inches and fractions, with quick takeoffs you can see: a dimensioned floor plan, a wall-by-wall drawing and a 3D view of what you're building.

FEET, INCHES AND FRACTIONS
Type it the way you say it: 5' 3 1/2" + 2' 10 3/4" = 8' 2 1/4". Areas and volumes come out in square feet, square yards, cubic feet or cubic yards. Squares, cubes and roots, parentheses, a tape of everything you worked out, and memory letters A to F. Round to 1/16", 1/8" or whatever you work to.

STUD WALLS
Lay out walls one after another, turning left or right, with doors and windows. Get full-height studs, kings, jacks, headers, cripples, sills and plates, a cut list and what to buy in stock lengths. Drag a window along the wall and watch it reframe.

BLOCK WALLS AND GROUT
Grout for a CMU wall, solid or cells at a spacing, with the cells at corners, wall ends and each side of every door and window. Lintels over openings, either lintel block grouted with the wall or formed and poured, shown as their own concrete. Block count too.

CONCRETE
Slabs, footings, walls, beams, columns and round piers, with waste and pump loss, rounded up to what you order.

SEE IT
Every takeoff has a dimensioned plan (tap a wall to edit it) and a 3D view you can turn and zoom.

CONVERSIONS
Lengths, areas and volumes between imperial and metric.

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no account, no tracking. Nothing you enter leaves your device. A2 Calc is open source under the MIT license.

Use at your own risk: these are estimates. Check every quantity against the plans and with your supplier before you order or bid.

name: Access Ability: Ambient Rain+
seller_name: CLEAR SKY MUSIC AND SOUND THERAPEUTICS, LLC
description:
Access Ability: Ambient Rain+ combines adjustable rain sounds, atmospheric visuals, and optional camera-based hand controls.

Shape your experience with five controls:
• Rain — adjust the rain level.
• Surface — explore different rain textures.
• Tone — shift the sound’s tonal character.
• Thunder — add adjustable thunder.
• Color — explore different noise colors.

Use touch controls, or enable the camera to interact through hand movement. Move between control rows, bring the tracking circle to a slider handle, and move left or right to adjust it. Hold over Play or Stop for one second to control playback.

Personalize the visuals with lightning and rainbow toggles and adjustable brightness. Choose a session timer to fade out the sound after 5, 10, 15, 30, or 60 minutes.

Camera access is optional. Camera images and hand-tracking results are processed on your device and are not sent to us. No account is required.

Designed for sensory exploration by individuals, parents, and educators. Start at a comfortable listening volume and adjust the experience to individual preferences. This app is not a diagnostic or treatment tool.

name: After You: Journal
description:
After You is a journal for people who miss the feeling of writing.

Open it and you're already on today's page. There's no list to get through, no title to think of, no prompts or streaks. Each day has one page.

INK THAT DRIES
New letters go on bright blue and settle to blue-black, the way fountain pen ink does. The controls fade while you type, and the line you're on stays at one height while the page moves up behind it.

SPEAK WHEN WRITING WON'T COME
Tap Speak and your words appear on the page as you talk. Your voice is kept right above them, so you can read it, edit it, or hear it again.

PHOTOS ON THE PAGE
Add a photo from your library or camera, and carry on writing below it.

YOUR WRITING STAYS YOURS
- No account and no sign-up
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics
- We run no server, and we can't read your journal
- Optional lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
- Syncs through your own iCloud

KEEP A COPY
Keep your whole journal as one file, with your pages as plain text that opens anywhere, and put them back whenever you need to.

COMING FROM APPLE JOURNAL?
Bring your entries with you. They land on their original dates.

SIMPLE BY CHOICE
Autocorrect and spell check start off, so your words stay exactly as you typed them. Turn them on if you like.

After You works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

name: Agagos
description:
Agagos is the catalogue of Græy Witness: an AI-generated music project, humanly initiated, curated and taken responsibility for.

Five bænds, five doors into the same Kathædra:
• RÆGILD – melodic and progressive metal
• Sermon on Vinyl – folk, cinematic, industrial
• Elphemia – quiet and personal
• Corbula – experiments
• Sun Ønion – Thai, Hindi, Mongolian and instrumentals

What the app does:
• Every album with credits, cover art and tracks – streamed straight from the Internet Archive
• Lyrics for almost every song, in about thirty languages, from English and German to Thai, Latin, Greek and Swiss German
• Bible references: from a passage to every song that carries it
• Verse of the day – a Bible verse every day with the songs that carry it, in German and English
• Themes and neighbourhoods to discover something new – reshuffled every day if you like
• Search by title, number, lyric line and sound
• Song infos: how a song came to be
• Bookmark what you want to hear again, and find what you played recently
• Take it offline – whole albums, downloaded in the background
• For iPhone, iPad and Mac

No sign-in, no ads, no data about you. What you bookmark and download stays on your device.

The app itself speaks German for now; an English interface is on its way. The lyrics are in their own languages.

name: Agendo.
description:
Agendo is a simple personal appointment diary for beauty professionals: nail technicians, lash and brow artists, hairdressers and anyone who works by appointment.

Everything stays on your iPhone. There is no account, no sign-in and no server, and the app collects no data.

WHAT YOU GET
• Today: all of the day's appointments at a glance
• Calendar: a month view with the number of appointments on each day
• Quick booking: client, service, date, time, price and notes
• Your own list of services with prices, icons and colours
• Reminders from your phone, from 15 minutes to a day before an appointment. They come only to you, never to your clients
• Export and import of all your data in a file you keep
• Six languages: English, Ukrainian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish and Arabic

SUBSCRIPTION
The first 7 days in the app are free, with no card required. After that, full access needs Agendo Pro:
• Monthly: $1.99 per month
• Yearly: $14.99 per year
These are US prices. The App Store shows the price in your currency before you buy.

Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm the purchase, even during the free days. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

Without a subscription you can still see today's and tomorrow's appointments and export all your data. Your data is never deleted.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://beautyapp800-ctrl.github.io/agendo-legal/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://beautyapp800-ctrl.github.io/agendo-legal/privacy/

name: Alaish: Motorcycle Loops
description:
Good roads. One loop. Home for tea.

Alaish plans motorcycle loops. Tell it where you're starting and how far or how long you fancy riding, and it plots a round trip that brings you back where you began. No routes to draw and no waypoints to drag.

PLAN THE LOOP
• Start from where you are, or touch and hold the map to start somewhere else.
• Pick a distance: 50, 80, 120 or 160 km, or step it in 10 km. Or pick a riding time from 1 to 4 hours.
• Choose the feel of the ride: Flowing, Twisty or Quiet roads.
• Alaish keeps you off motorways, rides round towns rather than through them, and gets you out of big cities first.
• Favour smaller roads and skip ferries if you'd rather.
• The route comes first, so your loop is usually on the map in seconds.

RIDE IT
Mount the phone and tap Start ride. The controls fade away and a dark, glanceable map takes over: the loop in mustard, your position, the next turn in big type and the distance left. Wander off the loop and Alaish tells you, then shows you the way back.

MADE FOR GLOVES
• Every button is at least 56 points, with room between them so you hit the one you meant.
• No keyboard. Distance and time are presets and a plus and minus.
• Ending a ride takes a deliberate second tap, so a bump in the road never stops your route.
• Follows your iPhone's light or dark appearance.

BIKER SPOTS
Turn on the Biker spots layer to see hand-picked bike cafes, meet spots and bike shops in South East England. It's off until you want it, so your route loads first.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS
• Free, with no ads and no account to make.
• Maps and places come from OpenStreetMap, mapped by people who ride and walk these roads. Routes come from Valhalla.
• Planning a new loop needs a signal. Your last loop stays on the phone, so it's still there when the signal drops in the hills.
• Biker spots aren't checked every day. Check opening hours, parking and access before you set off.
• Set the phone up before you ride, and keep your eyes on the road.

MEET ALAISH
The app is named after a rider who always finds the good bit. He'd rather take the long way round, stop for a proper coffee and still be home for tea. Look out for the mustard bags.

Alaish is in early access and we read every message. Tell us what worked and what didn't: our email is on the support page linked below.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: AlcheTile: Alchemy Puzzle
description:
A little alchemy. One thoughtful move.

Begin with a drop of dew and discover a world of elements. AlcheTile is a sliding merge puzzle played on a 4×4 board. Bring matching elements together, plan around obstacles and see what your next move can create.

MERGE AND DISCOVER
Swipe in four directions to combine matching elements. Merge several pairs in one move for a combo bonus. Discover twelve tiers of elements and their short stories, then keep playing beyond the twelfth-tier milestone.

MAKE EVERY TOOL COUNT
Frozen tiles and wild catalysts join the board after you reach 500 points. Use Undo, Hammer and Swap strategically: each tool has a limited number of uses per game.

FIND YOUR FAVORITE ATMOSPHERE
Choose from five free scenes: the alchemist's study, glowing forest, celestial observatory, lava forge and tranquil sakura garden. Adjust music, sound effects and haptics, and choose a light or dark appearance.

PAUSE AND PICK UP LATER
Progress saves automatically after completed actions. The core game works offline and needs no account. Designed for iPhone and iPad, with VoiceOver actions for accessible play.

OPTIONAL REWARDS, YOUR CHOICE
Download and play for free. When eligible, choose a rewarded video for a refill or revival. An optional one-time Play Pass lets you claim those rewards without videos, within the same per-game limits. It does not change starting tools, tile probabilities or reward limits. All five existing scenes are free. Videos, purchases and restoration require an internet connection; ad availability varies by region and network.

A small board. A new discovery.

The game interface and element stories are currently available in Simplified Chinese.

name: Alongside Bible
description:
Alongside is a simple, quiet Bible reader for people who want to understand what they read, not just get through it.

READ IN TWO LANGUAGES
• The full Chinese Union Version (和合本) and the Berean Standard Bible, built in and fully offline
• Read Chinese, English, or both verse by verse
• Made for readers whose first language is Chinese, and anyone reading across the two

PLAIN WORDS, SIDE BY SIDE
• Turn any chapter into a plain-language retelling in Chinese and English
• Read the original and the plain version paragraph by paragraph, or either one on its own
• Every verse is covered: nothing skipped, nothing added
• Short notes explain hard words, and one open question helps you pause and think

TALK IT THROUGH
• Ask about a verse or share a thought, and get a calm, honest reply about this chapter
• Tap any verse to bring it into the discussion
• Uses your own Anthropic (Claude) or OpenAI API key, stored only in your iPhone's Keychain
• Always asks before sending anything to an AI service. Private notes are never sent

MAKE IT YOURS
• Tap a verse to highlight it in four colours or write a short note
• Bookmarks, chapter notes, and a Marks page to find everything again
• Search words in both translations, or jump straight to a reference like John 3:16

A LITTLE EVERY DAY
• Reading plans: the whole Bible in a year, the New Testament in 90 days, the Gospels in 30 days, and Job to Ecclesiastes in 60 days
• Streaks and a daily reminder that lists today's chapters
• Swipe to turn chapters; mark a chapter read and keep going

COMFORTABLE TO READ
• Light and dark modes with nine colour palettes, from paper white to pure black
• Choose your reading font, including Kai and Song styles, and your text size

ON IPHONE AND MAC
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email to sync progress, notes, highlights, plans and plain versions between devices
• Everything works without an account too
• Share your plain versions with friends so they can read offline

A NOTE ON AI
Plain versions and discussions are AI-assisted. They are not a Bible translation or an authoritative interpretation. Alongside is meant to help you read and think for yourself, not to replace Scripture, prayer, or your community.

Made by Leonard. Love from the Father.

name: ALPEVISION Drone Arcade
description:
Fly your drone above the night city. Take off, load the cargo, clear the authorization gates, answer the flight quiz and deliver safely.

• 100 missions across 5 chapters, from your first delivery to the Hall of Fame
• 12 drones and 10 accessory licences
• An authorization quiz at every clearance gate
• Delivery Rush: endless drops with rising speed
• Missions 1-50 are free, no account required, works offline

Simple arcade controls: the stick steers, the arrows set your altitude, boost gets you there faster.

Every delivery has a time limit, a clearance gate to open with a quiz and a drop zone to hit precisely. The faster and cleaner you fly, the more credits you earn. Spend them on new drones and licences in the hangar, or unlock the whole career at once with the Pro Pilot Pass.

Night skyline, city lights, rotor noise: a pick-up-and-play flight arcade built for short sessions and long careers.

name: Alpin Club: Hike, Run, Ride
description:
Alpin Club is your companion for hiking, running and cycling. Plan a route, find marked trails near you, head out and record every step – with offline maps and real 3D terrain.

PLAN YOUR ROUTE
• Tap the map to draw a route for hiking, mountaineering, running, cycling, mountain biking or road/gravel
• See distance, time, ascent, elevation profile, surfaces and way types
• Out-and-back and loop routes, waypoints you can drag and move
• Save your routes and edit them any time

FIND TRAILS
• Thousands of marked hiking and cycling trails from OpenStreetMap, worldwide
• Public tours shared by the community
• Filter by length, level and loops

MAPS THAT WORK OFFLINE
• Topographic, satellite and cycling maps, hiking and MTB overlays, ski slopes and hillshade
• Download any area or the surroundings of a route and navigate without signal

SEE IT IN 3D
• Real terrain in 3D: tilt, rotate and fly along your route before you go

RECORD AND NAVIGATE
• GPS recording with the screen off, with distance, time, pace and climb
• Turn-by-turn navigation with voice guidance and off-route alerts
• Compass and heading-up map
PEAK FINDER
• Point your camera at the mountains and see their names, heights and distances

COMMUNITY
• Follow friends, like and comment on tours, share beautiful cards and route videos
• Monthly challenges and badges, a monthly leaderboard and your summit collection
• Create group hikes and invite friends with a link or QR code

PRIVACY FIRST
• Choose who sees each tour: only you, your followers or everyone
• Hide the start and end of your tours so your home stays private
• Photo location data is removed before upload
• We never sell your data

name: AltarPage: Live Prayer
description:
AltarPage brings your church or prayer altar's live broadcasts, prayer and giving together in one quiet app.

FOR MEMBERS
• Pray with someone, right now. See who is live and who starts soon, in your own time zone.
• Listen live without signing up, on any phone.
• Send a prayer request, share a testimony or tell your church you gave your life to Christ, while you listen.
• Give straight to your church: copy its own account number into your bank app, or give by card.
• Follow your church and get a quiet alert when it goes live. Alerts stay quiet at night unless you choose night vigils.
• Missed it? Listen again: every broadcast becomes a replay you can share.

FOR PASTORS AND MEDIA TEAMS
• Go live from your phone with one button. Lock the screen and keep broadcasting; the recording is made as you go.
• Already on YouTube or Mixlr? Keep it. AltarPage shows you as live and gathers prayer, giving and responses around it.
• See prayer requests, new believers and gifts arrive while you are live.
• After every broadcast, a summary: who listened, who responded and what was given.
• Your follow-up team gets an alert within minutes when someone gives their life to Christ, with their number ready.
• Post the daily word and share it as a WhatsApp Status picture in your colours.

Your ministry's website lives at yourname.altarpage.com, or your own web address. Broadcasting from a laptop and a mixing desk? AltarPage Studio for Mac and Windows is at altarpage.com/desktop.

Made in Lagos by Growth Figures Limited. We read every message: hello@altarpage.com.

name: ALTER: Fitness RPG
description:
ALTER turns your workouts into an RPG. You are your hero: every real workout gives it XP, levels and new gear.

• Log workouts — sets, reps and weights
• Earn XP and level up
• Watch your 3D hero grow
• Unlock new outfit designs as you progress
• Complete quests and earn achievements
• Track stats by muscle group
• Add friends, create groups and share your level cards
• Workout reminders

No registration required. Email login is only used to sync progress between devices.

Note: the app is currently available in Russian. English version is coming soon.

name: Alterna: Shift Calendar
description:
Alterna is the shift calendar for the person who works the shifts. Note down your own schedule in seconds, see who works with you and swap shifts with colleagues, without your employer having to set anything up.

YOUR SHIFTS, FAST
• Your own shift types: name, abbreviation, hours and split shifts
• Morning, Afternoon, Night, Split and Day off ready to go, and you can edit them
• Tap a day to set its shift, or use quick edit to fill several days in a row
• Copy a week or apply a repeating pattern: the same week, alternating weeks or day cycles such as 2-2-2-4
• Save your patterns ("Winter", "Summer") and apply them again in two taps
• Change the hours of a single day and add a note

A CALENDAR YOU WANT TO OPEN
• Month, week and list views
• One colour per category, which you can change; the abbreviation is always shown too
• Reminders before each shift
• Widgets: next shift and your week, on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen
• Works offline: your shifts are always there, even without signal

GROUPS WITH YOUR COLLEAGUES
• Create a group and invite people with a code
• See who works each day and in which shift, with your own row on top
• Find who works with you and who is off the same day as you
• Your notes are hidden from the group by default; pause sharing or leave whenever you want
• Nobody sees your custom colours

SWAPS
• Offer one of your shifts for a colleague's, or give a shift away
• Alterna only offers swaps that work: each person must be off the day they receive
• Your colleague accepts or declines; nothing changes until they accept
• Notifications for requests received, accepted or declined
• A swap is an agreement between colleagues and may need your employer's approval

IPHONE AND IPAD
• Adapts to any screen: sidebar and split views on iPad

ACCOUNT AND PRIVACY
• Use it without an account: your shifts stay on your device
• For groups and swaps, sign in with Apple or Google. No passwords of our own
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking, and we never sell your data
• Delete your account from the app whenever you want

Optional tips in Settings support the developer. They unlock nothing.

name: Ambit: Chat Where You Are
description:
Ambit is group chat that belongs to a place.

A music night in the park, a farmers market, a stadium, a campus: each has its own conversation, pinned to the ground it happens on. Open Ambit, see the groups around you, and talk with the people who are actually there.

PUBLIC GROUPS, IN PERSON
Public groups are joined in person. Walk into a group's circle on the map and tap Join. When you leave, you drop out half an hour later, so the people in a public group are the people actually there.

PRIVATE GROUPS FOR FRIENDS
Start a private group at a spot and share its code, or approve people who ask. Members chat from anywhere, and messages sent from afar are marked Remote. Only members can see what's said.

SEE WHO'S HERE
Each group shows who is here now, who is active from elsewhere, and who is offline. In a public group, only people who are there too, and your friends, can see that you're there. Turn off "Show me as here" and only your friends can.

EXPLORE ANYWHERE
Browse the groups near you on the map, or search any place in the world to see what's happening there before you go.

FRIENDS
Tap someone's name to add them as a friend. Friends are tagged in every chat, so you can spot them in a crowd.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• For adults 18 and over
• Messages are checked before they're posted
• Press and hold any message to report it or block its author; reports are reviewed by a person
• Delete your account at any time from the You tab
• Your location is used only while the app is open, and we don't keep a history of where you've been

Ambit needs your location to show the groups around you and to let you join public ones.

Terms: https://helloambit.com/terms
Privacy: https://helloambit.com/privacy
Help: https://helloambit.com/support

name: Ampfolio: Power Scenarios
description:
Plan your power. See the whole day.

Ampfolio: Power Scenarios helps you plan when devices run, compare daily schedules and understand estimated energy use and electricity costs. Built for households, market stall owners and small studios, it brings your devices, schedules and assumptions into one place.

PLAN YOUR DAY
Build a daily timeline for your devices. Drag and resize planned runs, set exact start times and durations, and explore how overlapping use changes the modeled peak load.

COMPARE THE POSSIBILITIES
Create alternative scenarios and compare peak running power, energy use and estimated cost. See what changes when you stagger device start times or adjust how long equipment runs.

BUILD YOUR DEVICE LIBRARY
Keep device input ratings, supply connections, notes and nameplate photos together. Record where values came from and reuse devices across scenarios within a project.

UNDERSTAND ENERGY AND COST
Estimate daily energy use using constant input, measured average or duty-cycle assumptions. Enter your own flat or time-of-use electricity rates and explore cost estimates for repeated model days.

KEEP ASSUMPTIONS VISIBLE
Review missing inputs and calculation assumptions. Unknown values stay visible, helping you understand what each estimate is based on.

EXPORT AND KEEP YOUR WORK
Export PDF summaries, import and export device CSV files, and back up or restore projects using JSON files.

FREE AND OFFLINE
All features are permanently free. No advertising, subscriptions, in-app purchases or account required. Work offline on iPhone and iPad, with projects stored locally on your device.

Start with the included sample project or build your own plan from scratch.

ABOUT THE ESTIMATES
Ampfolio: Power Scenarios is a planning tool, not a live electricity meter, device controller or electrical safety certification tool. Results depend on the values and assumptions you enter. Daily plans use a repeating 24-hour model. Cost estimates include entered variable energy charges and exclude fixed fees, taxes and demand charges. Use a qualified professional for electrical installation and safety decisions.

name: Amplify: Live Music Booking
description:
Amplify plans, books and protects your live-entertainment programme — from recurring nights with performers you trust, to last-minute cover when someone can't make it.

FOR VENUES & BOOKERS
Keep the performers you already trust. Amplify organises your schedule around your own roster first — a fixed fee, never a bidding war, never a public applicant count. Expand to a wider network only when you choose to.

• Plan a recurring programme with a clear budget, set once
• Invite your roster directly — no public listing required
• See a performer's track record before you book: completed gigs, repeat bookings, reliability
• Run every venue from one dashboard — add colleagues to help manage bookings, never locked to a single login
• One flat subscription per venue; artist fees, processing and any booker fee always itemised separately

FOR MUSICIANS, BANDS & ENTERTAINERS
Whatever you perform — band, solo act, DJ, fire performer, dancer or novelty act — manage your existing work and receive relevant, limited invitations from suitable venues. Always free, forever.

• No bidding, no endless application piles
• See your full fee before accepting — no percentage ever taken by Amplify
• Manage acts, line-ups and substitutes, including gigs booked outside Amplify
• Can't make it? Share the gig yourself with a real public link — even someone who's never used Amplify can cover it
• Payout released within 24 hours of the venue confirming the gig's done — often the same night

AUTOPILOT
Set your weekly budget and preferences once. Amplify's rules-based scheduling — never a black box — proposes your week using your approved performers first, checks availability and budget, avoids repetition, and shows exactly why each performer was recommended. Approve it in one tap.

AMPLIFY COVER
A band member drops out, or a whole act cancels. Amplify captures the reason, checks trusted substitutes, then your roster, then a small trusted-cover network — and confirms cover fast. The line-up, Gig Pack and payment split update automatically. No cancellation needed.

ORIGINAL & TICKETED EVENTS
Running a one-off, publicly ticketed night? Amplify handles the roster-first booking, a guaranteed fixed fee and a protected payment, with a public listing once confirmed. Amplify never sells tickets itself — list them externally and just share the link.

TRANSPARENT, PROTECTED PAYMENTS
Digital bookings settle through Stripe with the split handled automatically; cash-on-the-night bookings are tracked and confirmed by both sides. Performer fee, Amplify's fee and processing costs are itemised every time — nobody's guessing what the venue pays or what a musician takes home.

PRICING
Musicians and bands: always free. Venues: a 30-day free trial, then Amplify Core or Amplify Pro (adds Autopilot and multi-venue management) — one flat monthly subscription per venue, cancel anytime.

Currently piloting in Belfast.

name: Anatovus
description:
Anatovus is a colorful comparative biology studio for students and teachers who want more than a single human anatomy model.

Explore layered virtual dissections of frogs, earthworms, starfish, pigs, and plant tissue. Each specimen includes organ-layer explanations, habitat context, and homology notes that help you compare structures across animal phyla and plant systems.

Open Life Lab to step through dynamic simulations of mitosis, meiosis, photosynthesis, and cellular respiration. Advance stage by stage or use autoplay to visualize sequences for class discussion and independent study.

Use the Compare tab to place systems side by side—hearts, nerve cords, digestive plans, support structures, and gas exchange—so learners can separate evolutionary homology from analogous solutions.

Reinforce learning with classroom quizzes on structures, cell division, and energy pathways. Scores and progress are saved locally on your device. No account is required.

Anatovus also includes English and Swedish interface languages, bookmarks, a welcome orientation, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and an in-app support contact. Built for educational clarity, offline-friendly study, and complete App Store readiness.

name: Anekant: Jain Panchang
description:
Anekant is a Jain panchang for the city you live in, whether that is Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Leicester or New Jersey. Sunrise, sunset, and every Pachchakkhan time are calculated for your place.

TODAY AT A GLANCE 
• The Jain tithi, Sud or Vad, the Gujarati month, Vir Samvat and Vikram Samvat 
• Parva tithis, with "No green vegetables today" when it applies 
• Navkarsi, Porisi, Sadha Porisi, Purimaddha, Avaddha and Chovihar, with the time left to the next one 
• Today's observances and the next parva • Nakshatra, yoga, karana and Choghadiya

CALENDAR AND PARV 
• A month calendar with the Jain tithi on every day, and the parva, kshaya and vriddhi days marked 
• Paryushan, Navpad Oli, Diwali, Chaturmas and other observances for the year 
• The kalyanaks of the 24 Tirthankaras 
• Rohini Vrat, and Pushya and Rohini nakshatra days

REMINDERS 
• Navkarsi, and Chovihar up to an hour before 
• The evening before a parva tithi 
• A week before and the eve of Paryushan, the Olis and Diwali 
• Kalyanaks

WIDGET 
• The tithi, Navkarsi and Chovihar on the home screen and the lock screen, for the whole week

SADHANA 
• The Navkar Mantra with its meaning 
• A Navkarwali counter of 108 beads, with a gentle tap on each bead

MADE FOR DAILY USE 
• English, Gujarati and Hindi 
• Light and dark modes, with three colour themes 
• Works offline: the panchang is calculated on your phone 
• No account and no ads

The tithis follow the Tapagachha tradition and are checked against published Jain panchangs. More traditions will be added, each once it has been checked against its own panchang.

name: Animation Maker Pro
description:
Bring your ideas to life with Animation Maker—a drawing, animation, and audio studio for iPad. One purchase. No subscription.

LESS REDRAWING. MORE STORYTELLING.
Traditional frame-by-frame animation often means drawing the same character again and again. With Animation Maker, build a library of poses and reuse them throughout your story. Choose a pose, place it on the timeline, and change it when the action changes. Spend more time on timing, expression, and storytelling, with less repetitive drawing.

SMART DRAWING TOOLS
• Draw your own characters, poses, backgrounds, and objects.
• Turn rough strokes into clean lines, rectangles, circles, and ellipses with Smart Shapes.
• Use pressure-aware Apple Pencil drawing on compatible devices.
• Select, resize, rotate, flip, and copy your artwork.
• Remove a solid-color background with adjustable tolerance.
• Match your drawing pad to your project, or switch between landscape 16:9 and portrait 9:16.
• Work quickly with two-finger undo, three-finger redo, and customizable keyboard shortcuts.

BUILD THE ACTION
• Add frames and arrange your story on a visual timeline.
• Use automatic tweening for object movement, scale, rotation, and opacity between keyframes.
• Reuse poses without the free edition's frame or pose limits.
• Add backgrounds and objects, frame the action with camera controls, and use onion skin to plan your next move.
• Copy, paste, flip, and delete selected scene objects.
• Use Apple Pencil to work with the scene and scrub the timeline.

GIVE YOUR STORY A VOICE
• Get ready with a three-second countdown, then record your narration.
• Let the timeline extend to fit your recording.
• Import music and audio, split and cut clips, and adjust their placement and volume.
• Keep control of your sound with manual volume adjustments, mute, and solo.

SAVE AND SHARE
• Export your animation as an MP4 video and save it directly to Photos with your permission.
• Keep projects on your device and export portable project files with their media.
• Choose an iCloud Drive folder for project backups.
• Create with the built-in studio without an account or an internet connection. iCloud backups require your iCloud account and connectivity.

No subscription. No ads. No artificial frame or pose caps in the paid edition. Practical project size depends on your device's memory and available storage.

Apple Pencil features require compatible hardware. Microphone and Photos permissions are requested when you use recording or save a video.

Questions or feedback? deciferthis13@gmail.com

name: AP Customs Time Tracking
description:
AP Custom Time Tracking is the time clock for the AP Custom Contracting crew.

FOR EMPLOYEES
• Pick your job and clock in with one tap
• Switch jobs during the day without any gaps or overlaps
• Clock out at any time
• See today's hours and what you've earned as you go
• Review your week: every shift, every job, overtime and holiday pay
• Forgot to clock in or out? Send a correction request to your employer
• Works with no signal: punches are saved on your phone and uploaded when you're back online

FOR THE OWNER
• See who is working right now, on which job, and for how long
• Timesheets by week or month, with hours, overtime and pay for each employee
• See where each shift was clocked in and out, and get flagged when someone clocks out far from where they started
• Edit or add shifts, and approve or deny correction requests
• Set a pay rate for each employee on each job, plus overtime and public-holiday rules per job
• Export timesheets as a PDF or spreadsheet for one employee or the whole crew
• A permanent activity log of every change

TRUSTWORTHY BY DESIGN
• Times come from the company's server clock, not the phone's
• Employees can only see their own hours and pay
• Every change an employer makes is recorded

This app is for AP Custom Contracting employees. Accounts are created by your employer.

name: Aperture Lab Cinema
description:
Aperture Lab Cinema は、マルチカム撮影時のカメラ間の露出差（EV）を瞬時に計算し、完全に一致させるためのプロフェッショナル向け露出計算ユーティリティです。

映画制作、CM、MV撮影の現場で「AカメとBカメの露出をどう合わせるか」というシネマトグラファーの悩みを、極めてシンプルかつ正確に解決します。不要な機能を削ぎ落とし、現場での「即時性」と「正確性」に特化しました。

【主な特徴】
・Aカメ / Bカメ のEV差分計算：
IRIS、NDフィルター、ISO、シャッターアングル（またはスピード）、FPSを個別に設定し、2台のカメラ間の露出差を自動計算します。

・シネマスタンダード・パラメータ：
映画制作で必須となる「シャッターアングル」での計算や、「ND 0.3〜3.0」などの詳細なフィルター値に対応。直感的なホイール操作で素早く設定可能です。

・パーソナライズ可能なUI：
ベースISOのカラーハイライト設定や、不要な数値（使わないF値など）の非表示機能により、あなた自身のワークフローに最適化されたツールにカスタマイズできます。

・ダークモード特化の高視認性UI：
暗いスタジオ内やナイトシーンのロケでも眩しくなく、かつ直射日光下でも視認性を失わない、計算し尽くされたハイコントラスト・ダークデザインを採用。

【PRO版（全機能解放）について】
アプリ内課金（買い切り）またはリワード広告の視聴により、以下のPRO機能が解放されます。
- 1/3段刻みの精密なパラメータコントロール（無料版は1-Stop刻みのみ）
- FPS設定（ハイスピード撮影等の計算など）

現場のノイズを排除し、露出の計算をAperture Lab Cinemaに任せることで、あなたは「ライティング」と「構図」という最も重要なクリエイティブに集中できます。

name: Apex Match Day
description:
Every kid plays. You can prove it.

Apex Match Day runs your sideline: who's on, who has sat longest, and when it's time to rotate. Equal minutes without a clipboard, a spreadsheet, or a parent asking why.

BUILT FOR THE FIFTEEN SECONDS YOU ACTUALLY HAVE
A substitution window is a throw-in and a shout. The match screen puts the pitch on top and the bench below, sorted by who has sat longest. Tap a bench player, tap who comes off, done.

NEVER MISS A ROTATION
Pick a reminder, like every 6 minutes of play. When it's due, the app rings and vibrates until you tap Got it or make the sub, even with the phone on silent. With the phone locked you still get the alert. The countdown pauses for breaks and restarts after each change.

A CLOCK THAT KNOWS YOUTH SOCCER
Halves or quarters, hydration breaks, and halftime, each one tap. Minutes only count while the ball is in play.

YOUR TEAM, SET UP IN A MINUTE
• Import the roster PDF or Excel file from your league, including GotSport. Only first names and numbers are kept.
• 5v5, 7v7, 9v9, and 11v11, with the formations coaches use: 2-3-1, 3-2-1, 3-3-2, 4-3-3, 4-4-2, 4-2-3-1 and more.
• Mark who can play keeper. The app proposes a starting lineup from who showed up.

REAL MATCHES ARE MESSY
• Late arrivals join from the bench.
• Injuries: take a player off with one hold. Time out injured is tracked separately, shown in red, and never counts against fairness.
• Goals for both sides, with the scorer.
• Undo the last tap.

MINUTES PARENTS CAN TRUST
After the whistle, see every player's minutes, goals, and injuries. Season totals add up across matches: record, goals, starts, keeper minutes, and each player's share of the time they were available, so a missed match doesn't look unfair.

YOURS, ON YOUR PHONE
No accounts. No server. No ads. No tracking. Your roster and matches stay on your phone and ride along with your normal backup. It works at fields with no signal.

One price. $4.99 buys the app. There's nothing inside it to unlock.

Made by Apex Digital Software, the studio behind Apex Soccer and Apex Rules of the Game.

name: Ari — Personal Assistant
description:
Ari is your personal assistant with a voice. Call her with one tap, from Siri or the Lock Screen, and just say what needs doing.

SHE CALLS YOU
Say "call me at 9 about the meeting" — at 9 Ari calls like a regular incoming call and tells you why. Morning briefings, reminders, important emails — on your schedule.

GETS THINGS DONE ON IPHONE
• Alarms and timers that ring like the system ones, with a countdown in the Dynamic Island
• Entries in Reminders and events in Calendar
• "Call mom", "text Ivan on WhatsApp…" — Ari finds the contact and prepares the call or message; you just tap
• Routes in Maps, your Shortcuts, the weather

REMEMBERS AND REACHES OUT
Ari remembers what you tell her and writes first when it's time — in the app or in Telegram.

MAIL AND CALENDAR
Connect Google Calendar and Gmail — Ari tells you what's on today and finds the email you need.

YOURS ONLY
Give Ari a name and pick a voice. Everyone gets their own Ari: nobody else sees your conversations or memory.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Ari's eyes in the Dynamic Island during a call
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• A "Call Ari" control for Control Center and the Action button
• Siri: "Call Ari", "Ask Ari…", "What's next"

YOU'RE IN CONTROL
Irreversible actions only with your confirmation. The microphone works only during a call; Ari asks for contacts and calendar access the moment it's needed. Delete your account and all data right in Settings.

name: Ashenvault.
description:
Step into the abandoned Ashen Vault. The old kingdom is gone, its Crown is shattered, and its gems lie scattered through ten depths of a dark, forgotten dungeon. The vault’s guardians never left their posts.
You are Mara, a relic hunter with a sword, a lantern and one quest: recover every gem, then escape alive.
FIGHT
Swing your sword and chain three quick hits for a heavy finisher
Dodge-roll through attacks, traps and boss charges with a burst of invincibility
Enemies flash red before they strike, so read the warning, roll away and counter
Skeletons hunt you, Brutes hit twice as hard, and ghosts drift through walls
SLAY THE GUARDIANS
Two massive bosses block the way out: the Bone Warden and the Hollow King. Dodge their ground slams and charges, punish them when they are stunned, and survive when they call for help.
YOUR QUEST
Every depth hides a set of gems. Find them all, defeat whatever guards the gate, and escape. The exit stays sealed until you do.
LIGHT IS EVERYTHING
Your lantern is your only light, and it burns oil. See farther and enemies spot you sooner, or stay dim and sneak in the shadows. Find oil flasks before the dark closes in.
GROW STRONGER
After clearing each depth, choose an upgrade:
Sword: hit harder
Heart: more health
Boots: roll, swing and run faster
Lantern: oil that lasts longer
FEATURES
10 dungeon depths that grow bigger and deadlier
Locked doors, iron keys and spike traps that move on a rhythm
Fog of war with a remembered map
Earn up to 3 stars per depth: escape, beat the par time, and take few hits
Simple controls: drag to move, tap to attack, tap to roll
Play fully offline, with no ads and no sign-in
Can you slay the guardians, recover the Crown and escape the Ashen Vault?

name: ASINET Field Tech
description:
ASINET Field is the field app for ASINET Inc. technicians.

- Sign in with the login your office gives you.
- See the jobs you are dispatched to today, with the address and scope.
- Clock in and out at the job; travel and on-site time are recorded for payroll.
- Attach photos of the completed work to the job.
- Fill in and sign the service report on the device.

An ASINET account is required. The app is for ASINET staff and does not offer sign-up.

name: ATL Fluid Art Staff
description:
ATL Fluid Art Staff is the studio-floor app for the staff of ATL Fluid Art, a fluid art studio in Atlanta. It is for ATL Fluid Art employees only. To book an experience at the studio, visit atlfluidart.com.
