Staff sign in with the email and password of their atlfluidart.com account. There is no sign-up in the app: the studio adds people to its staff roster, and the app turns other accounts away.

Bookings
• See a day's bookings and check guests in
• Reschedule a booking to an open time
• Add and remove attendees

Events
• See who holds tickets for an upcoming event and check them in

Art pieces
• Find customers' art pieces by Artwork ID, date, name, phone or email, and filter by status
• Add a booking's pieces and get each one's Artwork ID for its tag
• Move pieces through drying and resin to pickup, and text the customer when a piece is ready
• Photograph a piece or choose photos of it, and keep comments on its timeline

Gift cards
• Look up a gift card's balance and redeem it for an in-studio purchase

SMS marketing consent
• Search the history of customers' marketing text opt-ins and opt-outs (read only)

Customer details are shown only to signed-in staff, and photos of art pieces are kept in the studio's private storage. The app has no ads and no tracking.

ATL Fluid Art Staff is published by RuleCMS, LLC for ATL Fluid Art.

name: Atmo Radio
description:
Atmo Radio turns your iPhone into a calm, physical-feeling radio for listening to live stations from around the world.

TUNE LIKE A REAL RADIO
• Turn the tuning knob to move across FM, MW, SW and LW, or switch to NET for internet stations.
• Tactile keys, knob detents, haptics and subtle sounds respond to every touch.
• Tilt your phone and the keys, shadows and glass reflections shift with it.

FIND STATIONS WORLDWIDE
• Open the station book and spin the globe to browse stations by country and region.
• Save favorites and recall them with the favorites dial.
• Suggest a missing station or report a broken one right from the display.

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Background playback with Lock Screen and Control Center controls.
• Sleep timer that switches the radio off when you're ready to rest.
• Record the radio and its sound as a video to share. Recording never uses the microphone.
• Light and dark appearance with four backlight colors.
• Optional iCloud sync for favorites, history and preferences.

FREE TO TRY
Listen free for 15 minutes every day. Unlock unlimited listening with a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew monthly until canceled in your App Store account settings. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.

Stations are streamed directly from their broadcasters. Availability and content depend on each broadcaster and may change. A purchase unlocks app features and does not grant rights to any program content.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aitalkeric.github.io/atmo-radio/privacy.html

name: AVS: AutoViral Screen Stream
description:
AVS streams this iPhone's screen to your AutoViral iPhone Control Board.

The AutoViral iPhone Control Board is a small box that plugs into a stock iPhone over its USB cable. It types and taps on the phone the way a keyboard and mouse do, and it needs to see the screen to do that. AVS is the half that runs on the phone: it captures the display with iOS screen broadcasting and sends the video to the board over the cable. The board hands it to the AutoViral Driver on your computer, and from there to your AutoViral dashboard, where you watch and control the phone in your browser or through the AutoViral MCP.

Requires the AutoViral iPhone Control Board (sold separately) and an AutoViral account with the Driver installed on a computer on the same network as the board.

HOW IT WORKS
• Plug the board's USB cable into the iPhone.
• Open AVS, tap Start, then Start Broadcast.
• The status turns Active as soon as the board answers, and the app shows a small preview of what it is sending.
• Leave AVS. The broadcast keeps running behind other apps and on the lock screen.
• Stop it any time from the app or from the red status bar.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
• No account, sign-in or personal data on the phone.
• Nothing is recorded on the phone. The video goes to your own board, your own Driver and your own AutoViral account, nowhere else.
• The app does not control the phone. The board does that, as a plain USB keyboard and mouse.

Operators who run many phones can set a password for Stop and Settings, and can push settings with a mobile device management profile.

name: Awarenism
description:
An open self-help community for everyone, including anyone working through trauma or hard times in modern life.

Free, with no ads, install fee or paid features, and no subscription.

PRACTICE
Breathe in, breathe out. Live in the present moment. Write down your thought. A simple breathing meditation, with plain steps for beginners.

RELAX
Encouraging lines, with peaceful music or nature sounds such as rain, to rest with after a long day.

READ
Books to read in the app, starting with the Heart Sutra, with notes on the words until you can understand every word.

COMMUNITY
A place for peer support. Share your thoughts and situation as a Thread, anonymously or with a Nickname, and choose who can read it. Others read and leave Encouragement. An anonymous Thread doesn't show your name to other Members or Nomis. Unkind words are filtered, and volunteer Nomis review reports.

POSITIVE ENERGY
Positive Energy is the community's point. You earn it while the app is open on screen, and by sharing and encouraging. It opens up sharing and commenting. Energy from time in the app stops after one hour a day, so it never rewards long screen time.

Practice and Relax are open to everyone, with no account. Signing up and sharing are for ages 16 and over.

ABOUT US
Awarenism is an open community for everyone. It isn't a health service, and it doesn't target or ask about anyone's health. What you write in a Thread is your choice, and so is who can read it.

Disclaimer: We are not a religious organization, and we do not provide medical treatment for mental or physical health. We are only a supporting community, sharing our practices and encouraging others.

Reaching out to others for help, including outside this community, is always a good step: awarenism.com/en/help/

name: Back Seat Video Remote
description:
Long journeys with passengers in the back? Back Seat Video Remote turns the back-seat
iPad into a calm video player and your phone into its remote, so you never have to twist
round or pass a tablet back again.

HOW IT WORKS
• On the iPad in the back, choose Player and add your videos.
• On your phone up front, choose Remote and type the 4-digit code the iPad shows.
• Pick what plays, pause, skip, scrub and set the volume from the front seat.

PLAY FROM WHERE YOUR VIDEOS ALREADY ARE
• Link folders instead of copying: a folder on the iPad, iCloud Drive, or a USB-C drive
  or SD card, all through the Files app. Videos play where they are, so a drive full of
  films uses no space on the iPad.
• Link as many places as you like. The remote shows everything, or one place at a time.
• New videos added to a linked folder show up by themselves.
• Unplugged the drive? The videos stay listed and greyed out until it's back. If one was
  playing, it pauses and carries on from the same spot.
• Or copy videos onto the iPad, from Files or from your computer.

MADE FOR THE CAR
• Works anywhere: phone and iPad connect directly to each other. No Wi-Fi network,
  mobile signal or internet needed, and no data used.
• Big, fixed-position controls you can find at a glance.
• Up Next queue: line up the next few videos and the iPad plays them in order.
• Reconnects by itself after a dropout, a locked phone or an app switch.
• The iPad's controls fade away during a video, so stray taps don't land in settings,
  and switching roles asks first.

YOUR VIDEOS, YOUR DEVICES
• Plays the video files you add or link (MP4, MOV and M4V). It doesn't stream from video
  services.
• Videos stay on the iPad or the drive. Only titles and small thumbnails go to your
  phone.
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Nothing is collected.

One purchase. Use it on the iPad and the phone with the same Apple Account or with
Family Sharing.

Back Seat Video Remote is for passengers and for when you're parked. Please don't use
your phone while driving.

name: Bad Ink Tower
description:
An ink-drawn tower defends its scrap of paper against waves of scribbled monsters. It grimaces, coughs, spits cannonballs and never gives up. Your job: make it stronger, run after run.

A RUN IN SECONDS
Tap start and the tower shoots on its own. During the run, spend gold on damage, defense or income. When it falls, the ink you collected goes to the workshop, and the next run goes further.

BUILDS THAT FEEL DIFFERENT
• 30 run upgrades and as many in the workshop: double shot, ricochet, thorns, lifesteal, knockback, mines, interest…
• 8 ink weapons on cooldown, from the Black Blot to the Judgement Spotlight.
• Cards that fuse into evolutions, and boss pacts that give a lot in exchange for something.
• 36 lab research upgrades and modules with unique effects, no loot boxes.
Glass cannon, fortress, storm, control or farming: find a build that holds up.

HOLDS OUT ALL NIGHT
Put the tower in sleep mode before bed: it farms on its own, and you get a report when you wake up. Even without sleep mode, ink keeps flowing offline.

MONTHS OF PLAY
• 8 tiers, each guarded by its boss.
• 16 enemy families, and elites that punish over-specialized builds.
• Tier challenges, daily challenges and seasons.
• A tower sheet that shows every damage layer: no wiki needed.

FAIR AND CLEAR
No ads, no tracking. No purchase relies on chance. Everything that matters in play can be earned by playing.

The game is free, with optional in-app purchases.

Ink Club: optional one-month subscription, renewed automatically at the price shown in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.epacus.fr/en/bad-ink-tower/privacy/

name: Balla Auto Rent
description:
Balla Auto Rent: car rental in Budapest, all in one app.

Browse our cars, book a time slot and follow your rental from pickup to return. The app is made for customers of Balla Auto Rent. The rental company is BALLA AUTÓ KFT.

What you will find in the app:

• Fleet and booking: cars with detail pages, photos and daily rates by rental length. Choose the pickup and return time and place, then add extras and a CASCO package. You see the price quote right away.
• You can browse without signing in. You only need to sign in to send a booking, with Sign in with Apple, a Google account or your email address. Your ballaauto.hu account works here too.
• My rentals: booking status, time remaining, your contract and handover reports in one place. You can request an extension, and you can cancel a booking until pickup.
• Your own photos: take pictures of the car at pickup and at return. Photos are saved with a timestamp and location, so both sides have a record.
• Documents: upload your driving licence and your ID with your iPhone camera for a faster pickup. They are not required to book.
• Incident and breakdown report: a step-by-step guide through what to do. Add the location, photos, the people involved and police details. It works without a mobile signal, and the report is sent automatically later. The call button is always at hand.
• Notifications about changes to your booking, rental and reports.
• Manage additional drivers and billing details (private person or company).
• English, German and Hungarian interface for iPhone and iPad, with light and dark mode. Quick reopening with Face ID or Touch ID.

Payment and deposit: there is no online payment in the app. The rental fee and the deposit are handled at our office at pickup. Delivery in and around Budapest is arranged with you by our staff.

Contact: Balla Auto Rent, Táncsics Mihály u. 59, 1174 Budapest, Hungary. Phone: +36 70 801 0294. Web: ballaauto.hu

name: Banner of Ages: Match Duel
description:
Raise the banner and carry it through the ages of ancient Egypt.

Banner of Ages is a match-3 duel RPG. Every battle is a head-to-head duel: you and your rival take turns on the same board. Line up tiles to strike, heal, charge spells and earn rewards, while your opponent does the same.

THREE AGES, 150 BATTLES
• Narmer: The Two Lands. March north from Nekhen to the Delta marshes.
• Sneferu: Builder of Pyramids. Guard the frontiers while pyramids rise at Meidum and Dahshur.
• Mentuhotep II: The Reunifier. Fight the northern kings from Waset until the Two Lands are one again.
Each age has its own map, chapters and short story scenes drawn from history, with notes on what the records say.

EASY TO START
• Your first battle is guided step by step: what each tile does, how spells work, how the turn timer drains.
• New ideas are explained once, when you first meet them.
• After several losses in a row, the next battle can give you a boost (Help after losses, in Settings).

DUELS WITH A PLAN
• Axes hit, flasks heal, lightning fills your energy, coins and scrolls bring gold and experience.
• Line up four for an extra turn. Fire axes blow up the tiles around them.
• Bosses have signature moves. A card warns you when one is charging and tells you how to break it.

GEAR, SETS AND UPGRADES
• Chiefs drop gear the first time you beat them. Gear is never sold for money.
• Wear pieces of one set (Nekhen, Dahshur, Theban) for bonus power.
• Upgrade and hone gear with stones. Fill the bar and the upgrade is certain: no random upgrade rolls.

THE MONSTER DUNGEON
• Face the beasts of the desert and the river: cobras, jackals, Nile crocodiles, desert lions, giant scorpions and more.
• Up to 12 stages per run, with bosses at stages 4, 8 and 12. Stop between stages to bank your gold, or press on for more.

MORE TO DO
• A daily battle and Legend rematches for extra rewards.
• Plays offline. No account, no login, no chat.

LIVES AND PASSES
• Each battle costs one life, and a win gives it back. Lives refill over time.
• You can also refill lives with gold earned in the game, or watch an optional ad for one more.

IN-APP PURCHASES AND ADS
Banner of Ages is free to download. It offers optional in-app purchases:
• Gold packs (5 sizes)
• A gem pack (gems buy extra Monster Dungeon keys)
• Unlimited-lives passes (4 hours, 12 hours or 5 days)
All purchases are consumable and are not restored on a new device. Gear is never sold. The whole campaign can be finished without paying.

Ads are rewarded video ads only, and only when you choose to watch one for a reward (gold, a life, a revive, a dungeon key and similar). There are no banner ads and no ads that interrupt play. On iOS you are asked whether to allow tracking; ads work either way.

Privacy policy: https://chomxoai.com/banner-of-ages/privacy
Support: https://chomxoai.com/banner-of-ages/support

name: BarefootCourse
description:
Welcome to BarefootCourse 1.0!

BarefootCourse is a high-precision surveying and measurement app designed for barefoot waterski jump courses.

Using a compatible Skiable RTK Unit connected to your iPhone via Bluetooth, BarefootCourse helps survey course buoys and jump positions, calculate distances and offsets, and produce detailed measurements for course setup, checking and homologation preparation.

**HIGH-PRECISION COURSE SURVEYING**

Survey barefoot jump-course positions using RTK GNSS technology.

Capture entrance gates, reference buoys, measurement-grid buoys, ride-out positions and jump reference points.

Each surveyed position is recorded for measurement and analysis, with GNSS status displayed to help confirm RTK FIX before capturing points.

**AUTOMATIC JUMP CENTRE CALCULATION**

Survey the left and right jump reference points and BarefootCourse automatically calculates the jump centre.

This removes the need to position an RTK antenna directly at the centre of the jump.

The calculated jump centre provides the reference point for local course measurements.

**COURSE MEASUREMENTS & HOMOLOGATION**

BarefootCourse calculates measurements from surveyed coordinates, including:

• Buoy spacing and alignment
• Course distances and offsets
• Actual versus nominal positions
• Measurement differences
• Local X/Y coordinates

Review measurements to identify differences from the intended course layout and assist with course verification.

**INTERACTIVE SURVEY MAP**

View surveyed positions on an interactive course map.

• Clearly labelled course points
• Local coordinate measurements
• Pinch-to-zoom and pan controls
• Jump and buoy reference positions

Export a detailed PNG course map with buoy labels and measured dimensions for reference, reporting or printing.

**MEASURE TAPE SUPPORT**

BarefootCourse includes dedicated support for Measure Tape measurements.

Select four surveyed grid buoys and one check buoy, with calculated local X/Y coordinates referenced to the jump centre.

Two grid selections are supported, with CSV export for use in Measure Tape workflows.

**SAVE & LOAD SURVEYS**

Save completed or partially completed surveys directly on your iPhone.

Load previous surveys to continue working, review measurements or export results without surveying the course again.

**CSV & MAP EXPORT**

Export survey results for further analysis, record keeping and homologation documentation.

Exports include:

• Surveyed buoy coordinates
• Calculated jump centre
• Local X/Y measurements
• Nominal positions and deviations
• Detailed course measurements
• Labelled course-map PNG

**BAREFOOTCOURSE PRO**

BarefootCourse Pro unlocks NTRIP correction support directly within the app.

Connect to an NTRIP correction service, manage caster settings and save connection profiles for future use.

BarefootCourse Pro is available as an auto-renewable yearly subscription.

Survey management, maps, homologation measurements, Measure Tape tools and exports are available without a Pro subscription.

**DESIGNED FOR BAREFOOT WATERSKIING**

BarefootCourse is designed for clubs, course surveyors and barefoot waterski officials who need accurate, repeatable measurements when installing, checking or maintaining barefoot jump courses.

A compatible Skiable RTK Unit is required for RTK surveying. High-accuracy positioning requires an RTK FIX and a suitable correction source.

BarefootCourse provides measurement tools to support homologation workflows; it does not independently certify a course.

Privacy Policy:
https://www.slalompath.com.au/barefootcourse-privacypolicy.html

Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Barocue: Pressure & Headaches
description:
Some people feel it when the weather turns. Barocue watches the air pressure where you are and tells you before it changes a lot.

PRESSURE FORECAST
• Hourly barometric pressure for the next 48 hours (9 days with Pro)
• Big drops and rises highlighted on the chart
• Pressure shown in inHg, hPa or mmHg

ALERTS BEFORE THE CHANGE
• A notification 1, 3 or 6 hours before a big drop
• Choose how big a change counts: sensitive, standard or big changes only
• Quiet hours from 10 PM to 7 AM

A DIARY IN TWO TAPS
• Tap how you feel: good, mild, moderate or severe
• Add symptoms, medicine taken and a note if you like
• Each entry saves the pressure at that moment and the change over the 6 hours before

YOUR OWN PATTERNS
• See how many of your entries came after a pressure drop
• Entries grouped by the pressure change before them
• Pro: weekday and time-of-day patterns, CSV export to share with your doctor

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your diary stays on your iPhone
• Only your approximate location (about 1 km) is used to get the forecast

BAROCUE PRO
• 9-day forecast, custom alert threshold, alerts for rises
• Full diary history and CSV export
• Weekday and time-of-day patterns
Choose a yearly subscription (with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers), a monthly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

IMPORTANT
Barocue is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, predict or treat any condition. Pressure alerts are weather information. Talk to your doctor about headaches, migraine and medicine.

Weather data: MET Norway (CC BY 4.0).

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://stroupp.github.io/barocue/privacy.html

name: BCG Store
description:
BCG Store réunit des boutiques vérifiées dans une seule application.

Parcourez le catalogue, ajoutez vos articles au panier et payez en ligne ou à la livraison. Suivez vos commandes et discutez avec les boutiques.

Vous êtes commerçant ? Déposez votre demande partenaire, ouvrez votre boutique et gérez vos produits, commandes et factures depuis votre espace vendeur.

Livraison disponible en Guinée, y compris pour les commandes passées depuis l'étranger.

name: BeatForgeMusic
description:
BeatForge Studio is an original touch-first music workspace for iPhone and iPad. Start with a rhythm, play an idea, shape its tone, and turn it into a compact song sketch without creating an account.

BUILD A RHYTHM
• Create patterns on a responsive 16-step grid
• Hear changes immediately through the built-in sound engine
• Use original drum, bass, chord, and lead tone recipes

PLAY AND ARRANGE
• Perform melodies and chords on touch keys
• Organize drum, bass, chord, lead, and audio track lanes on a clear timeline
• Add tracks, open clips for editing, and duplicate ideas
• Change tempo and control playback from the studio toolbar

SHAPE THE SOUND
• Set volume, mute, and solo for each track
• Enable persistent effects from a scrollable sound rack
• Draw and save a filter automation curve that changes tone during playback and export

RECORD AND SHARE
• Record a local take with the microphone
• Save projects on the device and keep working offline
• Render the current pattern as a WAV mix and share it with the iOS share sheet

BeatForge is designed around distinct workspaces, generous touch targets, and an original visual identity. Your projects and recordings stay on your device unless you choose to share them.

name: BeautyStream
description:
BeautyStream lets you broadcast live video from your iPhone to any streaming service that accepts RTMP, with beauty effects applied in real time.

BEAUTY, FILTERS, AR PROPS AND MAKEUP
- Smooth and Whiten sliders
- A film filter, AR face props and makeup looks
- Change effects while you are live

SIMPLE TO START
- No account or sign-in
- Paste your stream address and tap Go live
- Go live in portrait or landscape
- Front or back camera, and a mute button

CLEAR STATUS
- See Connecting, LIVE with a timer, Reconnecting, or Not live at a glance
- If the connection drops, the app tries to reconnect automatically
- Your screen stays awake while you broadcast
- Your stream key is hidden from the screen while you are live

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no analytics, no tracking
- Effects run on your device
- Your video goes only to the address you enter
- Your last stream address is kept in the iOS Keychain on your phone, and you can forget it in Settings

BeautyStream ends the broadcast when you leave the app, because iOS stops the camera in the background.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 16 or later and a stream address and key from your streaming service.

name: BentoWeek
description: Choose a day and plan lunch and dinner on the weekly board. Add one ingredient per line and copy a meal to reuse it on another day. The Shopping tab groups ingredients across the selected week and lets you check off each item. The count shows how many meals use that ingredient.

name: Bevean Town
description:
Bevean Town is your team's virtual office, now on your phone. Chat, see who is around and keep up with work from anywhere.

TEAM CHAT
• Channels, direct messages and threads
• Audio messages, video clips, photos and files
• Mentions, reactions, pinned and saved messages
• Instant notifications, with per-channel control

A LIVING OFFICE
• See who is online and everyone's status
• Open the office map and talk by voice with the people nearby
• Start a voice conversation right from a message

CALENDAR AND APPS
• Your calendar, with meetings and reminders
• Projects, Tickets, Deals, Notes, Recordings and the other apps enabled in your office
• An assistant to get work done faster

MADE FOR YOUR TEAM
• Light and dark themes
• Available in Brazilian and European Portuguese, English, Spanish, French and Italian
• Switch offices with one tap if you belong to more than one

To get started, sign in with Google, Apple or your email, then create your team's office or accept an invite.

name: Billet
description:
Billet is a camping gear and pack planner. Know every piece of gear you own — and exactly what it weighs — before you leave the driveway.

Build a detailed inventory of your kit, track the weight of every item, and see at a glance where the grams really go. When it's time to head out, turn your inventory into a trip checklist, tick things off at the gate, and know your pack weight before you lift it.

name: BirdRunner: Run & Walk Coach
description:
BirdRunner tracks walks and runs, with optional training plans and spoken cues. Choose a goal and the days you want to train, and get a plan for anything from short walks to a marathon.

PLANS THAT FIT YOUR WEEK
• Goals for walking, walk and jog, building a habit, 5K, 10K, half marathon, and marathon
• Walking and walk-jog plans use short timed sessions, 5 to 30 minutes, 1 to 5 days a week
• Treadmill sessions keep GPS off, and you can add the distance after or save just the time
• Choose three to six running days. The long run closes your week and the hard session gets the most rest around it
• Add a race date and your plan counts down to it through base, build, and peak weeks, then a taper, so you arrive rested
• Lighter weeks every fourth week, and gentle growth from the distance you already run
• Rather not follow a plan? Choose No plan and just log walks and runs whenever you like

SESSION TYPES
• Easy runs, strides, steady runs, tempo runs, intervals, and long runs with steady finishes
• Every session is broken into warm up, reps, recoveries, and cool down
• Personal training paces from a recent race or your quickest runs, using published running research. No race yet? Sessions are guided by effort

SPOKEN CUES
• The guided timer steps through each session and tells you what's next
• Spoken cues with your target pace and each mile or kilometer split. Your music lowers while the coach talks, then comes back
• Every cue also shows on screen

GPS RUNS
• Live distance, current and average pace, a live map, and splits
• Keeps recording with your phone locked
• Filters out GPS jumps and standing-still drift, and paused time never counts
• A run in progress survives the app closing

ADJUST YOUR PLAN
• After a mostly missed week, or when easy runs have felt hard, BirdRunner suggests easing back. Nothing changes until you tap Adjust
• Move, skip, or swap any hard session for an easy run

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• This week against plan, activity day streaks that respect rest days, and simple week, month, six month, and year charts of distance or time
• Separate run and walk totals, with matching activity filters for charts and history
• A run journal with route maps, splits, and elevation, plus share cards
• Shoe tracking with a nudge when a pair is nearly worn out
• Optional calorie estimates from the weight you enter, worked out with standard exercise formulas and clearly marked as estimates
• Optional notifications: run day reminders, a step goal alert, and step check-ins at the hours you choose

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
Import walks and runs from Apple Health, including ones recorded on Apple Watch or by apps like Garmin Connect that share with Health. Connect Watch data adds routes, heart rate, calories, and other available readings. Send upcoming planned sessions to the Watch’s Workout app. Save a phone activity to Health from its details when you choose.

PRIVACY
No account. No analytics or tracking. Your plan, runs, and routes stay on your iPhone. Export your journal as a spreadsheet or erase everything whenever you like.

BirdRunner gives general training guidance. It isn't medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting a new training plan.

Terms of use: https://thrivingbird.com/terms

name: Birdsong Atlas: Taiwan Forest
description:
Early morning in a Taiwanese mountain forest, the mist still hanging. The trees are full of song, but the birds hide in the canopy where you can't see them.
All you have is a sound dish and an empty journal.

FIND BIRDS BY EAR
- Put on headphones and listen: is that call on your left, your right, or behind you? Sounds behind you are muffled
- The sound compass at the top of the screen shows where the voices come from
- Hold up the dish and aim it: the noise drops and the bird gets clearer. Walk too loudly and the birds fly off

RECORD A WHOLE SONG
- A live spectrogram shows what you hear: wind and the stream are a soft haze, birdsong stands out
- Aim, get close, stand still, and wait for the bird to sing a whole phrase from the start
- If a recording isn't clear, you're told why: too far, off target, footsteps, or the stream is too loud

TRACE IT
- Trace the shape of the call on the spectrogram with your finger; the closer you get, the more stars (up to three)
- Once it's in your journal, the bird flies out of the canopy so you can finally see it

THE BIRDSONG JOURNAL
- Watercolour illustrations, the call you traced, clues and descriptions
- Fact chips: endemic to Taiwan or not, body length, weight, conservation status
- Listen to each call again any time

THREE CHAPTERS, 19 BIRDS
- Chapter 1, Morning Atlas: Taiwan Barbet, Taiwan Blue Magpie, Taiwan Yuhina, Grey-cheeked Fulvetta, White-eared Sibia (free)
- Chapter 2, Voices of the Whole Forest: 7 birds of the stream, the undergrowth and the tree trunks
- Chapter 3, The Northern Peaks: 7 birds of the fir forest and dwarf bamboo, including the Mikado Pheasant

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Play all of chapter 1 (5 birds) for free, with no ads.
The Full Version is a one-time purchase (not a subscription) that unlocks chapters 2 and 3 with 14 more birds. Family Sharing supported; restore it on a new phone.

Every bird call is synthesized by the app in real time. No internet needed, and no personal data is collected.
繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Español

Privacy Policy: https://birdsong.emptyoffice.app/legal/privacy.html
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: BitReview
description:
Review code from your phone. BitReview brings your Bitbucket Cloud pull requests, diffs and pipelines to a fast, native app.

• Inbox of pull requests waiting for your review and the ones you opened
• Readable diffs with syntax highlighting, word-level changes and a file list
• Inline and general comments, replies, tasks and resolved threads
• Approve, request changes and merge
• Builds and pipelines with step logs
• Browse source, commits and branches in any repository you can access
• Several workspaces, plus workspaces you reach through repository access
• List and detail side by side on large screens and in landscape

Sign in with an Atlassian API token. It's stored in your device's Keychain and sent only to Bitbucket. No analytics, no ads, no tracking.

BitReview is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Atlassian. Bitbucket is a trademark of Atlassian.

name: Bloomprint: Instant Art Camera
description:
Keep a little of your day.

A flower on your walk. A cup of tea. A moment worth keeping. Bloomprint turns your photos into illustrated prints in crayon, watercolor or pen.

Choose a photo or use the camera, turn the style dial, and watch your print develop. Keep prints in a box for each day, explore your photo wall, or save and share them. Home Screen widgets bring your prints a little closer.

Your prints can sync between your devices through your private iCloud account. Printing uses an online AI service and requires an internet connection. Bloomprint asks permission before sharing photos with OpenAI through its Cloudflare-hosted server. AI illustrations and plant information may be inaccurate.

Start with two free prints a day. Bloomprint Plus offers ten prints a day with monthly or yearly subscriptions. Eligible subscribers may receive a one-week free trial on the yearly plan. The app shows your local price and offer eligibility before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple account. Use Restore purchases in Settings after reinstalling or changing devices.

Privacy: https://saberzou.ai/bloomprint/privacy.html
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Blue Line: Hockey Stats
description:
Blue Line makes it easy for hockey parents to track their kids' stats, for players and goalies, and share them with family, coaches and scouts.

TRACK LIVE OR AFTER THE GAME
• Big, easy tiles for tapping stats from the stands
• Or enter a game afterward in about a minute
• Undo button, penalty lengths and score tracking built in

BUILT FOR GOALIES TOO
• Save %, GAA, shutouts, record and quality starts
• PK goals against, plus save % without them
• Save % chart for every game

PLAYER STATS
• Goals, assists, points, +/−, shots, shooting %, PIM, hits, blocks and faceoffs
• Power-play, shorthanded and game-winning goals
• Season pace chart

EVERY SEASON, WHOLE CAREER
• Each season kept separate
• Add past seasons game by game, or just the totals
• Career view with a season-by-season table

SHARE IT
• Game cards and profile cards, ready to text
• QR codes link to Elite Prospects, 1Rink, YouTube or any page you choose
• Full PDF report with clickable links for coaches and scouts
• Spreadsheet export (CSV)
• Send by email with clickable links

HIGHLIGHTS
• Attach video clips to each game, then play and trim them
• Save cards and clips to Photos to upload to 1Rink

EVERY KID, ONE APP
• Unlimited athletes, players and goalies

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no subscription
• All data stays on your phone
• Back up to iCloud Drive anytime

Questions or ideas? Email bluelinehockeyapp@gmail.com

name: Bombman: Elemental Adventure
description:
Pick water, fire, or wind and blast your own route through the fog. Bombman is a single-player adventure across two 110 × 130 maps, the Orchard and Volcanic Valley. Explore at your own pace and pick up where you left off.

• Choose the right bomb. Water breaks crates and traps regular monsters in bubbles you can tap to pop. Fire clears brambles and defeats regular monsters. Wind puts out fire walls and pushes regular monsters back.
• Challenge each map’s boss. Clear its breakable obstacles to summon it. Read the shield, dodge charges, and follow the prompts for your finishing taps.
• Find upgrades and hearts. Bomb capacity, blast range, and movement speed each cap at level 10. Maximum HP is 10.
• Set up your controls. Move and resize the on-screen controls in Settings. Portrait and landscape layouts save separately.
• Play tabletop on iPhone Duo. Partially open the inner display with the fold running horizontally to keep gameplay above and controls below. Open it flat to return to full-screen play. Customize and save a separate tabletop control layout.

The core game works offline with no account. Exploration and progress save automatically on this device. A knockout halves your three stats, down to a minimum of level 1. Your exploration and maximum HP carry over.

Return to camp for free, or spend a revive token to continue where you fell. One free token accrues every 12 hours. Optional App Store consumables add a revive token or a one-level boost to capacity, range, and speed within their caps.

name: Boring App: A Quiet Moment
description:
When boredom arrives, take a moment for yourself.

There are no tasks to complete here. Tap, drag, and hold to see how light, lines, and colors respond. Light up a constellation, let paths attract one another, or simply watch for a while.

Explore free scenes including Ink Canvas, Kaleidoscope, Time Capsule, and Tides. Sound and haptic feedback bring each interaction to life.

The Creative Edition is a one-time purchase that unlocks six scenes: Just Here, Make Room for Quiet, On Different Sides, Gravity Field, Make a Constellation, and Unzip the Sky. There is no automatic renewal. Restore your purchase with your Apple Account. Check the App Store for the current price.

name: Bounce Bastion
description:
Bounce Bastion is a fast, one-thumb arcade roguelite built for portrait play.

Slide your paddle anywhere on the screen. Your orbs fire on their own — ricochet them off walls, blocks and your paddle to smash the numbered blocks before they cross the red line.

EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT
• 16 upgrades to stack, each with gold Ascended tiers
• 14 gold Evolutions that redefine your build
• Elements that react: fire, frost, poison and lightning combine into powerful reactions
• Reroll a bad hand of cards

10 CHAPTERS, 20 BOSS FIGHTS
Each chapter is two waves, and every wave ends in a boss with its own trick. Earn up to 3 stars per chapter. Meet Drifters, Splitters, Ironclads and Menders along the way.

DAILY RIFT
A new challenge every day: a random boss, two head-start evolutions and a difficulty that changes daily. Keep your streak going.

ENDLESS
How long can you hold the line? The waves never stop and keep getting tougher.

GROW STRONGER
Every run earns shards, win or lose. Spend them in the Workshop on 12 permanent perks.

FEELS GREAT
Punchy sound, hit-stop, combos, screen shake and haptics. No internet needed to play.

FREE TO START
Play chapters 1–3 and the Daily Rift for free. Unlock the full game once for all 10 chapters, Endless mode and every Workshop tier.

name: BouncyBoot: Soccer Dodge
description:
Kick. Dodge. Find the gap.

Lines of defenders are charging down the pitch, and only your quick feet can get the ball through. Tap either side of the ball to kick it left or right and slip into the openings. Every line you clear scores a point, and the game keeps getting faster and more crowded the longer you survive. How far can you run?

SIMPLE TO PLAY, HARD TO PUT DOWN
• One-thumb controls: tap left of the ball to kick it right, tap right to kick it left
• Prefer buttons? Switch to on-screen kick buttons from the start screen
• Short, fast runs that are perfect for a quick break
• Every run is fair: each line of defenders always leaves a gap you can reach

READ THE DEFENDERS
• Red defenders hold their ground, but sparse lines sway side to side
• Green keepers slide across to track the ball
• Amber players lunge at you when you get close
• Watch for special formations: a solid wall with one way through, zigzags, and pincers that close in from both sides

PULL OFF A WALL PASS
Defender hugging the sideline? Kick hard into the wall just as they reach you and bounce straight past them. Time it right and you're through.

DAILY MISSIONS
• Three new missions every day, the same for every player
• Take on a tougher Daily Challenge for bigger rewards
• Missions reset at midnight, so there's always something new to chase

EARN COINS, UNLOCK NEW LOOKS
Every line you clear earns a coin, and completed missions pay out bonuses. Spend your coins in the shop on:
• Balls: Classic, Sunset, Retro, Neon and Gold
• Pitches: Classic, Night Game, Beach and Snow Day, complete with falling snow
• Trails: Streak, Sparkle and Fire
• Celebrations: Classic, Confetti and Fireworks for new bests and milestones

COMPETE WITH FRIENDS
• Climb the Game Center leaderboard
• Unlock achievements for big scores, your first Wall Pass and getting past a keeper
• Share your score and challenge friends to beat it

MADE TO FEEL GREAT
• Stadium atmosphere with a cheering crowd, whistles and satisfying kicks
• Haptic feedback on every kick, point and crash
• Respects your silent switch and plays nicely with your own music
• Pause anytime; the game pauses automatically if you get a call or leave the app
• Plays on iPhone and iPad

No in-app purchases. Every coin is earned on the pitch.

Lace up, find the gap and set a new best!

name: Brassfin
description:
Keep your lures ready for the next outing.

Brassfin is a personal tackle log for anglers who want to know what they own, where it belongs, and what needs attention. Follow each physical lure through packing, actual use, wear, repair, replacement, and return.

ORGANIZE EACH PHYSICAL LURE
Save specifications, buoyancy, target species, purchase details, photos, tags, and custom notes. Give identical lures separate records so each keeps its own use and repair history.

MAP YOUR TACKLE BOXES
Create a compartment layout, assign lures to numbered slots, and see occupied and empty positions. Generate box QR labels and open a box using a label image or its printed code. Physical audits record what is present so you can review differences before updating the map.

PREPARE AND RECORD REAL USE
Save main and backup combinations with reusable checklists. Enter your rod's marked casting range, reel, line, and leader, then check lure weights while preparing. Save packing checks, mark the lures actually used, and enter optional active minutes. Outings with no catches, or no fishing at all, remain useful records.

CONNECT WEAR, REPAIRS, AND PARTS
Track bent hooks, rust, cracks, chipped paint, damaged rings, and lost lures. Set repair dates and link stocked parts and costs. Completed repairs deduct parts; corrections adjust the difference and retain stock transactions.

FOLLOW REPLACEMENTS AND FOUND LURES
A confirmed loss or retirement releases its compartment and can create a refill request. Fill it with an owned lure or a new replacement, and choose whether to update reusable plans. A found or repaired retired lure can return to service after outstanding repairs and a physical inspection. Earlier incidents and filled replacements remain in its history.

CLOSE RETURNS AND PREPARE AGAIN
Check every packed lure back into storage, set it aside, or keep it pending while you look for it. Once returns are complete, prepare another outing from the current linked plan or your previous custom selection with recorded replacements. Packing and usage checks start fresh while past outings stay saved.

BUILD A USEFUL HISTORY
Review each lure's timeline, completed uses, zero-catch uses, entered minutes, and repair costs. Set inspection intervals based on completed outings or logged minutes. Link catches to the lure actually used. Summaries reflect your own records.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR RECORDS
Core features work offline without an account. Records and selected photos are stored on your device. Export related CSV tables, save a full records-and-photos backup folder, and use local recovery points. Choose where exported files are saved.

The app interface is available in English. Designed for iPhone and iPad with iOS 15.0 or later.

name: Breathe Well: Paced Breathing
description:
Open the app, tap once, and breathe. Breathe Well guides slow, paced breathing with soft tones and haptic taps, so you can close your eyes and follow by feel and sound.

No account. No ads. No subscription. No tips. Works offline. Nothing is sold or asked for before, during or after a session.

BREATHE
• Twelve patterns: Slow, Sigh, Even, Box, 4-7-8, Long exhale, three Resonance paces, Triangle, Easy box and Short sigh, plus your own library of custom patterns. Search, favourites and recent patterns.
• Choose a length in minutes (up to 60), a number of breaths, or open-ended. "End after this breath" and an optional get-ready countdown.
• Guidance by haptics and tones, with a strength slider, volume, four end sounds and four looks (orb, ring, bar, text). The screen fades to dark so you can keep your eyes closed.
• Optional "Keep guiding when locked": tones continue with the screen locked (iPhone haptics pause while locked, an iOS limit). Your own music keeps playing alongside. Optional shake to pause.
• No fast, forced or breath-retention techniques. Patterns that include breath holds say so and carry a caution.

ABOUT EACH PATTERN
Every pattern has an "About this pattern" page that describes how it is paced and where it comes from.

START FASTER
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widget showing your minutes today.
• Quick actions on the app icon: "Breathe now" plus your two recent patterns.
• Shortcuts and the Action Button through a start link: breathe://start?pattern=box&target=m:5
• Optional Live Activity that shows your session on the Lock Screen. Off until you switch it on in Settings; iOS then asks once.

YOUR HISTORY STAYS YOURS
• Totals, a 12-week calendar, the last 14 days, notes, tags and an optional mood check-in.
• Export as CSV or JSON, back up and restore, delete a date range or everything.
• Optional Face ID lock around History.

REMINDERS (OPTIONAL)
None by default. Up to eight, each with its own time, weekdays and pattern, with Start, Snooze and Skip today.

APPLE HEALTH (OPTIONAL)
If you switch it on in Settings, each saved session of 20 seconds or more is saved to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes. Write only: Breathe Well never reads your Health data, never shares it, and never uses it for advertising or marketing. It is off by default, iOS asks for permission at the moment you switch it on, and deleting a session in the app does not remove it from Health.

PRIVACY
All data stays on your iPhone. No account, no analytics, no tracking, no ads. The app itself makes no network requests.

IMPORTANT
Breathe Well is a timer for paced breathing. It is a general wellness tool, not a medical device, and gives no medical advice. If you are unsure whether breathing exercises suit you, ask a health professional first. Skip breath-holds and stop if you feel dizzy. Do not use it while driving, cycling, swimming or in a bath.

Requires iOS 16.4 or later. iPhone only. The app is in English.

name: Brivanta Cycletrace
description:
Brivanta Cycletrace is a countryside cycling playground split into three short challenges, each leaning on a different skill: reflex, planning, and reading the gears.

Pothole Dash speeds up the road while you hop lanes to dodge cones, slicks, and barriers, scooping golden spokes for bonus points. Three tyres carry you, and each crash costs one. Trail Ink gives you a limited ink supply to sketch a path from your bike to the rack, collect spokes, and slip past moving barrels before the timer runs out. Gear Shift is quieter but tense: read the current gear, call the next move as shift up, shift down, or hold, and chain correct holds into high-scoring combos across twelve rounds.

A Daily Route sets a fresh objective each day and pays out bonus spokes on completion. Spend those spokes at the Workbench on new frame paints, and swap between Classic, Sport, and Aero wheel sets to change how your ride looks. The Logbook keeps every attempt with score, distance, and time, filterable by game so you can chase personal bests. Ride Stats layers in weekly rhythms, saddle time, finish rate, and best-score curves, while eight badges mark steady milestones.

The whole app runs in landscape with roomy buttons, adjustable pace, and separate audio and haptic toggles, so it suits a quick break.

name: bTime — Work Hours
description:
bTime records the hours you work and turns them into a document you can hand to
whoever pays you.

It is built for one person: you. There is no account to create, no company
dashboard, nobody watching where you are. Your hours live on your phone and go
nowhere else unless you send them yourself.

STARTS THE DAY WITH YOU
Set the time you normally start and bTime opens the day for you. Fill the place
in when you get there — or let it find the address once you are on site, so the
gap between leaving the yard and arriving somewhere is never a gap in your
records.

KNOWS WHERE YOU WORKED
It remembers the places you have worked and offers yesterday's site when it
looks like you are back. Moved halfway through the day? Split the day in two and
both places are recorded, with the lunch break counted once.

LUNCH AT ITS TIME, NOT BY DEFAULT
Set when lunch is. The card and the Lock Screen say so at that hour, and the
break comes off only a day that ran through it: finish at 10:35 and nothing is
deducted; stop during lunch and bTime asks. One tap changes it either way.

TRAVEL BY THE KILOMETRE, IF YOUR COMPANY PAYS IT
Switch it on for a company and bTime counts the road from your start point to
each place worked and back, once per place, and adds the line to the estimate
and the document. Set the figure by hand whenever you know better.

ON THE LOCK SCREEN BEFORE YOU TOUCH THE PHONE
A Shortcuts automation can run "Start bTime day" at your start time, so the day
is already on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island at 6:30 — the app tells
you how to set it up, once.

THE DOCUMENT AT THE END
A typeset PDF for the person reading it, and a spreadsheet for the person keying
it into payroll. Both come from the same hours, so they can never disagree.
Totals are split 1–15 and 16–end, the way the pay periods actually run.

WON'T LET YOU HAND IN HOURS NOBODY WORKED
Forget to stop and a ten-hour day becomes a twenty-hour one overnight. bTime
asks you in the evening whether a day is still running — and if a day did run
on, Stop asks when you really finished and logs only up to then.

OVERTIME, THE BELGIAN WAY
Set your contract day once. Above 8 hours a day or 40 a week is overtime;
Sundays and public holidays count at +100%. Every day can be corrected by hand,
and the pay estimate shows the arithmetic behind every line.

YOUR PAY STAYS YOUR BUSINESS
Enter your hourly rate if you want an estimate — it is hidden until you tap the
eye, can sit behind Face ID, and never goes into a document unless you choose
"Include amounts" for that one send.

TWO COMPANIES, ONE PHONE
Paid by two? Each company counts time its own way — to the minute, or rounded
to the half hour — and each gets its own document. A day can be split between
them.

ALSO
· A guided setup that asks a few questions and is done
· A running day on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
· Belgian public holidays, marked for you, movable feasts included
· Days off, sick days and holidays, with hours still loggable on them
· A year at a glance, every month totalled, and the month on a map
· Backup and restore, as a file you hold
· English, Français, Nederlands, Română and Українська, chosen in the app —
  not taken from your phone; the documents follow the language you pick

NO ACCOUNT. NO SERVERS. NO ADVERTISING. NO TRACKING.
bTime works with the phone in flight mode. Nothing about your work is uploaded,
sold or shared, because there is nowhere for it to go.

name: Bubble Bay: Car Wash
description:
Your own self-service car wash in your pocket. Drop coins into the terminal, grab the pressure gun and make that car shine!

JUST LIKE A REAL SELF-SERVICE WASH
• Foam, high-pressure water, a drying towel and tyre shine
• One big SPRAY button with a timer ring — out of time? Drop another coin for +10 s
• Turn the car around and wash all four sides
• Mud, dust and autumn leaves come off right under your finger

THE CABIN IS NEXT
• Vacuum, air blower, wipes, glass cleaner and an air freshener
• Every type of car has its own interior

NO READING NEEDED
• The button you need gently pulses — you always know what’s next
• Coins for every step, a combo flame ×2, ×3, ×4, confetti and fanfare at the end

YOUR REWARD: A RIDE
• Take your clean car out on a 4-lane road with gas, brake and nitro
• Every other car is dirty! Bump into one and yours gets dirty too. Puddles and rain don’t help either
• Hit top speed to grab a Mystery Box — every fifth ride brings a Super Box

TAKE A FRIEND FOR A RIDE
• Put a friend’s photo behind the wheel — their bobble head bounces on every bump
• Record a video of the ride and send it to them

GARAGE AND TUNING
• 21 cars from a tiny hatchback to supercars, plus three rare ones that only come from the box
• Paint, rims, window tint, spoilers and decals
• Car levels, a collection and seasons

Foam, hissing water and the vacuum roar are synthesized live, with haptics you feel in your hand. Works offline, no sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases.

Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1smoQLZxZN30y4-k6LcjjYgwXNE8RaRze0j3jUzasuQo/edit?usp=sharing
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: BuildRank: Engineering Career
description:
Pick your discipline and role, and jump into your part of 60 modules on takeoff from excavation to finishes, inspection, BIM and coordination, LEED, project management and FIDIC contracts. Then build a whole villa over 5 working days, from footings to handover: calculate quantities, review approvals and inspections, prepare payment applications, resolve drawing conflicts and variations, sequence the schedule and get promoted to project manager. Every decision affects time, cost and quality, and you can rotate the growing 3D site with your finger.

An independent educational game with a fictional project, not affiliated with the owners of LEED or FIDIC. It does not replace codes or contracts and is not a professional certification.

name: C172S Cockpit & Avionics Sim
seller_name: AKINCIJET HAVACILIK TEKNOLOJI VE DANISMANLIK LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Take the pilot seat and explore an interactive C172S cockpit. Fly with a live exterior view based on real-world map and elevation data, operate cockpit controls and follow your flight on the instruments.

FLY FROM THE COCKPIT
Use the yoke, throttle, rudder and trim to guide your flight. Manage speed, altitude and descent as you explore the terrain and line up with the runway. Switch between seven camera views to reach the lower panel, inspect switches or look around the cabin.

FROM ENGINE START TO SHUTDOWN
Interact with modeled ignition, mixture, fuel and electrical controls. Watch engine, fuel and electrical indications respond to your inputs. Operate flaps, parking brake and cockpit lighting as part of the simulation.

A WORLD OUTSIDE THE WINDOWS
Explore coastlines and landforms using real-world map and elevation data. Change between the live flight view and a panoramic mountain setting. Continue into the night with a darkened sky and illuminated instruments.

INSTRUMENTS THAT FOLLOW YOUR FLIGHT
Read airspeed, altitude, heading and synthetic vision on the PFD. View maps, flight plans, navigation points and approach routes on the MFD. Move from the cockpit to a full instrument view and back while maintaining the same flight state.

MADE FOR iPAD AND MAC
Explore with touch on iPad or mouse and trackpad on Mac. Choose your preferred app language in settings.

SUBSCRIPTION ACCESS
A subscription is required to use the simulator. Choose a monthly plan at US$9.00 or an annual plan at US$89.00. Eligible new subscribers can start with a 3-day free trial. When the trial ends, the selected subscription starts automatically at the stated recurring price unless canceled beforehand. Prices may vary by country and are displayed in the app before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. The free trial is subject to eligibility; only one introductory offer is available per subscription group. Restore existing purchases from the subscription screen.

For simulation and familiarization only. Not for real-world navigation, flight operations or certified flight training. This independent app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin or the aircraft manufacturer.

Privacy Policy: https://akincijet.com/c172s/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://akincijet.com/c172s/terms/
Support: https://akincijet.com/c172s/support/

name: Cairnmark
description:
Cairnmark is a place for your logins that does not depend on a company, a cloud or a single phone.

Your vault lives on this iPhone, encrypted. The key that opens it is split into stones, and you hand those stones to people you trust. If the phone is lost, broken or replaced, a few of those people together can open the vault for you again. One stone alone, or two, show nothing at all.

Setting up a vault
You decide how many stones to make and how many must come together. Five stones with three needed is the starting point; a couple might choose three and two, a larger family seven and four. The split uses Shamir's Secret Sharing, a well-studied method in which fewer stones than needed give no hint of the key.

Handing a stone over takes a few seconds. The keeper opens Cairnmark on their phone and scans a QR code from yours. Someone without a smartphone can keep a printed card instead. Keepers see their stone and your name, never your logins. Your phone can hold stones for other people too, each listed under its owner's name.

Getting your logins back
Export the encrypted backup file from time to time and store it wherever suits you. On a new iPhone, open the file in Cairnmark and scan the stones of enough keepers. Without the file the stones have nothing to open, so keep it somewhere other than the phone it came from.

Everyday use
Each login holds a title, a username, a password and a note. A tap copies the password; it leaves the clipboard after a minute and never moves to your other devices. The app opens with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode, locks when you leave it and covers its screen in the app switcher.

What Cairnmark leaves out
There is no account to create and no server behind the app. It has no network code, no analytics and no ads. Stones move by camera or on paper, never over the internet.

name: Cammino dei Briganti
description:
The official Cammino dei Briganti app helps you find your way along the Abruzzo section of the Way, about 65 km in the Marsica area, in the province of L'Aquila. The Cammino dei Briganti is a loop of about 100 km between Abruzzo and Lazio, inspired by the routes of the brigands who took refuge in these lands in the 19th century. It crosses medieval villages and mountain landscapes of the Marsica and the Cicolano.

The interactive map shows your position on the Way via the device's GPS, even without an internet connection, because maps, itineraries and descriptions can be pre-loaded, avoiding roaming costs. The Way is presented in stages, with a descriptive page, technical data, images and elevation profile. Accommodation and points of interest are shown on the map and can be contacted directly from your smartphone.

Intervention carried out using resources under the Development and Cohesion Fund (FSC) 2021–2027.

name: Campaign Advertising
description:
Campaign Advertising is an offline campaign planner for independent marketers and small businesses. Organize campaigns, audience groups, and creative drafts in one workspace on your iPhone or iPad. Enter daily advertising results and sales to review spending, attributed revenue, and performance charts.

Compare campaigns over the same date range, allocate monthly budgets, and explore clearly labeled planning estimates. Local, rule-based insights help you review your saved records. Export PDF or CSV reports, or create and restore a JSON backup with your saved images.

No login is required. Campaign status changes affect your local plans only; the app does not connect to advertising platforms or publish ads.

**Key Features**

- Campaign planning: create, edit, search, sort, duplicate, and archive local campaigns.
- Audience groups: organize targeting notes and planned budgets within a campaign.
- Creative library: save copy, calls to action, local images, and text storyboards for video concepts.
- Performance tracking: enter daily spend, impressions, clicks, and conversions; calculate CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, and ROAS from saved totals.
- Sales ledger: record transactions and optionally attribute each sale to a campaign. Campaign revenue comes from attributed sales only.
- Campaign comparison: compare two to four campaigns over an identical date window.
- Budget planning: allocate monthly budgets to campaigns and groups; explore estimates using assumed costs, conversion rates, and order values.
- Local insights: review deterministic suggestions based on saved results and targets; snooze or dismiss them.
- Reporting and backup: export PDF/CSV reports; export and restore JSON workspace backups, including saved images.
- Offline workspace: on-device persistence, English and Vietnamese interface resources, and explicitly labeled optional sample data.

name: CAP Manager
description:
App interno de gestão da CAP Digital, para colaboradores e parceiros com acesso liberado pela empresa.

• Caixa de Entrada com as tarefas e pendências do dia
• Alertas com notificações das suas tarefas, comentários e prazos
• Kanban dos módulos: arraste os cards ou use "Mover para"
• Anexe fotos e arquivos nos cards
• Consulte as propostas em PDF

Não há cadastro público: os acessos são criados pela CAP Digital.

name: Car Repair Estimate
description:
Hit something? See what the repair may cost before you talk to a shop.

Car Repair Estimate uses AI to read photos of your car's damage. In about a minute you get a preliminary estimate, based on your location and shown in your currency.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Photograph the whole car, the damaged side and a close-up.
2. Mark the damage on the car and add a note if you like.
3. See the most likely cost, a low to high range and how severe the damage looks.

YOUR FIRST ESTIMATE IS FREE
See the repair cost range and the affected parts. For minor damage, you can also enter your deductible to compare it with the cost. No account needed. You get one free estimate every 12 months.

GO PRO FOR THE FULL REPORT
• Every part priced, with parts, labor and paint
• Possible hidden damage and what it could add
• What to do next, with body shops nearby
• A PDF to share
• Up to 10 reports a month

FOR EVERYDAY DAMAGE
Dents, scratches, bumpers, fenders, headlights and wheels, from a parking lot scrape to a bigger accident.

PLEASE NOTE
An estimate is a preliminary figure made by AI from your photos. It may be wrong, and the final cost is often higher. Prices are AI figures, not checked against local shops. It is not a repair quote, an insurance appraisal, an adjuster's opinion, claims advice, a car valuation or a safety inspection, and it can't tell you a car is safe to drive. In an emergency, call your local emergency number first.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Pro is available as a Yearly or a Weekly subscription. The App Store shows the price for your country before you buy. Yearly can start with a 3-day free trial if you qualify. Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before a trial ends, Apple charges the yearly price.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings on your iPhone.

Terms of Use: https://carsrepairestimate.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://carsrepairestimate.com/privacy

name: Cat Heist Duels
description:
Challenge your friends to a duel of thieving cats!

Cat Heist Duels is a turn-based game for 2 to 4 players. Spin the wheel, beat the minigame you land on and keep playing as long as you succeed. Every win fills your loot bar, and when it's full you can try the MASTER HEIST to steal a jewel. First to collect 6 jewels wins.

HOW TO PLAY
• Spin the wheel and face lasers, guards, safes, wires and more
• Chain wins to fill your loot bar
• Pull off the master heist and grab a jewel… or steal one from a rival
• Play at your own pace: we'll let you know when it's your turn

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Add them with your friend code
• 1-on-1 duels or group games of up to 4
• Watch a replay of what your rivals did on their turn

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CAT
• 200+ items: breeds, hats, glasses, capes, frames, wheels and effects
• Earn fish by playing and unlock daily rewards
• Progress along the Thief's Path and win exclusive rewards

Cat Heist Duels is free to play, with ads and optional in-app purchases.

Love thieving cats? Try Cat Heist too, our puzzle game.

name: Cat Rescue: Cozy Puzzles
description:
Slide the road tiles. Make a path. Bring a cat home.

Cat Rescue: Cozy Puzzles is a gentle sliding puzzle game with 150 fictional cat-rescue cases. Meet the cat, discover a little of their story, and connect a route to the waiting carrier.

ONE PATH AT A TIME
Slide a neighboring tile into the empty space. Work around fixed tiles, rethink the route, and watch the cat follow the path when it connects. There is no countdown. Undo, restart and hints let you try another idea.

A CAT BEHIND EVERY PUZZLE
Each case has its own cat and story. Keep the home screen simple, or open Story and Path preview when you want a closer look. Visit rescued cats in the courtyard and read how they settled in.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Your progress and current puzzle are saved on this device. Gameplay and stories work offline. Choose English or Simplified Chinese in Settings, and adjust music, sound, movement and haptics.

A SIMPLE FULL-GAME PURCHASE
The first 20 levels are free. A single optional non-consumable in-app purchase unlocks levels 21–150. No ads and no subscription. The purchase screen shows your local App Store price. Internet access is needed for purchasing and restoring; restoring a purchase does not transfer local puzzle progress.

The characters and rescue stories are fictional. This is a puzzle game, not a real animal-rescue service.

name: Catch Some Lux
description:
See the shape of your day at a glance.

Catch Some Lux draws today as a 24-hour ring: noon at the top, midnight at the bottom. The dark part is night, the thin bands are civil twilight — dawn and dusk — and the light part is daylight. A small tick marks the time right now. No hands, no clutter.

SUNNY HOURS
Inside the daylight band, every hour the forecast expects sunshine glows brighter: pale for a cloudy hour, full yellow for an hour of sun. See at a glance whether the morning or the afternoon is the time to get outside. Open the app for today's totals: hours of daylight and of forecast sunshine, each with a slim bar showing how much is already behind you.

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
• Small (ring) and medium (ring with dawn, sunrise, sunset and dusk times)
• Stays in full colour on a tinted Home Screen
• StandBy supported

YOUR PLACE — OR ANY PLACE
Use your current location, or add fixed places anywhere in the world. Noon is always at the top for that place's own time zone, so a Tokyo widget shows Tokyo's day. Each widget can show a different place.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sun times are calculated on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. The only network request sends a place's coordinates to Open-Meteo for the sunshine forecast — turn sunny hours off and Catch Some Lux works fully offline.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Inspired by Sol, the classic Mac Dashboard widget.

name: CeliMap
description:
¿Salir a comer siendo celíaco y quedarte con la duda? CeliMap te muestra en un mapa los lugares con opciones sin TACC cerca tuyo, en tu ciudad o en cualquier parte del mundo.

LO QUE HACE
• Mapa con pins por tipo: 100% sin TACC, con opciones, almacenes y supermercados que pueden tener productos aptos.
• Ficha de cada lugar con fotos, estrellas y reseñas, y los comentarios de otros celíacos.
• Confirmaciones de la comunidad: marcá "Vi sin TACC" y ayudá a otros a elegir mejor.
• Buscá cualquier ciudad o país con la lupa: ideal para viajes.
• Guardá tus lugares favoritos y marcá dónde estuviste.
• "Cómo llegar" te abre el mapa de tu teléfono para ir directo.

IMPORTANTE
La información viene de Google y de la comunidad y puede estar desactualizada. Confirmá siempre con el local antes de comer. CeliMap no es consejo médico.

SUSCRIPCIÓN
Probá CeliMap gratis 3 días. Después podés suscribirte por mes o por año. La suscripción se renueva sola hasta que la canceles desde los ajustes de tu cuenta de Apple, al menos 24 horas antes de cada renovación. Los precios pueden variar por país.

Términos: https://celimap-api.pepetirolacteo.workers.dev/terminos
Privacidad: https://celimap-api.pepetirolacteo.workers.dev/privacidad

name: Central FiberNet
description:
Com o aplicativo Central FiberNet, os assinantes da Fiber Net têm acesso rápido e fácil a todos os serviços da sua assinatura de internet direto pelo iPhone.

Principais recursos:
• Faturas e Pagamentos: Consulte suas faturas em aberto e histórico de pagamentos. Pague instantaneamente via PIX com código Copia e Cola ou QR Code, visualize o código de barras ou pague com cartão.
• Desbloqueio em Confiança: Realize o desbloqueio temporário da sua conexão em caso de suspensão por atraso, de forma rápida e autônoma.
• Consumo e Conexão: Acompanhe o consumo diário da sua banda e veja o status da sua conexão em tempo real.
• Atendimento e Chamados: Abra novos chamados de suporte técnico, consulte o andamento de solicitações e converse com nossa equipe.
• Documentos e Contratos: Acesse a 2ª via do seu contrato de prestação de serviços, termos, declarações de quitação anual e notas fiscais (NFCom).
• Testes e Diagnóstico: Realize testes de velocidade oficiais, ping e diagnóstico direto do seu aparelho.
• Acesso Seguro e Rápido: Faça login com comodidade utilizando Face ID ou biometria.

Aplicativo gratuito e exclusivo para clientes Fiber Net. Para acessar, utilize o CPF/CNPJ do titular do contrato e sua senha da Central do Assinante.

name: CertPrep
description:
Cert Prep puts the IT certification practice you need in one place. 14 providers, 90 exams and one consistent experience, from AWS Cloud Practitioner to SAP Security Administrator.

Pick a target exam, set a date and let the app build a daily plan. Readiness tracks accuracy, coverage and mock scores against providers' official blueprints.

Free to use:

* Practice banks for AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Cisco, CompTIA, Databricks, ISACA, ISC2, PMI, Salesforce, SAP, Scrum.org, PeopleCert and MikroTik
* More than 30,000 practice questions
* Practice, timed mocks, weak-domain drills and a daily challenge
* Answer explanations and links to official guides
* A daily goal, streaks, badges and weekly leagues
* Global, weekly and provider leaderboards
* Coins for hints, earned by playing
* Works offline, with no account needed

One plan opens the rest:

* Unlimited scored mock exams, with one a day free
* Unlimited hints
* A Pro mark on every board
* Support an offline, ad-free app

Cert Prep is free to use. The plan and the coin packs are for learners who want more. One exam at a time.

Independent Study Material: Cert Prep is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any certification body or vendor. Exam names and codes are trademarks of their respective owners and are used only to describe the exams this app prepares you for.

name: Chanso – Block Nuisance Calls
description:
Chanso blocks nuisance calls by number range, not just one number at a time. Type "0241 234 xxx" and 1,000 numbers with that prefix are blocked at once; the app loads up to 10 million numbers into your iPhone's block list, and those calls never ring.

Easy for everyone
• Large text, large buttons, one task per screen.
• No account, no typing words, digits only.

Find nuisance numbers from a screenshot
• iPhone doesn't let apps read your call log. Take a screenshot of Recents and Chanso reads the numbers on your phone, then suggests repeat callers and shared prefixes. You just tap Block.
• Images are processed on device and never uploaded.

Community lists
• Download reviewed lists and use them right away.
• Share your own list; a moderator reviews it before it goes public.

Clear and safe
• See how many numbers a pattern covers before blocking, with a warning when a range is too wide.
• Unblock with one tap; changes are pushed to iPhone immediately.
• Vietnamese and English; 230+ countries.

3-day free trial with every feature, then a one-time purchase. No subscription.

Note: Chanso uses iOS Call Blocking & Identification. After installing, turn Chanso on once in Settings → Phone → Call Blocking & Identification. Numbers saved in Contacts may not be blocked; this is an iOS limitation.

name: ChatFBN
description:
O ChatFBN é o aplicativo oficial de atendimento integrado e gestão de ordens de serviço da Fiber Net.

Desenvolvido para nossa equipe de atendimento e suporte técnico, o app permite:
• Gerenciamento em tempo real de filas de atendimento e conversas.
• Consulta e execução de Ordens de Serviço (OS) técnicas integradas ao SGP.
• Coleta de assinaturas digitais e anexo de fotos de instalações e manutenções.
• Notificações instantâneas de novos chamados e mensagens de clientes.
• Roteirização e acompanhamento de chamados de campo com precisão.

Observação: Este aplicativo é de uso corporativo exclusivo para colaboradores, técnicos e parceiros autorizados da Fiber Net. É necessário possuir credenciais de acesso fornecidas previamente pela empresa para utilizar o sistema.

name: Chemstral
description:
Chemstral is a lightweight educational companion for the periodic table.

Explore every element from hydrogen to oganesson in a clear dark interface designed for quick study sessions. Open any element to review melting and boiling points, electronegativity, electron configuration, crystal structure, density, and a short overview—plus an educational shell preview for visual learners.

Need patterns, not just facts? Use Compare to filter by category and numeric ranges, sort results, and build a comparison board for up to four elements. Spot trends across halogens, alkali metals, and more without leaving the app.

Going further in class? Labs offers supervised educational modules with objectives, safety notes, step-by-step procedures, takeaways, and linked elements. These walkthroughs are enrichment materials for instructor-led learning environments—not unsupervised chemical instructions.

Keep your progress private and local. Bookmark favorites, write personal study notes, and revisit recent elements. Everything is stored on your device, with no account required.

Chemstral is built for students, teachers, and curious learners who want a focused reference: rich enough for enrichment, light enough for everyday use.

name: CherrySunny
description:
Record food portions with CherrySunny and see your nutrition totals by day and week. Choose a product from the catalog, enter an amount, select a meal and date, and preview the nutrition before saving.

The Day view groups entries by meal and shows totals for energy, protein, fat, carbohydrates, fiber, sugars, and salt. The Week view offers a seven-day chart, counts of logged days and portions, and weekly nutrition totals. Shortcuts make it easy to log recently used products again.

The catalog includes six starter products and labels previously opened and stored on your device. Search online by name, brand, or barcode, or scan a barcode on a supported device. You can also open the product's page on Open Food Facts.

See today's summary in an iPhone widget. The app interface is in English.

name: Chilled Chilla Artist Portal
description:
The Chilled Chilla Artist Portal is your place at Chilled Chilla Records – from your first demo to release day.

SEND YOUR MUSIC
Upload your track or share a private link. Every demo gets a full listen and an answer.

FOLLOW EVERY STEP
See the moment we press play, get our decision right in the app and a push message when something changes.

SET UP YOUR RELEASE
Once we say yes, everything happens in one guided flow: your artist names and duo aliases, your WAV master with an automatic loudness check, cover, credits and track info.

PICK YOUR RELEASE DAY
Choose a free day in our release calendar – it’s booked the moment you send your release.

SIGN YOUR CONTRACT
Read and sign your contract right in the app. You get the signed PDF with a time stamp by email; collaborators sign with a link, no account needed.

PROMO KITS & RELEASE WEEK
Your Reel, Canva templates, cover and checklist for release week – with dates, so nothing slips.

Sign in with Google, Apple or Discord. No password, no fees. Made for lofi hip hop, jazzhop, chill house, lofi house, jazz house and dark ambient artists.

name: Chipmunk Challenge
description:
Every board is a picture made of colored blocks, and it’s up to the chipmunks to clear it.

Tap a nest to send its chipmunks to a holding slot, where they munch through the blocks of their color. Slots are limited, so think a few moves ahead: send the wrong nest too early and you’ll run out of room. Rocks get in the way, and some nests are locked until you finish the one holding the key.

Level Play. Work through a growing set of picture boards that get harder as you go.

Daily Challenge. A new puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Clear it to build your streak.

Coin Mining. Bonus boards that pay out coins each time you clear one.

Play your way:
• Line up nests in a queue so they go out as soon as a slot opens.
• Undo a move, or restart the board.
• Fast-forward when you know how it ends, and let the last column finish on its own.
• Choose your table: wood, linen, felt, sky, candy or night.

No account needed, and it plays fully offline.

name: Chore Relay
description:
Chore Relay kokoaa kotityöt, niiden vaiheet, pisteet ja perheen palkinnot yhteen iPhoneen. Vanhempi suunnittelee sopivan tehtävän, lapsi seuraa sen vaiheita ja vanhempi tarkistaa työn ennen pisteiden myöntämistä.

Tänään: Valitse perheenjäsen, aloita seuraava tehtävä, merkitse vaiheet tehdyiksi ja lähetä työ tarkistettavaksi. Vanhempi voi palauttaa tehtävän ystävällisen ja täsmällisen palautteen kanssa.

Suunnittelu: Aloita yhdestä 12 valmiista kotityöideasta tai kirjoita omat tehtävät, päivämäärät, arvioidut kestot ja pistearvot. Vanhempi hyväksyy tehdyt työt. Tehtävää voi muokata tai sen voi poistaa ennen tarkistukseen lähettämistä.

Palkinnot: Seuraa ansaittuja, käytettävissä olevia, varattuja ja käytettyjä pisteitä. Palkintopyyntö varaa pisteet, ja pyynnön peruminen vapauttaa ne. Vanhempi vahvistaa palkinnon toteutumisen sen jälkeen, kun perhe on toteuttanut sen. Neljää valmista palkintoideaa voi täydentää ja muokata.

Perhe: Hallitse lempinimiä ja tarkastele pistekirjauksia. Valitse englannin- tai yksinkertaistetun kiinankielinen käyttöliittymä sekä vaalea, tumma tai järjestelmän mukainen ulkoasu. Vanhemman hallintatilaa suojataan paikallisella nelinumeroisella PIN-koodilla. Koodia ei voi palauttaa tilin kautta, joten säilytä se muistissa.

Perustoiminnot toimivat ilman verkkoyhteyttä ja käyttäjätiliä. Sovellus ei pyydä kameran, sijainnin tai yhteystietojen käyttöoikeutta. Siinä ei ole mainoksia, analytiikkaa, käytönaikaista tekoälyä tai tietojen lähettämistä palvelimelle. Tiedot tallennetaan tämän laitteen paikallisiin tiedostoihin, eikä niitä synkronoida laitteiden välillä. Laitteen varmuuskopiointiin vaikuttavat järjestelmäasetukset. Sovelluksen poistaminen poistaa paikalliset tiedot.

Sovellus on tarkoitettu iPhonelle pystysuunnassa, ja se vaatii iOS 17:n tai uudemman. Käyttöliittymä on saatavilla englanniksi ja yksinkertaistetuksi kiinaksi, ei suomeksi. Vanhemmat valitsevat perheelleen sopivat tehtävät ja palkinnot.
