Sovellus ei tarkista fyysisen työn valmistumista automaattisesti, aseta lapsia paremmuusjärjestykseen eikä vähennä pisteitä rangaistuksena.

name: ChoreLore: Family Chore Quest
description:
Turn chores into a family adventure. In ChoreLore the whole family plays as one team: every chore earns XP, levels up your hero and adds to the team score. Each week brings a new challenge — a monster to beat in a fantasy quest, a rival team in a sports season — and the story moves on when you win.

• Quests and seasons: 4, 8 or 12-week campaigns with a story chapter every week, or a sports season against rival families.
• Heroes and battle cries: pick a hero, unlock new ones, and hear them call out their battle cry.
• Built for parents: approve chores (with photo proof if you like), set rewards and screen-time tokens, and see who did what.
• Everyone on their own device: kids link with a short code — no email needed.
• Parent alerts: get notified when a kid asks for a reward or sends a photo.
• Grown-ups only: a secret Spy campaign based on real spy operations from history, with documentary-style mission briefings.

Free trial, then a family subscription.

name: Chromalyx
description:
Chromalyx is a private atelier for painters who want clearer color decisions outdoors and in the studio.

Import a photo or capture a scene. Chromalyx analyzes it entirely on your device—no account, no cloud analysis, no tracking—and turns the image into practical mixing references.

What you can do • Extract dominant color masses with share percentages
• Inspect LAB, HSV, and RGB values side by side
• Read value distribution and switch to black-and-white value maps
• See warm / cool / neutral balance for temperature relationships
• Simplify shapes into posterized masses and notan studies
• Probe any point on the photo for a live pigment reading
• Compare two colors with ΔE, value delta, and contrast guidance
• Save studies and palettes locally with notes and tags
• Export value maps and simplified previews when you choose

Built for plein air and studio practice Use Chromalyx to squint smarter: lock big value shapes first, then decide hue and temperature. Field Guides explain value-first thinking, warm–cool turns, LAB literacy, shape simplification, and private on-device workflow—paired with the tools in Studio and Compare.

Privacy by design Photos you select stay on your iPhone. Saved studies live in the app sandbox. You only share or export when you explicitly choose to.

Open Studio, try Demo, then analyze your own landscape, still life, or sketchbook photo.

name: Chronos Eternal Paradox
description:
Chronos Eternal Paradox is a sci-fi arcade duology built on one idea: time has shattered, and only you can piece it back together. Two very different worlds live inside one app, a stealthy grid chase and a flowing rune puzzle, each with its own rules and secrets.

In Paradox Run, you guide the last Chrononaut through fractured epochs, collecting Time Shards while clockwork Sentinels patrol the corridors. Short-range powers like Stasis fields and Phase shifts give you room to read patrol patterns, plan safe routes, and outmaneuver the clock before it turns on you.

Rune Rift takes that clock to a different battlefield. Swap glyphs, chain cascades, and trigger special runes to seal rifts in the timeline. Frost locks parts of the board, rust corrodes it, relics must be guided home, and special runes combine into powerful boardwide effects when matched together. Each rift sets its own goal: beat a timer, clear a hazard, or escort fragile objects to safety.

Both modes share the same philosophy: everything is unlocked, there are no purchases or energy timers, and every level respects your time. Controls support VoiceOver, and every rune uses a distinct shape as well as colour so the board stays readable at a glance.

name: CipherBench
description:
CipherBench är en offlineverkstad för klassiska chiffer. Välj ett chiffer och om du vill kryptera eller dekryptera, ange nyckel och text och se resultatet direkt. För substitutionschiffer kan du jämföra bokstäverna en i taget och visa reglerna och parametrarna bakom resultatet.

- Utforska 13 klassiska chiffer: Caesar, Atbash, affin substitution, nyckelordssubstitution, Vigenère, Beaufort, Playfair, Polybios kvadrat, rälsstaket, kolumntransposition, morse, A1Z26 och Bacons chiffer. Varje metod har en beskrivning, ett nyckelformat och ett genomräknat exempel.
- Ändra Caesars förskjutning med bokstavshjulet eller knapparna och se hur alfabetet förändras.
- Analysera bokstavsfrekvenser och sammanträffandeindex. Prova Caesar-kandidater eller låt appen uppskatta nyckellängd och nyckel för Vigenère utifrån engelsk text.
- Lös 14 övningar på tre nivåer, med ledtrådar och facit. Appen sparar lösta uppgifter och antal dagar i följd lokalt.
- Spara klartext och chiffertext i ett lokalt arkiv. Sök, filtrera efter metod, lägg till anteckningar och radera poster.

Appen fungerar offline. Arkiv och övningsframsteg lagras på enheten och kan rensas i appen.

Klassiska handchiffer är avsedda för övning, pussel och undervisning. De skyddar inte verkliga hemligheter och ersätter inte moderna krypteringsverktyg. Analysresultaten är statistiska uppskattningar och kan vara fel, särskilt för korta texter.

name: Civic Exam France 2026 - QCM
description:
Free, no ads, no subscription. Prepare France's mandatory civic exam (examen civique) for the multi-year residence card (CSP), the resident card (carte de résident) or French naturalisation.

Note: the app and the exam are in French.

• Every knowledge question from the lists published by the French Ministry of the Interior, per track
• Each answer checked, with a short explanation and its source (service-public, Légifrance…)
• Mock exam in the real format: 40 questions, 45 minutes, 28 knowledge + 12 situational, 32/40 to pass
• Situational questions written by us, clearly labelled
• Your mistakes come back until you know them
• Readiness score, daily set of 10, streak and an optional evening reminder
• Works offline, no account, no data collected

Independent app, not affiliated with the French State.

name: CivicReady: Citizenship Test
description:
Practice the 2025 U.S. citizenship civics test out loud, the way your naturalization interview works.

CivicReady reads each official question aloud. You answer out loud, then check the official answer. A practice interview ends at 12 right or 9 missed, like the real test.

THE REAL FORMAT
Up to 20 questions per practice interview, ending at 12 right or 9 missed. 65/20 mode for eligible applicants.

ALL 128 OFFICIAL QUESTIONS
Every question and answer from the 2025 civics test (USCIS form M-1778), for applications filed on or after October 20, 2025. Study all 128 for free, with audio.

YOUR STATE AND YOUR OFFICIALS
Pick your state to see its capital, and save your senators', representative's, and governor's names to practice with them. Answers that change after elections show the date they were last checked.

FEATURES
- Practice interviews that work like the real one
- Every question read aloud
- 65/20 mode for eligible applicants
- Your state's capital and your officials' names
- Study all 128 questions for free, with audio
- Pro (one purchase, no subscription): unlimited practice interviews, Review missed, and hands-free Listen mode

Your progress stays on your iPhone. No account. CivicReady is independent and not affiliated with USCIS or any government agency. Always confirm answers that change at uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates before your interview.

name: ClearMETAR: Aviation Weather
description:
ClearMETAR turns every METAR and TAF into one plain sentence. Ceiling, wind and what comes next, at a glance.

No report at your field? ClearMETAR uses the nearest reporting station and tells you which one, how far and which way.

READ THE WEATHER, FREE
• Decoded METAR and TAF in plain sentences
• Tap any code to learn what it means
• The screen takes the color of the flight category: VFR, MVFR, IFR or LIFR
• TAF timeline, with TEMPO and PROB on their own layer
• Runway wind: headwind and crosswind for every runway, gusts included
• Small fields with no report get the weather of the nearest station. Prefer another? Pick it.
• Density altitude, temperature and dew point spread, sunrise, sunset and night
• Airfields worldwide. Search by name, ident or city
• Statute miles or metres, inHg or hPa, °C or °F. In English and French
• Share a station as an image card with a link

CLEARMETAR PRO
• Alerts: a SPECI, a category change, an amended TAF, or weather below your personal minimums
• Your personal minimums in amber on every report and forecast
• 12-hour trends for wind, ceiling and visibility
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Apple Watch app and complications: category, wind, crosswind, forecast and density altitude
Try Pro free for 7 days. One subscription covers your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

No account. No ads. Your location stays on your device.

Weather data: NOAA Aviation Weather Center. Airfield data: OurAirports. ClearMETAR helps you read the weather. It is not an official briefing. Always check official sources before you fly.

SUBSCRIPTION
ClearMETAR Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, for 12 months or monthly. New subscribers get a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at the end of the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://clearmetar.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://clearmetar.com/legal/privacy

name: Clipboard Vault – Clip Saver
description:
Clipboard Vault is a private home for the things you copy and reuse: text, links, images, colors and files.

SAVE IN A TAP
• Copy something, open Clipboard Vault and tap Capture to save it.
• Share text, links, photos and files from any app to Clipboard Vault.
• Write reusable snippets for addresses, replies, code and more, with an optional title and note.
Clipboard Vault saves only what you choose. iOS doesn't let apps read the clipboard in the background, and Clipboard Vault never tries to.

PASTE IN ANY APP
• The Clipboard Vault keyboard is a full keyboard with your saved clips right on top. Tap a clip to insert it.
• No Full Access required. What you type is never stored or sent anywhere.

FIND IT AGAIN
• Instant search across text, titles, notes, tags, links and collections.
• Filter by type, date, favorites, collection or tag, and sort newest or oldest first.
• Pin favorites and group clips into collections with your own icon and color.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your clips stay on this device. No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Passwords, verification codes, card numbers and API keys are detected on your device and masked.
• Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID, and wipe everything instantly if you need to.
• Optional iCloud sync uses your own private iCloud database.

FREE AND LIFETIME
Clipboard Vault is free to download. The free plan keeps each clip for 7 days. A one-time Lifetime in-app purchase keeps your clips forever. No subscription.

name: Close Checklist
description:
Organize client-month checklists on one device. Track which items are missing, requested, received and reviewed. Keep notes and dates beside each item, prepare a missing-item summary and start the next month with a fresh checklist.

Receipt and review are separate steps. A month cannot silently carry forward completed statuses. Export CSV records or a JSON backup for your own workflow.

Close Checklist stores checklist metadata, not accounting files. It does not provide a client portal, accounting integration, tax advice or independent verification. Works on one device, with no account or cloud sync. Save text edits before closing, and keep your own backups.

name: Club Mogul: Idle Rave Tycoon
description:
Your nightlife empire starts in a sweaty basement in Berlin. Where does it end? In a club in orbit.

CLUB MOGUL is an idle tycoon game with a beating heart: the soundtrack is original house music that grows with your club. Every room you build adds a new layer – kick, hi-hats, bass, chords, vocal chops – until the whole place is jumping.

BUILD YOUR CLUB
• 8 rooms in every venue: door, soda bar, dance floor, DJ booth, snack bar, merch store, VIP lounge and rooftop
• Upgrade them, reach milestones for ×2 profit and ×2 speed
• Hire managers who keep the party running – even while you are away
• Come back to a full safe and collect your earnings

HIT THE DROP
• Tap the big DROP button on the beat: PERFECT timing builds HYPE fast
• Fill the meter and unleash a BASS DROP – triple income, lasers, confetti and the full track
• Catch the spinning golden vinyl and welcome VIP guests at the door for big bonuses

SIX VENUES, ONE ENDLESS WORLD TOUR
Basement Party in Berlin → Warehouse Rave in Manchester → Skyline Rooftop in New York → Beach Club in Ibiza → Mainstage Festival → Orbit Club. Every venue has its own look, lights and music style – and after the Orbit Club the World Tour goes on and on.

COLLECT 16 DJs
• Common, rare, epic and legendary DJs, each with a unique perk
• Book up to 3 headliners in your DJ booth and level them up with duplicate cards
• Every DJ in your collection boosts all of your income

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily gift calendar, 3 daily missions and a free spin on the prize wheel
• Club Pass with 30 tiers of rewards every season
• Fame perks that make every new venue faster
• Nearly 40 achievements to unlock

FAIR PLAY, PROMISE
• Free to play. No ads. No tracking. No account. Plays offline.
• Record crates are only ever earned by playing – they are never sold: not for money, not for gems and not in the Club Pass.
• The odds of every crate and of the prize wheel are shown right in the game.
• Every DJ, venue and reward can be earned by playing. Optional in-app purchases – gem packs, VIP Membership, Club Manager and more – only speed things up. VIP Membership and Club Manager can be restored at any time.
• The bar serves sodas, smoothies and mocktails only.

Turn the music up, tap on the beat and become the biggest Club Mogul on the planet – and beyond.

name: Coaching Swimmers
description:
Coach every swimmer with one app built for the pool deck. Keep your roster organized, assign swimmers to multiple lane stopwatches, and track different events at the same time. Record or upload video, then add feedback to help athletes understand what to work on next.

Log swims with the event, course, session type, final time, optional goal, and 25- or 50-meter splits. Review pacing, positive or negative splits, fastest and slowest splits, and how each split compares with the goal. Personal-best badges, season top-three rankings, and school records make progress easy to follow.

Plan the season with an editable 16-week program spanning Base, Threshold & Technique, Race Sharpening, and Taper, with workouts for aerobic work, threshold, race pace, technique, IM, and dryland.

The app features:
Athlete roster (add, rename, merge),
Record (or upload) video and Coach feedback
Multiple lane stopwatch where each lane can be assigned to an athlete
Swim times: records event (stroke and distance), course (SCY/SCM/LCM), practice/meet/time trial, final time, optional goal time, and 25/50 splits.
Splits: if you enter real splits, the final time is their sum. If you leave them blank, the splits are estimated evenly and labeled as estimated.
Swim detail: shows first-half vs second-half, positive or negative split, fastest and slowest split, and ahead/behind goal at each split.
Personal bests: a PB badge appears on each swimmer’s current best in an event and course.
Season Records: a screen showing the season’s top three swimmers per event.
School Records
Training plan: with an editable 16-week swim season (Base, Threshold & Technique, Race Sharpening, Taper) with workout types such as aerobic, threshold, race pace, technique, IM, and dryland.

School Records
The list starts empty.
To add a record by hand, tap +. You can type any event name, such as 100 yd Backstroke or one of your own. A menu also offers suggested events and any you’ve already used.
To import, use the ... menu, then Import CSV.
The columns are Team, Event, Record Holder(s), Time, Year.
Team is Girls or Boys.
Relay swimmers go in one quoted cell.
Any new event names are created automatically, in the order they appear.
A row for an event that already has a record updates it.
You can also paste from Excel.
Export CSV uses the same format, so an export imports straight back in.

Roster
Roster > Add Swimmer has a Girl / Boy picker. You can change it later with the badge by each name.
Roster > Import CSV takes Name, Gender, where gender can be Girl or Boy (G/B and F/M also work). First Name and Last Name columns work too. Importing a name that’s already on the roster updates their gender.
Swimmers added automatically while logging a swim have no gender. The Roster screen flags them until you set it.

Logged Swims
It is now its own sidebar item, directly above School Records, with Girls and Boys tabs. It uses the gender set in the Roster.
If any logged swimmers have no gender, a third Not Set tab appears so they don’t disappear. That tab goes away once everyone has a gender.


Events on the stopwatches
Set Event for All puts one event on every stopwatch, and each stopwatch shows its event under the swimmer’s name.
Tap a stopwatch’s event to give just that one a different event, for swimmers doing a different set at the same time. Stopwatches with their own event show in a darker purple.
Choose “Same as all lanes” to put one back. Using Set Event for All again resets every stopwatch to that single event.
When you save a swim, it is logged under that stopwatch’s own event. The shared results text lists each lane’s event.

Coach-made events
In the event picker, tap New Event and enter a name and a total distance, such as 3000 Practice Workout.
Your events appear under “My Events” in the picker (swipe to delete), and also in the Add Swim event list.
They save and show in Logged Swims and swimmer history under their own name.

name: Coffee Count: Caffeine Tracker
description:
Your coffee. Your habits. Your balance.

Love coffee, tea, matcha, or energy drinks? Coffee Count helps you understand your daily caffeine intake without judgment, pressure, or complicated tracking.

Whether you want to be more mindful of your caffeine, explore your sleep habits, improve your routine, or simply stay curious, Coffee Count is here to help.

ONE-TAP CAFFEINE TRACKING

• Log coffee, tea, matcha, energy drinks, cola, and more
• Track your estimated caffeine intake in milligrams
• Customize serving sizes and caffeine amounts
• Record when and why you enjoy your drinks
• Explore your daily and weekly habits

UNDERSTAND YOUR ROUTINE

Discover when you usually drink caffeine and what motivates you.

• View your consumption history
• Explore visual charts and patterns
• Record optional sleep and focus check-ins
• Follow your own goals, at your own pace

A MOMENT FOR YOURSELF

Thinking about another coffee?

Caffeine Pause gives you a gentle moment to reflect. Take a short break, check your records, or simply enjoy your drink.

No guilt. No pressure. The choice is yours.

GO FURTHER WITH COFFEE COUNT PRO

Unlock more personalized tools designed to help you understand your habits and explore small, meaningful changes.

Personal Coach
Get guidance based on your goals, recorded habits, and previous experiences. No AI required.

Personal 7-Day Program
Explore one small, optional step at a time. Pause, skip, or adjust your approach whenever you like.

Advanced Insights
Explore detailed caffeine patterns, an animated caffeine rhythm, and your personal caffeine profile.

Adaptive Experiments
Try small changes and compare your recorded habits before and after.

My Toolkit
Keep the strategies you've found helpful and revisit them whenever you need them.

Smart Reminders
Receive optional, personalized reminders based on your goals and preferences.

Weekly Letter
Reflect on your week through a personal summary of your records and experiences.

MADE FOR COFFEE LOVERS

Coffee Count isn't about forcing you to quit caffeine.

It's about understanding your choices, finding what works for you, and enjoying the drinks you love with greater awareness.

Your information is stored locally on your device. No account is required.

Caffeine amounts and rhythm visualizations are estimates, not medical measurements or advice.

Enjoy what you love. Find your balance.

Download Coffee Count and start discovering your own rhythm today.

name: Cogniswipe
description:
Cogniswipe is a focused micro-learning app for authentic English phrases and fixed collocations. Open it between meetings or on the commute, swipe a short deck, and close it with a clear win.

HOW IT WORKS
• Practice — swipe right when a phrase feels familiar, left to schedule a review.
• Grammar Trap Cards — spot the natural fix for common learner slips.
• Scene Talk — short dialogues for cafés, standups, polite declines, shopping, networking, and travel.
• Insights — due cards, comfort count, streaks, focus minutes, and recent sessions.
• More — daily goals, session length, haptics, privacy details, and local reset.

WHY COGNISWIPE
• Built for fragmented time: short sessions, not long courses.
• Spaced repetition (SM-2 style) so harder items return sooner.
• Phrase + collocation focus for sounding natural, not textbook-stiff.
• Colorful card decks with clear visual cues — text and imagery together.
• Fully usable offline. Progress stays on your device.

No account required for core study. Cogniswipe is a quiet, deliberate language tool — swipe, learn, repeat.

name: ColorBloom: Paint by Number
description:
ColorBloom is a color by number app where every picture tells part of a story: tap a number, fill the area, and watch a gray world bloom back into color.

Pick a color from the palette, tap the matching numbered areas, and see your artwork come to life one area at a time. No drawing skills needed, just a few calm minutes.

STORY MODE
• 8 illustrated fairy tale stories with 6 to 8 chapters each
• Finish a chapter to unlock the next one and read what happens
• Each story cover fills with color as you progress

200+ PICTURES TO COLOR
• Cute, Anime, Magic, Animal, Nature and Flower categories
• Trending picks on the home screen
• Detailed coloring pages for relaxing sessions

HELPFUL TOOLS
• Find Spot zooms straight to an area you have not filled yet
• Fill Color paints every area of the selected color at once
• Pinch to zoom in on the smallest details
• The selected color's empty areas are highlighted so nothing is missed

GROW AS AN ARTIST
• Earn 3 stars for every finished picture
• Level up from Tiny Artist all the way to Art Superstar

YOUR GALLERY
• My Art keeps your pictures in progress and your finished artwork
• Pick up any picture right where you left off
• Share finished art with friends, or re-draw a favorite from scratch

Available in English, Spanish, Vietnamese and Japanese.

Terms of Use: https://mobocovietnam.com/Term-of-Use.html

name: Computer View
description:
Control your Mac from your iPhone or iPad with a dedicated trackpad and keyboard, no Mac companion app required.

Turn iPhone Duo into a tiny laptop for your Mac. See your Mac desktop above the fold, use the dedicated trackpad below, and switch to the keyboard when it's time to type.

Terms of Service: https://www.andrewfinke.com/terms

name: Cộng Đồng Tài Xế
description:
Cộng Đồng Tài Xế là mạng xã hội giao thông tương tác hàng đầu dành riêng cho cộng đồng bác tài Ô tô, Xe máy, Xe tải và Xe đường dài trên toàn lãnh thổ Việt Nam. Nơi anh em cầm lái kết nối, cập nhật thông tin đường sá thời gian thực, trao đổi kinh nghiệm xử lý tình huống thực chiến và cùng nhau gìn giữ vạn dặm bình an.

TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT DÀNH CHO BÁC TÀI:

1. CẢNH BÁO CUNG ĐƯỜNG & GIAO THÔNG 24/7
- Cập nhật liên tục tình trạng thời tiết xấu, sương mù dày đặc trên các cung đèo lớn (Đèo Bảo Lộc, Đèo Prenn, Đèo Cả, Đèo Hải Vân...).
- Báo cáo điểm ngập úng theo chiều cao gầm xe, sạt lở đất đá, ổ voi ổ gà, đoạn đường đang thi công hoặc trơn trượt nguy hiểm.
- Thông báo mật độ ùn tắc tại các nút giao thông trọng điểm, trạm thu phí BOT và cửa ngõ thành phố lớn.

2. GÓC CAMERA HÀNH TRÌNH (DASHCAM) & KINH NGHIỆM THỰC CHIẾN
- Chia sẻ và phân tích các tình huống giao thông nguy hiểm, điểm mù xe tải lớn, kỹ năng giữ khoảng cách an toàn trên cao tốc.
- Rút kinh nghiệm thực chiến từ các clip va chạm thực tế, nâng cao phản xạ lái xe phòng thủ (Defensive Driving).

3. HỎI ĐÁP LUẬT GIAO THÔNG & BIỂN BÁO CHUẨN XÁC
- Tra cứu nhanh quy chuẩn biển báo hiệu đường bộ QCVN 41, vạch kẻ đường và hiệu lệnh phân làn giao thông.
- Giải đáp thắc mắc về lỗi vi phạm, quy định xử phạt vi phạm hành chính mới nhất, giúp tài xế vững vàng tay lái và chấp hành đúng pháp luật.

4. CẨM NANG CHĂM XE & CHỐNG "VẼ BỆNH" GARA
- Kinh nghiệm bảo dưỡng ô tô các mốc quan trọng (1 vạn, 4 vạn, 8 vạn, 10 vạn km): Giữ lại các hạng mục cốt lõi, loại bỏ phụ gia không cần thiết.
- Mẹo phát hiện sớm hư hỏng thước lái, hệ thống phanh, lốp xe, nước làm mát và ắc quy.
- Đánh giá địa chỉ gara, trạm dừng nghỉ, trạm sạc xe điện uy tín từ chính cộng đồng tài xế trải nghiệm.

5. ĐỒNG HÀNH - KẾT NỐI - HỖ TRỢ CỨU HỘ
- Đăng bài chia sẻ và tương tác hỏi đáp nhiều cấp linh hoạt.
- Kết nối mạng lưới anh em lái xe khắp các tỉnh thành, sẵn sàng hỗ trợ, chia sẻ kinh nghiệm cứu hộ và hướng dẫn đường tránh khi gặp sự cố.

TẢI CỘNG ĐỒNG TÀI XẾ NGAY HÔM NAY ĐỂ CÙNG NHAU NÂNG CAO VĂN HÓA GIAO THÔNG VÀ VỮNG BƯỚC TRÊN MỌI HÀNH TRÌNH!

name: Conquer Statistics
description:
Turn statistics from formulas you memorize into ideas you can see, explain, and use.

Conquer Statistics builds statistical intuition across five parts:

Part 1: Exploring one-variable data and collecting data
• Investigative questions, populations and samples, parameters and statistics
• Categorical data, bar charts, pie charts
• Dotplots, stemplots, histograms, cumulative frequency plots
• Describing distributions, center and spread, z-scores, boxplots
• Sampling methods, bias, observational studies, and experiments

Part 2: Probability, random variables, and sampling distributions
• Two-way tables, probability rules, conditional probability, independence
• Random variables, expected value, variance
• Binomial and normal distributions, normal calculations
• Sampling distributions and the central limit theorem

Part 3: Inference for proportions and categorical data
• Estimators and sampling distributions
• Confidence intervals and tests for one proportion
• Confidence intervals and tests for two proportions
• Chi-square tests of independence and homogeneity

Part 4: Inference for means and quantitative data
• Sampling distribution of means and the t-distribution
• Confidence intervals and tests for one mean
• Paired data and two independent samples
• Simulation p-values, power, and errors

Part 5: Regression analysis
• Scatterplots, correlation, coefficient of determination
• Least-squares regression line, slope and intercept
• Residuals, residual plots, and influence

Every part includes
• Knowledge cards with definitions, key points, worked examples, pitfalls, and tips
• Practice sets with multiple-choice and free-response questions, full explanations, and rubrics
• A reference sheet of formulas, terms, and statistical-thinking tips

Why it works
• Charts are drawn inside the app: histograms, boxplots, normal curves, scatterplots, and regression lines — crisp and easy to read in dark mode
• Three interface languages: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English
• Progress, answer history, and mistakes stay on your device; no account needed
• Works offline after the first download
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no third-party tracking

Who it's for
• High-school and university students learning statistics
• Learners reviewing statistical concepts and problem-solving methods
• Self-learners who want to read and reason with data

Privacy
No account is required. To download lessons and understand app usage, the app contacts our content server with a randomly generated installation identifier. The server records the installation identifier, IP address, IP-derived country, platform, operating system version, app version, last-used time, and request count for content delivery, access recognition, and usage statistics; it is not used for tracking and is never sold. Learning progress stays on your device. Usage data is retained for 90 days. No ads, no in-app purchases, no third-party SDKs.

name: Courtwise: Pickleball Rotation
description:
Run fair open play without the paddle stack.

Paste your players' names, pick your courts and tap Next round. Courtwise decides who plays and who sits, mixes partners, and shows every court in names big enough to read from the bench.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• Nobody sits out twice in a row when it can be avoided
• Sit-outs are spread evenly across the session
• Partners and opponents mix round after round

BUILT FOR REAL SESSIONS
• Late arrivals, breaks and early leavers in one tap
• Undo a round if something changed
• Big display mode for a phone or iPad on a court-side stand
• A summary of games played and sit-outs when you finish

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No accounts for you or your players
• Works offline; names stay on your device

FREE AND PRO
Free for 1 or 2 courts. Pro is one purchase with no subscription: up to 8 courts, saved groups and skill balance.

For pickleball, padel, tennis doubles and badminton doubles: any game with four players on a court.

name: Crack: Code Duel
description:
Crack is the classic code-breaking duel for two people and one phone.

Each of you sets a secret four-colour code. Then you guess each other's. After
every guess you get pips: a gold dot for a right colour in the right place, a
white ring for a right colour in the wrong place. Crack their code in fewer
guesses than they crack yours and you win the round.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Open the phone and lay it flat on the table, or stand it half-open like a book.
Each half faces one player, split exactly on the crease, so you both play at
the same time on your own side. Your secret code is masked while you enter it;
hold Peek to check it, let go and it is hidden again. Fold the phone mid-game
and nothing is lost.

PASS & PLAY ON ANY IPHONE
No Duo? Take turns and hand the phone over. A curtain screen hides everything
between turns, so neither player sees more than they should.

FAIR BY DESIGN
When one player cracks the code on guess five, the other gets to finish their
fifth guess too. Fewest guesses wins. Same number is a draw. A running series
score keeps the rivalry going across rematches.

MAKE IT YOURS
• 6 or 8 colours, repeats on or off, 8, 10 or 12 guesses each
• Player names
• Shapes on every peg for colour-blind play
• Haptics you can turn off
• Full VoiceOver support

One price, no ads, no subscription, no account, nothing collected. Just the two
of you and a code to crack.

name: Crank Layer
description:
Start with the barrel. Enter its diameter, the width of the spool, the line diameter, and how many metres you want on it.

Each turn adds the circumference of the layer you are on. Turns in one layer are the width divided by the line. The next layer sits two line diameters farther out.

A 30 mm barrel, 12 mm wide, with 0.30 mm line, holds 40 turns on a layer. Twenty-two turns on the first layer are about 2.1 m.

Add one turn, undo the last turn, or open another spool. The numbers stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. Share sends one line: the spool name, the metres, and the layer.

name: CTSMD Connect
description:
**CTSMD Connect: Your Theatre Community, All in One Place**

Every great production takes a community. CTSMD Connect brings the Children's Theatre of Southern Maryland community together, helping performers, families, volunteers, and production teams stay informed, organized, and connected.

From the first audition to the final curtain call, CTSMD Connect makes it easier to keep up with everything happening onstage and behind the scenes.

**STAY CONNECTED**

Keep conversations going with direct messages, group discussions, and community channels. Share updates, ask questions, and stay in touch with the people who make each production possible.

**KEEP TRACK OF WHAT'S NEXT**

Find rehearsals, performances, production events, and important dates in one convenient place. Stay informed about schedule changes and upcoming commitments.

**MANAGE YOUR FAMILY'S THEATRE EXPERIENCE**

Parents and guardians can access household information, manage family connections, review assigned forms, and keep track of their children's theatre activities.

**GET INVOLVED**

Explore volunteer opportunities, manage commitments, and help support the productions and programs that bring our community to life.

**NEVER MISS AN IMPORTANT UPDATE**

Stay informed with notifications about messages, production announcements, assigned tasks, and other activities that need your attention.

**EVERYTHING YOU NEED, BEHIND ONE CURTAIN**

Whether you're a performer preparing for opening night, a parent coordinating schedules, a volunteer lending a hand, or a production team member keeping things running smoothly, CTSMD Connect helps everyone play their part.

**Built for the Children's Theatre of Southern Maryland. Powered by our theatre community.**

Because the magic doesn't just happen onstage. It happens when we all come together.

name: CueSplice
description:
One rehearsal. One mix that follows your plan.

CueSplice helps dance teachers, choreographers and performance organizers turn their own audio files into a rehearsal-ready sequence. Keep the parts you need, put them in performance order, and adjust the mix when the choreography changes.

SHAPE EACH EXCERPT
Trim the beginning and end against the waveform, preview the selection and adjust its volume.

SET THE RUNNING ORDER
Drag excerpts into place. Add a count-in or a quiet gap, or use a crossfade where two sections should flow together. A fixed waveform player keeps playback and seeking within reach.

TAKE IT TO REHEARSAL
Export WAV or M4A through the system share sheet. Keep an editable project, or create a full project backup with the source audio for later restoration.

YOUR FILES, ON YOUR DEVICE
Editing works offline. No account, advertising or developer audio upload service. Import your own unprotected local audio; streaming downloads and DRM-protected tracks are not supported.

FREE TO START
Create two personal projects free, with every editing tool and WAV/M4A export included. The reusable demo does not use your allowance. A one-time, non-consumable purchase unlocks unlimited new projects. No subscription. Per-project limits remain the same: up to 20 clips and a 10-minute output.

Keep full project backups of important work. You are responsible for the rights to the audio you import.

name: CutQuill
description:
Make your first cut with CutQuill. Bring your footage into a focused mobile editor, shape your story, then render and share a finished video.

EDIT YOUR FOOTAGE
Import videos and photos from Photos or Files. Trim, split and reorder scenes, choose portrait, square or landscape framing, adjust original audio, and add captions. Preview your edit with native video playback and undo changes as you work.

START WITH A DRAFT
Build an automatic first cut from your clips. When your connected CutQuill service and account support AI, request a draft, revise an edit or generate captions. The app explains what will be shared and asks permission before each AI request. Review AI edits and captions before sharing.

SAVE AND SHARE
Projects save on your device. Sign in to keep private uploads and account backups on your connected service. Render an MP4, follow export progress and share the downloaded result through your device's share sheet. Background music and animated titles are included in the rendered export; review the finished video for those effects.

MADE FOR MOBILE
Use light, dark or device appearance, accessible controls and optional haptic feedback. Your device credentials are stored securely. Privacy, support and account-deletion controls are available in Settings.

CutQuill is a companion to the CutQuill editing service. Cloud uploads, backups, AI and rendering require an internet connection and are subject to service availability and account allowances. There are no purchases in this app. Local editing does not require AI. Website walkthrough tools and connected cloud-provider browsing are available in the web product and are not included in this mobile app.

name: Cyber Carrom
description:
Bring carrom to your screen with Cyber Carrom. Aim your striker, control your shot and pocket the coins.

Take on the Daily Challenge, play matches and personalise your game with boards, strikers and effect packs.

Optional in-app purchases include cosmetic items and Remove Ads. Purchased cosmetics can be equipped in the shop.

name: DaeJangBu Viewer
description:
One app for all your documents.

DaeJangBu Viewer opens more than 90 file types, including Korean HWP and HWPX, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF, e-books, and comics. Choose DaeJangBu Viewer from any app's share menu and the file opens.

■ HWP files, free and true to the original

HWP files often break on phones: text goes missing and tables shift. DaeJangBu Viewer keeps tables, images, and page breaks where they were laid out, so notices from school, work, or a government office read the way they were written. (Very complex formatting may look slightly different.)

■ No ads, no sign-up, no purchases

It's free from start to finish. The app doesn't use the internet, so your documents, bookmarks, and notes stay on your phone.

■ Files it opens

• HWP documents — hwp, hwpx, hml, hwt, hwtx
• Word processing — docx, doc, docm, dot, dotx, dotm, rtf, odt, ott
• Spreadsheets — xlsx, xls, xlsm, xlsb, xlt, xltx, xltm, ods, ots, cell, csv, tsv, prn, skv, XML Spreadsheet 2003
• Slides — pptx, ppsx, potx, pptm, ppt, pps, pot, show, odp
• PDF
• E-books — epub, mobi, azw, azw3, prc, fb2
• Comics — cbz, cbr, cb7, cbt
• Text and web — txt, md, markdown, html, htm, xhtml, mht, mhtml, xml, json, jsonl, ndjson, log, vcf
• Email — eml, with its attachment list
• Subtitles — srt, vtt, smi, ass, ssa
• Settings files — ini, cfg, conf, toml, yaml, yml, properties
• Images — jpg, jpeg, jpe, jfif, png, gif, bmp, webp, ico, heic, heif
• Scans and faxes — tif, tiff (multi-page)
• Documents inside zip, tar, gz, and tgz archives

■ Reading

• Read aloud — keeps going with the screen off
• Highlights in six colors, underlines, and notes
• Bookmarks, and Resume to pick up where you left off
• Find in document — results show page numbers in HWP documents
• Capture screen — crop it, mark it up with a pen or highlighter, and share it
• Print, or share the file with another app
• Text size, line spacing, margins, and five page themes
• Dark at night, for easier reading in low light
• Two-page view in landscape for PDF, HWP documents, slides, and comics
• Korean fonts built in, so documents look the same on any device

■ Finding documents

• Search by title or author, even by Korean initial consonants (ㄷㅈㅂ)
• Link a folder and pick documents from it in one place
• Browse by favorites, reading status, or format

Contact: ssadaryzerom@gmail.com
Privacy policy: https://y-mj-pro.github.io/daejangbu-legal/privacy-en.html

name: Daily Mahjong Puzzle: 3D Game
description:
‧‧‧ Match Smarter. Play Differently. ‧‧‧
Love Mahjong? Ready for a Fresh New Experience?

Daily Mahjong Puzzle: 3D Match brings a fresh twist to classic Mahjong Solitaire with innovative Dual-Layer Mahjong, unique Diagonal Roll Gameplay, smooth 3D visuals, and creative puzzle layouts.

Tap, slide, and roll Mahjong tiles, discover hidden matches, challenge your mind, and enjoy a relaxing tile-matching adventure unlike traditional Mahjong games.

Whether you're a Mahjong fan or new to puzzle games, this easy-to-learn yet challenging experience offers satisfying moments every day.

‧‧‧ A Fresh Take on Classic Mahjong ‧‧‧
Classic Mahjong has never felt this fresh.

Explore dual-layered puzzle layouts, discover hidden tiles, and create new matching opportunities through smart moves and unique mechanics.

Slide tiles through the board, use diagonal rolling to reveal new possibilities, and enjoy the perfect balance between relaxation and strategy.

Every puzzle offers a new challenge. Every move matters.

‧‧‧ Discover a New Mahjong Experience ‧‧‧
· Dual-Layer Mahjong
Experience Mahjong from a new perspective. Match tiles across two interactive layers, uncover hidden opportunities, and solve puzzles with deeper strategy.

· Diagonal Roll Gameplay
Try a unique movement mechanic that changes how you solve puzzles. Roll Mahjong tiles through special paths, create new matching possibilities, and discover unexpected solutions.

· Creative Puzzle Levels
Enjoy hundreds of handcrafted Mahjong puzzles with creative layouts, different objectives, and unique challenges. From relaxing matches to brain-training puzzles, every level brings something new.

· Daily Challenges
A brand-new Mahjong puzzle awaits every day. Complete daily levels, maintain your streak, and earn rewards through fresh challenges.

· Journey Adventures
Progress through themed journeys, unlock new scenes, collect rewards, and enjoy a relaxing adventure as you complete puzzles.

· Customize Your Mahjong Style
Choose from different Mahjong tile skins and background themes to create your own relaxing 3D Mahjong world.

Use powerful boosters to reveal hidden matches, overcome difficult situations, and complete challenging puzzles.

· Smooth tap, slide, and roll controls  
· Creative Mahjong puzzle layouts  
· Fresh Daily Challenges every day  
· Rewarding Journey progression  
· Customizable tile skins and backgrounds  
· Helpful boosters for challenging puzzles  
· Easy to learn, fun to master  

Perfect for Mahjong & Puzzle Lovers
Whether you enjoy Mahjong Solitaire, matching games, or relaxing brain puzzles, Daily Mahjong Puzzle: 3D Match offers the perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.

Start Your Mahjong Adventure Today!
Match smarter, solve creative puzzles, and discover a fresh way to enjoy Mahjong.

Download Daily Mahjong Puzzle: 3D Match now and begin your Mahjong journey!

name: Dash: Focus Buddy
description:
Dash: Focus Buddy es tu compañero experto en foco: un Yorkie de orejas dobladas que vive en tu iPhone y te ayuda a terminar lo que de verdad importa.

TUS PRIORIDADES DEL DÍA
Cada mañana eliges tus 3 prioridades. Marca cuáles tienen alto impacto y cuáles tienen a alguien esperando, y Dash te sugiere el mejor orden y te explica por qué. ¿Tienes más tareas? Agrégalas en "También hoy", hasta 7 en total.

BLOQUES DE FOCO
Trabaja en bloques de 25, 50 o 90 minutos con un temporizador visual. Al terminar, Dash te propone un descanso de 5 minutos, y uno largo cada 4 bloques. El tiempo restante aparece en tu pantalla bloqueada y en la Dynamic Island.

INTERRUPCIONES BAJO CONTROL
Cuando llega una emergencia, decide en segundos si es urgente o si puede esperar. Lo urgente pausa tu bloque; lo que puede esperar se queda en el Estacionamiento, no en tu cabeza.

ADIÓS A LAS ARDILLAS
Define tus ventanas para revisar mensajes. Si te escapas a redes, al correo o a WhatsApp, regístralo con un toque y Dash te ayuda a volver, sin regaños.

CIERRE DEL DÍA
Mira la línea de tu día, tus fugas y tus interrupciones. Decide qué pasa a mañana y qué sueltas, revisa tu semana y tu racha, y anota cómo te sentiste.

TAMBIÉN INCLUYE
• Widget "Ahora mismo" para la pantalla de inicio y la de bloqueo
• Recordatorios para tu plan de la mañana, tus ventanas de mensajes y el cierre
• Cinco compañeros más para elegir: Chispa, Nopi, Nimbo, Bit y Quetzi

PRIVACIDAD
Sin cuentas, sin anuncios y sin rastreo. Todo se queda en tu iPhone.

LA HISTORIA DE DASH
Dash existe de verdad: es un Yorkie de orejas dobladas que acompaña a su dueño cada día de trabajo. Ahora también puede acompañarte a ti.

name: DBIS Connect
description:
Connect to compatible Dirty Burners Commercial Monitoring Panels over Bluetooth to view live oxygen readings, temperature, and device status beside your equipment.

DBIS Connect helps service technicians and facility teams monitor connected panels and perform authorized configuration tasks.

VIEW LIVE READINGS
Connect up to four panels and view each device's oxygen level, temperature, serial number, BACnet settings, status, and sensor powered runtime.

FOLLOW OXYGEN TRENDS
Compare recent oxygen readings in a live chart. Show or hide individual device traces and adjust the chart history and gridlines.

MANAGE CONNECTED PANELS
Use password-protected commands to change device names and BACnet configuration, manage device passwords, calibrate sensors, and restart panels. Available commands depend on compatible panel firmware.

ADJUST YOUR WORKFLOW
Set scan duration, optional scanning at startup, and command response timeout. Manage saved device passwords and contact support from Settings.

Compatible Dirty Burners Commercial Monitoring Panel hardware is required for live measurements and device commands. The app connects locally over Bluetooth; no app account is required. Device configuration commands require the panel's password.

For qualified equipment service and monitoring. Existing burner-management and safety systems remain authoritative.

name: Dear you: Mood Journal
description:
Dear you is a pretty pink diary that feels like a real journal and answers like a best friend.

A JOURNAL THAT WRITES BACK
Write your page, list three good things, then press the wax seal. Your diary writes back in ink, noticing what you wrote, cheering you on or keeping you company on a heavy day.

HOW ARE YOU, REALLY?
Pick a face from Heavy to Glowing, fill your energy battery, and check in on each part of life: career, love, friends, family, health, money and me-time. Add your own areas too.

HABITS AND MOOD TRACKERS
Tick off water, skincare, reading or anything you're building. See your month as a calendar of mood faces, a habit dot grid, and a life wheel that shows which parts of life feel full and which need a little love.

VISION BOARD AND AFFIRMATIONS
Pin your dreams, from a promotion to a trip to Kyoto, break them into baby steps, and see how your mood changes on the days you work on them. A new affirmation greets you on your page every day, and you can write your own.

YOUR BOOKSHELF AND FILM STRIP
Add the books you read and the movies you watch, rate them, and write what they made you feel.

ABOUT ME
A page that's all you: your zodiac, your era, likes and dislikes, favourite songs and shows, and your favourite photos.

STICKERS EVERYWHERE
Decorate your pages with gem hearts, satin bows, gingham, tulips, an iced pink latte and more than 30 other stickers.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone, and it works offline.

Dear you is a friend, not a therapist. If you're struggling or feel unsafe, please reach out to someone you trust or a crisis line.

name: DeliveryLife Lite
description:
Milky used to be on stage.
Now she's a delivery rider who can barely make rent on a one-room flat.

But the dream isn't over.
Delivery by delivery, she rents a practice room, gets the old members back, records a demo…
and finally buys out the agency that dropped her, Starlight Ent.

■ Auto handles the deliveries, you handle the chaos
• Auto-delivery takes the call, picks up outside the shop and drops off at the door — even fast bikes brake before corners.
• Watch, and when a star event pops up, jump in yourself: thief chases, delivery duels, customers' weird requests.
• Grab the handlebars any time. Controls are just move plus two buttons.

■ A small Korean neighborhood, seen from above
• Market, food alley, café street, industrial park, riverside.
• Rain, heat waves, storms and snow. Food spoils fast in the heat; gusts shove you around in a storm.
• Big helmet, tiny scooter, even bigger delivery box.

■ 14 rides · tuning · para-bara horns
• From a scooter to a van, a broom, a rocket fridge, a UFO and a Chicken Dragon.
• Horns, tuning, custom paint and a super engine — build your own delivery machine.
• Delivery-only mode is open from the start.

■ Gig minigames
• Fan-letter chaos, wedding songs, paparazzi chases, chicken commercials… all the way to Billboard No. 1.
• Better grades, bigger paychecks.

■ More than one ending
• Part 1 "Comeback" — buy back your old agency and return to the stage.
• Part 2 "Queen of Delivery" — beat 12 rival delivery companies in duels and buy them out.
• Part 3 "Queen of Dining" — buy 24 local restaurants and take your company public.
• After the ending: [Keep delivering].

■ Bonus modes
• Minigame mode — jump straight into any gig minigame.
• Zombie mode — auto-fire your way through a zombie-filled neighborhood and find the rooftop where the rescue chopper lands.

■ Free to play
• The whole game is free. One ad plays at the end of each in-game day. Remove ads forever with a single purchase. Plays offline too.
• 11 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German, Russian.

name: Diamond in the Rough
description:
Somewhere in a mountain of 100 million ordinary rocks sits one legendary diamond. Your job is to find it.

DIG, SORT, GET PAID
Hold to fill your bucket, tip it onto the sorting table and inspect every rock. Ordinary stones pay a coin or two. Quartz, amethyst, garnet, gold, topaz and aquamarine pay much more. When a batch is done, watch the whole haul shower into your coin pile.

UPGRADE EVERYTHING
Swap your bucket for a wheelbarrow, a dump truck and eventually a mountain silo. Speed up the sorting table. Hire an apprentice, then build conveyors, crushers, sorters and scanners that keep working while you're away.

CHASE THE RARE ONES
Sapphires, rubies, emeralds, alexandrite, black opal and painite are rare, and each one powers up a different part of your mine. Every new discovery gets its own big reveal.

THE LEGENDARY
Your odds start at 1 in 100,000,000 and improve with every rock you search. The diamond only turns up while you're playing, so you'll be there when it happens.

THEN DIG DEEPER
Finding the legendary earns Diamond Dust. Spend it on permanent perks, then set off for new deposits like the Amethyst Caverns, each with its own legendary to find.

FAIR TO PLAY
• No account or login needed
• Play at your own pace; machines keep digging while you're away
• Every purchase is a one-off, kept forever, with no subscriptions
• Nothing in the shop can find or improve the odds of a legendary
• Optional ads, which you can remove

Made in the UK by an independent developer.

name: Digital Closet: AI Outfit Plan
description:
Digital Closet turns the clothes you already own into a wardrobe you can browse, mix and plan from your phone.

YOUR WHOLE CLOSET, IN YOUR POCKET
• Snap a photo of any piece - the background is removed automatically
• Lay out several items at once and let the app cut each one out
• Sort by category, color, season, occasion and more
• Search your wardrobe in seconds

MIX AND SAVE OUTFITS
• Build outfits from your own clothes on a simple canvas
• Tag looks for work, weekends, parties or travel
• Group pieces and outfits into collections

PLAN WHAT TO WEAR
• Schedule outfits on a weekly or monthly calendar
• Get a morning suggestion that fits today's weather
• Pack for trips with outfits for each day and a packing checklist

AI STYLIST
• Tell the stylist where you're going and get outfit ideas made only from clothes you own

VIRTUAL TRY-ON
• See an outfit on a model or on your own full-body photo before you wear it
• Your photo is stored privately and you can delete it at any time

SHOULD I BUY IT?
• Thinking about something new? Snap it and see how well it works with what you already own

KNOW WHAT'S WORTH KEEPING
• Track how often you wear each piece and its cost per wear
• Find clothes you haven't worn in a while and declutter with confidence

DIGITAL CLOSET LUXE
The free version includes up to 45 wardrobe items and 18 saved outfits and shows ads. Upgrade to Luxe for:
• Unlimited wardrobe items and saved outfits
• More AI virtual try-ons and Stylist AI requests
• Unlimited "Should I buy it?" checks
• Custom categories, brands and materials
• No ads

Luxe is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly ($4.99) or yearly ($29.99, starting with a 7-day free trial). Prices are in US dollars, may vary by country, and are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://digital-closet-47b51.web.app/privacy

name: Digital Tidewater Client
description:
Digital Tidewater Client is the companion app for businesses and venues that use Digital Tidewater for their Wi-Fi, AV and building systems.

Sign in with the login from your Digital Tidewater invite and you'll see the controls set up for your venue, and only those. Depending on your setup, that can include:

• Room control: run a meeting or event room, including modes, volume, cameras, displays and recording.
• Wi-Fi: see your access points and connected devices, change network names and passwords, and disconnect or block devices.
• Guest Wi-Fi: manage your guest sign-in page, offers and guest list.
• Digital signage: check your screens and turn them on or off.

New features for your venue show up automatically, without waiting for an app update.

Sign in with your email and password, with Apple or Google, or with a passkey.

The app is for Digital Tidewater clients. To get access, contact hello@digitaltidewater.com.

name: Dindaş: Prayer, Quran, Adhan
description:
Dindaş (Turkish for "fellow believer", a companion in faith) brings prayer times, prayer tracking, duas, the Quran and a tasbih counter together in one simple app. It is completely free: no ads, no account, no in-app purchases.

Please note: the app's interface is in Turkish. Duas and the Quran include Arabic text, transliteration and an English translation.

PRAYER TIMES AND NOTIFICATIONS
• Diyanet, ISNA, Muslim World League and Umm al-Qura calculation methods
• US states, counties and cities, all provinces and districts of Turkey, and 7,000+ cities worldwide
• Countdown to the next adhan and to the end of the current prayer time, with makruh time warnings
• Adhan notifications and a "Did you pray?" reminder before the time ends, with one-tap marking from the notification
• Qibla compass

PRAYER TRACKING
• Mark fard, sunnah and witr separately
• Daily progress, streaks and history
• Missed (qada) prayer and fast tracking
• Rakat counts by madhab (Hanafi by default)

DUAS AND QURAN
• About 100 duas and dhikrs with Arabic, transliteration, meaning and source
• Guided tasbih after prayer
• The full Quran with Arabic text, transliteration and Pickthall's English translation
• Bookmark where you left off and track your khatm by juz
• Tasbih counter with dhikr suggestions for the time of day

LEARN
• Learn to pray: wudu, ghusl, tayammum and the prayer, step by step with drawings
• Memorize short surahs verse by verse
• The 99 Names of Allah with meanings
• A daily question on Islamic basics

CALENDAR AND RAMADAN
• Hijri calendar with holy nights and Eids, and a reminder the day before
• Ramadan: suhoor and iftar countdown, fasting and taraweeh tracker, suhoor reminder
• Friday reminder for Surah al-Kahf and salawat

PRIVACY
Dindaş collects no personal data. There is no account; your prayer log, dhikr counts and settings stay on your phone. Your location is read only once when you tap "Use my location", to find the nearest city, and is never stored. You can always pick your city from the list instead.

name: Dispatch GPS
description:
Dispatch GPS helps EMS responders turn latitude and longitude from dispatch information into a clear map view.

Built from experience in NYC EMS

As an active member of the NYC EMS system, I know that the location provided for a call does not always identify the exact spot where help is needed. Highway calls, large parks, and unfamiliar territory can make locating a caller especially challenging.

I created Dispatch GPS to make the coordinates already available to responders easier to view and use. It provides another way to review location information alongside dispatch updates, caller descriptions, landmarks, and other approved resources.

How to use Dispatch GPS

1. Open the app. The live camera scanner starts automatically.
2. Point the camera at the latitude and longitude on your onboard computer or dispatch display. Center both numbers inside the green brackets. Autofocus adjusts automatically; tap the numbers to refocus or use 2× zoom from farther away.
3. Check the detected latitude and longitude against the original information, including decimal points and minus signs.
4. View the automatic map preview and location pin inside the app.
5. Tap Open in Google Maps, or choose Waze or Apple Maps. Opening a map does not automatically start navigation.

You can also import an image, type coordinates manually, or copy individual coordinates. Scan history stays on your iPhone until you remove it using Clear History.

A supplemental tool

Dispatch GPS supports the information you receive; it does not replace dispatch instructions, agency procedures, or professional judgment. It maps the coordinates supplied to it and does not track a caller or make inaccurate source coordinates more precise.

Always follow local procedures for responding to the dispatched location, communicating with dispatch, and locating callers. Verify recognized coordinates before relying on the map, and use all available, agency-approved information to support your response.

Privacy

Text recognition runs on your iPhone. Dispatch GPS does not save camera images or recognized dispatch text. History stores only coordinates and scan times locally until you clear them.

Coordinates are used by Apple Maps to load the automatic preview and are shared with your chosen map provider when you open its app.

name: Dozeline: Baby Log & Nap Times
description:
Dozeline is a quiet notebook for the first year. Open it, tap what just happened, put the phone down.

NOW
A night-sky ring counts the time since the last nap and shows how close the next sleep window is. It starts from a typical awake stretch for your baby's age and shifts toward your own baby's recent naps as you log them. Big buttons start a nap, record a feed or note a diaper with one hand.

DAY
Scroll back through any day: every feed, nap and diaper in order, with small totals at the top. Tap an entry to fix it, swipe to delete it, or add something you forgot.

PATTERNS
Seven, fourteen or thirty days of sleep, feeds and diapers as simple bar charts with the average marked, so you can see how this week compares to last without doing any math.

SHARE WITH A CO-PARENT
Send your log as a file by Messages, Mail or AirDrop. When your partner opens it in Dozeline their entries merge with yours, duplicates left out. No account, no server, no sign-in.

MORE
Several babies, ounces or milliliters, an optional nudge before a sleep window, a spreadsheet export, and a button that erases everything from the device when you want it gone.

YOUR LOG STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Entries are stored only on your device. We do not run a cloud copy and cannot read your notes.

FREE, WITH CHOICES
Dozeline is free with ads. Watch a short video to turn ads off for 30 minutes (up to 100 videos a month), or subscribe to Ad-Free Monthly for $2.99 a month; payment is charged to your Apple ID, renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and can be managed in your Apple ID settings. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ . Privacy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-dozeline.html

Dozeline records what you tell it and offers planning estimates only. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose or monitor any condition. Ask your pediatrician about any concern.

name: Draftvex
description:
Draftvex is fantasy football research built on real NFL stats. Nothing is estimated or guessed: every number comes from recorded games.

STAT LAB
Pick the stats you trust, weight them, and rank every player your way. Then check how your formula would have done in past weeks.

RANKINGS
See this week's rankings from your saved formulas. Players on a bye, on IR or ruled out are left out automatically.

PLAYERS
Every player's stats, weekly role and fantasy points by game. Compare up to four players side by side.

INJURIES
The official NFL injury report, plus who got the work when a starter sat.

LEAGUES
Paste your fantasy roster from any fantasy app and follow your players every week in your league's scoring.

COMMUNITY
Share formulas and calls, and follow people whose research you like.

Works with PPR, half PPR, standard and custom scoring. Sign in with Apple or email to save formulas and get a weekly alert.

Draftvex is not affiliated with the NFL or its teams.

name: Duovid
description:
React, film and edit — one vertical video, ready to post anywhere.

  Duovid plays a video while you record your reaction next to it. Or film just yourself, or edit the clips 
  you already have. Add captions, text and music, then export without a watermark. Free, no account needed.

  THREE WAYS TO START
  • React to a video – a video plays while you record your reaction next to it. Pause, resume and retake 
  whenever you want; the sound stays in sync.
  • Selfie video – just you and the camera: full screen, rounded, circle or green screen.
  • Edit a video – no camera needed. Add text, captions and music to videos and photos you already have.
  Mix it up later: selfie, duo, photo and video clips can go into the same project in any order.

  6 REACTION LAYOUTS
  Top / Bottom, Side by Side, Bubble, Circle, Reverse Bubble and Green Screen. Switch layouts while
  recording or afterwards, drag and resize the bubble, and mirror your selfie.

  BUILT-IN TELEPROMPTER
  The prompter sits right under the front camera, so you keep eye contact while you read.
  • Write or paste scripts and keep a library of them
  • Adjust speed, text size and colours, with a reading line and mirror mode
  • Move, resize or hide the window
  • Countdown before the text starts scrolling

  EVERY CLIP, ONE TIMELINE
  • Line up selfie, reaction, photo and video clips and rearrange them
  • Trim clips, change the layout after recording and undo anything
  • What you see in the preview is exactly what you export
  • Drafts are saved automatically

  AUTO CAPTIONS IN 100 LANGUAGES
  Duovid listens to your voice and writes the captions for you, right on your iPhone. Your voice is never
  uploaded, and once a language is ready it works without internet. Fix any word or timing line by line,
  then pick a style. Includes a dedicated Albanian speech model for accurate captions in Shqip.

  TITLES THAT POP
  • Add titles, captions and credits
  • Drag, pinch and rotate text right on the video, and choose when each one appears
  • Rounded, Classic, Serif, Mono and Condensed fonts
  • Plain, outline, box or neon styles, in any colour and size
  • Stack, duplicate and layer as many texts as you like

  MUSIC, SOUNDS AND VOICE-OVER
  • Add background music from your Files
  • Use the soundtrack of another video
  • Record a voice-over while the video plays back
  • Set the volume of every track separately, balance the original video against your voice and fine-tune 
  their sync

  EXPORT AND SHARE
  Export in 720p, 1080p or 4K. Save to Photos or share straight to your favourite apps. You can also send a
  video to Duovid from the share sheet of another app and start reacting right away.

  PRIVATE BY DESIGN
  Your videos stay on your phone. No account, no sign-up, no watermark.

name: E6B Flight Computer Slide Rule
description:
Check your E6B reading. Solve a problem on your own E6B, type what you read, and the app tells you if it's good. When your numbers point to a slip, it names it, then walks the steps on a simulated E6B.

FREE, WITH NO LIMIT
• Flight calculator: wind triangle (heading, track, or the wind itself), crosswind, true airspeed, density and pressure altitude, time, speed, distance, fuel, units. Negative temperatures, US and metric. Each computed result opens its formula and source; unit factors are one tap away.
• The E6B, both sides, drawn from the formulas. Rotate, slide, zoom.

ALSO FREE
• Over 50 practice problems, generated and graded: a lifetime count per type.
• Weight and balance on a fictional example: loading, CG, envelope.

ONE PURCHASE ($9.99 in the US)
• Unlimited problems, graded on your E6B or in the app.
• Your own aircraft, saved. You enter the values from your manual.

One purchase. No subscription. No account. Works offline.

WHAT IT ISN'T
The phone stays out of the test room: you use your E6B or a calculator there, and this app gets you ready. It makes no promise about any exam. It names common slips it can recognize, not every mistake.

Not an instrument for use in flight. Training and planning aid only. Doesn't replace your instructor or your aircraft's manual. No aircraft data is included.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FAA or NWS.

name: Easy Tasbih
description:
Easy Tasbih помогает спокойно уделить время зикру и сохранить свой прогресс.

Ведите отдельный счётчик для каждого зикра, задавайте цели и возвращайтесь к своим записям в удобное время.

В приложении:
• семь зикров по умолчанию и возможность добавить свои
• независимые счётчики с общим итогом и текущей сессией
• цели на день или на сессию и общее дневное задание
• начальное значение цели, если часть повторений уже выполнена
• история завершённых сессий и статистика по дням
• библиотека с арабским текстом, приблизительным русским чтением, переводом смысла и хадисами с указанием источников
• вибрация при нажатии и отдельный отклик при достижении цели. Вибрацию можно отключить
• локальное ежедневное напоминание по желанию
• светлая, тёмная и системная темы
• сохранение и восстановление резервной копии в файл

Счётчики, цели и история хранятся на вашем iPhone. Для основных функций не нужны регистрация и интернет. Для открытия внешних источников хадисов нужен интернет.

Хадисы и переводы приведены для ознакомления. Самостоятельно проверяйте текст, перевод, источник и оценку достоверности; при сомнениях обратитесь к квалифицированному специалисту по хадисам.

Заметили ошибку, опечатку или неточность? В настройках можно скопировать адрес поддержки: soltoss@mail.ru

name: EatzWebPdv
description:
EatzWebPdv é o aplicativo de pedidos e caixa do sistema EatzWeb, feito para garçons, atendentes e operadores de caixa de restaurantes, bares e lanchonetes.

PEDIDOS NA MESA
• Mapa de mesas com a situação de cada uma em tempo real
• Lançamento de produtos com opções, adicionais e observações
• Envio do pedido direto para a cozinha e para o sistema

CAIXA
• Conferência da conta da mesa
• Impressão da conta
• Recebimento em várias formas de pagamento
• Fechamento da mesa com emissão de NFC-e

FEITO PARA O DIA A DIA
• Login com e-mail ou celular, o mesmo do sistema EatzWeb
• Tema claro e escuro
• Funciona em iPhone e iPad

O EatzWebPdv é de uso exclusivo de restaurantes clientes do EatzWeb. O acesso é feito com o usuário cadastrado pelo administrador do restaurante. O acesso ao Caixa depende da permissão do usuário.

name: Echo Breakout
description:
Echo Breakout is an offline dark-room action puzzle: the map stays black until you Pulse a short flash of light. Study the walls, traps, and exits in that blink—then move from memory.

FEATURES

- Pulse sonar — reveal the room for a moment, then navigate blind
- Memory escape — mistime a turn and traps cost a life
- Six rooms — clear stages, earn stars, unlock the next challenge
- Collect shards — hunt extras as you learn each layout
- Same Wi‑Fi race — host a room, share a QR, race a friend in real time
- No accounts — local multiplayer on your network; solo play fully offline

HOW TO PLAY

1. Pulse when you need a glimpse of the dark.
2. Remember walls and hazards before the light fades.
3. Reach the exit with lives left—or challenge a friend to get there first.

Built for short sessions and tense rematches. Feel your way through the dark.

name: ECHOLIGHT: Sonar Cave
description:
ECHOLIGHT is a stealth exploration game played in total darkness.

You are a small spark of light lost in a cave. You cannot see the walls until you make a sound. Tap the screen and a sonar ping ripples outward; wherever the echo touches stone, the cave glows for a moment, then fades back to black.

But sound travels both ways. Shades sleep in the hollows, and a ping that reaches them wakes them up. Every tap is a choice: light up the way ahead, or stay silent and slip past.

• SEE WITH SOUND: pings reveal walls, pearls and the violet crystal exit, but only where the echo can actually reach
• LISTEN: with headphones, echoes arrive from the left or the right, so you can hear an opening before you see it
• SNEAK: an awake shade hunts you for seven seconds, then falls asleep again. Hide, wait, choose your moment
• 60 CAVES across five regions, from the Shallow Hollows to the Silent Floor, each deeper and busier than the last
• THREE STARS: reach the exit, collect all three pearls, and finish without being caught
• Pings recharge slowly, and you can hold up to three
• Every sound is synthesized live, with subtle haptics for pings, bumps and danger
• A full map of every cave you have explored glows faintly as you go
• Korean and English

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Embers: Ephemeral Focus Tasks
description:
What if your to-do list had a natural half-life?

Modern productivity apps encourage an endless accumulation of tasks. Over time, that backlog becomes an emotional burden—a monument of undone commitments, self-reproach, and guilt.

Embers is built on the philosophy of Digital Stoicism. In nature, a fire that isn’t fed oxygen and wood peacefully extinguishes into cold ash. Embers brings that gentle, restorative physics to your daily focus.

---

KEY CAPABILITIES

THE ENTROPY ENGINE
Every thought begins as a radiant Fresh Spark with an intentional lifespan (24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours, or 7 days). If you don't engage with it, it gradually cools into a Warm Ember, fades into Fading Ash, and softly dissolves into ash. What you let go of was never truly vital today.

MINDFUL TRI-STATE ACTIONS
• Ignite to Complete: Celebrate meaningful action with a bright visual burst and crisp haptic resonance.
• Stoke the Flame: Extend a critical task's lifespan by 24 hours. To prevent hoarding, each ember can only be stoked up to 3 times.
• Let Go: Mindfully release an unneeded thought as gentle smoke, removing mental clutter without guilt.

THE DAILY ASHING RITUAL
An evening review session where you examine dying embers. Swipe through them one by one: renew what matters, and grant peace to the rest. Start each morning with a clear hearth.

COGNITIVE RELIEF ANALYTICS
In the Ash Sanctuary, review not just what you completed, but what you had the courage to release. Track your Letting Go Index, Active Flame load, and total cognitive weight lifted.

NATIVE CRAFTSMANSHIP & PRIVACY
• Built with pure Swift and UIKit for smooth 60fps responsiveness and minimal battery consumption.
• Local-first architecture: on-device task storage, privacy-centric design, and self-contained data structures within your iOS device sandbox.

Let the unessential turn to ash. Protect the flame that truly matters.

name: EmberTrail: BBQ Cook Log
description:
Keep a useful record of each barbecue cook, from the first manual reading to your own result notes. EmberTrail organizes the process by cut, so several foods can share one cook without mixing their temperature histories.

Record the equipment, fuel and cuts you used. Add pit or core temperatures and dated moments such as seasoning, wrapping, refuelling and resting. Each cut has its own timeline and chart. You can correct a record, finish a cook with a rating and notes, or reopen it when you need to continue.

Compare two saved cooks with their own cut histories. When a setup worked well, copy its equipment, fuel and cuts into a fresh cook with no old events or results. Add a result photo and export a PDF repeat card with CSV records through the iPhone share sheet.

Temperature values are your manually entered observations. EmberTrail does not connect to thermometers or determine doneness or food safety.

Works offline without an app account. Records and selected photos are stored locally. There are no ads or tracking. You choose whether and where to share exported files.

name: emo emo: period tracker
description:
the minimalist period tracker. less, on purpose.

emo emo is a calm, minimal period and mood tracker. no feeds, no articles, no streaks, no ads. just your cycle, your mood, and emo: a small face that checks on you and spots your patterns.

what's in it
• today: your cycle day, phase and the days until your period, inside one quiet ring
• a calendar with past periods, predictions, your fertile window and ovulation
• pick how you feel each day: crampy, tired, grumpy, emotional, fine or cute
• heads-ups from your own patterns after a few cycles: "psst. low days start tomorrow."
• gentle pad reminders and an evening check-in, only if you want them
• home and lock screen widgets, and 8 calm colour themes

what's not in it
feeds, articles, streaks, badges, a community, ads. we left them out on purpose.

your data, your rules
• your cycle and moods stay on your phone, encrypted
• optional backup, encrypted on your phone with a recovery code only you have
• no ads, no selling, no tracking. ever.
• export or delete everything, anytime

one honest thing
predictions are estimates. emo emo isn't birth control or medical advice. if something feels off, see a doctor.

subscription
emo emo needs a subscription: yearly (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or monthly. payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

terms of use: https://emoemo.renaiss.cc/terms
privacy policy: https://emoemo.renaiss.cc/privacy

name: EmPortuguese
description:
EmPortuguese — European Portuguese (PT-PT) built for Chinese speakers.

Six levels from A1 to C2, in order. The course structure follows European Portuguese teaching materials, but every explanation, gloss and example sentence is original.

【SIX LEVELS】
• A1 Beginner — 373 words / 51 grammar points / 792 exercises
• A2 Elementary — 593 words / 63 grammar points / 1,269 exercises
• B1 Intermediate — 712 words / 69 grammar points / 1,494 exercises
• B2 Upper Intermediate — 388 words / 77 grammar points / 803 exercises
• C1 Advanced — 289 words / 45 grammar points / 604 exercises
• C2 Mastery — 74 words / 26 grammar points / 152 exercises

【SIX TABS】
• Progress — today's session, streak, and three progress bars per level
• Words — swipe through cards with article, gender, plural, part of speech and three examples
• Practice — four-option questions for the current level, covering vocabulary examples and grammar; the correct answer and explanation appear right after you answer
• Grammar — sentence patterns, what follows them, and confusable pairs side by side
• Quick Reference — 1,039 entries in 19 categories, including a 251-verb dictionary: numbers, time, pronouns, articles, ser vs estar, verb conjugation, irregular verbs, prepositions & contractions, connectors, adverbs, quantifiers, spelling, easily-confused words
• Settings — interface language (Traditional Chinese / Simplified Chinese / English), daily goal, speech rate

【BUILT FOR EUROPEAN PORTUGUESE】
• Feminine and plural forms are often irregular (o irmão → a irmã; o homem → os homens) — every one is flagged
• Verbs are grouped by -ar / -er / -ir, with full conjugation tables and reflexive pronouns
• ser vs estar, and preposition + article contractions (de + o → do), each get their own explanation
• The Quick Reference is shared across all levels, so it is always one tap away

【ALSO】
• Portuguese pronunciation, with adjustable speech rate
• Works offline after the first sync
• No account needed

Good luck, and enjoy learning Portuguese.

name: Éphéméride de comptoir
Ergomotion: REBA (Free)
description:
Ergomotion Free shows how a worker's posture rates on the REBA (Rapid Entire Body Assessment) scale, using only the camera on your iPhone or iPad.

Point the camera at one person, with the full body in view, and Ergomotion tracks the body, draws a skeleton overlay and shows the REBA score and risk level.

IN THE FREE VERSION
• Live body tracking with skeleton overlay
• REBA score and risk level (status) after each assessment
• Photo and video capture, or import from Photos and Files
• History with Overlay, Camera and Skeleton playback
• Task inputs such as load and activity
• Processing happens on your device

IN THE FULL VERSION, Ergomotion: REBA Assessment
• PDF assessment reports
• CSV and keypoints export, and file sharing
• Detailed joint angles and sub-scores
• 3D skeleton rotation
• Optional on-device AI report drafting on supported devices

Locked features stay visible in the free version and link to the full app.

Ergomotion gives estimates for preliminary screening. It does not diagnose health conditions, certify safety or establish regulatory compliance. A competent assessor should verify results.

name: ErnteMiete
description: Saisonale Maschinenvermietung im Blick behalten: Geräte erfassen, Vermietungen und Kosten dokumentieren, Zahlungen und Abrechnungen nachverfolgen – alles lokal auf dem iPhone, klar und ohne Umwege.

name: EV Showroom Tycoon
description:
Welcome to your very own electric-vehicle showroom — time to sell some cars!

EV Showroom Tycoon is a light, feel-good business simulation. Welcome customers, show off shiny electric cars, close deals and reinvest your profits to upgrade the showroom, hire staff and expand your EV empire. Watch the money roll in, even while you plan your next big move.

FEATURES
• Easy, satisfying tap-to-sell gameplay
• Upgrade your showroom, cars and team
• Grow from a small shop to a huge EV dealership
• Charming characters and a bright modern showroom
• Earn rewards and keep your business booming
• Play offline anytime
• Free to play

Build the greenest, busiest EV showroom in town. Open for business!

name: EvacCheck™
description:
EvacCheck™ tells your techs, car by car, whether to evacuate the oil from the top or drain it from the pan, and exactly how to do it.

Evac the right 80%. Drain the rest.

Built for quick lube, tire and service shops that run topside oil evacuation. Every answer is made for the bay: fast, clear, and specific to the vehicle in front of you.

WHAT YOU GET
• Evacuate, Evacuate with adapter, Check first, or Drain only, for every car and light truck
• The right probe or wand for your machine: JDI, DEVON or Samson
