• Filter location and type, plus canister and skid-plate time adds, before the hood goes up
• Vehicle alerts: known drain plug, filter housing and oil-change hazards, shown first when they matter
• Oil-life reset steps
• VIN scanner: point the camera at the door-jamb barcode
• Log what came out after each evac: 100% or short, tracked for your shop
• Send a vehicle update from any answer, so the list keeps getting better

WHY IT MATTERS
Skid plates, oil pans and engine oil-outs are some of the most expensive claims in an oil change. Evacuating the right vehicles takes the drain plug out of the job, speeds up the service, and keeps oil off the floor.

HOW ACCESS WORKS
Sign in with your work email; we send a 6-digit code, with no password to remember. New accounts get free lookups to try it. For full access for your shop or your stores, request it in the app or contact us at evaccheck.net.

EvacCheck™ is a product of AWB Consultants Inc.

name: Evalezy: AI Copy Checking
description:
Evalezy checks handwritten answer copies with AI and gives them back the way a teacher would: in red pen, on the student's own copy.

Scan a whole class on your phone, let the AI check every copy, and download the checked copies as one zip.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Create a test. Add a name, the total marks and the question paper as a PDF or photos. Evalezy reads the paper into questions and marks, and you review them before checking starts.
2. Add the copies. Scan with the camera page by page and tap Next student between copies, or upload files. Each PDF is one copy, and photos picked together make one copy.
3. Check. See the number of copies, pages and credits before you start. You can leave the app and get an email when the batch is finished.
4. Download. Follow the progress of each copy, open any checked copy and download the whole class as a zip.

WHAT YOU GET ON EACH COPY

- Ticks and crosses next to the answers
- Short notes on what went wrong
- Marks for each question
- The total circled on the copy

MADE TO FIT YOUR MARKING

- Choose the ink colour, darkness, handwriting and size of the pen
- Put comments inside the copy or beside it
- Give the AI your own instructions
- Highlight spelling and grammar mistakes
- Match copies to your students, or only check them

CLEAR USAGE

Checking uses credits: 1 credit per page. A copy that fails or is cancelled is not charged. Your credit history names the test and the student for every charge.

Evalezy is built for teachers, schools, coaching institutes and colleges. It needs an Evalezy account, and you can create one in the app with your email.

Privacy policy: https://evalezy.com/privacy/

name: Everydraw: Draw with the World
description:
Every day, one topic opens for the whole world. Draw it with your finger in five minutes. When you're done, the world map opens, and you can see how people in Brazil, Japan or France drew the same thing.

You don't need to be good at drawing. A doodle is enough.

TODAY'S TOPIC
No blank-page worry. There's one topic a day, and everyone draws the same one.

FIVE MINUTES
A black pen, an eraser and undo. That's the whole toolbox. You can still submit when time runs out, and you can set the timer to 1, 3 or 5 minutes.

THE MAP OPENS WHEN YOU DRAW
Submit today's drawing and the world map opens. Each country or region shows an "average drawing": everyone's lines, layered faintly on top of each other. Tap in to flip through drawings one by one.

AI, BUT ONLY TO PLAY ALONG
• AI guess: when you submit, an on-device AI guesses what you drew. It's often wrong.
• Help me finish: stuck? Once per drawing, AI adds a few strokes in blue. You decide whether to keep them.
• If you keep them, your drawing gets an "AI helped" label. The world map is for people's drawings.
• AI runs on your phone. Your drawings are not sent to any AI service.

YOUR SKETCHBOOK
Your drawings collect by date. Tap one to open its share card. A year from now, you'll have a sketchbook of 365 drawings.

SHARE CARD
Share any drawing from your sketchbook as a card with its date and topic, in story (9:16) or square (1:1). If you kept AI strokes, the "AI helped" label is on the card too.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED TO START
Drawing, your sketchbook and the world map all work without an account. After your first few drawings, posting to the world map needs sign-in with Apple or Google. Otherwise, keep the drawing private in your sketchbook. Signing in also keeps your drawings when you change phones.

A MAP EVERYONE CAN SEE
• Before your first post, you agree to short community rules.
• Every drawing can be reported, and any user can be blocked. We review reports within 24 hours.
• Reminders: today's topic and your streak, at most two a day.

GOOD TO KNOW
• While the app is new, some average drawings include drawings from Google's Quick, Draw! dataset (CC BY 4.0) so the map isn't empty. People counts include real users only.
• We ask for your birth year. Under the age limit for your country, you can draw and keep a sketchbook, but not post publicly.
• No ads. Drawing and the world map are free.

Questions: support@everydraw.co.kr

name: Eye Rest & Move
description:
Eye Rest & Move reminds you to rest your eyes and to stand up after long sitting. It asks for nothing before you start.

No account. No ads. No subscription. Works offline. Nothing you do in the app leaves your iPhone.

EYE BREAKS
• The classic 20-20-20 rhythm is the default (20 minutes, 20 seconds). Change the interval and break length, set active hours and weekdays, or pause for 15 minutes, 30 minutes, an hour or until tomorrow.
• On iPhone, iOS does not let apps see how long you use the screen, so reminders run on a timer. The app schedules them about ten hours ahead each time you open it, so open it once or twice a day to keep them coming.
• Three strengths: Gentle, Balanced, Firm. Each reminder is followed by one nudge at most.
• Answer from the notification: Start break, Snooze, Done or Skip.
• Break types: look far, blink, close your eyes, stand up, or a mix. Each has a short "Why this?" note with links to published studies.
• Four chimes and an end-of-break sound.

MOVE BREAKS
• One reminder to stand up and move after about 45 minutes (choose 30 to 120), on weekdays 09:00 to 18:00 by default. You can turn it off in one tap.
• When an eye break and a move break are close together you get one reminder, never two within five minutes.
• Walk, stretch or a mix, for 1, 2 or 5 minutes.
• Optional "Notice when I've moved": when you open the app or answer a reminder, it checks your steps on this iPhone (Motion & Fitness) and skips a reminder after a walk. Off by default.

SEE IT AT A GLANCE
• "Next break" widget for the Home Screen.
• Optional Lock Screen and Dynamic Island countdown (Live Activity). Off until you switch it on in Settings.
• Stats for 7 or 30 days, hour bars and a move card. Export as a CSV file or delete your history in one tap.

PRIVACY
All data stays on your iPhone. No account, no analytics, no tracking, no ads. The app itself makes no network requests. Study links open Safari only when you tap one.

IMPORTANT
Eye Rest & Move is a reminder app for everyday habits. It is not a medical device and gives no medical advice.

Requires iOS 16.4 or later. iPhone only. The app is in English.

name: EZ Shots
description:
EZ Shots is the app for real estate agents who book listing photography with EZ Shots in Metro Detroit.

Sign in with your email and a one time code. No password to remember.

- Book a shoot in a few taps: interior, exterior and drone photos, with an optional listing video.
- Follow every shoot in one place, from booked to shot to delivered.
- Open your gallery and look through your photos before you pay.
- Download MLS ready and full size photos, or save them straight to Photos.
- Ask for a change, add a tip, or tell us if something is not right.

$0 to book. You pay after the shoot, once you have seen the photos. If you are not happy with a gallery, you do not pay for it.

EZ Shots serves realtors across Metro Detroit with professional photo, video and licensed FAA Part 107 drone work.

name: Əlişir Ekspres: Bakı Kuryeri
description:
Əlişir köhnə yan arabalı motosikletində Bakının dar küçələri ilə qapı-qapı sifariş daşıyır. Təndirxanadan isti çörək və qutab, bazardan qarpız və kənd yumurtası, samovarda çay, bəzən də nəhəng toy tortu. Bu, Bakıda keçən ilk kuryer oyunudur: vaxt azdır, yol çalalarla doludur, küçə isə həmişəki kimi qonşularla, toyuqlarla və uşaqlarla doludur.

Tələs, amma ehtiyatlı ol! Hər çalada çay dağılır, yumurtalar çatlayır, tort sarsılır. Toyuqlara, vedrəli qonşulara, meyvə yeşiklərinə və nərd oynayan kişilərin masasına dəysən, məhəllənin hirsi artır. Hirs dolanda bütün qonşular arxanca düşür, terlik də atırlar!

OYUNDA NƏ VAR
• 4 xəritə: Köhnə məhəllə, İçərişəhər, Bulvar və Abşeron kəndi
• 3 nəqliyyat: yan arabalı motosiklet, sürətli moped və köhnə yük maşını
• 6 cür sifariş: çörək, qutab, çay, yumurta, qarpız və toy tortu - hər yükün öz çətinliyi var
• Seriya və bəxşiş: tez çatdır, xalı artır
• Tryuklar: tramplindən uç, toyuqların üstündən tullan
• Təsadüfi hadisələr: yağış, toy karvanı, təcili sifarişlər
• Bulvarda yol hərəkəti: ağ Ladalar və bənövşəyi Bakı taksiləri
• Hər gün yeni gündəlik tapşırıqlar
• Qaraj: Şirvan qazan, motosikletin rəngini, siqnalını, Əlişirin geyimini dəyiş, yeni nəqliyyat və xəritə al
• Qonşuların, müştərilərin və Əlişirin 200-dən çox gülməli sözü, bir hissəsi səsli
• İnternetsiz oyun: yolda, metroda, kənddə də oynamaq olar

Köhnə motosikletin mühərriki tez-tez sönür, o zaman təpik vurub yenidən işə sal. Müştərilər səni qapıda gözləyir: tez gəlsən "Maşallah, nə tez gəldin!", gec gəlsən "Mən burda saqqal saxladım!" deyəcəklər.

Sadə idarəetmə: sola, sağa, qaz, geri, tullan və siqnal. Bir oyun 3–10 dəqiqə çəkir - çay fasiləsi üçün ideal motosiklet oyunu.

Əlişir Ekspres (Elisir Ekspres) Azərbaycanda hazırlanıb və tamamilə Azərbaycan dilindədir. Oyunda reklam var, istəsən reklamları və əlavə paketləri tətbiq daxilində ala bilərsən.

Sür, Əlişir! Bakı səni gözləyir!

name: FAIRLOT
description:
Snap a photo of anything you want to sell and FAIRLOT tells you what it's worth on resale.

FAIRLOT names the item, then looks at sold and asking prices on public marketplace listings to give you a typical resale price, a price range and the places it sells. Tap any listing to see similar items for yourself.

- Point, snap and get a price in seconds
- A typical price and a low to high range
- Where it sells, with example listings
- Tips for selling it
- Any country and currency
- Your scans saved on your phone

Great for thrift and garage sale finds, clearing out a closet, or checking a price before you list something.

FAIRLOT PRO
Your first 3 scans are free. FAIRLOT Pro includes up to 300 scans each calendar month and comes in two auto-renewing plans: $9.99 a month, or $99 a year (about two months free). Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The monthly plan renews automatically every month and the yearly plan renews automatically every year, at the same price, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it any time in your Apple ID subscription settings.

Prices are estimates based on public listings, not a guarantee of what an item will sell for.

Terms of Use: https://fairlot.ryan-ed2.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fairlot.ryan-ed2.workers.dev/privacy

name: Fangcun - Home Sizes
description:
Fangcun keeps the measurements of your home. A fridge nook, a window, a doorway, a curtain, or an outlet: measure it, save it on your iPhone, and look it up before you buy or install.

You measure with a tape and type the numbers yourself. Fangcun does not measure distance for you.

You can: 
· Save a name, room, width, height, depth, and note. Fill in only the dimensions you need. 
· Switch between centimeters, millimeters, and meters. Numbers you have entered convert automatically. 
· Take a photo with the camera, or choose one from your library. 
· Add, move, and edit marks on the photo to point out a frame, a gap, or the space you need to leave. 
· Filter by room, and search names, rooms, and notes. 
· Turn one record into an image and send it with the system share sheet. 
· Export a full backup of sizes, marks, and photos, then restore it on another iPhone. Restoring replaces every record on that device.

Rooms include living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, balcony, and other. You can also type your own.

Photos, sizes, and marks stay on this iPhone. There is no account, no ads, no third-party analytics, and no cloud server. Deleting the app can erase the data on this device, so export a backup before you switch phones.

name: Fantasy Dog League
description:
Every breed has its day. Make yours count.

Fantasy Dog League is the free fantasy game for dog shows. No dog expertise needed. Pick your three favorite breeds in each of the seven groups and rank them. When they place on the big shows, you score.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick three breeds in each group, ranked. Your top pick counts the most.
- Start a league with your people, or join the Open Division and play against everyone.
- Watch the show. Breeds earn points for placing in their group and winning Best in Show.
- Tap anyone in the standings to see their points, group by group.

THE SEASON
The National Dog Show on Thanksgiving, the AKC National Championship in December, and Westminster in February. Double points at each one.

WATCH PARTIES
Hosting Thanksgiving? Start a watch party, share the code, and let everyone play along from the couch, no account needed.

Free to play, with no prizes and no entry fees.

Fantasy Dog League is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the AKC, the Westminster Kennel Club, the National Dog Show or any broadcaster.

name: FarePop
description:
FarePop watches flights from the airports you use and tells you when a fare drops well below its usual price.

Pick your home airports and the places you'd like to go. When a deal turns up, you get one clear alert with the price, the dates and how far below the usual fare it is.

• See why it's a deal: the usual price for those dates, the discount and how the price has moved.
• Swipe through every deal from your airports and save the ones you like.
• Filter by region, month, price, stops and trip length.
• Check the weather first: wet and dry seasons, typical temperatures and the best months to visit.
• Choose priority countries, and hear about those first.
• Get alerts by push notification or email, with quiet hours and a weekly limit.

FarePop covers airports in Australia, New Zealand, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Europe.

Fares change quickly and aren't guaranteed until you book with the airline or travel agent. FarePop doesn't sell tickets.

FAREPOP PRO
Try FarePop Pro free for 3 days, then pay yearly or weekly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://farepop.app/terms
Privacy: https://farepop.app/privacy

name: Farpane: Remote Desktop
description:
Farpane puts your Mac on your iPhone. Sign in with your Mac's own username and password through macOS Screen Sharing, and use your desktop as if you were sitting in front of it.

SMOOTH ON A MAC

On a Mac, Farpane uses Screen Sharing's encrypted session, with a video stream and sound when your connection can carry them. If the picture gets choppy, it steps down to a lighter mode on its own.

BUILT FOR TOUCH

• Use the screen as a trackpad, or tap right where you want to click.

• Pinch to zoom and pan around a large desktop.

• A keyboard bar with Esc, Tab, Control, Option, Command and arrow keys.

• Write with autocorrect and dictation in a compose field, then send it to your computer.

• Paste to and copy from your computer, or type the clipboard into terminals and password fields.

• Mac shortcuts one tap away: App Switcher, Spotlight, Mission Control, Spaces, screenshots and Lock Screen.

• Fill the display: ask your Mac for a desktop shaped like your phone, so nothing is letterboxed.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO

Unfolded, your desktop fills the big inner screen. Folded, the outer screen is a quick way to check in. Held upright, the inner screen turns into a laptop-style deck with the desktop on top and a trackpad below.

AWAY FROM HOME

Reach your computers through Tailscale or a built-in SSH tunnel. Nearby computers on your network show up on their own.

NOT JUST MACS

Connect to any computer running a VNC server, including Linux and Windows.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account, no ads and no tracking. Farpane connects straight to your own computers, and nothing passes through us. Passwords stay in your iPhone's Keychain, and you can require Face ID or Touch ID before connecting.

ONE PRICE, NO SUBSCRIPTION

Farpane is free to download, with a 14-day free trial. Unlock it for good with a single in-app purchase, shared with your family through Family Sharing.

name: Ferra AI Agents
description:
Meet Ferra, a focused AI workspace designed for iPhone.

Create an agent with a name and one clear task, choose the AI model that fits it best and start a conversation. Whether you are researching, writing, translating or planning, each agent stays focused on the job you gave it.

CREATE YOUR PERSONAL AGENTS
• Give each agent one clear purpose.
• Keep separate chat threads for different projects.
• Switch between English and Uzbek.
• Send selected photos to models that support image input.
• Edit agents or remove content you no longer need.

CHOOSE YOUR MODEL
• Browse a live catalog of more than 400 OpenRouter models.
• Search by model name or paste a model ID.
• Compare context length and published input/output pricing.
• Choose a different model for every agent.

START FREE OR BRING YOUR KEY
• Try Ferra with a server-enforced daily free allowance.
• Connect your own OpenRouter API key when you want to use your own account.
• Your key is validated, encrypted on Ferra’s server and never returned to your iPhone.

STAY IN CONTROL
• Review proposed email or message actions before they run.
• Approve in Ferra, then confirm in Apple Mail or Messages.
• Deny or cancel an action before anything is sent.
• Report an AI response to hide it and send it for review.
• Use safety filtering, reporting and blocking built into the chat experience.

SEE YOUR USAGE
• Review requests, tokens and model-reported cost.
• Break usage down by agent and model.
• Check your remaining daily free allowance.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Sign in with Apple is the only login method.
• No ads, no tracking and no third-party analytics SDK.
• Delete individual content or your entire account directly in Settings.
• Read the complete Privacy Policy at https://tou.gg/ferra/privacy/

AI output can be inaccurate. Review important information and external messages before relying on or sending them. Availability and charges for BYOK requests depend on your OpenRouter account and selected model.

Ferra — AI agents that work for you.

name: Ferrowl
description:
Ferrowl è un client di posta veloce e attento alla privacy. Funziona con qualsiasi casella IMAP (Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, il provider della tua azienda o il tuo server) e ti fa leggere, cercare e scrivere i messaggi senza intermediari: la posta passa solo tra il tuo iPhone e il tuo server.

COSA PUOI FARE
• Leggere i messaggi HTML con un'impaginazione pulita, senza JavaScript e con le immagini remote disattivabili, così chi ti scrive non sa quando apri il messaggio
• Cercare in tutta la posta già scaricata, anche senza connessione
• Rispondere, inoltrare, archiviare e spostare i messaggi nelle cartelle
• Scrivere con allegati, Cc e Ccn
• Ricevere le notifiche dei nuovi messaggi
• Vedere se un messaggio è firmato o cifrato con OpenPGP
• Bloccare o consentire mittenti e domini
• Scegliere tra 6 temi di colore
• Usarla in 10 lingue

PRIVACY PRIMA DI TUTTO
Nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento, nessuna vendita di dati. Password e chiavi restano nel Portachiavi del dispositivo. Ferrowl è open source: il codice è pubblico e chiunque può verificarlo.

FERROWL PRO
Il primo account di posta è gratis, per sempre. Con Ferrowl Pro, abbonamento annuale, puoi aggiungere altri account. L'abbonamento si rinnova automaticamente e si gestisce o disdice quando vuoi nelle impostazioni dell'App Store.

Termini d'uso (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://ferrowl.com/privacy/

name: FieldMark: Photo Dimensions
description:
Your measurements, on your photos

Take a reading with your tape or laser. Draw a line, enter the value, and share a clear record. Everything saves on this device.

1. Create a project and add a photo from Photos, Files or the camera. Assign a room in Photo details.

2. Choose Dimension. Draw a line or tap its two endpoints, then enter your tape or laser reading. Each new line opens the input straight away.

3. Pinch to zoom, drag with two fingers to pan. In Select mode, drag endpoints or the label. Snap keeps dimensions horizontal or vertical. Lock finished annotations to prevent accidental moves.

4. Angle: tap the first arm, vertex, then second arm, and enter the angle you measured. Photo perspective can distort angles.

5. Mark uncertain readings Recheck and completed checks Verified. Add a detail photo and caption for anything hard to explain.

6. Share a PNG/JPEG from the editor or a multi-photo PDF from the project. PDF includes a text measurement register, notes and detail photos. Choose A4 or US Letter.

7. Export an editable .fieldmark backup regularly. A PDF or picture cannot restore an editable project. Restore from the home screen or open a .fieldmark file in Files.

Free: 2 saved photos with unlimited annotations and exports. Restored backups remain editable and exportable without purchase. Existing work is never held behind a paywall.

*Each project: up to 50 photos / 75 MB of image data. Up to 200 annotations per photo. Subject to available device storage.

FieldMark records measurements you enter. It does not automatically measure objects, calculate scale from a photo, perform AR scans or connect to laser meters. Verify measurements on site before fabrication or ordering.

Batch import photos, select and reorder photos for PDF, ZIP or CSV export. Attach up to eight detail photos and link them to annotations. Save sums, areas and volumes from entered readings.

Lifetime removes the personal photo creation limit. Annotation tools and exports are also available free. The example does not use your free photo slots.

Edit photo
Readings stay unchanged. Labels remain visible. The full source photo is retained in editable backups.
Freehand
Drawing style
Line width
Line style
Report settings
Company branding
Compact fits two main photos per page. Photos only omits notes, registers and calculations. Templates apply to PDF exports.
App lock
Locks on backgrounding. Protects app access, not exported files. Face ID, Touch ID and device passcode are handled by iOS; FieldMark receives no biometric data.

name: FitSprig: Kids Size Cards
description:
Take the sizes you know into the next shopping trip.

FitSprig keeps each child's dated clothing-size history, measurements and shopping needs together. A current size card uses the latest entry for the same child, brand and clothing category, while older sizes remain in history.

- Create separate nickname cards for your children.
- Record the brand, category, label size, date and whether an item fits, is too small or is too large.
- Add an optional label photo selected through the system photo picker.
- Keep dated height and foot measurements with centimetre or inch display.
- Add shopping needs with a quantity and note, then mark them bought when you choose.
- Review the current size card and earlier records without replacing the original label text.
- Preview a PDF shopping card and share a CSV of your recorded history, measurements and shopping list.

FitSprig works offline without an account. It records your observations; it does not predict growth, suggest the next size or promise that sizes match across brands.

name: Fixmit Studio
description:
Dein Studio – direkt auf dem iPhone.

Fixmit Studio hilft Studios, Salons und selbstständigen Dienstleistern, ihren Alltag mobil zu organisieren.

TERMINE IM BLICK
Sieh deine Termine im Tages- und Wochenkalender. Lege neue Termine an, verschiebe Buchungen oder sage sie ab.

KUNDEN VERWALTEN
Finde Kunden über Name, E-Mail oder Telefonnummer und öffne ihre Terminhistorie. Bearbeite Kontaktinformationen direkt in der App.

LEISTUNGEN UND ARBEITSZEITEN
Erstelle Dienstleistungen, passe Preise und Dauer an und verwalte Arbeitszeiten. Sperre Zeiträume, in denen du nicht verfügbar bist.

DEIN STUDIOPROFIL
Ändere Logo, Namen, Adresse und Beschreibung deiner öffentlichen Buchungsseite.

RESTZAHLUNGEN ORGANISIEREN
Bei entsprechend eingerichteten Zahlungsleistungen kannst du Restzahlungslinks teilen oder eine tatsächlich im Studio erhaltene Zahlung erfassen. Kunden bezahlen ihre Behandlung beim angebundenen Zahlungsanbieter.

Fixmit Studio ist derzeit kostenlos. Du benötigst ein Fixmit-Konto; die Registrierung ist in der App möglich. Dein Konto kannst du unter Studio → Datenschutz & Konto dauerhaft löschen.

Fragen? office@dadakaev.com

name: Fırsat Arabalar Araç Değerleme
seller_name: PARABABASI BILGI TEKNOLOJILERI PAZARLAMA VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Fırsat Arabalar ile aracınızı satmak artık çok kolay. Aracınızın bilgilerini girin, değerlemesini yapalım, size en uygun nakit teklifi sunalım.

ARACINIZIN DEĞERİNİ ÖĞRENİN
• Marka, model, yıl, donanım ve kilometre bilgilerini birkaç adımda girin
• Tramer, boya ve değişen bilgilerini ekleyin
• Aracınızın fotoğraflarını çekin veya galeriden yükleyin
• Fiyat beklentinizi belirtin, değerleme sonucunuzu uygulamadan takip edin

NAKİT VE GÜVENLİ SATIŞ
• Anında nakit ödeme
• Tüm işlemler yasal süreçlere uygun
• Kurumsal güvence ile profesyonel hizmet

EKSPERTİZ RANDEVUSU
• Anlaşmalı ekspertiz firmalarını görüntüleyin
• Size uygun gün ve saati seçerek randevu oluşturun
• Randevunuzu güvenli 3D Secure ödeme ile onaylayın
• Tüm randevularınızı tek ekrandan takip edin

SATILIK ARAÇLAR
• Satılık araçları inceleyin
• Yakıt, kasa tipi ve diğer kriterlere göre filtreleyin
• Size uygun aracı kolayca bulun

Değerlemeleriniz, randevularınız ve bildirimleriniz her zaman cebinizde. Fırsat Arabalar'ı hemen indirin, aracınızın gerçek değerini öğrenin!

name: Fleetfall: 3D Naval Battle
description:
Hunt down the enemy fleet before it finds yours.

Fleetfall is the classic grid sea battle, rebuilt in 3D. Drag your ships onto a living ocean, turn them with a tap, then take turns calling shots across the water. Missiles arc overhead, splashes mark the misses, and a hit leaves a ship burning until the last shell sends it to the bottom.

* Three computer admirals: Easy, Normal and Hard
* A fair-play replay after every game shows exactly how the computer chose each shot. It never sees your ships
* Standard, Large and Grand boards, from five ships to nine
* Optional sea mines that bite back at whoever fires on them
* Five seas to fight on: Open Ocean, Island Life, Stormy Weather, City Harbor and Desert Outpost
* A flat view of both boards, or a free-rotating ocean view
* Play nearby: two players on the same Wi-Fi, each on their own device, with saved games that reconnect
* Cinematic sinks, realistic or mild battle sound, and haptics
* Built for iPhone and iPad

Try the whole game for 10 days, then keep it with a single one-time purchase. No ads, no subscription.

Choose your sea, deploy your fleet, and fire.

name: Flush Hour
description:
The perfect game for your bathroom break. You were going anyway.

A game of Flush Hour lasts 60 seconds. Exactly one bathroom break. While you are sitting there, change the toilet roll on the beat: arrows rise with the music, you tap them at the right moment, the roll gets changed. Easy. Until it speeds up. Then it gets urgent.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap the arrows when they hit the targets
• Pull the spindle, toss the tube, rip the plastic, paper over the top
• Every miss drains your coworkers' patience bar
• Last 60 seconds and score as many points as you can

WHAT'S INSIDE
• A real rhythm game with its own soundtrack
• Levels that speed up: off-beat arrows, double arrows, bursts
• Striped arrows: the new roll is wrapped, chain the burst to rip off the plastic
• The golden roll: double points
• Between levels, a coworker drops by to mess with you. Kévin and his turbo curse. Josiane and her golden roll. Régis, who slows down time. Never the same effect twice in one game.
• Brenda. If the team runs out of patience, Brenda shows up. She is not happy.
• A merciless verdict at the end of every game
• A unique little avatar for every nickname

LEADERBOARDS
• Weekly leaderboard, reset every Monday
• All-time leaderboard
• Last place earns the title of Roll Changing Attendant. Officially.

START YOUR OFFICE TEAM
• Create a team and get a 6-character code
• Drop it in the office chat
• Private leaderboard with everyone's best score
• Up to 5 teams: the office, the family, the hockey crew

NO NONSENSE
• Free
• No account, no email: just a nickname
• No ads, no in-app purchases
• No tracking. What you do in there is your business

Compatible with every toilet. No plumber required. Made with love and plenty of fiber.

Wash your hands after.

name: Folio: Foldable Instruments
description:
Folio turns your open iPhone into a book of music. Every page is an instrument, and they all play together, at one tempo. Record a loop, turn the page, layer another instrument on top: a whole song builds up under your fingers.

SIX INSTRUMENTS, ONE PAGE EACH
• Drum machine: eight steps, seven sounds, layers that stack up.
• Freehand score: draw across both screens and the playhead plays your drawing. Eight colours, eight sounds.
• Wind: blow into the microphone, cover the holes with your fingers. Flutes, clarinet, saxophone, trumpet, ocarina…
• Strings: thirteen strings to pluck, with the hinge as the bridge.
• Keyboard: two octaves, knobs (filter, resonance, attack, release) and a modulator.
• Turntables: two records to scratch, the fold as the crossfader. Load your own songs too.

TEN SOUNDS PER INSTRUMENT
808 and 909 kits, gamelan, harp, oud, electric piano, organ, synths, celesta… sixty sound sets, all synthesised live.

YOUR OWN SOUNDS
Record a voice, an object or an instrument with the iPhone microphone, a Bluetooth microphone or a USB-C interface, then play it across the keyboard or put it on a turntable.

A REAL MIXING DESK
• Volume, loop and two effects per track: reverb, delay, flanger, chorus, phaser, envelope filter, auto-wah, saturation, bit crusher, tremolo.
• Tempo, loop length, metronome.
• Save your whole project and export your song as audio.
• With the phone closed, the outer screen becomes the mixing desk.

MADE FOR THE FOLDING IPHONE
The hinge is part of the instruments: the turntables' crossfader, a note that bends on the strings. On a regular iPhone, tilt and sliders take over.

Nothing is collected, nothing leaves your iPhone. No account, no ads.

name: FolioMobile
description:
Folio is a native word processor for Mac, iPhone and iPad — completely local.

No account. No sign-up. No network calls. Your documents never leave the device.

WRITE
• Rich text: font family and size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, text colour, highlight
• Paragraph control: alignment, line spacing, spacing before and after, first-line indent, indent steps
• Bulleted and numbered lists, inline images, tables, page breaks, links
• System spell checking, find and replace, undo/redo, live word and character counts

LAYOUT
• Paper-on-screen page view: A4, A5, B5, Letter, Legal; portrait or landscape; adjustable margins
• Headers, footers and page numbers
• Zoom from 50% to 200%, ⌘+ / ⌘- / ⌘0 on the Mac, pinch on iPhone

OUTPUT
• Export print-ready PDF with real pagination
• Export and import .docx so you can hand documents to Word users
• Native .folio documents: a single portable file

MADE FOR EACH PLATFORM
• Mac: full menu bar with shortcuts, inspector panel, multi-window documents
• iPad: three-column layout, keyboard shortcuts, pointer support, split view
• iPhone: keyboard accessory bar, share sheets, compact inspector

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French,
German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian — switch at runtime, no relaunch needed.

name: FoneScope Tester
description:
FoneScope Tester is the phone-side app for FoneScope, the phone checking system used by repair and refurbishment shops.

When a shop checks a phone, FoneScope Tester walks the technician through every hardware test and sends each result to the phone's report on the shop PC and the FoneScope website:

• Touchscreen grid, multi-touch and dead pixels
• Loudspeaker, earpiece and a real phone call
• Bottom, front and rear microphones with a live level bar
• Front and rear cameras, flashlight
• Gyroscope, accelerometer, compass, GPS
• Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and NFC
• Volume buttons, silent switch, vibration, side button
• Face ID / Touch ID and proximity sensor
• True Tone and parts history checks
• Wireless charging
• Optional battery stress test that catches weak replacement batteries

Plugged into the shop PC, the app links to the right phone record by itself. Without a cable, scan the QR code on the PC. Every result is saved against the phone's IMEI.

FoneScope Tester needs a FoneScope shop account to save results. Tap "Try a demo" to run the tests without one.

name: ForeLeft!
description:
ForeLeft! is the operating system for your buddies' golf trip. One organizer sets it up, the crew joins with an invite code or QR, and everyone sees the same schedule, pairings, scores and chirps.

PLAN THE TRIP
- Trip board with dates, lodging, dinner reservations, schedule and packing list
- Tee times with course search and course logos
- Import an itinerary from a confirmation email or document
- Trip costs, so everyone knows their share of lodging and green fees
- Invite buddies with a code or QR, or add guests as placeholders

SET THE MATCHES
- Pairings and team draft for each round
- Formats including stroke play, Stableford, match play, skins, scramble, best ball, foursomes, Sunningdale, Nassau, quota, closest to the pin, longest drive and greenies
- Net or gross scoring with handicap support
- A Ryder Cup-style trip cup with a running team score

SCORE IT LIVE
- Hole-by-hole scoring that syncs to the whole group in real time
- Scores entered offline queue up and sync when you're back in range
- GPS course map with live yardages to the green (location is only used while the app is open)
- Optional live "where's the group" view for your trip members

TRACK THE SIDE GAMES
- Record friendly side games such as Nassau, presses, skins, closest to the pin and longest drive
- ForeLeft! works out who owes whom and shows a settlement ledger
- ForeLeft! never handles money. There is no deposit, no payout and no payment between players in the app. It's a scorekeeper for your group, and any settling up happens outside the app.

KEEP THE CHIRPS GOING
- Trip group chat and direct messages with buddies on your trip
- Roast wall, banter and push notifications for big moments
- Course passport stamps for every course you play

PRICING
ForeLeft! is free to download, and planning is free: build any trip by hand, one day or a whole week, score it, and use your one free AI itinerary import. Adding your crew to a trip, or importing again after your free import, takes a one-time Trip Unlock in-app purchase that covers the whole crew.

Privacy: https://www.foreleft.golf/privacy
Terms: https://www.foreleft.golf/terms
Support: https://www.foreleft.golf/support or help@foreleft.golf
You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

ForeLeft! is published by ForeLeft, LLC.

name: ForgeDocs
description:
Une quittance de loyer, un état des lieux, une lettre de résiliation : remplissez, signez, envoyez. ForgeDocs crée vos papiers du quotidien en PDF, sur votre iPhone ou votre Mac.

PAS DE COMPTE. PAS DE SERVEUR. PAS D'IA.
Ouvrez l'app et commencez, sans inscription. Le PDF est créé sur votre appareil et vos documents restent chez vous, pas chez nous. Remplir, signer et créer le PDF fonctionne hors connexion : il ne faut du réseau que pour envoyer le document.

13 MODÈLES
Logement : quittance de loyer, état des lieux, préavis de départ.
Argent : reçu de paiement, reçu de vente.
Écrits courants : reconnaissance de dette, lettre de résiliation, mise en demeure, attestation sur l'honneur, procuration, lettre libre.
Famille et associations : autorisation parentale, attestation d'hébergement.

PENSÉ POUR GAGNER DU TEMPS
• Votre nom, votre adresse, votre ville et votre signature sont repris d'un document à l'autre.
• Chaque mois, la quittance suivante vous attend sur l'accueil, déjà remplie, pour chaque locataire.
• Un exemple fictif de chaque modèle, pour voir le résultat avant de commencer.
• Un encadré rappelle ce qu'il faut savoir avant d'utiliser le document.
• Vos documents sont gardés dans l'app : retrouvez-les, renvoyez-les ou refaites-les.

SIGNEZ SUR PLACE
Sur iPhone, tournez le téléphone et signez au doigt dans un grand cadre. Si un locataire ou un acheteur doit signer aussi, il le fait au même moment.

AUSSI SUR MAC
Le formulaire à gauche, le document à droite, mis à jour pendant que vous écrivez. Enregistrez le PDF où vous voulez ou imprimez-le. Sur Mac et sur iPhone, les documents restent séparés : chaque appareil garde les siens.

À SAVOIR
Modèle à vérifier selon votre situation. Les lois changent et chaque cas est différent : en cas de doute ou d'enjeu important, faites relire votre document par un professionnel. ForgeDocs ne donne pas de conseil juridique, et certaines démarches imposent un formulaire officiel.

Vos documents ne sont gardés que sur votre appareil et dans vos sauvegardes : si vous supprimez l'app sans sauvegarde, ils sont perdus. Pensez à envoyer ou enregistrer ceux que vous voulez garder.

name: Four by Eight
description:
Draw your raised bed as one-foot squares, drop a crop in each, and get spacing, good and bad neighbors, and sowing dates worked out from your frost dates.

Four by Eight plans raised beds the square foot way: one crop per square, the right number of plants in each, and every date counted from your own frost dates.

DRAW A BED
Pick 4 × 8, 4 × 4, 3 × 6 or 2 × 8, or set any size up to 12 by 16 feet. Each bed is drawn as a wooden frame of one-foot squares with column letters and row numbers, so "C5" means the same thing in the app and in the yard.

DROP CROPS
Choose a seed packet from the tray and tap squares. 44 vegetables, herbs and flowers know how many fit in a square: 16 carrots, 9 bush beans, 4 lettuces, 1 tomato. Zucchini, winter squash and melons take a 2 × 2 block.

SEE THE NEIGHBORS
A red edge between two squares means keep them apart, like beans next to onions. A green dot means they do well together, like tomato and basil. Open a square to read why, or ignore a pair in that bed.

FOLLOW THIS WEEK
Set your last spring frost and first fall frost once. Four by Eight works out when to start seeds indoors, when to sow or plant out, and when to harvest. The home screen shows what to do this week, and anything late is marked. The calendar lists every step for the season, week by week.

KEEP THE SQUARE BUSY
Mark a square harvested and it suggests what can follow it there and still be ready before fall frost, skipping the same family and anything that clashes with the neighbors.

ROTATE NEXT SEASON
Start a new season and last year's beds are kept, read only. A yellow corner marks any square where the same crop family grew last season.

Share a bed as an image with its crop key. Feet or 30 cm squares.

Try a sample garden before drawing your own.

No account and no sign-in. Your beds stay on this iPhone.

name: Frame Capture – Video Stills
description:
Frame Capture pulls exact frames out of any video. Scrub to the moment, step one frame at a time, mark every frame you want, and save them as full-quality photos, all at once.

FIND THE FRAME
• Frame-accurate scrubbing and stepping: the exact frame, not the nearest one
• Drag below the timeline to slow the scrub down to frame by frame
• Drag across the picture to jog; hold a step button to keep stepping
• Pinch or tap to zoom the timeline

MARK IT
• Markers keep their exact frame and time
• Give each one a name, a note and a colour
• Move markers, jump between them, and undo any change
• Compare two marked frames with a wipe
• A marker one frame away from another is pointed out

EXPORT
• One frame or all of them, in one go
• JPEG, HEIC or PNG
• Full source size, or a preset up to 8K (DCI 4K included) that keeps the video's shape, or a custom size
• Optional contact sheet: one image of every frame with its name and time
• Save to Photos (optionally into a Frame Capture album), to a Files folder you choose once, or share to any app
• Progress with cancel; nothing half-written is ever left behind

PROJECTS
• Every video is a project you can reopen months later
• Search, sort and rename; free up space by removing a video and keeping its markers

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Portrait and landscape, Light and Dark, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver
• Hardware keyboard: Space, arrow keys, M to mark, Return, Delete, Command-Z

PRIVATE
• No account, no upload, no ads, no tracking
• Videos and frames never leave your device

FREE TO TRY
• Every export is unlimited for your first 14 days
• After that, 3 exported frames a day are free; the count resets at midnight
• Frame Capture Lifetime, a one-time purchase, makes exports unlimited for good. No subscription. Family Sharing supported.
• Importing, scrubbing, marking and previewing are always free. Settings always show how many free frames are left today.

Terms of use: Apple's standard licence agreement.

name: Frartap Chente
description:
Frartap Chente is the glaze chemistry studio that lives in your pocket. Write a recipe, choose your cone and atmosphere, and watch the app predict exactly how your glaze will fire — surface texture, colour, opacity, melt fluidity, thermal fit to your clay body, and food-safety warnings — all before you load a single test tile.

The on-device chemistry engine converts raw material weights into a full Seger unity molecular formula, then runs an eight-step analysis pipeline covering melt, surface, opacity, colour, coefficient of thermal expansion, and durability. A built-in library of 37 raw materials and 8 clay bodies gets you started instantly, and you can add your own custom materials and bodies at any time. Need a batch sheet? Enter your dry batch weight and application method and Frartap Chente calculates the grams of each material plus the water to add.

The Formulate solver works in reverse: set a target chemistry, choose up to eight materials from your library, and the app finds the recipe that best matches your goal using a full non-negative least-squares algorithm. The Blends tool lets you plan line blends, triaxial grids, and colorant series, showing a row of predicted glaze orbs so you can spot trends before firing. The Firings log lets you record test tile outcomes, compare observed results against predictions, and calibrate your clay body expansion range from real fired evidence over time.

Whether you are testing a new clear base, chasing a celadon, or diagnosing a crazing problem, Frartap Chente gives you the chemistry insight to make better glazes faster.

name: Freedom Transactions
description:
Freedom Transactions is a transaction coordinator for Idaho real estate agents.

Upload a signed purchase contract on the website and Freedom Transactions reads it, builds every deadline from the contract's terms, drafts the Under Contract email to everyone on the deal, and keeps a checklist for the file. The iPhone app keeps you on top of it from anywhere:

• Today: a morning briefing of what's due, what's at risk, and what needs your approval.
• Deadline alerts two business days before each deadline, the morning it's due, and three hours before it closes.
• Approve the Under Contract email and drafted documents. Nothing is sent to anyone until you tap Approve.
• Ask for an addendum, notice or letter by typing or speaking, and review the draft on your phone.
• Alerts when a contract has been read and when a draft is ready.

Freedom Transactions is for agents who have been added by their brokerage. Contracts are uploaded and terms confirmed on the website at transactions.freedomidaho.com.

name: FridgeDates
description: A cute offline helper for opened fridge and freezer food. Log when you open something, get gentle due reminders, finish items as eaten or thrown, and see simple waste insights.

name: FrostRoster: Freezer Stock
description:
See where each recorded freezer batch is and how many portions remain. FrostRoster organizes food by compartment, chosen priority date and a saved movement history.

Create your own compartments and add batches with portions, frozen dates, notes and optional photos. Use First puts your chosen priority dates in order and shows each batch's location. Record the portions you take, and undo an eligible use without losing its source action.

Check the freezer with an inventory-count draft. Enter an actual amount for every row: a missing value is not treated as zero. Save the draft, reopen it and explain differences before applying. If stock changes after a draft starts, its revision check prevents an outdated count from overwriting newer movements. An applied count forms a boundary for earlier use reversals.

Keep used-up batches in history. Add fresh stock as a new batch with a new identity and empty movement ledger. Preview inventory and count PDFs, then export CSV records with movement and count references through the iPhone share sheet.

Priority dates are chosen by you. FrostRoster does not determine expiry, food safety or whether food is safe to eat.

Works offline without an app account. Records and selected photos stay locally. No ads or tracking are included. You choose where exported files are shared.

name: Fuel Log Health
description:
Fuel Log turns your Apple Health data into targets you can actually follow.

• Targets from your real data: calories and macros based on your goal, your weight trend and your activity, not a generic formula.
• Weekly and monthly reviews: what went well, what didn't, and what to try next, written on your iPhone.
• Training and rest day targets, plus optional menstrual cycle adjustments.
• Meal ideas for what's left today, from what's in your fridge.
• Optional photo estimates: snap a meal and get an editable calorie and macro estimate (needs a free Google Gemini key).
• Save a photo meal to Apple Health only when you choose.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPhone.

Works best with a food app that writes to Apple Health, plus an Apple Watch or a smart scale.

Fuel Log gives general information, not medical advice.

name: Fuel Log Pro - Tracker & Trips
description:
Fuel Log Pro tracks what you spend on fuel and charging, for your own motorcycle or car and for every car you rent on trips abroad.

MY VEHICLES
• Log a fill-up or charge in seconds, or scan the fuel receipt with the camera
• See your real consumption (L/100km, km/L or mpg), cost per km and total spent
• Charts for consumption, fuel price, spending and distance, with plain-language insights
• Petrol, diesel, hybrid and electric vehicles, side by side
• Renewal reminders for licence, insurance, inspection and road tax, with suggestions for your country

TRIPS
• Create a trip, log each drive in your rental car, and see what the whole trip cost
• Costs in the local currency are converted to your home currency with daily exchange rates, or your own rate
• Compare the cars you've rented

MADE FOR YOU
• 18 languages, six colour themes, light and dark mode, adjustable text size
• Your data stays on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Export a backup any time

FUEL LOG PRO
The free version includes 1 vehicle with 10 fill-ups, and 1 trip with 1 car and 10 entries. Fuel Log Pro removes the limits: unlimited vehicles, fill-ups and trips. Everything you've logged always stays available.
• Pro Monthly and Pro Yearly are auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it's cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
• Pro Lifetime is a one-time purchase.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://toddd12345232.github.io/fuel-log-pro/

name: Gabay sa Salah (Pagdarasal)
description:
Ang app na ito ay naglalayon na tulungan ang isang Muslim na mapag-igi at mapag-ibayo ang pagsasagawa ng kanyang pagdarasal, ang maturuan siya sa tamang pamamaraan at sa mga bagay na dapat niyang matutunan kaugnay sa usaping SALAH (PAGDARASAL).

Ganap at kumpletong gabay sa Salah (Pagdarasal) para sa hindi pa marurunong nito.

name: GalaxyHandyman
description:
Galaxy Handyman connects people who need a job done with trusted local helpers.

FOR CUSTOMERS
• Post a task in minutes: describe the job, add photos or PDF files, set your address and budget.
• Receive offers from helpers and compare their price, message and profile.
• Ask questions on your task and chat directly with helpers before you decide.
• Accept the offer you like. Your payment is held securely by Galaxy Handyman and is only paid out once the task is marked complete.
• Leave a review when the work is done.

FOR HELPERS (HANDYMEN)
• Browse open tasks near you and filter by category, city and budget.
• Place offers, ask questions and chat with customers.
• Set up task alerts so you never miss a job that fits your skills.
• Build your reputation with reviews, badges and levels.
• Get paid securely through the app and follow your payouts.

WHY GALAXY HANDYMAN
• Cleaning, repairs, moving, gardening, assembly and many more everyday tasks.
• Real-time notifications for new offers, questions, replies and messages.
• Secure payments held until the job is complete.
• Public helper profiles with reviews, so you can choose with confidence.
• Available in English and Danish.

Download Galaxy Handyman and get your next task done, or start earning by helping others.

name: Galleriet – Art Collection
description:
Galleriet is a private catalog for people who collect art.

Photograph a work and it is cropped and straightened automatically. Add the artist, medium, dimensions and provenance. Everything stays private until you decide otherwise.

DISCREET
Nobody can browse collections. You show your works only to collectors you have both approved, and you choose what is shared for each work. Address and location are never shown, and location data is removed from every image.

OFFERS WITHOUT A MIDDLEMAN
Mark a work as open for offers. Approved collectors can make an offer, and you can accept, counter or discreetly decline. Once you agree, you message each other in the app and settle payment and shipping directly.

FOR YOUR INSURANCE
Export your whole collection as a PDF catalog whenever you need it.

Galleriet is free to use and takes no commission.

The app is in Swedish.

name: GALS
description:
Discover your next favourite with GALS, your style companion for bags, heels and accessories made for every mood.

Browse the latest collection, explore pieces by category and colour, and save the styles you love to your wishlist. Create your GALS Babe profile, join GALS Club to collect coins and unlock member rewards, then keep your orders and delivery tracking together in one convenient place.

With GALS you can:
• Shop bags, heels, charms and accessories
• Search and browse by category or colour mood
• Save favourites to your wishlist
• Join GALS Club and access rewards
• Manage your profile and delivery addresses
• View orders and courier tracking

Good looks. Your rules.

name: GDL楼梯灯
description:
GDL楼梯灯是一款配合兼容楼梯灯设备使用的蓝牙控制工具。打开 App 后，可以搜索附近的设备、连接楼梯灯，并在手机上控制灯光和调整设备设置。

使用设备控制功能时，请打开手机蓝牙，并将手机靠近楼梯灯。

name: Geldberg: Coin Vault Idle
description:
The bank vault is full to the brim: a huge mountain of coins – and every single one counts. Hundreds of thousands to millions of individual coins, and somewhere inside are the director's golden crown coins – often hidden among deceptively real fakes. Grab a shovel, haul copper, silver, gold and platinum to the green counter, and build a coin factory of real machines.

EVERY COIN COUNTS
• What you shovel goes into your pockets one to one
• Loose coins slide down when you dig underneath
• 7 shovels and 7 pockets – from bare hands to the plasma vacuum

REAL MACHINES – NEW
• Every machine visibly grabs a few coins per grip and fills its own hopper – expensive machines refine the coins instead of taking thousands at once
• You only get paid at the counter: tap a machine to empty its hopper, build up to 5 conveyor belts, buy up to 4 cash trucks, hire helpers
• When a hopper is full, the machine stops – plan your transport
• A coin checker per machine: without one, crown coins land unchecked in the hopper and are only recognised at the counter

YOUR COIN FACTORY
• 25 machines with their own models – from the coin chute and chain conveyor via the minting robot and vault train to the teleport gate, nano swarm and coin reactor, with upgrades up to level 10 and shift supervisors
• 15 machine combos, 22 upgrades and power from generators
• A warehouse for high gold rates and a shopping robot that buys machines for you
• Offline progress: up to 8 hours, conveyor belts and cash trucks keep delivering

HUNT FOR THE CROWN COINS
• New: Forger Hunt (8 crown coins, only one is real), Collector's Order and the Giant Mountain with around 6.4 million coins – plan for hours
• Scanners, scanner ping and a gold-seeking robot lead you to the hidden crown coins
• Dynamite, drill, jetpack and, from level 8, the Money Storm
• Companions like Bruno the Bank Dog, Mimi the vault cat and Frosti the penguin
• 15 letters from the director – and a secret platinum crown …

PROGRESS THAT STICKS
• Talent tree with 6 branches and 37 talents
• Prestige: open new branches, collect diamonds, buy bonuses and decorations and research 18 lab projects
• Found a banking group – permanent holding shares, each worth +50% coin value and +10% machine speed
• 10 vaults as worlds – from the Moon Vault, the Pharaoh's Tomb and the glacier to the Volcano Vault and the Space Station
• Treasure album with 8 sets, 150 achievements, story missions – and free play after you win
• An estimated 40–60 hours until you've seen it all

ALWAYS SOMETHING GOING ON
• Gold rush, the Golden Hour, coin rain, bank robbers, landslides, power cuts, ice rain, northern lights and more
• Bosses: the master thief, the Yeti thief, the bank inspection and the tax raid
• Customer orders, the "Safecracker" number puzzle, daily tasks, a wheel of fortune and weekly challenges

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Campaign with 57 levels in 8 chapters plus 2 bonus levels: goals, time limits, mutators, boss levels and star rewards
• 15 more modes: First Day at Work, Easy, Normal, Hardcore, Mega, Giant Mountain, Forger Hunt, Collector's Order, Deep Drill (endless), Treasure Hunt, Zen, Time Trial, Weekly Challenge, Monthly Mountain and Daily Mountain
• 15 mutators for custom games – from moon gravity and Frost to Deception (4 extra fakes) and No Scanner
• Touch controls with large buttons, or a gamepad with vibration and controller button prompts
• Photo mode with a free camera and 6 filters
• Quick start "Like last time", searchable help, statistics, minimap, backups
• Colour schemes, subtitles for sounds, reduced camera effects, text size, high contrast, colour-blind-friendly coins
• 6 languages: German, English, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil) and Polish

Free to play. Ads only as optional reward videos – or buy “Ad-free” once. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Geobound
description:
Geobound turns geometric dimensioning and tolerancing into something you can see.
Build a datum reference frame, place feature control frames, and watch translucent 3D tolerance zones wrap around a specimen. Instantly read the allowed deformation range—envelope volume, zone thickness, and maximum deviation—so orientation, runout, and profile controls feel concrete instead of abstract.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Create GD&T studies for blocks, shafts, and flanges
• Define primary, secondary, and tertiary datums (A | B | C)
• Add parallelism, circular runout, surface profile, flatness, and perpendicularity
• Inspect Feature Control Frames with material condition modifiers
• Orbit a live SceneKit viewport with labeled tolerance envelopes
• Review a cross-section band of the allowed surface departure
• Keep a local shelf of projects—search, pin, duplicate, and share summaries
• Learn from an illustrated primer covering symbols, zones, and DRF basics
BUILT FOR LEARNING AND DESIGN DISCUSSION
Geobound is an educational visualization aid for students, designers, and manufacturing teams. It helps you communicate how a callout constrains a part in space. It does not replace calibrated inspection equipment, certified drawings, or professional engineering judgment.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Projects and preferences stay on your device. No account is required for core features, and Geobound does not need a network connection to visualize tolerance zones.
Open a sample blueprint—or start a blank study—and make geometric tolerance tangible.

name: Ghim: AI Calendar & Reminders
description:
Ghim turns messages, photos and voice notes into calendar events, reminders and notes – in seconds.

Every day you get messages with meeting times, bills to pay, school notices, class and shift schedules, and you retype each one into Calendar or Reminders. Ghim does it for you – including the things a single voice command can't.

CAPTURE IT ANY WAY
• Snap a notice, a poster or a screen with the camera
• Share straight from Messages, WhatsApp, Mail, Safari or Photos – no need to open the app
• Paste a chat, type a quick thought or tap the mic and speak
• One long message with five plans? Ghim finds all five

UNDERSTANDS HOW YOU TALK
• Repeats: "Mon, Wed, Fri every week", "every other week", "monthly", "10 sessions"
• Medicine "3 times a day for 7 days" becomes morning, noon and evening reminders
• Lunar dates and anniversaries, converted and repeated on the lunar calendar
• "Next Friday at 3pm", "tomorrow 7:30 in the evening", "before the 15th" – in English and Vietnamese

TIMETABLES IN ONE PHOTO
Photograph a class timetable or a shift rota. Ghim reads every cell of the table and creates the whole series of weekly events.

NO MORE DOUBLE BOOKING
Ghim warns you when something overlaps your calendar and suggests the nearest free time, one tap to move it.

WIDGETS & MORNING SUMMARY
See what's next on your Home and Lock Screen, plus a year progress bar with a little runner. Every morning, get a short note of the day ahead.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Ghim uses Apple Intelligence right on your iPhone. Your messages are never uploaded. No account, no ads, no tracking.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Nothing is added automatically. Every item waits for your review before it goes into Apple Calendar or Reminders, synced with iCloud everywhere.

SIRI & SHORTCUTS
Use "Add to Ghim" from Siri, the Shortcuts app or the Action button to capture without opening the app.

GHIM PRO
The free version includes 15 analyses every month, with the camera, sharing, lunar dates and repeats. Ghim Pro unlocks unlimited analyses, timetables from photos, clash warnings, the morning summary and the Up next widget – monthly, yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or lifetime.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage them in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

REQUIREMENTS
AI features need an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or newer) with Apple Intelligence turned on. Other devices use a basic date detection mode.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Glanceline: Video Teleprompter
description:
Look at the lens, not at your notes.

Paste your script, tap Record, and read as it scrolls right under the front camera. Your eyes stay close to the lens, so your video feels like a conversation.

READ NATURALLY
• Smooth scrolling at the words per minute you choose
• Change speed or text size during a take
• Tap the text to pause; drag it to find your place
• Each script shows its word count and reading time

RECORD IN ONE TAP
• A 3-2-1 countdown, then recording and scrolling start together
• Rehearse without recording
• Save takes to Photos or share them right away

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account
• Scripts stay on your iPhone, and takes go only where you save or share them

FREE AND PRO
Free: unlimited scripts and takes up to 60 seconds. Pro is one purchase with no subscription: takes up to 30 minutes and rear-camera recording.

name: Glass Seconds: Clock Widgets
description:
Keep the time in view with seconds on your iPhone. Add the Seconds widget beside the Lock Screen clock, or place a larger Clock widget on your Home Screen.

• Choose seconds, minutes and seconds, or a 24-hour clock with seconds.
• Style your digits with SF Pro, SF Pro Rounded, New York, or SF Mono. Adjust size, weight, and width.
• Choose white or glass-style digits on the Home Screen. For a transparent glass background, touch and hold the Home Screen, then choose Edit > Customize > Clear. iOS supplies this background.
• Preview your choices in the app, then use Edit Widget to set up each widget.

Requires iOS 26 or later. Available layouts depend on placement and iOS version. Inline widgets use system typography. iOS manages widget refresh timing and rendering.

One purchase includes all four typefaces and every display setting. The app works offline, with no ads, accounts, or in-app purchases.

name: GlassTraxx Source
description:
GlassTraxx Source brings glass part searches, VIN matching, and your company’s supplier pricing together on iPhone.

• Part Check: search a glass part number and compare available supplier options.
• VIN Check: choose the glass type and location first, then enter the VIN to find matching part suggestions.
• Glass location guidance helps distinguish front and rear vents from body quarter glass.
• Connect your company’s own supported supplier accounts.
• Save purchase-tax and fee settings to estimate your buying cost.
• Review previous checks in History.

GlassTraxx Source is a business price-checking tool. It does not generate customer quotes or place supplier orders. Supplier pricing and availability depend on your accounts and the supplier’s current data. Confirm the exact glass variant, fitment, attachments, and availability before ordering.

An eligible GlassTraxx Source company account and supported supplier accounts are required.

name: Gloop Rush: Blob Evolution
description:
You are a jelly blob on the run from the lab. Drag to steer, swallow everything smaller than you, and grow until you can gulp the boss.

EAT OR BE EATEN
Green enemies are smaller than you: swallow them. Red ones are bigger: dodge them, or come back when you have grown. Every bite makes you bigger and wobblier.

MUTATE AT EVERY GATE
Pick a gate and change your body: Bouncy hops over danger, Spiky pops anything, Liquid melts through walls, Magnet pulls candy in. Stack two forms to fuse them into Urchin, Splash, Pinball and more.

SQUEEZE THROUGH WALLS
Too big for the hole? Shed some jelly to squeeze through, then swallow the bits back. The floor shows green if you fit, amber if you will have to squish.

GULP THE BOSS
Every level ends at the vault. Arrive big enough and you swallow the boss whole; if you are close, tap fast to puff up. The bigger you are, the bigger the coin shower.

HATCH 36 BLOBS
Open eggs to find Mintly, Frosty, Ember, Nova, the rainbow Prism and more. Each blob has its own perk, and duplicates level it up.

RACE YOUR RIVALS
Three rival blobs run every level. Finish biggest to take first place.

ALSO
• 100 levels across 5 worlds: Lab Pipes, Candy Kitchen, Greenhouse, Neon Arcade, Orbit Station
• Daily gift and daily quests
• Lab upgrades: start bigger, mutate longer, earn more coins
• Plays offline
• Free with ads; one optional purchase removes them

name: Glyph Whisperer
description: Glyph Whisperer is a language puzzle adventure built around observation, not translation tables. You meet speakers who answer in glyphs and tone alone. Read situations, form hypotheses in a field notebook, and test phrases until reactions match your expectations. From the expedition hub, choose your path: campaign lessons across the archipelago, grammar puzzles in the Cipher Room, one utterance in Single Phrase, a shared daily dialect seed, sandbox Free Conversation, or Interpreter mode bridging two speakers. Field tools keep work grounded. The research notebook stores guesses and notes without letter grades. The atlas and inscription archive revisit patterns. The dialogue log preserves exchanges so you can trace how meaning emerged. Each procedural language has its own seed and word order. Settings show the active seed and syntax pattern. Optional camera, photo library, and microphone access support notebook captures when you attach media. Progress comes from dialogue reactions—the only feedback the world gives.

name: GOR GOR Taxi & Delivery
description:
Gorgor brings Baidoa to your door.

• FOOD – Order from Baidoa's restaurants. See the menu, the price and the delivery time before you order.
• GROCERIES – Fresh food and everyday shopping from local shops, delivered.
• TAXI – 4 or 6 seat cars at a fixed price. You know the fare before you go.
• SEND A PARCEL – Documents, clothes, anything — now or at a time you choose.
• LIVE TRACKING – Watch your rider on the map until they reach your door.
• PAY YOUR WAY – EVC Plus, your Gorgor wallet, or cash. Cancelled orders go back to your wallet, and you can send wallet money back to your EVC Plus at any time.
• IN SOMALI – The whole app speaks Somali.

Gorgor waa app-ka Baydhabo: cunto, raashin, taxi iyo shey dir — hal meel.

name: Gorgor Darawal
description:
Gorgor Darawal is the app for drivers and riders who work with Gorgor in Baidoa (Baydhabo), Somalia.

• GO ONLINE – One switch and you start receiving jobs near you.
• NEW JOBS – See the fare, the distance and the pickup before you accept.
• NAVIGATION – A live map to the customer and to the destination, and one tap to call them.
• TAXI, FOOD AND PARCELS – One app for every kind of job.
• EARNINGS – Your commission, cash collected and payouts, day by day. Request a payout to EVC Plus.
• SAFE SIGN-UP – Register with your phone, photo and vehicle, and a short identity video reviewed by our team.

Darawalka Gorgor: shaqo taxi, cunto iyo shey dir, Baydhabo oo dhan.

name: Gotchu: Push Notifications API
description:
Waiting on a long build, a cron job or an AI coding agent? Gotchu makes your phone ring the moment it finishes.
Open the app, copy your personal link, add it to the end of your command. That's about 10 seconds of setup.

HOW IT WORKS
Your link looks like https://gotchu.techinpark.workers.dev/send/your-key?text=Done
Anything that can open a URL can use it: the browser address bar, curl, a cron job, a Python script, a no-code automation tool, a spreadsheet formula, or the last line of a task you hand to an AI coding agent.

  long-task && curl "https://gotchu.techinpark.workers.dev/send/your-key?text=Build%20finished"

No account to create, no API token to copy, no bot to register. You can link an Apple or Google account later to keep your channels when you switch phones.

WHAT YOU GET
• A personal link the first time you open the app
• Channels, each with its own link (for example "Server" and "Home")
• Custom message text and title through URL parameters
• Three notification sounds to tell channels apart
• History of recent pushes on your phone
• English, Korean and Japanese
• A dark, high-contrast design that is easy to read at 2 a.m.
• No ads

FREE
• 2 personal channels
• 300 pushes per month
• 3 basic sounds
• 24-hour history

PRO
• Unlimited pushes (fair use)
• Unlimited group channels: invite up to 10 people per channel with a QR code, so the whole team hears when a deploy finishes
• Siren sound for alerts you cannot miss, sent as a Time Sensitive notification so it can break through Focus
• 30-day history with search
• Resend pushes that failed to arrive
• Action link: add &url= and tapping the notification opens that page, such as a pull request or a dashboard
Pro is available monthly, yearly (7-day free trial) or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Bought Pro on your other phone? Link the same account and it carries over.

PRIVACY
Messages are kept on our server for up to 30 days so you can see your history (Free shows the last 24 hours), then deleted automatically. We use crash reports and anonymous usage analytics to fix bugs. Anyone who has your link can send you a push, so treat it like a password. You can reset it anytime.

Terms of Use: https://gotchu-2611.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gotchu-2611.web.app/privacy
Questions or ideas: tmsaeapp@gmail.com

name: Gotura — 3D Maps & Navigation
description:
Gotura Maps turns everyday driving into a clear 3D view: the map tilts ahead of your car and buildings rise around you, so the next turn is obvious at a glance. It is fast, private and works without an account — nothing you do is tracked or sent to a server of ours.

PLAN YOUR DRIVE
- Search any place by name, category or coordinates, or hold the mic and say it
- Look Around street imagery where Apple has coverage
- Add several stops and let Gotura Maps put them in the fastest order
- Choose fastest or shortest, and avoid tolls or highways

DRIVE IN 3D
- Turn-by-turn guidance with a clear maneuver banner and spoken voice
- A Live Activity and Dynamic Island keep the next turn and ETA on your Lock Screen
- Gotura Maps keeps you on the road and reroutes on its own if you miss a turn
- A gentle alert if you go faster than the limit you set

NEVER LOSE YOUR CAR
- Gotura Maps notices when you finish driving and offers to save where you parked
- Walk back with on-screen AR arrows, a compass and the distance to go

ONE TAP FROM ANYWHERE
- Ask Siri to take you home, to work, or back to your car
- Home-screen widgets for Home, Work and your parked car
- Save Home and Work, build lists, and keep a private history of your trips

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads and no analytics. Your places, saved spots, trip history and settings stay only on your iPhone. One tap exports everything as a file; another wipes it all.

OFFLINE & ACCESSIBLE
- Save a still map of an area to glance at without signal
- Larger text, higher-contrast routes and reduced motion when you need them

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Gotura Maps opens in your iPhone's language when it can, and you can switch any time in Settings. It speaks six languages: English, Vietnamese, Spanish, French, German and Japanese.

Download Gotura Maps and drive with a map that finally looks like the road ahead.

name: Gravon Coffee
description:
Gravon Coffee Roastery'nin sadakat uygulaması. Her kahvende damga topla, sekizinci damgada kahven bizden.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR
• Kahveni al, uygulamadaki QR kodunu kasada okut.
• Damgan anında hesabına işlenir; güneşin ışınları birer birer dolar.
• Sekizinci ışın dolduğunda bir kahve ikramımız.

UYGULAMADA NELER VAR
• Damga kartı: Topladığın damgaları ve ikram kahve hakkını tek bakışta gör.
• Güvenli QR kod: Kod dakikada bir yenilenir; ekran görüntüsüyle kullanılamaz.
• Menü: Sıcak, soğuk ve serinletici içecekleri fiyatlarıyla incele.
• Öğrenci indirimi: Öğrenci üyeler indirimli fiyatları menüde hemen görür.
• Sana özel fırsatlar: Kampanyaları ve duyuruları kaçırma.
• Salla kazan: Belli sayıda kahveden sonra telefonunu salla, sürpriz hediyeni kazan.
• Arkadaşını davet et: Davet kodunla gelen arkadaşın ilk kahvesini aldığında ikinize de birer damga.
• Mağazalar: Çalışma saatlerini gör, tek dokunuşla yol tarifi al.
• Hareketler: Kazandığın ve kullandığın her damganın geçmişi.

Apple, Google ya da e-posta ile giriş yapabilirsin. Hesabını istediğin an Hesabım > Hesabımı sil ile kalıcı olarak silebilirsin.

name: Guess My Santa
description:
Secret Santa, with a guessing game.

Start a group in a minute, share the invite code, and Guess My Santa draws the names for you. Everyone sees only who they're buying for. Not even the organiser can see the draw.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set the draw date, the exchange day and a price limit
• Invite people with a code, link or QR code. No accounts, no email addresses
• Names are drawn automatically, or the organiser draws early
• Add a wishlist so your Santa knows what you'd like
• Ask the person you're buying for secret questions. They never find out who asked
• Before the exchange, guess who your Santa is. Each guess is marked right or wrong straight away
• On the day, the names are revealed with a leaderboard

GOOD FOR
Families, friends, offices, clubs and classes.

FREE, WITH UPGRADES PER GROUP
Free groups take up to 15 people with 3 guesses each and show a small advert.
• Extras: up to 500 people, up to 10 guesses each, and keep people apart in the draw (for example couples)
• Ad-free: everything in Extras with no adverts
An upgrade is a one-off purchase for one group and works for everyone in it.

SAFE AND PRIVATE
Offensive words are filtered. You can report any question, answer, wishlist or name, and stop questions from your Santa. We check every report within 24 hours. Groups are deleted automatically 60 days after the exchange day.

Made in the UK by Phoenix Digital Innovations Ltd.

name: Gummy Screws 3D
description:
Gummy Screws 3D is a relaxing and tricky screw puzzle. Every stage is one squishy, glossy 3D model held together by screws on every side. Spin it any way you like, unscrew it piece by piece and watch it come apart.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag with one finger to spin the model in any direction, even upside down. Pinch to zoom.
• Tap a free screw to unscrew it. Screws under another part stay blocked until that part comes off.
• Each box takes 3 screws of its colour. Fill it and it slides away.
• Screws no box wants wait in the tray. Fill the tray and the next wrong screw falls off: plan ahead!

24 WORLDS TO EXPLORE
Travel an animated world map from Critter Farm and Sunny Beach to Gumdrop Glen, Dino Volcano, the Red Planet and beyond. Models grow from cute critters to whole towns, castles and space stations, and every world ends with a boss.

SKILLS FOR TOUGH SPOTS
Hammer, Magnet, Extra Slot, Undo, Extra Box, Shuffle and Bomb. Earn coins by winning new stages and spend them when you are stuck.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily reward that grows over a 7-day streak
• A new Daily Stage every day
• Daily missions and a Star Chest that fills with every new star
• Weekend Event with three special stages every Saturday and Sunday
• Achievements and a Collection of every model you finish, with golden frames for top stars

BATTLE AND YOUR PROGRESS ONLINE
• Battle: race another player or the computer on the same stage, first to finish wins, and climb the monthly top 100
• Sign in with Google (optional) to keep your progress online and carry it to a new phone

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Colour-blind mode: every screw colour also gets its own shape
• Low graphics option for older phones
• Available in English, Português, Español, Français, Deutsch, Русский and Bahasa Indonesia

Gummy Screws 3D is free to play. It shows ads, some videos are optional ways to get a reward, and it offers optional in-app purchases (coin packs and Remove ads).

name: gurbet AI
description:
gurbet AI, yurt dışında yaşayan Türkler için ücretsiz yapay zekâ yardımcısıdır. Bağımsız bir hizmettir; hiçbir devlet kurumunu temsil etmez. Bilgiler ülkelerin resmî kaynaklarına dayanır; yanıtların altında kaynak bağlantıları verilir.

NE SORABİLİRSİN
Oturum izni, vatandaşlık, çocuk parası, vergi, sağlık sigortası, iş ve işsizlik başvuruları, belediye işlemleri gibi resmî konular. Türkçe sor, yaşadığın ülkeye ve şehre göre yanıt al.

BELGENİ GÖSTER
Gelen resmî mektubun ya da belgenin fotoğrafını çek; ne yazdığını Türkçe anlatsın, ne yapman gerektiğini söylesin.

ÜLKENE GÖRE
Yaşadığın ülkeyi ve şehri seç; yanıtlar ona göre gelir.

ÜCRETSİZ
Üyelik ücretsiz ve Gurbet App hesabınla aynı hesap. E-postana gelen kodla girersin.

ÖNEMLİ
Yanıtlar yapay zekâ ile otomatik üretilir ve hata içerebilir. Hukuki, vergi ya da sağlık danışmanlığı değildir; önemli kararlarda ilgili kurumdan ya da bir uzmandan teyit al. Uygunsuz bir yanıtı uygulamadan bildirebilirsin.

name: Gurbet App
description:
Gurbet App, yurt dışında yaşayan Türklerin ilan uygulaması. Bulunduğun ülkedeki ev, iş, eşya ve hizmet ilanlarını Türkçe bul, ilanını ücretsiz ver.

EV ARIYORSAN
Şehrindeki kiralık ve satılık ilanlara bak ya da "Ev arıyorum" ilanı ver. Ev sahibi sana uygulamadan yazar.

İŞ ARIYORSAN
İş ilanlarına bak ya da "İş arıyorum" ilanı ver.

SATIYORSAN YA DA KİRAYA VERİYORSAN
Fotoğrafını çek, birkaç adımda ilanını yayınla. Eşya, araba, ev ve hizmet ilanı verebilirsin.

FİRMAN VARSA
Türk firmaları, ustalar ve hizmet verenler hizmetini ücretsiz tanıtır.

ÜLKENE GÖRE
Almanya, Avusturya, İsviçre, Hollanda, Belçika, Fransa, İspanya, Danimarka, İsveç, İngiltere, ABD ve Kanada. Fiyat, para birimi ve ilan alanları ülkene göre gelir.

GÜVENLİ
Alıcı ve satıcı uygulamanın içinde mesajlaşır. Telefon numaran yalnız sen istersen ilanda görünür ve yalnız üyelere açılır. Şüpheli ilanı tek dokunuşla bildirirsin.

Üyelik ücretsiz. E-postana gelen kodla girersin, şifre yok.

name: HaptiView: Feel Sound
description:
HaptiView lets deaf and hard-of-hearing people feel music and the sound of videos through vibration on iPhone.

Pick a song or a video from Photos or Files and press play. HaptiView reads the whole soundtrack and turns it into detailed vibration on your iPhone's Taptic Engine, in exact sync with playback.

WHAT YOU FEEL
• The voice and the melody drive the main vibration: higher notes feel higher and crisper
• A tap on every beat, drum hit, new note and syllable
• A deep rumble for the bass, even bass a phone speaker can't play
• A Voice / Bass slider to choose what you feel most
• Pause, seek or replay and the vibration follows instantly

WORKS YOUR WAY
• With the sound off, on the speaker or with headphones (Bluetooth delay is corrected automatically)
• Your own videos and music files: MP4, MOV, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF and more
• A built-in sample with music and game sounds to try it right away

WEB
HaptiView also has a web player for sites that provide a ready-made haptic track, plus an optional desktop session over your local Wi-Fi (connect with a QR code). Developers can add haptics to a video page with a few lines of JavaScript; see the support page.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sound is analysed on your iPhone. No account, no tracking, no data collected.

Requires an iPhone with a Taptic Engine (iPhone 8 or later). Copy-protected movies from stores can't be read; your own videos and music files work. Haptics play while HaptiView is open on screen.
