name: Harvest: Succession Planting
description:
Harvest Backwards plans your garden from the harvest back to the seed.

Say what you want: 40 quarts of tomatoes by August 20, or a head of lettuce every week from May to October. The app works backwards from that date, using your last and first frost dates and each crop's days to maturity, and tells you how many plants to start, how many cells to fill and the day to sow each round.

Enter a US ZIP code and the app finds the frost dates of the nearest NOAA weather station (1991–2020 normals) and tells you how far away it is. In the UK, or anywhere else in the northern hemisphere, pick your own frost dates and switch to metric.

For a steady harvest it lays out your succession planting round by round, and skips the rounds that fall outside a crop's sowing window or too close to first frost, and says why.

What you get:
- One garden with unlimited beds and pots
- Up to 8 harvest goals at a time
- Pantry jars that fill as you sow, with the planned amount marked
- A bed timeline with free gaps and overbooking warnings
- A reminder at 8:00 on each sowing day
- Done and Slipped: a late sowing moves the later rounds for you
- A printable planting chart (PDF) with your frost dates, no watermark
- Custom crops, and JSON export and import

Harvest Backwards is free, with no ads. It works offline. There is no account, and nothing leaves your phone.

name: Heart of the Titan
description:
Remember the RPGs you could lose a whole afternoon to as a kid? A party of heroes, a bag full of loot, a piece of armor you actually earned, and a boss you spent the whole evening preparing for. Heart of the Titan is an old-school action RPG for iPhone and iPad: a big world, your party and a long road.

An entire continent, Ormohar, lies on the back of a sleeping titan. A ford warden from the river delta learns that the alchemists of the Order of the Alembic are waking the giant by drilling into him. You travel upriver along the Tepna, through the marshes of the delta, the cliff city of Zvonohrad and the frozen ridge, all the way into the heart of the mountain. Four acts (The Fords, Voice of the Bells, The Spine and Roots of the Mountains) lead to one choice: lull the titan back to sleep, or let him rise. There are two endings.

Heroes and party
• Create your hero from four peoples: Brodans, Skalans, Popelans and Mokrans, each with its own origin.
• Eight companions, each with a story, personality, quips and skill tree. You recruit them on the way; each has a personal quest.
• Five kinds of pets, each yours to own. They grow into stronger forms and learn skills. Two fight in the party; the rest you stow and call back in the inventory.
• A party of four to six places, depending on difficulty, counting you and your pets. Set each member's stance and the formation, and in a hectic fight stop time with the tactical pause and give orders.

You grow by doing
• Four disciplines: Close Combat, Marksmanship, Elemental Magic and Nature Magic. Each grows the more you use it, and your character level is the sum of your discipline levels.
• Skill trees with 64 nodes, 20 abilities, 46 spells and four advanced classes that combine two disciplines.
• Abilities are tied to weapons. Ranged skills need a bow or crossbow, melee strikes need a melee weapon, and spells can be cast with anything in hand.

Loot and gear
• Eleven kinds of weapons, from daggers to two-handed hammers, bows and crossbows, plus shields, armor, amulets, rings and spellbooks.
• Five rarity tiers, 102 magic prefixes and suffixes, 36 unique items and four sets of four pieces each.
• Merchants, enchanters, healers, a stash chest and stables with four mounts to ride; you pick your mount in the inventory.

World and bosses
• 22 hand-built areas: 4 towns, 5 dungeons and 13 open areas, from marshes and coast through mountains and glacier to the crystal caves inside the titan.
• 18 bosses, each with its own tactics and a visible warning before a dangerous attack.
• 54 quests: 20 main, 26 side and 8 personal quests for your companions.
• A world map and an area map, quest tracking that guides you to the objective, and 19 waystones you can travel between.

Difficulty and replay
• Three difficulties: Wayfarer, Hero and Legend. The upper two unlock by finishing the third act on the previous one.
• Two endings and New Game+, where you start again with your whole party, gear and gold.
• 10 save slots and autosave.

English and Czech
The game is available in English and Czech; switch the language in Settings. The story dialogue has English voice-over, in the Czech version too: more than 60 voices that vary by race, gender and age. Settings can turn it off. The voices (intro film and narrator included) were created with speech synthesis (AI), not recorded by actors. The intro film's English voice has subtitles in the game's language.

Touch controls, landscape
You tap the ground, enemies, items and people. Drag to rotate the camera, pinch to zoom; abilities and spells sit on a bar at the bottom. A short tutorial introduces the basics. The game runs in landscape and needs iOS or iPadOS 18.4 or later.

Offline, no ads
The game needs no internet connection, has no ads or in-app purchases and collects no personal data. Saved games are never sent anywhere. The music is composed live and changes with the place and the fight.

The game contains fantasy combat violence.

name: Heliotrope
description:
イベントや待ち合わせで、仲間との合流を助けるアプリです。

位置の共有先を選ぶ
フレンドや参加グループから、現在地を見せる相手を選べます。Free、Friend、Private+ で共有先を切り替え、Private・Offline では自分の位置を送信しません。共有はアプリで変更・停止できます。

地図と方向を見ながら合流
地図上の位置、方角、距離を確認できます。対応端末では双方の同意で Bluetooth による近さや UWB による距離・方角も利用します。利用できる機能と精度は端末、OS、通信環境によって変わります。

グループで集まる
招待リンクからグループに参加し、共有を許可したメンバーと位置や集合地点を確認できます。

近くの相手と名刺を交換
プロフィールや画像を載せた名刺を作り、同じ Wi-Fi に接続した端末間で暗号化して直接交換します。QR で接続情報を渡します。名刺本体は運営者のサーバーへアップロードしません。インターネット共有や Wi-Fi 接続には OS の操作が必要です。

通報とブロック
相手の詳細画面から通報・ブロックできます。ブロックした相手とはお互いにオフラインの扱いになります。ブロックの解除は設定から行えます。

無料で利用できます。広告、利用解析ツール、クラッシュ収集ツール、トラッキングは使用しません。通信費は利用者の負担です。サービス稼働維持のための集計はプライバシーポリシーをご確認ください。

利用できるのは13歳以上です。18歳未満の方は保護者の同意が必要です。位置や方角の正確性は保証されず、安全や生命に関わる判断には使用できません。

iOS は位置情報の「使用中のみ（When In Use）」を基本とし、アプリで開始した共有は、画面ロックや他のアプリの使用中も、iOS の位置情報使用中の表示（青い表示）付きで継続します。「常に許可」は求めませんが、許可されている場合も同様に継続します。アプリを開かずにバックグラウンドで起動された場合は、開くまで接続しません。iOS の通知許可は位置共有の継続には関係しません。権限は OS 設定、共有はアプリで管理できます。

プライバシー：https://heliotropeapp.com/privacy
利用規約：https://heliotropeapp.com/terms
アカウント削除：https://heliotropeapp.com/delete-account
お問い合わせ：support@quickcompass.app

name: HexaStudy
description: Explore Gann-style hexagonal geometry through 12 structured lessons, worked examples and self-checks. Adjust price or calendar parameters, inspect numbered points and angles, and save studies with notes. Test your understanding with eight explained questions. Keep progress and bookmarks on your device. Works offline with no account. Educational use only: no market quotes, trading, investment advice, or predictive promises.

name: HiddenEye: Camera & Trackers
description:
HiddenEye helps you check hotel rooms, Airbnbs, changing rooms and your car for hidden cameras and Bluetooth trackers.

WI-FI CAMERA SCAN
Connect to the room's Wi-Fi and HiddenEye lists the devices on that network, flagging the ones that look like cameras (video ports, camera makers).

TRACKER RADAR
Find nearby Bluetooth trackers like Tile, Galaxy SmartTag and Chipolo. HiddenEye warns you when the same unknown tracker keeps showing up in different places.

LENS FINDER
Use your flashlight and camera with a red filter to spot the glint of a hidden lens.

ROOM CHECKLIST
A step-by-step guide to the places cameras are usually hidden: smoke detectors, clocks, chargers, vents, mirrors and more.

HIDDENEYE PRO
• Background tracker alerts
• Unlimited Wi-Fi scans
• Car mode and trip history
• PDF sweep reports
• No ads

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All scans, locations and history stay on your iPhone. HiddenEye never sells or uploads your data.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
HiddenEye Pro is available as weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly auto-renewing subscriptions with a 3-day free trial, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

No app can prove a space is 100% free of cameras or trackers. HiddenEye is a helper, not a guarantee. If you believe you are being recorded or followed, contact local law enforcement.

Terms: https://md5to.com/hiddeneye/terms
Privacy: https://md5to.com/hiddeneye/privacy

name: Hingebloom
description:
Hingebloom is a puzzle about folding. Every bed is a black lacquer tray with a gilt grid. A chain of enamel petals lies across it, joined by small brass hinges. Each hinge can rest straight, swing one way, or swing the other. Your job is to bend the chain, hinge by hinge, until its petals cover every gold pad. When the last pad is covered the whole bed blooms.

Nothing is timed and nothing is random inside a bed. A hundred hand-balanced beds are each checked by a solver, so there is always a way through and a best possible number of bends to chase for three stars.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Tap a petal, or its numbered chip in the dock, to bend that hinge. Drag a petal to swing it into place.
- A swinging tail may not cross stones or its own petals, so the order of your bends matters.
- Undo, redo and restart are free. The lightbulb points to the next useful bend, as often as you like.

WHAT MAKES THE BEDS DIFFERENT
- Ten gardens teach one idea each: plain petals, rockeries with stones, frozen hinges, wide 45-degree bends, mirrored twin chains, and more.
- A Daily Bloom every day of the year, and a Long Garden of endless beds when the hundred are done.
- Press a Herbarium bloom with coins you earn by playing. Forty blooms, published odds, nothing to buy.

LOOK AND SOUND
Real-time 3D lacquer, gold leaf and clear-coat gloss, a living flower on the home screen, and soft plucked strings that follow your bends. Sound and haptics can be switched off in Settings.

FREE, WITH ADS
Hingebloom is free. It shows a banner on the menu and play screens and an occasional ad between beds, and you can choose to watch a rewarded video for bonus coins. An optional monthly Ad-Free subscription removes the ads; it renews automatically each month at the price shown in the app until you cancel at least 24 hours before renewal in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. The game is complete without it. Progress stays on your device.

Privacy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-hingebloom.html

name: HiveScribe: Apiary Visits
description:
Take a field book through your apiary, one hive at a time. HiveScribe keeps visit observations and the tasks you choose together, while showing which hives still need an inspection.

Create apiaries and hive labels, then choose the hives included in each visit. Record queen observations, temperament, brood and honey frame counts, notes and selected photos. Previous observations remain available while you make a new inspection. An unknown count stays unknown; an explicit zero remains zero.

Set your own next-visit tasks and handle them independently in Tasks. Completion and reopening retain their action history and inspection source. Historical visit snapshots remain readable if a current hive is removed, without creating new tasks for that deleted hive.

Preview a saved visit, including selected photos, as a PDF field report and share the PDF with its CSV observations through the iPhone share sheet.

HiveScribe records your observations. It does not diagnose bee conditions, recommend treatments or predict colony outcomes.

Works offline without an app account. Records and selected photos stay in local app storage. No advertising or tracking is included. Exported copies are shared only when you choose a destination.

name: Hnaya Source
description:
Hnaya Source محرك بحث لعروض تجار الجملة. صوّر أي منتج أو اكتب اسمه، ونريك تجار الجملة الذين يعرضونه، بالصور والأسعار.

البحث بالصورة
صوّر المنتج أو اختر صورة من هاتفك، ونجد لك نفس المنتج والمنتجات المشابهة عند تجار الجملة.

البحث بالكلمات
اكتب اسم المنتج بالعربية أو بالفرنسية.

قارن الأسعار
رتّب العروض حسب الأقرب أو الأرخص أو الأحدث، واختر الألوان، واعرض العروض التي فيها سعر فقط.

وش حطّو اليوم؟
كل ما وصل اليوم عند تجار الجملة، في مكان واحد.

منتجات جديدة ورائجة
ما يظهر لأول مرة، وما يعرضه أكبر عدد من التجار هذا الأسبوع أو هذا الشهر.

الفئات
إلكترونيات، المنزل والمطبخ، الجمال، الملابس، الأحذية، الساعات وغيرها، مع فلاتر حسب السعر واللون والماركة.

تفاصيل كل عرض
كل الصور، الأسعار حسب الكمية، وحاسبة تريك هامش ربحك.

المحفوظات
احفظ العروض التي تهمك وأضف ملاحظاتك عليها.

التواصل مع البائع
عبر واتساب أو تيليجرام، حسب حسابك.

العروض منشورة علنًا من طرف تجار الجملة في قنواتهم على تيليجرام. يمكن لأي تاجر طلب حذف عروضه عبر support@hnaya.me.

name: HOLA Professional
description:
HOLA Professional brings clients, salons and the HOLA team together in one app.

FOR CLIENTS
• Discover salons near you and see their services, prices, team and reviews
• Book an appointment in a few taps and get it confirmed by the salon
• Reminders the day before and two hours before your visit
• Get directions, call or message the salon
• Rate your visit and help others choose
• Salon offers and vouchers in one place

FOR SALON OWNERS AND TEAMS
• Today at a glance: bookings, expected takings and requests to answer
• Calendar for every team member, with walk-ins
• Accept or decline bookings, set your services, prices and opening hours
• Manage your team and who takes bookings
• Order HOLA professional products at trade prices, cash on delivery or on credit
• Track your credit, statement and payments
• Returns and replacements with photos, followed step by step
• HOLA Academy training sessions for your team
• Message your clients and the HOLA team

FOR THE HOLA TEAM
• Sales officers keep salons supplied and supported
• Riders see assigned deliveries, record proof of delivery and cash collected

Available in English and Urdu, with light and dark themes. Sign in with Face ID or Touch ID.

Clients and salon owners can create an account in the app. HOLA sales officers and riders sign in with the account HOLA gives them.

Questions? Email info@metaxperts.net.

name: HoloTill: TCG Card Till
description:
HoloTill is the till for trading card vendors. Price your raw singles, print QR labels, scan to sell, and see your real profit before the customer walks away.

SELL FAST
• Scan your QR price labels with the camera and every card lands in the cart
• Give a discount and see your profit before you say yes
• Record cash, card, Venmo, PayPal, Zelle or other

BUY SMART
• Look up any card by name and see every printing with its market price
• Pick the exact version and finish, then offer cash or trade credit at your % of market
• See what the stack resells for before you pay

PRINT LABELS
• Print QR price labels over Bluetooth on Niimbot B1, B21, D11, D110 and more
• Or print labels without prices, so your stickers never go stale

STAY ON MARKET
• Price warnings flag cards that moved away from your price
• You set the line: for example 3% on big cards, 10% on the rest
• Update everything to market in one tap

KNOW YOUR NUMBERS
• Profit, sales and stock value, with a separate total for each game
• Export your inventory and sales to CSV

Works with Pokémon TCG and Magic: The Gathering singles. Your vault works offline at the table. Sign in with just your email to sync across phones.

HoloTill is free while in beta.

HoloTill is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by The Pokémon Company, Nintendo, Wizards of the Coast or Hasbro. Card names and images belong to their owners.

name: HosRocket Housekeeping
description:
HosRocket Housekeeping is the task board for room attendants at hotels that use HosRocket.

• Each floor's rooms and their housekeeping tasks: check-out or stayover, dirty, cleaning or rejected, with the guest's stay dates and the room's notes.
• Start a room and mark it complete with one tap. Your supervisor sees it at once.
• Notifications when the day's rooms are ready to clean, when a room is added later in the day, and when a supervisor rejects a room, with what to fix.
• The board updates by itself as rooms change.
• Filters and sort by status, occupancy and priority.
• English, Japanese, Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, Malay and Indonesian; light and dark themes; iOS's larger text sizes.

An account is needed: your hotel's administrator creates it in HosRocket.

name: Housing Hub Contractors
description:
Housing Hub Contractors is the app for trades and contractors who work with Canadian housing co-operatives on Housing Hub.

When a co-op invites you to quote, awards you a job, or assigns you work, it lands in the app, and your phone tells you.

QUOTE REQUESTS AND TENDERS
See the scope, the location, the deadline and the co-op's budget when they share it. Send your quote from your phone. On capital tenders your bid is sealed: nobody, not the co-op and not other bidders, sees your price until bidding closes.

JOBS
Accept or decline an award. Mark the work complete with notes for the office. Send your invoice as a PDF or a photo, and see when it is approved and recorded as paid.

QUESTIONS
Ask the co-op a question on a tender and get the answer in the app. Published answers go to every bidder, so everyone prices the same information.

YOUR COMPANY
Keep your contact details current. Upload your liability insurance and WSIB certificates so co-ops see them when they compare quotes. See your averages for response time, quality, pricing fairness and communication, and your work history.

HOW YOU GET IN
There is no sign-up. A co-op office that lists your company invites you by email, and you sign in with a code sent to that email. Quoting and bidding are free.

Housing Hub is the property management platform for Canadian housing co-ops: member records, maintenance, documents, board tools, housing charges and a shared contractor network.

name: HumanPower People
description:
HumanPower People is the phone app for HumanPower's recruitment team and the companies we hire for.

Sign in with the staff account your HumanPower administrator created for you, and keep hiring moving wherever you are:

• See today's new applicants, interviews and replies at a glance
• Open candidates, read their applications and move them through the hiring stages
• Follow each job ad's pipeline, as a list, a board or the Solar view
• Keep classes, datasheets and messages with candidates up to date
• Get a notification when something needs you, and unlock the app with Face ID

The app is for HumanPower staff only. It has no sign-up: accounts are created by an administrator.

name: Hushloom: Sleep Sound Mixer
description:
Hushloom is a sleep sound mixer built like a loom: every sound is a thread, and you decide how much of each goes into the night.

Twelve threads, all generated live on your device (no recordings, no downloads, no internet needed): steady rain, brown noise, pink noise, a box fan, ocean swell, night wind, summer crickets, a crackling hearth, a bubbling brook, far thunder, a soft heartbeat and a gentle shush. Slide any of them up from silence and blend as many as you like. Each has its own level.

A SLEEP TIMER THAT FADES, NOT CUTS
Pick a length from 15 minutes to 8 hours, or choose a bedtime routine. Routines shape the whole night: they ease the sound in, take the brightness off the tone as time passes and fade out at the end, so the room never goes abruptly quiet. A power nap routine wakes you clear after 20 minutes.

CRADLE MODE FOR LITTLE ONES
One tap opens a calm, dim screen with four large buttons (heartbeat, soft shush, rain, box fan). Volume is capped, there are no ads, and you press and hold to leave, so small hands cannot wander off.

KEEP YOUR BLENDS
Save a mix with a name and bring it back with one tap. A few starter mixes are included.

PLAYS ON WHEN THE SCREEN GOES DARK
Hushloom keeps playing with the phone locked and answers the lock screen play and pause buttons.

FREE, WITH CHOICE ABOUT ADS
Hushloom is free and shows ads in the menu and after a listening session. You can earn 20 minutes of ad-free time by watching a short video, or subscribe monthly to remove ads. The subscription renews each month until you cancel it in your Apple account settings; Restore is in the More tab. Cradle mode never shows ads.

Hushloom is a relaxation aid, not a medical device. Keep the volume low and the phone at a distance from the bed.

Privacy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-hushloom.html
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Hyphae: The Genre Web
description:
Hyphae is a living map of music. About 6,000 genres sit on one map, linked by the threads between them: where a sound came from, what it grew into, and what it shares roots with. Tap any dot to hear it.

HEAR THE REAL THING
Thousands of genres play real records chosen to fit that genre at the track level, not just the artist. When a pick is less certain, Hyphae says so.

DRIFT
Tap Drift and Hyphae walks the map for you, thread by thread, playing as it goes. Lock your phone and it keeps going, with a Live Activity on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island, plus play, pause and skip.

FIVE WAYS TO SEE IT
Kin groups genres by family. Sky, Land, Tunnel and Axes turn the same web into other views, including a landscape whose height shows how alive each sound is today.

WHOLE SONGS WITH APPLE MUSIC
Connect Apple Music to hear full tracks instead of previews.

MADE FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND APPLE TV
- Lock screen and Control Center controls
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Start Drift in Hyphae", "Play the sound of the day in Hyphae"
- Sound of the day widget for the home screen and lock screen
- On Apple TV, a full-screen Drift visualizer you steer with the Siri Remote

YOURS TO KEEP
Save favorite sounds, build crates, see your own map rings, and look back through your listening history.

In 13 languages. Free, no account, no ads.

name: IANT – Lớp học
description:
IANT – Lớp học giúp thầy cô và học sinh làm việc với bài tập ngay trên điện thoại.

DÀNH CHO THẦY CÔ
• Giao một bài cho nhiều lớp, đặt hạn nộp riêng từng lớp
• Nhìn cả lớp: ai đã nộp, ai chưa, ai hay nộp trễ
• Nhắc những bạn chưa nộp chỉ bằng một chạm
• Chấm liên tục từng bài, chọn điểm và nhận xét nhanh
• Thử ngay với lớp mẫu có sẵn học sinh và bài nộp

DÀNH CHO HỌC SINH
• Vào lớp bằng mã 6 ký tự thầy cô gửi
• Quay video, chụp ảnh hoặc viết bài để nộp
• Xem điểm và nhận xét của thầy cô

ĐẤU TỪ VỰNG
• Game 60 giây với 6 chủ đề quen thuộc và chế độ trộn
• Trả lời liền mạch để nhân điểm
• Bảng xếp hạng lớp và toàn app mỗi tuần

MINI APP CẬP NHẬT LIÊN TỤC
Các công cụ trong IANT là mini app do IANT phát triển, tự cập nhật khi mở. Danh mục: https://app.iant.vn/mini-app

RIÊNG TƯ VÀ AN TOÀN
• Dùng thử không cần tài khoản; giữ dữ liệu bằng Đăng nhập với Apple hoặc tên đăng nhập + mật khẩu, không cần email hay số điện thoại
• Quên mật khẩu: dùng mã khôi phục, hoặc nhờ thầy cô của lớp cấp mã đặt lại
• Không quảng cáo, không bán dữ liệu, không theo dõi
• Lọc từ ngữ tục tĩu, báo cáo nội dung, chặn người dùng
• Xoá tài khoản ngay trong app

name: IceKit Log
description:
IceKit Log is an offline field book for ice climbers. Keep a history of your equipment, build a packing checklist for your next trip, and record what you climbed and what the ice was like.

Organize ice tools, crampons, ice screws, and other equipment in your gear locker. Record inspection findings, set a date for the next check, and track work such as cleaning, sharpening, part replacement, and repairs. The Home screen shows which items need another look.

Create a trip and add equipment from your locker to its Trip Kit. Review the inspection status of each item as you pack, then mark it as packed. Reuse the equipment list on another trip with Duplicate Kit.

After a climb, record the route, ice conditions, and equipment you actually used. Add the grade, temperature, elevation, and field notes if you have them. The climb log keeps a copy of the equipment details and recorded inspections for that outing.

Use IceKit Log offline with metric or imperial units. Your field book is stored on your device.

name: Incenify
description:
Meet Ellis, your Incenify assistant. Take part in your program through a conversation.

Send an invoice to prepare a sales claim. Ellis reads the details and asks you to check them before you authorize submission.

Explore offers and rewards available to your account. Review the points and delivery details before redeeming, and return to your saved tasks and receipts when you need them.

Personalized suggestions can help you find relevant opportunities based on your saved rewards, past redemptions, claimed offers and interests you confirm. You can turn suggestions off in Account.

Incenify is free to download and use with an existing Incenify participant account. No credit card or bank details are needed to use the app or Ellis. Offers and rewards depend on your program. Ellis uses AI and can make mistakes; check important details before confirming.

name: Inksound: Lecture Notes & PDF
description:
Inksound is a note-taking app built for the pen. Write and draw with pressure-sensitive ink, highlight, erase, and move things around with the lasso. Type in English or Hebrew right on the page.

Record a lecture or meeting while you write. When you play it back, your notes appear in the order you wrote them, and tapping any word jumps the audio to that moment.

Organize everything into subjects and dividers, find notes by title or typed text, and export any note as a PDF. Send a note to a friend as a single file, with its pictures and recordings included.

Coming from another app? Import your .note files and keep working on them.

- Pen with pressure, highlighter, partial and whole-stroke eraser
- Draw and hold to turn a sketch into a perfect line, circle or rectangle
- Lined, grid, dotted and Cornell paper in six colors
- Audio recording synced to your handwriting
- Subjects, dividers, search and sorting
- PDF export and note sharing
- Full Hebrew and English interface
- iPad and iPhone

Inksound Pro unlocks unlimited notes and every feature. Choose monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://inksoundapp.wordpress.com/privacy/

name: InspectClan
description:
InspectClan is the daily vehicle inspection report (DVIR) app for trucking and fleet companies. Drivers finish a pre-trip or post-trip inspection in about two minutes; the office sees it the moment it syncs.

Built for FMCSA §396.11 and §396.13: every inspection is guided, signed, timestamped and kept for the 3 months the regulation asks.

FOR DRIVERS
• Guided checklists — one check at a time, big Pass / Fail / N/A buttons that work with gloves on.
• Works offline — no signal at the yard? Inspections save on the phone and send themselves later.
• Defects with proof — a failed check takes a note, photos or a short video, so the shop sees what you saw.
• Sign it — done. Your signature closes the report.
• Hands-free when needed — answer checks by voice ("pass", "fail", "next") and dictate defect notes.
• Scan the VIN — point the camera at the VIN plate or door-jamb barcode instead of typing 17 characters.
• See last trip's open defects before you roll, and acknowledge them.

FOR OWNERS AND FLEET MANAGERS
• Repair certification on the phone — mark repairs and sign the §396.11 certification.
• An inbox for new defects, overdue weekly and monthly checks, expiring documents and repair sign-offs.
• The web console does the rest: the fleet status board, every inspection with its photos and signature, defects to repair certification, vehicles and schedules, people and assignments, documents with expiry alerts, and reports for the last 90 days.

A CHECKLIST THAT GROWS WITH YOUR FLEET
Start with the 11 FMCSA checks every DVIR needs, then add your own — liftgate, reefer temperature, load straps, DEF level — per vehicle type, with the evidence each one requires. Drivers can propose new checks from the inspection itself, and roadside findings turn into checks so the same write-up never happens twice.

GETTING STARTED
InspectClan is a service for companies. The owner creates the company on the web console at inspectclan.com and invites fleet managers and drivers. Drivers install this app and join with their invite code. Already invited? Open the app and tap "I have an invite".

Questions: support@inspectclan.com
Terms: https://inspectclan.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://inspectclan.com/privacy.html

name: InspectSync
description:
InspectSync is the field app for fire-protection technicians and inspectors whose companies use the InspectSync platform.

YOUR DAY IN ONE PLACE
See your schedule as a list or on a map, get directions to the job, and open the files you need from the library.

INSPECTIONS AND SERVICE JOBS
Work through systems, forms and devices, record deficiencies with photos, track your time, and collect the customer's signature on site.

FIRE EXTINGUISHER ROUNDS
Scan barcodes with the camera or a scanner and move through each unit quickly.

QUOTES
Build quotes with items and pricing while you are on site.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
Download your jobs ahead of time and keep working with no connection. Your changes are sent when you are back online.

STAY CONNECTED
Message your team, manage tasks and see notifications.

An InspectSync company account is required. Accounts are created by your employer.

name: Intercambio: Amigo Secreto
description:
¿Te toca organizar el intercambio de la oficina, la familia o los amigos? Con Intercambio lo resuelves en minutos y sin papelitos.

CREA TU GRUPO
Ponle nombre, fecha del intercambio, presupuesto y fecha límite para unirse.

INVITA POR WHATSAPP
Comparte el link o el código y cada quien se une desde su celular. No hace falta crear cuenta: basta con tu nombre (o entra con Apple si prefieres).

LISTAS DE DESEOS
Cada participante arma su lista con enlaces, notas (talla, color…) y rango de precio, para que su amigo secreto acierte con el regalo.

SORTEO JUSTO Y SECRETO
El sorteo se hace en el servidor: nadie se toca a sí mismo y es completamente aleatorio. Lo más importante: nadie, ni quien organiza, puede ver quién le tocó a quién.

DESCUBRE A TU AMIGO SECRETO
Toca el regalo para revelar a quién le regalas y ve su lista de deseos.

RECORDATORIOS
Te avisamos cuando se haga el sorteo y cuando se acerque el día del intercambio.

GRUPO PREMIUM (pago único por grupo, lo disfruta todo el grupo)
• Hasta 50 participantes (gratis: hasta 10)
• Exclusiones: "X no le puede tocar a Y" (ideal para parejas)
• Agrega regalos desde Mercado Libre y Amazon
• Temas navideños para el grupo
• Varias rondas de sorteo
• Revelación final: el día del intercambio, quién le regaló a quién

Sin anuncios. Hecha en México para los intercambios de diciembre, las posadas y cualquier ocasión para regalar.

name: JadeonVera
description:
Every inspection program has a pace, a queue and a distribution of work.

JadeonVera turns seven inspection measures into individual numerical checks.

THE PACE OF AN INSPECTION

Start with Inspection Efficiency Ratio to examine how inspection effort relates to output.

Use Mean Time to Inspect (MTTI) to look at the time spent per inspection.

Compare timing scenarios without assuming that faster always means better.

THE WORK WAITING IN LINE

Explore Inspection Backlog Management to assess unfinished inspection work.

Review Inspection Completion Rate to examine how much planned work is completed.

Keep the size of a backlog distinct from the rate at which checks finish.

THE RESULT OF A FIRST CHECK

Examine First-Pass Inspection Success Rate for items accepted on the initial review.

Use Deficiency Detection Efficiency to study the detection figures supplied.

Read success and detection measures as different questions about inspection outcomes.

THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE CHECKS

Turn to Inspector Workload Distribution to compare how duties are allocated.

Review differences in assigned work without treating them as individual performance grades.

Choose the calculation that matches the question in front of you.

Enter the requested figures and read the result in its stated units.

Change a value to explore a second inspection scenario.

Move between pace, completion, findings and workload for a broader view.

Use the outputs for planning conversations and routine technical review.

Calculations depend on the information provided, not independent site verification.

JadeonVera makes inspection metrics easier to explore one measure at a time.

name: Jahtikoe: Finnish Hunter Exam
description:
Jahtikoe is an unofficial practice app for the Finnish hunter's exam (metsästäjätutkinto), which you can take in English from 2026.

MOCK EXAMS WITH THE REAL STRUCTURE
• 15 species identification questions and 45 theory questions
• 15 minutes for species, 90 minutes for the whole exam
• Pass with 8 wrong answers or fewer; unanswered counts as wrong, just like the real exam
• Results by topic and an explanation for every wrong answer

PRACTISE BY TOPIC
330 practice questions and 63 species photos. Law questions are based on the current Hunting Act and Decree, and every question shows its source. All eight exam topics: hunting law, species knowledge, game ecology and management, ethical and sustainable hunting, firearms and ammunition, hunting safety, hunting methods and traps, and handling the game.

REVIEW SMARTER
• Spaced repetition puts weak and due questions first
• Mistakes stay on a list until you answer them right twice in a row
• A readiness estimate shows how many errors you would make on a 60-question exam today

SPECIES CARDS
Identification features of game mammals and birds, and the look-alikes people mix up.

One-time purchase unlocks everything; no subscription. The app collects no personal data and your progress stays on your phone.

Jahtikoe is an unofficial practice app and is not affiliated with the Finnish Wildlife Agency (Suomen riistakeskus). The questions were written for practice from the exam syllabus and are not official exam questions. The official textbook is Metsästäjän opas.

Species photos: Wikimedia Commons, free licences (authors listed in the app).

name: Jobsite Calc: Construction
seller_name: ITWORKED YAZILIM IC VE DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Jobsite Calc is a fast, accurate construction calculator for contractors, carpenters and DIYers. Add feet and inches with fractions, work out concrete in yards and bags, get square footage and roof pitch, and send a materials estimate as a PDF. Works offline on the job site. No ads and no account.

FREE: FEET, INCHES AND FRACTIONS
• Big keypad with ft, in and fraction keys: type 5 ft 3 in 1/2 and add, subtract, multiply or divide
• Answers rounded to the nearest 1/16" (or 1/8", 1/32"), and the app tells you when it rounded
• Every answer also in decimal feet, inches, metres and millimetres
• Length × length gives square feet; × a third length gives cubic yards
• % key for waste and markup: add 10% to any answer
• History of your last 5 answers; tap one to use it again

FREE: CONCRETE SLAB CALCULATOR
• Cubic yards, cubic feet and cubic metres for any slab
• 80 lb, 60 lb and 40 lb bags (and 25 kg), always rounded up
• Waste allowance added before bags are counted
• Ready-mix order rounded up to the next quarter yard

JOBSITE CALC PRO
• Concrete footings, round columns (sonotubes) and steps with a top landing
• Area and square footage: rectangle, triangle, circle and room walls minus doors and windows, in sq ft, sq yd and m²
• Paint gallons, 4×8 drywall sheets and flooring or tile boxes, with waste
• Slope and roof pitch from rise and run, pitch (x/12), angle or grade %, with rafter length
• Materials list: add any result or your own items
• Saved projects: one list per job
• PDF estimates to send to your client or supplier, or share the list as text
• Full history of your last 1,000 answers

Pro is available yearly (with a 7-day free trial), monthly, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in your account settings. Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ · Privacy: https://itworkedsystems.com/trade-calc/privacy

BUILT FOR THE SITE
• Imperial and metric, switch with one tap
• Light and dark mode, large text friendly
• No sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Your measurements, lists and projects stay on your phone.

Results are estimates: check your measurements and your supplier's figures before you cut, pour or order.
