name: KanaStroke
description:
KanaStroke är en offlineapp för dig som har börjat lära dig japanska och vill öva på att skriva hiragana och katakana, inte bara känna igen tecknen.

Öppna appen och börja med dagens nästa tecken. Följ den ljusa förlagan i skrivrutan och börja varje streck vid den numrerade röda punkten. När du kontrollerar din övning får du återkoppling på antalet streck, deras startpunkter och hur väl du har följt teckenformen. Appen visar vad du behöver öva på igen. När övningen blir godkänd får tecknet en stämpel och läggs till för repetition.

Funktioner:
• 92 inbyggda tecken: 46 hiragana och 46 katakana, ordnade efter de tio traditionella raderna i respektive teckenuppsättning.
• Hjälp med streckordningen: numrerade startpunkter för varje streck. Stäng av hjälpen när du vill öva själv.
• Kontroll av skrivövningar: jämför streckens startpunkter och hur väl de följer förlagan, med konkreta förklaringar till vad du kan förbättra.
• Repetition med intervall: inlärda tecken återkommer enligt ett schema. Flervalsfrågor ger direkt återkoppling och felaktiga svar kommer tillbaka i kön.
• Översikt över dina framsteg: dagar i följd, dagens övningar, andel rätt, ett aktivitetsdiagram för de senaste 14 dagarna och framsteg per teckenrad.
• Teckentabell: bläddra bland hiragana och katakana med startpunkter för strecken, exempelord och korta förklaringar av tecknens ursprung.
• Gränssnitt på förenklad kinesiska och engelska, med stöd för ljust läge, mörkt läge och större text. Gränssnittet finns inte på svenska.

Appen fungerar helt offline och gör inga nätverksanrop. Den kräver inget konto och innehåller ingen reklam. Den begär inte åtkomst till kamera, mikrofon, plats eller notiser. Inga data samlas in. Dina övningsresultat sparas lokalt på enheten och tas bort när du raderar appen.

Observera: KanaStroke är ett övningsverktyg. Kontrollen jämför streckens startpunkter och hur väl de ritade punkterna ligger på förlagan. Den bedömer inte hela rörelsebanan för varje streck och ersätter inte en lärare, en kurs eller en lärobok. Appen innehåller inget ljud eller uttal. Förlagorna visas med systemets japanska typsnitt och kan skilja sig från handskrivna tecken. Pappersstrukturer och illustrationer i tomma vyer är statiska, AI-genererade dekorationer. De innehåller ingen text och är varken fotografier eller användarnas egna verk.

name: Kanji Bento – Daily Kanji
description:
Learn Japanese kanji and vocabulary five a day, packed like a bento.

Every day Kanji Bento gives you five new characters and the reviews you need, scheduled right before you'd forget them. Ten minutes a day adds up to all 2,136 jōyō kanji, the ones Japanese adults read every day.

A BENTO OF FIVE, EVERY DAY
Open the app and today's bento is ready: five new kanji (or kana) with their meanings, on and kun readings, two common words and a real example sentence with furigana. Tap to hear everything spoken in Japanese.

SENTENCES CHECKED BY A NATIVE SPEAKER
Example sentences are short, natural and chosen to use only kanji you've already met where possible. A native Japanese speaker checks them, so you learn Japanese the way people actually say it.

WRITE IT WITH YOUR FINGER
Watch the stroke order animation, trace it, then write from memory. Kanji Bento checks each stroke's order, direction and count on your device and tells you exactly what to fix.

REVIEWS THAT ADAPT TO YOU
Reviews use FSRS, a modern open spaced-repetition algorithm. Grade Again, Hard, Good or Easy and the schedule learns how your memory works. Aim for about 90% recall without cramming.

WIDGETS THAT TEACH
Add Kanji of the Hour to your Home Screen or a kanji to your Lock Screen and learn a little every time you look at your phone. The Reviews widget shows what's waiting and your streak.

START WHERE YOU ARE
A 10-question placement quiz skips what you already know. Begin with hiragana and katakana, or go straight to kanji. Browse the Library by school grade or JLPT level (N5 to N1), and search in English, kana or romaji.

FREE
• Hiragana and katakana
• The first 100 kanji with words, sentences and handwriting
• The daily bento, reviews, streak and widgets

KANJI BENTO PRO
• All 2,136 jōyō kanji and their common words
• Up to 20 new items a day
• Handwriting practice for every kanji
• Custom study lists
• Full stats: retention, JLPT progress and 3 months of history
• iCloud sync across your devices

Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (yearly starts with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in Settings.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything you study stays on your device.

Kanji data: KANJIDIC2 and JMdict (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0), stroke order: KanjiVG (CC BY-SA 3.0), sentences: Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://nekosora1110.github.io/kanji-bento/privacy.html

name: Kanji Dictionary & Trainer
description:
Master Japanese characters and vocabulary with Kanji Dictionary — a comprehensive offline reference and interactive trainer designed for learners of all levels, from JLPT N5 beginners to advanced N1 readers.

Whether you are looking up an unfamiliar character by drawing it on your screen, exploring readings and radicals, or preparing for the JLPT exam, Kanji Dictionary gives you fast, accurate, and distraction-free tools right in your pocket.

COMPREHENSIVE OFFLINE DATABASE
- 3,393 Kanji characters — covering all 2,136 Joyo Kanji (常用漢字), Jinmeiyo, and advanced literary characters.
- 12,847 compound words & expressions — real-world Japanese vocabulary with readings and accurate meanings.
- Detailed readings — Onyomi (katakana) and Kunyomi (hiragana with okurigana boundaries) with clear meanings for every reading, plus an option to view historical/obsolete readings.
- 207 Radicals — browse and filter characters by root radical and stroke count.

SMART SEARCH & HANDWRITING RECOGNITION
- Draw to search — don't know how to read a kanji? Draw it with your finger using built-in handwriting recognition to find it instantly.
- Multi-way search — search by kanji character, kana reading, romaji, or English/Russian meaning.
- Powerful filters — filter by JLPT level (N5, N4, N3, N2, N1), Japanese school grade (Elementary Grades 1–6 & Junior High), radical, stroke count, Favorites, or unlearned status.
- Flexible sorting — sort by frequency of use, stroke count, or JLPT level in list or grid view.

10 INTERACTIVE TRAINING MODES
Practice both Kanji and Vocabulary with customizable session sizes (10, 20, or 50 cards) and targeted filters (by JLPT level, Unlearned, or Favorites):

Kanji Training:
1. Kanji Flashcards — flip two-sided cards to test your memory at your own pace.
2. Kanji → Reading — choose the correct reading from 4 options.
3. Reading → Kanji — match the reading to the right character.
4. Kanji → Meaning — test your knowledge of kanji meanings.
5. Meaning → Kanji — find the character that matches the meaning.

Vocabulary Training:
6. Word Flashcards — review Japanese words, readings, and translations.
7. Word → Reading — master compound word readings (jukugo).
8. Reading → Word — select the correct kanji spelling for a reading.
9. Word → Meaning — build a strong vocabulary for reading and exams.
10. Meaning → Word — recall the exact Japanese word from its translation.

SMART PROGRESS TRACKING & STATISTICS
- Automatic mastery — set your target winning streak (2 to 5 correct answers in a row) to automatically mark kanji and words as Learned, or manage your progress manually.
- Detailed statistics — track your overall accuracy, mastered Joyo kanji, and visual progress bars across JLPT N5–N1 levels and school grades.

CUSTOMIZABLE & COMFORTABLE UI
- 3 authentic Japanese fonts — switch between Kyokasho (textbook style), Mincho (serif), and Gothic (sans-serif) to get used to reading kanji in any print or digital format.
- Dark & Light themes — easy on the eyes day and night.
- Bilingual interface — full support for English and Russian, with instant switching in Settings.
- 100% Offline — all dictionary data and quizzes work without an internet connection.

Start learning Japanese Kanji systematically and effectively today!

name: kasten - Sampler
description:
kasten is a sampler and step sequencer for iPhone, built around a simple idea: less, but better.

Twelve glass pads, four sound groups and one turquoise light. Everything you need to make a beat is on one screen, and nothing else is.

PLAY
• 48 built-in sounds: drums, bass and chords, ready to play
• Pads respond the moment you touch them
• Haptics that follow each sound: a kick hits short and hard, a bass note rumbles until it fades

RECORD
• Hold a pad and sample anything with the microphone: a clap, your voice, a table
• Import your own sounds from Files (WAV, AIFF, MP3, M4A) onto any pad
• Silence is trimmed and the level set automatically. Fine-tune start and end on the waveform

SEQUENCE
• 16-step sequencer with 8 patterns of up to 4 bars
• Record live: what you play snaps to the beat
• Tempo, tap tempo and swing

SHAPE
• Pitch, volume, reverse and play-while-held for every pad
• Four effects to hold while you play: Filter, Echo, Crush and Stutter

KEEP
• Save as many tracks as you like
• Light and dark mode
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Kasten works completely offline

KASTEN PRO
One payment, no subscription:
• Export your patterns as WAV files for your DAW, or share them with AirDrop and Messages
• Choose your accent color: coral, yellow, green, blue, violet or graphite

Playing, recording, sequencing and saving stay free.

name: KayCade
description:
The best way to play your GBC and GBA games on iPhone and iPad.

KayCade was built from scratch for one job: making your old games feel right on the phone in your pocket. They run at full speed with the sound they're supposed to have, and the buttons click under your thumbs like the real thing.

Free. No ads, no account, nothing to sign up for.

BUTTONS THAT FEEL REAL
A and B have a two-stage click. The d-pad rocks. Every press has its own haptic, and you decide how strong it is. Move the controls, resize them or fade them out. Prefer a real controller? Pair one and remap whatever you like. Keyboards work too.

SAVE WHEREVER YOU WANT
Ten save state slots for every game, each with a picture so you know which is which. In-game saves work the way they did on the cartridge, and a copy lands in the Files app. Leave mid-boss fight and pick up right where you stopped.

SKIP THE GRIND
Fast-forward at 2x, 4x, 8x or as fast as your phone can go. Hold it or toggle it.

MAKE IT LOOK RIGHT
Color correction, an LCD grid, sharp or smooth scaling and classic palettes. Play in portrait or landscape. On iPhone, the Rotate button works even with rotation lock on, and wide-screen games open sideways with L and R up top.

YOUR GAMES STAY YOURS
KayCade collects nothing. No tracking, no analytics. Your games and saves stay on your device.

KayCade comes with no games. Add your own .gb, .gbc, .gba or .zip files from the Files app or iCloud Drive. Only add games you own and are legally allowed to use.

KayCade isn't affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any console maker or game publisher. All trademarks belong to their owners.

Gameplay shown: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe by Tangram Games (CC BY 4.0) and Butano Fighter by GValiente (art by Pixel-boy, CC0).

name: Keeplight-Photo & Video Editor
description:
Keeplight makes photos and short videos feel like film. Pick a look, fine-tune the light, then save it as your own preset to reuse in one tap.

Features
• Cinematic and film looks you can compare with the original
• Color and texture controls for light, tone and grain
• My Presets: save a look and your adjustments to reuse
• Templates and multi-page collages with editable text, stickers and layers
• Short videos with captions, voice-over and music
• Built-in camera that goes straight into editing

Private by design
Your photos and videos are processed on your device. No account needed.

Free to use with ads, or watch a video to unlock a Pro look once. Buy the yearly or lifetime unlock to get every Pro look and remove ads.

The yearly plan renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vRXKnauQol8SsAjpQNnhOq0lQfkZsaoQc1Pu2oulpdeOsiCBM4EcemEu8QYX9CZis4eW55gbFoKvpw2/pub

name: Kinoptra
description:
Kinoptra is an offline physics studio for students who want more than textbook diagrams. Open any of 140+ interactive modules spanning mechanics, waves, electromagnetism, optics, special relativity, quantum mechanics, and hydrogen orbital visualization.

Each lab pairs a live animation with adjustable parameters, a focused formula readout, and a concise insight panel so you can build intuition by experiment—not by memorization alone. Pin favorites to your Workbench, track completion on Learning Pathways, and keep personal notes that stay on your device.

FEATURES
• 140+ simulation modules across seven domains
• Real-time animations with sliders for mass, angle, field strength, quantum numbers, and more
• Orbital Atelier for hydrogen probability clouds and selection rules
• Explore library with domain filters and formula search
• Studio workbench for pinned and recent labs
• Pathways progress with local completion tracking
• English and Swedish interface (fully offline)
• Local persistence for favorites, notes, and parameter presets

WHO IT IS FOR
University physics students, olympiad / contest trainees, and curious learners who want deeper, visual explanations with hands-on controls.

Kinoptra does not require an account or network connection for core learning. All simulations and progress remain on your iPhone.

name: Kivorina Wonder Hops
description:
A glasshouse above the clouds, three flasks on the shelf, and a fearless guide called Luna. Pick a brew and step inside.

LUNA'S DRAGON NEST
Swap glowing eggs to line up three or more of the same colour. Match four for a Blaze egg, form an L or T for a Nova, and connect five in a row for a rare Prism. Every fused set hatches a dragon — Emerald, Amber, Amethyst, Sky, Lagoon or Midnight. Clear every hatch goal before your moves run out to advance through an ever-growing series of levels.

LUNA'S NUMBER TRAIL
Guide Luna across glowing stepping stones by solving equations against the clock. Begin in Addition Forest with simple sums, wade through Subtraction Swamp, climb Multiplication Mountain and face mixed puzzles with brackets and division at Wisdom Peak. Fast answers build streaks that multiply your score. Guard your three hearts and reach the golden carrot to earn up to three stars.

CARROT CHASE
Sprint with Luna along three moonlit garden lanes. Swipe up or down to switch lanes, tap to jump over rocks, and dodge thorny brambles. Grab carrots to build combos, and collect bubble power-ups for a carrot magnet, a protective shield or double score. The path speeds up the further you go.

DAILY QUESTS & STAMPS
Three new quests appear every morning. Finish rounds, hit target scores, earn stars or try all three games in one day. Seal a quest and collect a stamp for your album.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
A dashboard shows total score, play time, stars and your best streak over seven, fourteen or thirty days. A detailed history log records every round you finish, sortable by date or top score.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose Relaxed for extra moves and slower lanes, Classic for the intended challenge, or Expert for tighter clocks and faster paths. Adjust the backdrop blur and tone, toggle sound, vibration and ambient firefly particles, and show or hide the how-to-play guide before each round.

TEN STAMPS TO UNLOCK
First Steps · Dragon Tamer · Hatchery · Math Wizard · Carrot King · Explorer · Stargazer · Quest Keeper · Steady Compass · Legend — each one a small milestone on the journey.

PRIVACY FIRST
Everything runs on your device. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network requests. Your settings, scores, history and stamps live inside the app and go nowhere else. Reset whenever you like from Settings, or simply delete the app to remove all data.

Designed for all ages. Kids can play safely, grown-ups can chase high scores, and Luna is always there to cheer you on.

name: Klyvora Quest
description:
Klyvora Quest is a two-game arcade pack built around speed, reflex, and a short-run loop. Every session is a single sector: enter, read the layout, clear the goal, and bank what you earned.

Crystal Vault is a grid stealth board. Swipe or tap the pad to step one tile at a time. Patrol drones lock on when you walk into their sight line, and void pools raise an alert gauge that ends the run at 100 percent. Lift every crystal shard to arm the rift gate, then stand on it to escape. Each sector reshapes the grid, so a safe path cannot be memorised, it has to be read.

Skyline Dash is a three-lane ride played in bursts. Swipe up or down to switch lane. Hold the screen to burn stored energy for a speed boost. Energy orbs refill the cell and add score. One clip from a rotor ends the run, unless an equipped relic absorbs the hit. Clear the gate before the timer drains and the sector banks.

Both games feed the same progression. Shards earned in a run upgrade relics at the Forge, including defensive wards, extra lives, orb magnets, and time shields. The relics you equip shape the next run. A Daily Rift seeds the same layout for everyone each day, so your score is a direct comparison against yesterday's attempt.

Haptics and spatial audio are built in and can be toggled in Settings.

name: Knock One Off
description:
Too many tabs open. A to-do list that keeps growing. You start ten things at once and finish none of them, and every time you open your list, all of it stares back at you.

Knock One Off shows you only the one thing in front of you. Your lock screen holds a single task: the one you're doing now. When it's done, a cut-paper cat pushes it off the desk and the next one slides in.

ONE TASK, RIGHT ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• Your current task sits on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island as a Live Activity
• Complete it from the lock screen, no need to open the app
• The next task slides in on its own
• Tapped done by mistake? Undo it
• iOS ends a Live Activity after up to 8 hours (it can stay on the lock screen for up to 4 more). Open the app and the card comes back

A CAT THAT CLEARS THE DESK
• Every finished task gets pushed off the desk by a cat drawn in Japanese cut-paper style
• When the list is empty, the cat roams the desk: stretching, napping, rolling over
• 12 cats and 5 scenes

YOUR LIST, IN YOUR ORDER
• Add, edit, and drag to reorder
• Repeating tasks: daily, weekly on the days you pick, monthly, or every N days. Skip once when you need to
• Optional "from when": a dated task shows up on that day; a timed task jumps to the front at that time, with a countdown on the lock screen
• No notifications unless you set them
• Look back at what you've finished

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
• No sign-up, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline
• Optional iCloud sync (off by default)

FREE VS. ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Free: every feature above, with 4 cats and 2 scenes.
Collect Them All (one-time purchase, not a subscription): all 12 cats and 5 scenes, plus any added later. Works with Family Sharing.

Requires iOS 18 or later. iPhone only.

name: Korea Audio Guide: Silgeo
description:
Explore Korea through the stories of its places.

Korea Audio Guide: Silgeo brings together original audio recordings and transcripts supplied by Korea Tourism Organization’s Odii.

• Browse places across Korea by region and search for a destination.
• Listen and read in Korean, English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. Available stories differ by place and language. Stories without recordings are provided as text.
• Explore places on Google Maps in your selected language.
• Download individual recordings for offline listening and manage saved audio on your device. Maps require an internet connection.
• Sign in with Google, or with Apple on iPhone, to save favorite places to your account. Browsing, reading, listening and downloading do not require an account.
• Start in your phone’s supported language, with English as the fallback.

Each guide shows its source and original dates. Map coordinates are supplied by the content provider and are not verified entrances or walking routes. Check the operating institution’s current visitor information before travelling.

Audio and transcripts: Korea Tourism Organization, Odii. Silgeo is independently operated.

Support: pygoda6@gmail.com
Privacy: https://silgeo.com/privacy.html

name: Kotori Akari: Night Journal
description:
In a dark room sits a little bird-shaped lamp.
As its light slowly comes on, the bird asks: "How was your day?"

Kotori Akari is a gentle companion for the few minutes before sleep: put today's feelings into words and let your heart settle.

- Choose a feeling by color
Irritated, happy, excited, relieved, refreshed, lonely, tired, unsettled, cozy, or okay. Pick tonight's mood from ten soft lights.

- Gentle questions from the bird
Each feeling has five questions, and they change from day to day, so you look back on your day from a new angle each night. Keyboard dictation works too.

- Tonight's words
When you finish writing, the bird lights up a few words just for tonight. They stay with that day in your calendar.

- Kept in a calendar
What you write glows on the calendar in that day's color. Tap a date to read your words and feelings again.

- Breathe with the light
In for 4 seconds, out for 6. Follow the bird's light as it swells and fades. Choose 1, 3, or 5 minutes.

- Soft marimba music
A slow marimba piece plays in the background and fades away after good night.

- Your words stay on your phone
No account needed. Everything you write is stored only on this device and is never sent anywhere.

This app is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose or treat any condition.

name: Kozmik: Moon Calendar
description:
Kozmik is a calm, beautifully simple life calendar that reads the Moon's phase and sign for you every day. Open it in the morning and see at a glance what today is good for.

A haircut, a skincare night, a big clean, a romantic evening or a shopping trip… Kozmik filters traditional lunar calendar wisdom through your interests and tells you why each suggestion fits.

CALENDAR
• Best of the Day: every day shows the coloured icon of what it suits best
• Best Day: pick an activity and watch the month's best days light up
• Add it to your calendar or set a reminder at the time you choose; cancel anytime

TODAY
• Today's energy and intention
• For Today: the three best things to do, and "Why today?"
• Today's Table: a nutrition theme and a dinner idea based on the Moon's sign
• Your Week: the best day for each area over the next 7 days

THE SKY
• Moon phases and the Moon's sign changes, with exact times
• Where the Sun and planets are, retrogrades and major aspects

8 AREAS
Hair · Skin & Beauty · Nutrition · Home · Body · Love & Relationships · Shopping & Budget · Mind & Growth

RITUALS
• Short, quiet rituals for every phase
• Intention Journal: set an intention at the new moon, revisit it at the full moon (Pro)

KOZMIK PRO
• Finer daily scores using the Moon's sign
• The whole month and future dates
• A dinner idea for every day and body notes for each Moon sign
• Intention Journal and a personal note every morning
The annual plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions renew at the end of each period unless cancelled in App Store settings.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads. Every calculation runs on your phone, offline; your notes stay on your device.

In 10 languages: Türkçe, English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Português, Русский, Polski, Nederlands.

Kozmik's suggestions come from folk tradition and lunar calendar culture; they are for inspiration and enjoyment, not medical or nutritional advice.

Terms of Use: https://vectura.works/kozmik/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://vectura.works/kozmik/privacy/

name: KrazuniFelpoth
description: Forklift truck design: mast, forks, counterweight, hydraulics and tyres. Calculate moment balance, lifting capacity, tilt, cylinder pressure and aisle width.

name: Kuaförüm: Randevu Defteri
description:
Kuaförüm, kuaför ve berberler için randevu defteri. Kağıt ajandayı bırakın; randevularınız, müşterileriniz ve personelinizin saatleri cebinizde.

• Günlük takvim: Randevuları personel bazında görün; yeni randevu ekleyin, taşıyın, iptal edin ya da "gelmedi" olarak işaretleyin.
• Çakışma yok: Aynı saate aynı kişiye iki randevu verilemez; boya beklerken araya başka müşteri sığdırılabilir.
• Müşteri kartı: Telefon, notlar (boya formülü gibi), randevu geçmişi ve gelinmeyen randevular tek yerde. Tek dokunuşla arayın ya da WhatsApp'tan yazın.
• Hizmetler ve fiyatlar: Kadın, erkek ve çocuk hizmetlerini süre ve fiyatlarıyla girin.
• Personel: Her çalışanın hizmetleri, çalışma saatleri, izin ve tatil günleri.
• Online randevu linki: Müşterileriniz size özel bağlantıdan 7/24 randevu alır, randevu takviminize düşer.

Salon hesabı kuaforum.tekniksoft.com adresinden açılır; uygulamaya aynı hesapla giriş yapılır. Uygulamada reklam ve izleme yoktur.

name: Kumi: English Collocations
description:
Speak natural English — phrase by phrase.

Know plenty of English words, but your sentences still don’t feel quite right? Saying do a mistake instead of make a mistake, or big rain instead of heavy rain?

Native speakers don't build sentences word by word; they speak in ready-made word combinations (collocations). Kumi is built specifically for Russian speakers to bridge that gap, with clear explanations and natural translations in Russian.

WHAT’S INSIDE

326 Essential Collocations
Not an endless dictionary you will never finish, but a focused, high-yield curriculum from A2 to C1. Grouped into practical topics: Work, Money, Travel, Health, Relationships, and News.

A 4-Step Active Learning Method
- Meet: Clear definitions, nuanced Russian translations, and real-life context.
- Recognize: Pick the correct combination among deceptively similar options.
- Recall: Type the phrase from memory, with adaptive hints when you're stuck.
- Listen: High-clarity native iOS text-to-speech with adjustable playback speed.

Smart Spaced Repetition

Kumi brings each expression back right before you're about to forget it. Start each session reviewing due items, then unlock new phrases up to your daily target.

Frictionless Daily Practice
- 5–10 minutes a day
- Gentle, customizable daily reminders
- Searchable catalog with level and topic filters
- Streak tracker and visual progress calendar
- Native Dark & Light Mode
- 100% offline support — practice anywhere, anytime

HONEST PRICING & PRIVACY

Try 30 phrases for free.
One-time purchase, lifetime access: No recurring subscriptions, no paywalls down the road, and zero ads.
Reviews are always free: Keep practicing your unlocked phrases forever, even without upgrading.
Privacy first: No sign-up, no accounts, and no tracking analytics. Your learning data stays entirely on your device.

name: LAGYRINTH
description:
LAGYRINTH is a minimalist puzzle where every successful move reshapes the maze. Start at the bottom and find your way to the bright exit at the top.

Swipe through an open passage to move one cell. Parallel lines glide against your movement: the nearest lines shift one cell, the next two, then three and beyond. The central line stays still. Plan your route as the maze changes around you.

• Endless procedurally generated levels, growing from 8×8 to 36×36.
• Smooth, flowing movement and a clean, distraction-free board.
• Compare your moves with the exact minimum for each level.
• Undo, replay and automatic progress saving.
• Light, dark and system appearance.
• English and Russian, with an ENG/RUS switch in Help.

Free to play. No ads, in-app purchases or registration. Play offline, at your own pace.

name: Lanio: Row Counter & Patterns
description:
No account, no ads, no AI. Your counts are never lost, and everything that is free today stays free.

Lanio is a calm row counter and pattern keeper for knitting and crochet. Open a project, tap anywhere on the upper part of the screen, and the row is counted and saved at once.

COUNT WITHOUT TOUCHING THE PHONE
- Add a row from the Lock Screen or Home Screen widget, without unlocking
- A Live Activity keeps your row on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with +1 and −1
- Say "Next row in Lanio" to Siri, or put it on the Action Button or in Control Center
- Count with a Bluetooth page-turner pedal or a ring clicker, by foot or by thumb
- Count on Apple Watch with a tap or a double tap (Pro)

YOUR PATTERN AND YOUR COUNT ON ONE SCREEN
Import a PDF pattern from Files, or open it in Lanio from another app. A madder-red highlighter bar lies on the row you are working and moves on with the counter; the rows you have finished are dimmed, like the card and tape knitters have always used on paper. Charts can be read upwards. Lanio remembers the page, the zoom and the bar for each project, even months later. Your patterns stay on your iPhone.

SMART COUNTERS
- A row counter with a stitch counter that resets every row, and a stitches-per-row target
- A repeat counter: "Repeat 4 of 6, row 3 of 8"
- A linked total and sections, with a gentle signal on the last row
- Undo as far back as you need, with where each count came from
- The screen stays on while you count, a left-handed layout, and a large number that grows with your text size

PROJECTS AND A FINISHED LIST
Each project keeps its needle or hook size, yarn, photos and notes. Time is tracked on its own while the counter or pattern is open. Finished projects move to their own list with their rows and total time, and you can share a simple finish card.

YOUR STASH
Keep your yarn with colour, weight, fibre, length per skein, number of skeins, where it is stored and the dye lot. Filter by colour family, weight or place, and link yarn to a project.

CROCHET, FULLY
Crochet projects get US or UK terms, rounds instead of rows, and hook sizes in millimetres and US letters.

COUNTS THAT ARE NEVER LOST
Every tap is written to your iPhone before the screen moves on, and nothing is lost if the app is closed or the battery runs out. When two devices disagree, the higher count wins and its history is kept. You can export everything, with projects, patterns and photos, as one backup file at any time, for free.

HONEST PRICING
Lanio opens without a paywall, and there is no weekly plan. The free version keeps two projects on the needles at a time, with unlimited counters, the PDF reader and highlighter bar, the widget and Live Activity, pedal counting, your stash and full export. Everything that is free today stays free.
Lanio Pro is a yearly subscription with an optional 14-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. The date your trial ends is shown before you start, and Lanio reminds you two days before it does. The lifetime purchase is shared with your family through Family Sharing.

LANIO PRO
- Unlimited active projects
- iCloud sync of projects, counters, notes and stash between your devices
- An Apple Watch counter with double tap and a complication
- Pen, highlighter and sticky notes on your PDF patterns

Lanio speaks English, German and Turkish.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://glory-psychology-2be.notion.site/Lanio-Privacy-Policy-4111a43f484c803d8388e59bda181a0e

name: Lara – Kurdish Keyboard
description:
Lara is a modern keyboard made for Kurdish.

Type Sorani (Central Kurdish), Kurmancî (Northern Kurdish), Arabic and English on one keyboard, with word suggestions for each language.

WHAT LARA DOES
• Word suggestions and autocorrect in Sorani, Kurmancî, Arabic and English
• Learns the words you use most, on your iPhone or iPad only
• All Kurdish letters in the right place: ڕ ڵ ێ ۆ ە and Ş Ê Î Û Ç
• A number row with Kurdish digits (١٢٣) or Latin digits (123)
• Long-press any key for extra letters and symbols
• Switch language with the globe key, or long-press the space bar to choose one
• Email and web address fields open in English, with @ and / ready
• Slide your finger on the space bar to move the cursor
• Light, dark and colourful themes and adjustable key height
• Companion app in Sorani, Kurmancî, Arabic and English

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Lara contains no networking code. What you type is processed on your device and is never sent, sold or shared. Lara does not learn from password fields, and you can view or delete learned words at any time in the app.

ABOUT "ALLOW FULL ACCESS"
Lara works without Full Access. If you turn it on, Lara uses it only for key-press haptics and to share your settings and learned words between the Lara app and the keyboard. It is never used to go online or to read your clipboard.

SET UP IN A MINUTE
Open Lara and follow the two steps: add the keyboard in Settings, then tap the globe key in any app.

name: LarderLoop
description:
LarderLoop is a calm, simple way to run your kitchen and waste less food.

TRACK WHAT YOU HAVE
• Add food in seconds with category, amount, dates, price and an optional photo
• Sort by fridge, freezer, pantry or countertop, and by category
• See what's fresh, what to use soon, what has expired and what is running low

NEVER MISS A DATE
• Reminders 7, 3 and 1 days before, and on the day, at a time you choose
• Clear difference between "use by" (safety) and "best before" (quality) dates
• An expiry calendar for the week and the month

COOK WITH WHAT YOU'VE GOT
• AI Recipe Studio creates recipes from your pantry and uses items that need eating first
• Choose servings, time, difficulty, cuisine and equipment
• Scale recipes, find substitutes, and send missing ingredients to your shopping list
• Save recipes to cook offline and keep a cooking history

SHOP SMARTER
• Shopping lists grouped by category, with cost estimates
• Warnings when you already have an item at home
• A grocery planner for low-stock items, recipe ingredients and AI suggestions
• Move bought items into your pantry in one tap

UNDERSTAND YOUR HABITS
• A kitchen journal of what you bought, used, cooked and threw away
• Charts for used vs wasted food, spending and waste by category
• AI food-waste and monthly kitchen reports, exportable as PDF

YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline; AI is optional and only runs when you ask
• Before any AI request, you see exactly what will be sent
• CSV export, backup and restore
• Dark mode

LarderLoop's dates, storage tips and AI answers are guidance only. Always follow the product label and official food safety advice.

name: Last Light: A Keeper's Vigil
description:
Your lantern is dying. Things in the dark only move when your light isn't on them.

Drag anywhere to carry the lantern. Anything inside its glow freezes, shivering. Anything outside it comes for you. The flame shrinks every second, so you have to go out into the dark for oil, and the dark is full of eyes.

ONE RULE, A HUNDRED WAYS TO BREAK IT
• Stalkers move inside your light, but only while you move. Stand still.
• Wisps hide their eyes. You only see them up close.
• Moths love a big flame and bite chunks out of it.
• Leeches cling to the edge of your light and drink it.
• Blinkers jump closer every time they blink in the dark.
• Some oil flasks are Mimics. Look for the green flicker.
• Brutes are too big to freeze. A Flare stops them cold.
• Your reflection walks out of the mirror and copies every move, the wrong way round.

15 PLACES. 120 NIGHTS. EACH ONE DARKER.
From the Shore to the Whispering Pines, Mirefen Marsh, the Hollow Village, Saint Ash graveyard, frozen Frostmere, the Bell Tower, the Hall of Mirrors, the Eclipse and the Blood Moon, all the way to the Lighthouse and the thing that put its lamp out.

NO TWO NIGHTS ALIKE
• Survive until dawn, gather what was lost, kindle the old braziers, or run for shelter.
• Fog swallows your light. Gales nearly blow it out. Lightning shows you everything for one white instant. The bell tolls and everything lunges.
• Trees and rocks cast real shadows. Anything in shadow isn't in your light.
• Find the hidden spark on every night for the stars.

MADE TO BE PLAYED IN THE DARK
• A heartbeat that quickens as your flame gutters, whispers when something is close, and real scares.
• The Long Night: the endless mode. How long can you last?
• A new Daily Night every day, daily tasks and a 7-day gift.
• Lanterns that change the rules, flames in eight colours, and charms: Flare, Ward and Oil.

Short nights, big scares. Plays offline.

Last Light is free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads. Remove ads with a single purchase.

name: Lattice Lens
description:
Explore how the shape of a crystal unit cell and the placement of its scatterers affect a diffraction pattern. Lattice Lens is an interactive two dimensional lab for learning about crystal structures, reciprocal space, and interference.

Drag the basis vectors to stretch or tilt a unit cell and watch the reciprocal pattern update in real time. Add, move, or remove scatterers to see how their positions change the intensity of the spots. Start with a square, rectangular, oblique, or centered square cell.

Tap a spot to open the Spot Inspector. See its reflection indices, relative intensity, and the phase contribution from each scatterer. Show extinct reflections to explore where contributions cancel and why some spots disappear.

Try two guided experiments to see how stretching a cell changes spot spacing and how interference can make a spot disappear. Save your cells and observations in the Notebook, then reopen them to continue or duplicate an experiment to explore a variation.

Lattice Lens uses an idealized model designed for students, teachers, and anyone curious about crystallography. The lab, guides, and notebook work offline without an account.

name: Le La El La: French & Spanish
description:
Is it le or la? El or la? Gender is the thing French and Spanish learners never quite stop getting wrong, and it's rarely taught in a way that sticks. Le La El La trains it directly: see a noun, pick masculine or feminine, and learn from every answer.

HOW IT WORKS
• See a noun with a short English meaning and choose le or la (or el or la)
• Every answer shows the noun with its article, the ending rule that applies, and whether this noun is one of its exceptions: la peau, la fleur, el día, la mano
• Nouns you get wrong, or answer slowly, come up more often until they stick
• French and Spanish in one app, or mixed in the same round

THE RULES THAT WORK
Endings really do give away the gender. In French, -tion, -té and -ie are feminine; -ment, -age and -eur are masculine. In Spanish, -ción, -dad and -ía are feminine; -or, -aje and -o are masculine. The app teaches the rules, then drills the exceptions that break them.

SEE WHERE YOU STRUGGLE
Your progress is broken down by ending, so you can see whether -eur, -age or -ción is the problem, and which nouns you find hardest.

LOOK ANYTHING UP
Search an English word to see the French and Spanish nouns for it, or a French or Spanish noun to see its gender, its meaning and the other language. About 28,000 nouns, offline, free.

ARCADE
Race the clock. In Level up you start with 5 seconds a noun and get faster every level, with three lives. In Sprint you get 20 nouns at 4 seconds each. Build combos, beat your records and work through seven levels in each language, from the commonest 100 nouns to the exceptions.

THE TRAPS, HANDLED
Before a vowel, French drops le and la for l' (l'eau), and some feminine Spanish nouns take el (el agua). When the article would give the answer away or mislead, the app asks "masculine or feminine?" instead, and explains.

FREE AND UNLOCK EVERYTHING
The 500 commonest nouns of each language are free, with the ending rules, your progress and the first three Arcade levels. A single purchase of Unlock everything adds every noun (about 19,000 French and 9,000 Spanish), Arcade levels 4 to 7 and the Exceptions drill. Paid once, shared with your family. No subscription.

No account, no ads, nothing collected, and it works offline.

Ideal for GCSE, A level, DELF and DELE learners, and for anyone who has ever said "la problème".

WORD LISTS AND CREDITS
French: Lexique 3.83 (New, Pallier et al.) and the English Wiktionary, via kaikki.org. Spanish: the English Wiktionary, via the spanish_data project, with word frequencies from FrequencyWords. All shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. The processed lists are published at mattjamespettitt.github.io/gender-trainer-site/data/

name: Leaf Pals: Plant Care
description:
Leaf Pals keeps your houseplants happy without turning care into a chore.

WATER THESE 3 TODAY
One calm reminder a day lists every plant that needs a drink. Open the app, swipe right on a plant, and it's done, with a little splash and a tap of haptics.

SCHEDULES THAT FOLLOW THE SEASONS
Plants drink more in summer and much less in winter. Leaf Pals stretches and shortens every watering schedule with the seasons, in either hemisphere, and pauses feeding in winter.

A CARE GUIDE FOR 120 HOUSEPLANTS
Search 120 common houseplants in English or Japanese. Each comes with a watering range, light and humidity needs, and a short tip, and you can change any of it for your own plant.

A CARE LOG THAT WRITES ITSELF
Every watering, feeding, misting, repotting and note lands in each plant's log.

WATCH THEM GROW (PRO)
Add growth photos over time and compare any two side by side.

A ROUGH LIGHT METER (PRO)
Point the camera at a spot and Leaf Pals estimates how bright it is, then suggests plants that like that light. It's a rough estimate, not a lab instrument, and perfect for finding a better windowsill.

SHARE WITH YOUR HOUSEHOLD (PRO)
Care for the same plants with the people you live with, through your own iCloud. No accounts, no servers.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
"Thirsty today" shows who needs water and lets you water them right from the widget.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your garden stays on your iPhone unless you choose to share it through iCloud.

FREE AND PRO
Free: up to 5 plants, reminders, the care guide and the care log.
Pro: unlimited plants, the light meter, growth timeline and compare, household sharing through iCloud, and care history export.
Pro is available monthly, yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Leaf to Wing
description:
A caterpillar, a page of leaves, and one unbroken line.

Drag the caterpillar from leaf to leaf until it has eaten every one. Visit the flowers in order, finish on the twig, and watch it spin a chrysalis. Then a butterfly opens its wings, drawn from the very path you made. Every puzzle you solve leaves a butterfly of its own.

HOW TO PLAY
• Eat every leaf, and each leaf only once.
• Visit the flowers in order: 1, 2, 3…
• End on the twig.
• Drag back along your trail to undo.

A NATURALIST'S NOTEBOOK
Pencil lines, watercolor leaves and soft paper. The notebook follows the seasons, from spring to summer, autumn and winter.

EASY TO START, CLEVER LATER
The first puzzles take seconds. Further on, thorny branches block the way, leaves with holes must be skipped, and arrow leaves can only be left the way they point.

AT YOUR OWN PACE
• No timers and no move limits.
• Stuck? A hint shows you the next leaf.
• Come back each day for a small gift of hints.
• Short puzzles that fit into a spare minute.

Your butterflies gather on the levels page, one for every puzzle solved.

FREE TO PLAY
Leaf to Wing is free and shows ads. Hints come from optional short videos and the daily gift. A one-time Remove Ads purchase removes the ads between levels; hint videos stay optional.

Questions or ideas? Write to hello@leaftowing.com.

name: Learnmize: Digital Marketing
description:
Learnmize is the student app for Learnmize, the digital marketing institute with centres in Bhopal, Indore and Delhi, and live online batches for learners anywhere in India.

LEARN AT YOUR PACE
• Short video lessons, with your own notes saved on every lesson
• Pick up right where you left off, with a clear next step
• See your progress on every course: lessons, classes and what your certificate still needs

JOIN LIVE CLASSES IN ONE TAP
• A reminder before every class
• Join on Google Meet in one tap; your attendance is marked when you join
• Watch the recording of any class you missed

CERTIFICATES ANYONE CAN VERIFY
• Download your certificate as a PDF
• Add it to LinkedIn in one tap
• Every certificate has a QR code and a public link that proves it is genuine

START FOR FREE
• Free masterclasses from Aryan Tripathi, founder of Learnmize
• Shorts: one marketing tip in a minute, swipe for the next
• Explore the programme ladder: Foundation, Professional, Mastery and Specialization

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Your courses, class timetable, fees and certificates
• Sign in with your mobile number and a 6-digit PIN
• Notifications for classes and certificates

New to Learnmize? Create a free account to watch the free courses, and talk to a counsellor about the right programme for you.

name: Listably: Read Aloud Reader
description:
Listably reads your documents aloud in natural Studio voices that run on your iPhone, and highlights every sentence and word as it goes.

WHAT IT READS
• PDF, EPUB, TXT and HTML files
• Web pages: paste a link, or share one from Safari with "Listen in Listably"
• Photos of printed pages, scanned with the camera and recognised on your phone
• Anything you paste

LISTENING
• Sentence and word highlighting, so you can follow along or find your place
• Six Studio voices, British and American, that run entirely on your iPhone. Fern and Willow are free; Pro adds Iris, Rowan, Ash and Reed
• The voices installed on your iPhone as well, including Enhanced and Premium voices, for other languages or faster reading
• Speed from 0.5x to 2x with Studio voices, up to 3x with iPhone voices
• Plays in the background and on the lock screen, with play/pause and skip from your earphones
• Sleep timer
• Skip citations such as [12] and (Smith, 2020) so papers read cleanly
• Picks up where you left off in every document

READING
• Large, clean text with a serif or sans-serif font, adjustable size, line and letter spacing
• Tap a paragraph to read from there
• Works with Dynamic Type and VoiceOver

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in
• Documents stay on your iPhone; nothing is uploaded
• No analytics, no tracking, no advertising
• Web pages are fetched by your phone directly from the site, as Safari would

FREE
Everything above is free, with no account and no limit on how much you listen. Scanning is one page at a time on the free plan.

PRO
• Save as audio: turn a document into an audio file to keep or share
• Listen-later queue: line up documents and they play one after another
• Batch scan: up to 50 pages in one go

Pro is a yearly or monthly subscription, or a one-off lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and are managed in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy policy: https://listably.co.uk/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Little Bear's Christmas Trip
description:
Little Bear's Christmas Trip is an advent calendar in which every door opens the next part of one story: a bedtime story told over 24 evenings.

Pörri the little bear has been trusted with an important job. He is to carry the Christmas star all the way to Grandma and Grandpa's cabin on faraway Star Mountain. Along the way he meets a moose, a wolverine, reindeer and many other new friends, watches the northern lights dance across the sky, and learns that he was never traveling alone. On Christmas Eve, the whole bear family is finally together.

A NEW DOOR EVERY DAY
• 24 painterly illustrations and a final picture for Christmas Eve
• a short story behind every door, written for reading aloud at bedtime
• calm background music for each picture (13 pieces in all), easy to mute
• no peeking ahead: doors can't be opened early, but opened doors can be visited again
• in landscape, the story turns page by page so the picture stays in view

FIND HUHU
Huhu, a little snowy owl, is hiding in every picture. To search, just tap where you think Huhu is. In landscape, the text steps aside once the story has been read, leaving the whole picture free for the search. Each owl you find gets a gold circle, and a counter shows how many of the 24 your family has found so far.

FOR PARENTS
• write your own message for the last picture on Christmas Eve, perhaps a clue to where a present is hidden
• grown-up settings sit behind a simple "Are you a grown-up?" question
• unlock all doors for the day to preview the story, or close them all and start over
• no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts
• collects no data and works offline

Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape, in 10 languages. The calendar starts over every December, ready for a new countdown to Christmas.

name: Little Bird Watcher
description:
A little world of birds is waiting for you.

Welcome to Little Bird Watcher, a peaceful, illustrated birdwatching experience inspired by the natural beauty of Georgia.

Settle into a quiet garden, listen to the sounds of nature, and watch as colorful birds visit the trees, feeders, and branches around you. There's no rush, no score to beat, and no pressure to complete anything. Just a lovely little world to explore at your own pace.

DISCOVER THE BIRDS

Meet 30 species of birds, each brought to life with charming illustrations, natural movements, and authentic bird calls. Watch them perch, hop, flutter, and explore their surroundings.

TAKE A CLOSER LOOK

Use your binoculars to observe birds up close. When you spot something special, capture a photograph and save it to your personal collection. Share your favorite discoveries with family and friends.

EXPLORE THREE BEAUTIFUL HABITATS

• Backyard Garden — A welcoming garden filled with flowers, feeders, and familiar feathered visitors.

• Woodland Hideaway — A peaceful forest sanctuary surrounded by trees and woodland birds.

• Pond & Wetlands — A tranquil waterside habitat with reeds, reflections, and birds to discover.

WATCH NATURE CHANGE

Experience the beauty of changing seasons, from fresh spring greenery to golden autumn leaves and quiet winter landscapes. Explore different weather conditions and enjoy the atmosphere of each habitat.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Customize birdhouses, explore feeders, and create a welcoming place for your feathered visitors.

KEEP A LITTLE FIELD JOURNAL

Discover new species in your Bird Book and revisit your favorite moments in My Photos. Every bird you encounter is another little discovery to remember.

A PEACEFUL EXPERIENCE

• No timers or competitive challenges
• No advertisements
• No accounts required
• Designed for relaxed, offline play
• Suitable for nature lovers of all ages

START YOUR BIRDWATCHING ADVENTURE

Enjoy Backyard Garden for free. Unlock Woodland Hideaway and Pond & Wetlands together with one optional, one-time purchase.

Whether you're a lifelong bird enthusiast, a curious beginner, or simply looking for a quiet moment in a busy day, Little Bird Watcher offers a gentle escape into nature.

Take your time. Look a little closer. See who comes to visit.

name: Loapfiry - Forest Focus Haven
description:
Loapfiry is a doodle-style to-do and focus app set in a quiet forest outpost. Instead of another bare checklist, daily work arrives as woodland commissions on sketch-paper slips. Finish a focus watch, unlock a Jobling companion or a yard piece, then place what you earned in a yard that grows with every quiet hour.

What makes Loapfiry different

Most productivity apps stop at lists and timers, or keep tasks, focus tools, and collectibles in separate places. Loapfiry keeps commissions, focus watches, Joblings, and yard layout in one continuous outpost loop. Every finished session feeds a collect-and-decorate rhythm without turning focus into a noisy contest. You hang a commission, keep a watch, and fill a personal outpost with friends and props only you arranged. A sealed job becomes a companion on the yard, not just a checkbox that disappears.

Commissions on the Today board

- Pin custom commissions with a title and focus length from 1 to 180 minutes, or grab a starter slip such as Brew the kettle, Sort the mail, or Sweep the porch.
- Use quick watch chips for 10, 15, 25, or 45 minutes.
- Sort work across Waiting, Sealed, and Board views. Open a slip to edit or remove it, then start focus when you are ready.
- Time-of-day cues such as Dawn shift, Noon bench, Lantern hour, and Night watch keep the board feeling like a living desk.

Focus watches that unlock rewards

- Enter a calm night-grove focus screen with a clear countdown. Pause, resume, or quit anytime.
- When the watch completes, inscribe the session to seal the job and unlock a woodland Jobling or yard piece on a reward card with a short blurb.
- Finished sessions leave a local focus trace you can revisit later.

Joblings catalog

- Browse companions and props in the Cards tab, with progress as unlocked over total. Filter by All, Friends, or Rare. Locked entries stay muted until a finished watch brings them in.
- Collect Joblings such as Ember Fox, Moon Owl, Moss Hedgehog, Tunnel Mole, and Pine Squirrel, plus props such as Glow Lantern, Soft Mushroom, Clay Pot, and Nest House.

My Yard, arranged by you

- Drag unlocked Joblings and props onto a hand-painted yard stage, place them, move pins, and clear ones you no longer want. The layout stays saved on the device.
- Switch among eight scenery moods: Meadow, Dawn Dew, Brookside, Blossom, Golden, Pine Shade, Clover, and Lantern. The yard masthead shows how many companions have joined your nest.

Cabin and on-device privacy

- Cabin shows nest progress for friends and pieces, opens Terms, Privacy, and the story of Loapfiry, and can reset local commissions, traces, yard layout, and unlocks.
- Commissions, focus traces, and yard layouts stay on this device. Loapfiry does not collect a personal profile or upload your task notes.

Loapfiry is for anyone who wants focus to feel like tending a small outpost: pin the work, keep the watch, unlock a weird little friend, and build a yard shaped by your quiet hours.

name: Locale Forge
description: Locale Forge is a localization QA workbench for iOS teams who ship multilingual apps. Import .strings, .stringsdict, JSON, or folders through the system file picker—only files you explicitly share are parsed on device. Browse keys, compare locales side by side, edit values inline, and jump from validation findings to the exact row that needs attention. The Plural Lab helps you review .stringsdict categories per locale with runtime-style previews. Run built-in QA rules, scan coverage gaps, and export CSV or JSON readiness reports before you cut a release build. Set a base locale, merge project resources, and keep your string catalog organized in one focused workspace. Designed for translators, release managers, and developers who want fast feedback without leaving the iPhone or iPad. Parsing, search, and reports stay on your device so your source strings remain under your control.

name: Lookfold: Closet & Outfit Log
description:
Your wardrobe has more possibilities than you remember. Lookfold brings your clothes, outfit ideas, and actual wear history together so tomorrow's choice can start with something you already love.

BUILD A WARDROBE YOU CAN USE
Save clothing with or without a photo. Keep categories, colors, sizes, purchase notes, and personal fit or comfort notes in one place. Search for a piece, keep a wishlist, and archive items you no longer reach for.

REMEMBER WHAT YOU WORE
Record an outfit for a day, look back through your calendar, and reuse a combination. Correct a record without losing its history. Wear counts reflect recorded days of actual wear; a future plan stays a plan until you confirm you wore it.

PLAN AHEAD, ONE DAY AT A TIME
Build future outfits from your own wardrobe. Keep your choices together in a weekly view, then turn a plan into a wear record when the day comes.

TRY A NEW LOOK WITH OPTIONAL AI
Preview a top or dress on a selected photo. Compare the original, AI preview and applied piece, then save an idea as a plan or preview a share card. AI processing requires your permission and fitting credits. It is a visual suggestion, not a guarantee of fit, sizing, comfort or fabric.

KEEP YOUR FAVORITES CLOSE
Group looks into ordered collections. Preview share cards and choose what leaves the app. Private fit and comfort notes stay out of those cards.

YOUR RECORDS, YOUR CHOICES
Explore a fictional sample wardrobe before signing in. Prepare a draft on your device; sign in with Apple when you're ready to save to your account. Manual wardrobe and outfit recording do not require AI photo processing. Export your records, manage photos, and start account deletion from Account.

Photos are optional for manual records. Notification reminders are optional. Account saving requires an internet connection. Lookfold is intended for adults 18 and older.

Privacy policy, support, and terms are available from Account and the links on this page.

The app interface is currently in English. Store information and support documents are available in Korean, English, and Japanese.

Terms (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Luisour
description:
La photographie, en perspective.

Luisour vous invite à découvrir des photographes, à explorer leurs images et à préparer vos prochaines visites d’expositions.

• Parcourez un atlas de photographes avec leurs œuvres, biographies et sources.
• Retrouvez Regards actuels et des lectures pour comprendre la photographie.
• Aimez une image avec le pouce levé et enregistrez les regards qui comptent pour vous.
• Composez votre sélection d’expositions, consultez-la en liste ou dans un calendrier et choisissez vos dates de visite.
• Créez un compte Luisour, que vous soyez amateur de photographie ou photographe. Retrouvez votre carnet personnel dans l’application et sur le site.
• Découvrez la collection de la boutique et accédez à votre espace photographe.

Les contenus éditoriaux sont embarqués et consultables hors connexion après installation. La connexion au compte, sa synchronisation et la boutique nécessitent Internet. La collection marchande se prépare : les commandes ne sont pas encore ouvertes.

Une présentation sobre, attentive aux images, avec des crédits et des liens vers les sources.

name: Lumen - Mistérios do Rosário
description:
O Lumen é um app para contemplar a vida de Cristo com os olhos de Maria, diante das grandes obras da arte sacra.

Cada um dos vinte mistérios do Rosário vem acompanhado de cinco a sete pinturas de mestres como Murillo, Zurbarán, Velázquez, El Greco, Guido Reni e Rubens. Passe de uma obra a outra, demore-se nos detalhes e deixe que a imagem conduza a oração. Uma jaculatória acompanha cada mistério.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA
• Os mistérios do dia: gozosos, luminosos, dolorosos e gloriosos, segundo a carta Rosarium Virginis Mariae.
• Vias-Sacras completas, com uma pintura para cada estação: a de São Josemaria Escrivá, a do Papa Francisco (Coliseu, 2025) e a antologia “A melodia do Calvário”, organizada pelo Pe. Alberto Shintani.
• “Santo Rosário”, de São Josemaria, para meditar cada mistério com um santo.
• Um guia de contemplação baseado nos ensinamentos de São João Paulo II.
• Tema claro e escuro, ajuste do tamanho do texto e modo imersivo para olhar só a pintura.

O Lumen não é um contador de contas: é um lugar de silêncio para olhar, meditar e rezar.

Gratuito, sem anúncios, sem cadastro e sem coleta de dados. Todas as obras são de domínio público, com os créditos no app.

name: Lumen Hour: Golden Hour & Sun
description:
Lumen Hour tells you exactly when the most beautiful light of the day arrives, and where it will come from.

• LIVE COUNTDOWN to the next golden hour, down to the second. The card turns warm the moment golden hour begins
• SUN PATH CHART: the sun's height through the whole day, with golden and blue hour bands and a marker for right now
• EVERY KEY TIME: sunrise, sunset, morning and evening golden hour, morning and evening blue hour, solar noon with its altitude, and day length
• BEARINGS: a compass that shows where the sun rises and sets today and where it is right now. It turns with your phone when you hold it flat
• SHADOW LENGTH: how long shadows are right now, as a multiple of height
• MOON PHASE: illumination and days until the full moon
• PLAN A SHOOT: pick any date and any of 33 photo cities, from Seoul and Jeju to Santorini, Reykjavik and the Grand Canyon, and see the next two weeks of evening golden hours
• ALERTS: optional reminders 10 to 60 minutes before morning or evening golden hour
• Handles midnight sun and polar night

Times are calculated on your device with the NOAA solar position algorithm. Terrain and weather are not taken into account.

No ads, no account, no tracking. Your location is used only to calculate the sun's position, and you can choose a city instead.

name: Lumen Tally
description:
Lumen Tally is a calm logic puzzle set on a harbour pier at dusk.

Every chart is a grid of covered squares. Some hide lanterns. An open square shows a number: how many lanterns sit in the squares beside it. Read the numbers, work out where the lanterns are, and light every one without waking the wrong square.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap a square to pencil a maybe.
• Double-tap to light a lantern.
• Hold to mark a square as quiet.
• Each chart gives you a few wicks. A wrong light burns one, so think before you commit.

PURE LOGIC, NO GUESSING
Every chart can be solved by reasoning alone. Each one has been checked by a solver, so there is always a next move you can prove.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• 80 charts across 8 chapters. Each chapter adds a new rule and teaches it in a short lesson before it counts.
• This Week: seven new charts every week, one for each day.
• Ledger: your best times, streaks, three-star reads and a suggestion for what to read next.
• Extra cabinets that open as you progress.
• Two optional helpers: a Note that shows a move you can be sure of, and a Snuffer that opens a square.
• Three stars for each chart, awarded for clean, careful reading.

YOUR KEEPER PORTRAIT
Build a keeper card with your own photo, a name and a rank that climbs as you earn stars. Save it to Photos and share it however you like. You can also record a short call in your own voice that plays when you light the last lantern of a chart. Camera, photos and microphone are only used for these features and are always optional.

MADE TO BE CALM
• Hand-drawn lanterns, a dusk harbour and soft music.
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No account.
• Plays fully offline.
• Sound, music and haptics can each be turned off, and Reduce Motion is available.
• Supports iPhone and iPad.

Light the pier, one lantern at a time.

name: Lumi: Flashlight, Strobe & LED
seller_name: Shanghai Rethinking Cultural Consulting Co., Ltd
description:
Lumi Toolkit puts every light you need in one beautifully simple app. Use your iPhone's flashlight and its screen as two separate lights — or switch both on at once.

FLASHLIGHT
• Steady light with fine brightness control
• Strobe, breathe and candle flicker
• SOS and Morse code signals for emergencies and the outdoors

SCREEN LIGHT
• Soft fill light for selfies, video calls and makeup — drag one panel to set warmth and brightness together
• Any color from the color wheel, or save your own swatches
• Colorful strobe and ambient effects such as aurora, flowing gradients and candlelight
• Scrolling LED text for concerts, parties and pick-ups
• Full-screen controls: swipe up and down for brightness, left and right for warmth

SCENES
• 11 built-in scenes for reading, bedtime, photos, parties, night runs and more
• Save your favorite combinations and switch with one tap
• Sleep timer that slowly fades out before turning off

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Control Center buttons and Siri Shortcuts
• Live Activity shows a running sleep timer

PRIVATE AND SAFE
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Lumi works fully offline and collects no data.
• Flashing modes show a photosensitivity warning and are limited to 3 flashes per second by default.
• Screen brightness returns to normal when you leave.

FREE AND LUMI PRO
Free forever, with no time limit: flashlight, SOS, white screen light with color temperature, preset colors and the sleep timer.
Strobe, breathe, Morse code, candle, the color wheel, screen strobe, effects and LED text are free for 10 minutes every week.
Lumi Pro is a one-time in-app purchase. It removes the weekly limit, lets you save unlimited scenes, unlocks alternate app icons and includes future features. No subscription.

name: LumiGeo
description:
LumiGeoは、Panasonic LUMIXデジタルカメラとBluetooth Low Energy（BLE）で常時接続し、撮影写真へ正確なGPS位置情報（緯度・経度・高度）および現在時刻を自動記録するための専用ユーティリティアプリです。

【主な特長】
・電源ONで自動接続＆即時送信
一度ペアリングを済ませれば、以降はカメラの電源を入れるだけでバックグラウンドで自動的に再接続し、最初の1枚目からすぐに位置情報を反映します。iPhoneをポケットやカメラバッグに入れたまま撮影に集中できます。

・2つの世代のLUMIXプロトコルに両対応
最新の「LUMIX Lab」世代（DC-S9 等）だけでなく、従来の「LUMIX Sync」世代（DC-S1 / DC-S1R 等）のBluetooth GPS連携プロトコルにも対応しています。

・複数台のカメラ登録・切り替えに対応
複数のLUMIXボディを登録し、使用するカメラをワンタップで切り替え可能です。個体ごとのシリアル番号やBluetooth識別情報を厳密に照合し、混信や誤接続を防ぎます。

・プライバシー重視の設計
取得した位置情報はBluetooth経由で直接カメラへ送信されるのみであり、外部サーバーへの送信・収集・保存は一切行いません。

【動作確認済み機種】
・LUMIX Lab 方式：DC-S9、Leica D-LUX 8 等
・LUMIX Sync 方式：DC-S1、DC-S1R 等

name: LunarWise
description:
LunarWise shows solar and Vietnamese lunar dates, stems and branches (can chi), auspicious hours, solar terms, and a day score on your phone—computed on device, with no account required.

Today at a glance
• Solar date, lunar date, and can chi on one card
• Auspicious hours and a day score
• Current solar term progress

Month calendar
• Solar–lunar month grid with festival and solar-term marks
• Swipe months; tap a day for details

Good-day finder & day plan
• Purpose-based day lookup: weddings, groundbreaking, openings, moving in…
• Day plan / shortlist: save candidates, compare, notes and checklist on device; export .ics

Calendar toolkit
• Convert solar ↔ lunar, can chi, solar terms, day count
• Good hours, next seven days, age-fit tasks
• Five phases, four pillars (bát tự), age compatibility tools
• Feng shui: house facing, flying stars, Lỗ Ban ruler, 24-mountain compass
• Prayer texts, dream notes, name tools, I Ching, sao hạn, zodiac, and other in-app lookups

Home feng shui (Làm nhà)
• Building age, borrowing age, cung phi, facing, groundbreaking dates—last run saved on device

Family & memorials
• People profiles and death anniversaries (giỗ) stay on the device
• Optional reminders for giỗ / new moon / full moon when you allow notifications

Festivals & articles
• Festivals, solar terms, and cultural articles; a bundled content pack for offline reading

Themes
• Ten themes (Paper, Ink, Lacquer, Bamboo, Wood, and the five-phase set) plus system default

Also
• Home-screen widget (after opening the app once)
• Ads may appear; optional one-time Remove ads purchase (`lunar_remove_ads`) with Restore purchase on the same store account
• No sign-in; family / day-plan data is not uploaded to our servers

Verified calendar range: 1 Jan 1900–31 Dec 2199. Content is cultural reference—not professional advice.

name: Lux Leaf: Light for Plants
description:
Lux Leaf measures the light in any corner of your home and tells you which plants will thrive there.

Place your phone where the plant will sit, screen facing the window, and Lux Leaf estimates the brightness from the camera's exposure. No frames are ever saved.

• LIVE LIGHT METER in lux or foot-candles, on a clear log-scale gauge from deep shade to full sun
• LIGHT BANDS: too dark, low, medium, bright indirect and direct sun, with plain-language advice for each
• DAILY LIGHT INTEGRAL estimate (DLI, mol/m² per day) for the hours of daylight you choose
• PLANT LIGHT GUIDE: 32 popular houseplants, succulents and herbs, from snake plant and pothos to monstera, fiddle leaf fig, orchids, basil and lemon trees, each with its survival and thriving range and a care tip
• "THRIVES HERE" suggestions update as you move around the room
• MY SPOTS: save readings for windows, shelves and rooms, compare them, and see what to grow in each
• Optional calibration if you own a dedicated light meter
• Front or rear camera, Korean and English

Lux Leaf gives an estimate that is accurate enough for choosing plant spots; it is not a laboratory instrument.

No ads. No account. No tracking. Everything stays on your device.

name: MAJEKO
description:
With MAJEKO you rent a holiday home on the Costa del Sol, in Spain. From picking your dates to getting the key on arrival: it's all in this app.

CHOOSE YOUR HOME
Browse photos, features and house rules. See what's nearby, such as the beach, the supermarket and restaurants.

PICK YOUR DATES
The calendar shows which days are available and the price per night. Choose your arrival and departure and see the total price right away.

REQUEST YOUR STAY
A request is not yet a booking: you pay nothing upfront. Your host confirms the request and you're notified in the app.

EVERYTHING FOR YOUR STAY IN ONE PLACE
Your booking shows the address with directions, check-in and check-out times, the Wi-Fi (with a QR code to connect instantly) and the key box code. Check in yourself, whenever suits you.

CHAT WITH YOUR HOST
A question about parking or your arrival time? Send a message. You'll be notified as soon as there's a reply.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Adults only, no pets
• Available in English, Spanish and Dutch
• Sign in with Apple or with a code sent by email

name: Makaan Pager
description:
Makaan Pager is a digital pager for clinics, restaurants, cafés and shops.

How it works
• Scan the QR code at the counter with your camera.
• You instantly get your number in the queue. No sign-up, no account.
• Lock your phone and relax. When it is your turn you get an alert with sound, and your number appears on the Lock Screen.

Why Makaan Pager?
• No more standing at the counter or asking staff every minute.
• Opens right from the camera as an App Clip, no install needed.
• Arabic and English.
• We don't collect your name or phone number.

For businesses: staff get a simple queue with one Call button. To get started contact info@makanstudios.net

name: Maker Print: Size & Poster
description:
Print your designs aiming at the size you designed, and check the result on paper: templates, stencils, sewing and craft patterns, rulers, labels, decals. Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no subscription. The app itself makes no network connections (the privacy-policy link opens your browser).

Pages written at the paper size you chose
Maker Print writes every page of its print file at the paper size and sends it to AirPrint with its own page renderer, without scaling (scale 1). PDF pages keep their designed size (it reads page boxes, rotation and unit scale). SVG files get their size from their units; if a file has none, the app asks once which program made it (96, 72 or 90 pixels per inch) and shows the resulting size before you place it. Photos show their resolution live while you type a size.

Check the size on paper
Prints carry a 100 mm check bar (the app warns when a job has no room for it). Measure it with a ruler. Printers, drivers and the print dialog can still change the size (in the iOS print dialog, leave Scaling at 100 %), and a screen cannot show true size: only paper proves it. If the bar is off, the Calibrate wizard prints a test sheet, you type what you measured, and Maker Print saves a correction for that printer and paper and applies it to later prints from this iPhone; check the bar again afterwards. It was tested with virtual printers on a simulator; your own printer is the final judge, which is why the bar is there.

Big jobs on small paper
Sheets up to 3 metres are split into pages with overlap, registration marks that match on neighbouring pages, page labels with arrows and an assembly map. Blank pages are skipped and you can leave out single pages. Landscape pages are printed turned on portrait paper.

Templates and copies
Rulers up to 3 metres long, graph paper, dot grid, lined paper, circle templates and test squares. Add text, rectangles, ellipses and lines. Repeat a design in rows and columns, fill a sheet, add trim marks, mirror it for transfer paper. Set the scale of a photo from a length you know.

Units
Millimetres, centimetres and inches, including fractions such as 3 1/16". Type any unit into any size field. English and German.

Export
Export a vector PDF at the paper size you chose to print at a copy shop or from a computer (choose Actual size there; other programs and printers may still rescale it, so check the bar).

Good to know
- SVG text, embedded pictures, patterns and filters are not printed, or printed differently; the app lists them before you print. A PDF keeps the most detail.
- PDF comments and form fields are not printed; flatten the PDF first.
- Maker Print keeps at least 3 mm blank at the paper edge.

Not included in this version
DXF import, PNG export, label sheet catalogues, barcodes, sequential numbers, custom fonts.

name: MaltFolio: Brew Batch Log
description:
Keep the recipe you brewed and the measurements you recorded in one batch journal. MaltFolio follows your own homebrew process from a planned batch to its recorded packaging result.

Build recipes from ingredients, quantities, units and process notes. Starting a batch saves a frozen recipe snapshot: later recipe edits do not rewrite an earlier brew. Record actual Brew day, Fermenting and Packaged stages with dates and notes.

Save original specific-gravity and temperature observations. Review separate measurement charts, switch temperature display units, and compare saved batches by elapsed time from brew day. Planned batches stay separate from actual stages and results.

After recording the Packaged stage, add the actual packaged volume, package count and result notes. Preview a batch PDF and export CSV rows for ingredients, stages, measurements and results using the iPhone share sheet.

MaltFolio records your process. It does not control brewing equipment, determine fermentation readiness, or provide chemical or food-safety advice.

Works offline without an app account. Your records are stored locally. No ads, tracking or recipe community are included. You control exported copies.

name: Marcador Pádel Watch y Tenis
description:
Lleva el marcador de pádel y tenis desde la muñeca, sin perderlo nunca. Toca el lado que gana el punto y Marcador cuenta 15, 30, 40, el punto de oro, los juegos, los sets y el tie-break, te dice quién saca y desde qué lado, y te avisa cuando toca cambiar de lado. Funciona con Apple Watch o solo con el iPhone.

SE ACABÓ EL ¿CÓMO ÍBAMOS?
Un toque por punto. La mitad de abajo es tu pareja; la de arriba, los rivales. El marcador se ve en grande y el iPhone muestra el mismo partido en vivo mientras anotas en el reloj.

PUNTO DE ORO, TIE-BREAK Y CAMBIO DE LADO AUTOMÁTICOS
Elige punto de oro, ventaja o punto estrella. A 6-6 empieza el tie-break solo, con su orden de saque y el cambio de lado cada seis puntos. Te avisamos al terminar los juegos impares, con una vibración en la muñeca.

SIEMPRE SABES QUIÉN SACA
La pelota marca a quién le toca sacar, desde qué lado y hacia qué cuadro va el saque. En dobles seguimos la rotación de los cuatro jugadores, también en el tie-break y de un set al siguiente.

NUNCA PIERDES EL MARCADOR
Cada punto se guarda en cuanto lo tocas, en el Apple Watch y en el iPhone. Si se cierra la app, se duerme el reloj o reinicias el celular, el partido vuelve tal como estaba. Cada partido en el reloj se registra como un entrenamiento de pádel o tenis: al levantar la muñeca ves el marcador, no la hora, y Salud guarda lo que juegas (solo si lo permites; no leemos nada de Salud).

UN TOQUE PARA CORREGIR
Deshacer quita el último punto, incluso el que cerró un juego, un set o el partido. La corona del reloj no hace nada durante el partido, así que un giro de muñeca no cambia el resultado.

BOLA DE BREAK, DE SET Y DE PARTIDO
El marcador te avisa de los puntos que deciden algo.

CANTA EL MARCADOR EN VOZ ALTA (PRO)
El iPhone dice el resultado en español después de cada punto, también cuando anotas en el reloj. Déjalo junto a la cancha y lo oyen todos. La voz se genera en tu dispositivo.

LAS REGLAS DE TU CLUB (PRO)
Super tie-break en lugar del tercer set, sets cortos a 4 juegos, partidos a un set o a cinco sets.

TODOS TUS PARTIDOS (PRO)
El historial completo, las estadísticas de cada partido (puntos ganados, puntos y juegos ganados con tu saque, bolas de break, puntos de oro, rachas y duración) y una imagen del resultado para compartir.

GRATIS
- Partidos ilimitados en Apple Watch y iPhone
- Pádel y tenis, dobles e individual
- Punto de oro, ventaja y punto estrella
- Partidos a 3 sets con tie-break
- Deshacer
- Quién saca y desde qué lado, en cada punto
- Aviso de cambio de lado
- Cada punto guardado mientras juegas
- El marcador en vivo en el iPhone mientras anotas en el reloj
- Nombres de las parejas y los jugadores
- Tus 3 últimos partidos

PRO
- El marcador cantado en voz alta
- Super tie-break, sets cortos, un set o cinco sets
- Historial completo
- Estadísticas de cada partido
- Imagen del resultado para compartir

TUS PARTIDOS SON TUYOS
Sin cuenta, sin anuncios y sin analítica. Los partidos y la configuración se guardan en tu iPhone y tu Apple Watch, que se los envían entre sí directamente. No nos llega nada.

name: Mastook
description:
Mastook tracks the products you love for you. When a sold-out size comes back in stock, is marked "coming soon", or drops in price, you get a notification right away.

HOW IT WORKS
• Paste a product link, or add it with one tap while browsing a store.
• Pick the size or colour you're waiting for.
• Know the moment it's back.

FEATURES
• Stock tracking by size and colour
• Price drop alerts and price history chart
• "Coming soon" alerts
• Quick Buy: when it's back, the product opens in the store's app within seconds (Premium)
