name: MATCH RUSH: Cosmic Duel
description:
One board. Two rivals. Every swap is an opportunity.

MATCH RUSH turns match-3 into a real-time duel. Both contestants act on the same board, so a clever swap can create an opening for either side. Play solo against alien rivals or invite a friend to a private duel.

FIND YOUR SHOW

Adventure: Follow 50 episodes across ten destinations. Read the arena, compete for transmitter chips and pair the regions to complete broadcasts. Short, playable lessons introduce new rules, and story scenes mark your journey to the final show.

Classic Story: Take on 50 score-based episodes with new tools, combo goals and chapter rivals.

Arcade Tour: Play three stages with fresh openings, rivals and objectives. After the first two stages, choose between two different next shows. Every result moves the tour forward, including a loss. Complete the tour to record your points and stars.

Daily Broadcast: Return for different pairs of goals, from creating and launching bonuses to collecting characters or using your tools. Replay today and six earlier broadcasts. Daily and Director's Cut challenges unlock as you progress.

Practice and Rehearsals: Try a practice duel with hints, learn through untimed rehearsals, or test the real ten-second broadcast window in an optional follow-on lesson.

Friend Duel: Create a private room and invite someone by code or link. Play on two iOS devices, or invite a friend using the web game. Both players need an internet connection.

MAKE YOUR NEXT TAKE COUNT

Revisit cleared Adventure episodes for optional replay medals. Choose a goal, read its full condition and work on your personal best. Earn stars and Studio rewards, then equip a new look for your next show.

Adjust music, sound, announcer voice, captions, motion and haptics. Solo modes work offline and require no app account. Resume a saved offline round or export your progress through Files and the share sheet.

The interface and announcer are in English.

name: Math Birthday
description:
Celebrate the numbers in your life. Enter a birth date to discover mathematical milestones measured in days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

• See every reached milestone and your three nearest upcoming milestones for free.
• Explore round numbers, powers, Fibonacci numbers, palindromes, and other patterns.
• Save profiles for people you want to celebrate, then filter results by unit or milestone status.

Math Birthday Premium is a one-time purchase. It unlocks the full upcoming timeline, lets you choose milestones for saved profiles, and adds reminder and bulk calendar options. Calendar and notifications are optional. You can explore without creating an account.

name: MathPath
description:
Math Path is a quiet math number puzzle for a spare five minutes.

Every row and column is an equation. Some numbers are clues, the rest are blank, and your job is to fill the gaps so every run is true. Tap a square, type a number, and watch the equation click into place.

The path runs for one thousand levels. It starts with addition and subtraction, moves through multiplication, and ends with division and longer equations. Difficulty rises at a steady pace, so the next step is always within reach.

Free to play:

- One thousand levels across Easy, Medium and Hard
- A daily challenge, the same grid for everyone
- A daily goal and a calendar, with a 40 coin reward
- Global, weekly and daily leaderboards
- Weekly leagues, from Bronze to Math Master
- Eight colour schemes, one free and seven with Pro
- Coins for hints, earned by playing
- Plays offline, with no account needed

One plan opens the rest:

- Every colour scheme
- Unlimited hints
- Double coins on every solve
- A Pro mark on the boards

Math Path is free to play. The plan and the coin packs are there for players who want more.

**One small sum at a time.**

name: Maze Mania Daily
description:
Grow your way through a garden of mazes.

Guide Sprout to Bloom with simple swipes. Collect the seeds, match each valve to its gate by shape, and slide across moss to find a route home.

• A shared daily maze, with fresh challenges every day
• Garden Path: 100 levels that introduce the garden one step at a time
• Practice mazes for a relaxed warm-up
• Unlimited undo for accidental swipes
• Stars for efficient routes—every finish still blooms
• A weekly flower garden that keeps your collection even when you take a break
• Shape-coded gates, patterned moss, readable paths and Reduce Motion support
• Spoiler-free results to share

No account is required. Progress stays on your device. An optional one-time Remove Ads purchase hides ad panels; Restore Purchases is available in the Garden shop. Every maze is playable without purchasing.

name: Mecanografía: Escribir Rápido
description:
Escribe más rápido en el teclado, para el trabajo, la escuela o desde cero. Un test te dice tu velocidad real en pulsaciones netas por minuto, y un plan te dice cuántos minutos al día necesitas para llegar a tu objetivo.

TU VELOCIDAD REAL, CON LOS ERRORES DESCONTADOS
Escribe un texto y al terminar ves tus pulsaciones netas por minuto: lo que escribiste menos una penalización por cada error. También ves tus errores y las palabras que escribiste mal, para saber qué corregir.

UN PLAN HASTA TU FECHA
Dinos tu objetivo de pulsaciones y una fecha (o 12 semanas si aún no la tienes). Con un test de 30 segundos calculamos dónde estás y dibujamos tu curva: cuándo llegarás al objetivo y cuántos minutos al día necesitas. El plan se ajusta con cada test que haces.

LECCIONES DESDE LA FILA GUÍA
Seis etapas: fila guía, fila superior, fila inferior, mayúsculas y tildes, números y signos, y textos reales. Cada lección usa solo las teclas que ya conoces y te dice con qué dedo va cada una.

CON TECLADO FÍSICO, COMO EN LA COMPUTADORA
Conecta un teclado a tu iPad o a tu iPhone y practica igual que en la computadora, con el mapa del teclado español (distribución de España) en pantalla. Sin teclado, practicas con el de la pantalla.

LA Ñ Y LAS TILDES FUNCIONAN
Ñ, tildes, diéresis, ¿ y ¡ se escriben y se cuentan bien, también con las teclas de acento de un teclado físico.

TEXTOS PARA PRACTICAR
Textos originales para practicar cada día, y artículos de la Constitución española, leyes españolas y clásicos de la literatura en español. También puedes pegar tu propio texto.

SABES DÓNDE FALLAS
Tu historial de tests y un mapa del teclado con las teclas que más te cuestan, para practicar justo lo que necesitas.

UN RECORDATORIO AL DÍA
Elige la hora y te avisamos para tu práctica diaria.

¿PREPARAS UNA OPOSICIÓN EN ESPAÑA?
Elige las reglas de tu examen y el test cuenta como el tribunal: pulsaciones brutas, errores y pulsaciones netas, con la penalización y el máximo de errores de tus bases. Y un simulacro de 10 o 15 minutos con el texto arriba y tu hoja abajo, sin ayudas en pantalla, como el día de la prueba.

GRATIS
- Un test al día
- Todas las lecciones de la fila guía
- Tu último resultado y tu plan
- Recordatorio diario

PRO
- Tests ilimitados
- Todas las lecciones
- Simulacro de examen de 10 y 15 minutos
- Historial y mapa de errores del teclado
- Constitución, leyes, clásicos y tus propios textos
- Cambiar tu objetivo, tu fecha o tu examen cuando quieras

TUS DATOS SE QUEDAN EN TU CELULAR
Sin cuenta, sin anuncios y sin analítica. Tus resultados se guardan en tu dispositivo.

Las reglas de cada examen se basan en sus bases publicadas. Esta app no tiene relación con ningún organismo convocante: comprueba siempre las bases de tu convocatoria.

El cargo de la renovación se hace en las 24 horas anteriores al final del periodo. name: Medieval War Castle Defense
description:
The siege has come. Hold the gate!

Medieval War Castle Defense is an offline medieval castle defense game where you play the hero. The archers and the catapult on your wall fight by themselves, tower defense style. You take the field in front of the gate, steer your hero into the thick of the fight and lead your army against every siege engine the enemy rolls up.

LEAD THE HERO
This is hero defense: drag to move, and your hero strikes whatever is closest. Start as the Knight: smash through a crowd with Shield Charge, spin a Whirlwind, then stun everything near with a War Cry. Raise your keep to call the Ranger, who tumbles, fans out arrows and marks foes for the kill, and the Mage, who freezes the field with Frost Nova, hurls Fireballs and brings down a Meteor Storm. Later each hero learns a third skill: the Battle Banner, the Snare Net or Chain Lightning.

COMMAND YOUR ARMY
Spend the gold you win in battle to send spearmen, swordsmen, archers and mounted knights out of the gate. One tap switches your army between Follow me, where they form up around your hero, and Hold the gate. Strategy matters: spears stop cavalry, knights break rams, and a mixed army fights harder than one kind alone.

BREAK EVERY SIEGE
Every castle siege brings something new: battering rams, ladder crews, shield walls, siege catapults, siege towers and sappers, and each needs a different answer. Before a wave starts you see what is coming and what beats it. Drag a Fire Volley onto the enemy, pour boiling oil on the gate and mount a ballista that shoots through a whole line.

TOPPLE GIANT BOSSES
A boss waits at the end of every region: Gorvak the Gatebreaker, Hessa the Pyre Queen, Ironhide the Siege Lord, Morcant the Black Knight and more. Learn their moves, step out of the slam and strike back. When a boss returns, it has learned a new trick.

WIN LOOT, FORGE YOUR GEAR
Bosses and their armies drop weapons, armor, helms and rings, from common to legendary, with effects that change how you fight: a Whirlwind that sets enemies on fire, a Frost Nova that freezes them in place. Upgrade your gear at the smithy and salvage what you don't need. Gear is never sold for money: you win every piece in battle.

UPGRADE AFTER EVERY WAVE
Between waves you pick your upgrades, and every pick counts. Troop lines fork: braced spears or a pike charge, fire arrows or piercing arrows. Raise your keep to unlock pikemen, crossbowmen, heavy knights, a watchtower and, at the very top, the Gate of Legends. While you are away, your mine digs gold and the ore cart brings it up to the keep.

A MEDIEVAL WAR WITHOUT END
Fight on through Green Meadow, Darkwood, Frostpeak Pass, Blackwater Marsh and the Ember Wastes, through blizzards, marsh fog and burning ground. New foes keep coming: halberdiers who stop any charge, war priests who heal, tunnellers who dig under the field and war boars that trample your lines. The weekly castle siege brings two new twists every week, and a daily order sets you a goal with a rare piece of gear as the prize.

PLAY OFFLINE, YOUR WAY
Medieval War Castle Defense plays offline, no internet needed. Waves are short, so a battle fits a quick break, and there is no energy to wait for. Ads are optional: watch one only when you want a bonus.

MADE BY ONE DEVELOPER
I'm a solo developer and I made Medieval War Castle Defense on my own. Got an idea for a new siege engine, boss or hero? Tell me in a review.

Part medieval tower defense, part hero defense, all medieval war: an offline TD where you hold the gate yourself. Raise the portcullis, lead the charge and defend the castle!

name: Meldom
description:
Meldom runs your coding agents on your Mac as long-lived chats over your tickets, notes and terminals. This app puts that Meldom on your phone.

• Sign in with your Meldom account and your Macs are there, ready to open. A pairing link or QR code from a Mac opens the app too.
• Read and answer your agents, review plans and permission requests, move tickets, open a terminal and look at files, from anywhere your Mac is reachable.
• When an agent asks you something, finishes, or fails, your phone shows the same notification as your Mac: the question, the project and the chat, with the sound you picked. Tap it to land in that chat.
• Notifications are end-to-end encrypted. Your Mac encrypts each one for this phone; Meldom's servers and the push services carry it without being able to read it.

Meldom needs the desktop app on a Mac. The app shows what your Macs share with it and stores nothing of your code.

name: MemoryTape: Cassette & Vinyl
description:
Turn your photos into CDs, records and mixtapes for your shelf. Send them to friends and they land on their home screen.

Snap a photo and MemoryTape presses it: a CD shining in a clear jewel case, a record sliding out of its sleeve, a cassette with reels that actually turn. Every one is a collectible.

CD, VINYL, CASSETTE
• Clear jewel cases, record sleeves, cassette cases
• Show your shelf with or without the cases
• Handwritten labels and that orange date stamp from the old days

THE DAILY
Once a day, at a random time, everyone gets the call at once. You have 2 minutes to shoot what's around you. Add a selfie and it sticks on the case like a sticker. Friends' dailies stay locked until you post yours.

FRIENDS
• Add friends by @username
• Friends see what you post automatically; set any post to "Only me"
• Their drops show up on your home-screen and lock-screen widgets
• React to what they send

GIF MODE
Shoot a 3-second moment: the disc stays still while the clip plays inside.

SOUND & SONGS
Record 10 seconds of the moment's sound and attach up to 5 songs (Apple Music previews). Open it later and the moment plays again.

MIXTAPE OF THE MONTH
Every month your tapes come together as a mixtape, J-card included.

SHARE TO STORIES
Post any tape to your Instagram Story, sound and all.

TURKEY PACKS
Arabesk, Yeşilçam and 90s Pop designs straight out of Turkish pop culture.

iCLOUD BACKUP
Back up your shelf to your own iCloud so your collection survives a new phone.

MEMORYTAPE PRO
• Extra cases and prints
• 45s
• Colored and splatter vinyl
• More cassette shell and label colors
• Arabesk, Yeşilçam and 90s Pop packs
• Unlimited friends (free: 3)
• Photo backgrounds for stories
Monthly, yearly or lifetime.

Drops are end-to-end encrypted, only your friends can open them. No ads, no tracking.

name: Meter Forecast: Annual Bill
description:
Get an estimate of whether you may owe money at the end of the year and whether your monthly payment looks high enough. Meter Tracker estimates your annual electricity, gas or water bill from your meter readings and your tariff, and shows how it got the number. Everything stays on your iPhone: no account, no ads, no subscription, no tracking.

AN ESTIMATE, NOT A PROMISE
Enter the prices and the monthly payment from your last bill, then add a reading now and then. For each meter the app shows the estimated back-payment or refund at the end of the billing period, for example "≈ €96 back-payment", with a range from other ways of measuring your use and a confidence label (low, medium or high, from how much of the period is already measured). It also shows a suggested monthly payment from now on and for the next period. "How we got this" lists every assumption: dates, readings used, prices and days, gas conversion, rounding. A forecast is only as good as your readings. It is information, not financial advice, and your supplier's bill is what counts.

BUILT AROUND GERMAN-STYLE BILLS
A billing period with its own start date, price changes on a date, base fee, prices with or without VAT, a bonus or credit, and the monthly payment (Abschlag) with 11 or 12 payments and changes over time. Gas: m³ to kWh with the calorific value and correction factor from your bill. Gas and heat use a seasonal profile until you have a year of your own readings. The same maths applies to any unit price, base fee and optional prepayments.

READINGS: TYPE OR SCAN
Type a reading or scan it. Scanning reads the number on the iPhone itself (Apple's text recognition, plus the app's own seven-segment reader) and shows how it read the number. It works best with clear digital displays; mechanical roller counters and dials are less reliable. You always check the number before it is saved, and typing is one tap away. You can also use a photo you already took, or read all meters of a property one after the other. Before saving, the app checks for a value lower than last time, a big jump, a counter that rolled over and a replaced meter.

OVERVIEW
One card per meter with the expected result, charts of the last 12 months (months partly estimated are drawn lighter and say so), cost so far and the payments made. Electricity, gas, cold and hot water, heat and other meters; several properties.

REMINDERS
An optional monthly reminder on the day and time you choose, and one on the last day of a billing period. At most one notification a day. Nothing is asked until you switch reminders on.

REPORTS AND YOUR DATA
A PDF report per billing period with the readings, cost by price, payments, the expected result with its range and all assumptions. CSV export and import (German or English format). One backup file with photos and a restore that can be undone. Files leave the app only through the share sheet, when you choose. The app makes no network requests. Backup and CSV files are not encrypted: keep them private. A backup of your whole iPhone (iCloud or computer) includes the app's data, like any app's.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no analytics. The camera is asked only when you tap Scan.

LANGUAGES
English and German; numbers and dates follow your iPhone.

NOT INCLUDED IN THIS VERSION
- Day/night (two-rate) meters, solar feed-in, tiered or time-of-use prices, oil tanks, heat cost allocators.
- Sharing between iPhones, widgets, live tariff comparison or supplier switching.

name: Meterology: GPS Light Meter
description: Meterology suggests a shutter speed and aperture for film and digital cameras from your location, the time of day and the current weather, or from a reading through the iPhone camera. The location reading estimates open outdoor light, so switch to the camera reading for shade, window light and indoor scenes. Choose your film to apply the long exposure correction its maker publishes, and choose your camera and lens so Meterology keeps to settings your gear can make. On Apple Watch, raise your wrist for a reading from location and weather, and keep your last exposure on the watch face.

name: MetrBayit: Room & Floor Plans
description:
Measure your space. Plan your home.

MetrBayit helps you create room plans, estimate internal floor area, and try furniture layouts in 3D. Build from dimensions on any supported iPhone, mark floor corners with guided camera measurement, or scan automatically on an iPhone with LiDAR.

PLAN YOUR SPACE
• Build rectangular or L-shaped rooms from entered dimensions.
• Trace a room outline over an image or PDF and calibrate it against a known length.
• Scan rooms with LiDAR, including multiple rooms in one continuous session.
• Edit corners, walls, doors, and windows.
• Explore schematic 3D views and measure between points in the model.

TRY FURNITURE AND LAYOUTS
• Choose from 150 editable furniture and accessory presets for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, offices, and outdoor spaces.
• Adjust dimensions, position, rotation, and finishes.
• Save alternative layouts and check furniture overlaps and clearances.
• Arrange separate room scans manually to create a home plan.

SHARE AND PREPARE
• Create PDF reports with plans, dimensions, notes, and optional photos or 3D views.
• Export DXF, SVG, and CSV files.
• Estimate paint and flooring quantities using the assumptions and prices you enter.
• Compare a wall with an external measurement and calibrate against a known length.
• Initial Bluetooth laser profiles and iOS keyboard-mode input are available for compatible meters. Physical device and firmware compatibility has not yet been verified.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
Scans, plans, notes, and photos stay on your device. MetrBayit does not operate a scan server or upload projects to its cloud. Save a local project file in Files or transfer it to another device when you choose. Purchases and purchase restoration are handled by Apple.

ENGLISH AND HEBREW
Choose your app language in Settings. Your own project names, notes, and furniture labels keep their original language. Dimensions are in meters and square meters; keyboard-mode laser input can convert supported length units.

FREE AND PRO OPTIONS
One basic project is included free. Advanced tools are available through a monthly or annual subscription or a one-time project unlock, subject to App Store availability. Apple's confirmation screen shows prices and terms before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple account settings. Viewing measurements and exporting a personal project file remain available without a subscription.

Automatic scanning requires a supported LiDAR iPhone. Guided camera measurement requires AR tracking and camera access. Building from dimensions needs no camera. Plans and areas are estimates, not certified surveys or registered property areas. Verify critical dimensions with a laser measure. Furniture geometry and illustrative wall thicknesses are schematic; clearance checks are not accessibility certification.

name: Metrivo – Unit Converter
description:
Metrivo converts everyday and technical units quickly and works completely offline. No internet connection, no account, no ads — your data never leaves your device.

• 16 categories, 144 units: length, mass, temperature, area, volume, speed, time, data, energy, power, pressure, force, torque, angle, fuel consumption and data transfer rate.
• Type like a calculator: 12×3+4, parentheses, scientific notation (1e3), fractions (1/2, 2 1/2). Percent works like a calculator: 100+10% = 110.
• Compound units: feet–inches, pounds–ounces, hours:minutes:seconds.
• Optional fraction results (nearest 1/64), marked with ≈ when approximate.
• Distinctions kept: US/imperial gallons, bits/bytes, MB/MiB, mechanical/metric horsepower.
• Exact math: conversion factors based on NIST definitions; no rounding in intermediate steps.
• Shoe, pants and top size guides for women and men.
• Search across all units and guides, favorites, optional history of your last 100 conversions, and CSV export.
• Copy and share; reorder or hide categories.
• Night Mint dark theme, light theme or follow system; large text and VoiceOver support.
• 13 languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German, French, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Indonesian and Arabic.
• iPhone and iPad, with a side-by-side layout on iPad.

name: MigraDossier: Visit Notes
description:
Bring your own records, with their gaps still visible.

MigraDossier helps you keep a dated record for a migraine-related visit. Record an episode's start, optional end, self-rated intensity, symptoms, actions and notes. Keep those original details together instead of turning them into a diagnosis.

- View episode days, explicitly recorded no-episode days and days with no record as three different states.
- Keep ongoing episodes open until you record an end; the app does not invent an end time.
- Edit or remove a saved record while keeping your diary under your control.
- Record a no-episode check deliberately; a missing day is never treated as clear.
- Choose a report date range and see both recorded coverage and unknown days.
- Count overlapping episode intervals once in the duration summary while retaining each original record.
- Include records that cross midnight, with the diary's recorded time zone made explicit.
- Preview a visit-notes PDF and share a CSV of the recorded data and coverage.

MigraDossier works offline without an account. It does not diagnose conditions, infer causes or treatment effects, recommend treatment, or replace professional care.

name: MiniScreen Remote Desktop
description:
MiniScreen puts your Mac's screen on your iPhone, so you can clear whatever is waiting for you from anywhere.

It's built for Macs that stay on, like a Mac running AI agents or long jobs. When a permission prompt, password dialog or sign-in page stops the work, open MiniScreen, see the screen and deal with it in seconds.

NO HELPER APP ON YOUR MAC
MiniScreen works with the Screen Sharing built into macOS. Turn it on and connect.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There are no accounts, servers, analytics or ads. Your screen travels only between your iPhone and your Mac, over your own Tailscale network. Your Mac password stays in your iPhone's Keychain, behind Face ID.

MADE FOR A PHONE
• Tap to click, and hold to right-click
• Hold and move to drag
• Pinch to zoom, and use two fingers to scroll
• A key row with Esc, Tab, Return, arrows, Command, Option, Control and Shift
• Paste from your iPhone
• Works at the Mac's lock screen
• Save several Macs

FREE TO USE
No subscription and no in-app purchases. There's a demo too, so you can try it before setting up your Mac.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Mac with Screen Sharing turned on
• Tailscale on your Mac and iPhone

MiniScreen isn't affiliated with Apple or Tailscale.

name: MirrorSage: Spiritual Guide
description:
Remember and reconnect with your higher self.

MirrorSage is a voice companion that listens and talks back. Powered by AI, love, light and the universe. Your guide appears as a figure of light inside an oval portal, answers in a soft voice, and always speaks as "we".

Choose your guide
Eight guides, one for each light: Ora the white light, and seven guides for the root, sacral, solar plexus, heart, throat, third eye and crown. Each has its own voice and its own way of seeing you.

Talk the way you like
• Type to your guide. Your first 15 messages are a gift.
• Talk face to face: press Speak, say what is on your heart, and hear the guide answer in a calm voice while the light moves with its words.
• "In your room" mode places the portal in front of your own camera view, so the guide stands with you.

Do the practice together
• Affirmations you say out loud with your guide
• Manifestation chants
• Tarot readings with the full 78-card deck
• Gentle words when you feel stuck, tired or lost

Make it yours
Name your guide, choose from a library of voices, change the pace and warmth of the voice, add an astral shimmer, and tune the light: warmth, brightness, presence, depth.

Your face as light (optional, one-time purchase)
Take one photo in the app and we paint you as a figure of light that resembles you. Your guide can then wear your light.

Minutes
Talking face to face uses minutes, sold in packs of 10, 30 and 100. One credit is one minute. There is no subscription.

Privacy
Your conversations are never sold and never used to train AI models. Delete your account and everything in it from inside the app at any time. Full details: mirrorsage.com/privacy

MirrorSage is for adults 18 and over. It is a space for reflection and encouragement, not medical, psychological or financial advice.

name: MiSpot
description:
MySpot makes managing your workplace easier, smarter and more connected.

Designed for modern businesses, MySpot brings desk booking, meeting room reservations, visitor management and workplace safety together in one easy-to-use app.

Whether you're working in the office, managing a team or welcoming visitors, MySpot helps everyone stay organised.

Key Features

Desk Booking
Find and reserve available desks in seconds. View your workplace layout, choose your preferred location and book ahead.

Meeting Room Booking
Check room availability and book meeting spaces directly through the app, with Microsoft Outlook integration.

Automatic Check-In
Make arriving at work effortless with location-based check-in, helping businesses understand workplace occupancy.

Visitor Management
Manage visitor arrivals, provide important health and safety information and maintain accurate visitor records.

Workplace Safety
Support emergency evacuations with accurate occupancy information and digital evacuation lists.

Workplace Insights
Help businesses understand workspace usage, desk occupancy and booking trends to make better decisions.

Microsoft 365 Integration
Enjoy secure, convenient access using your existing Microsoft 365 account.

One Workplace. One App. MySpot.

MySpot simplifies everyday workplace management, giving employees a better experience while helping businesses operate more efficiently.

name: ModelBoard — AI Leaderboards
description:
ModelBoard brings AI model leaderboards and benchmark results from across the ecosystem into one focused app.

Explore rankings and benchmark results from Arena, OpenRouter, Epoch AI, and Bug Hunt Bench. Browse each source in its own context, with source notes, methodology information, data dates, charts, tables, and available metrics.

ModelBoard helps you:

• Find a natural model for everyday assistance, writing, and research
• Explore coding and web development results before choosing a model
• Compare models for image understanding, long document analysis, image generation, and video generation
• Compare available information about cost and response speed
• Follow popular agent models when exploring AI assistants

Filter results by source, section, category, and available metric. Read explanations for each source and export supported views as images.

ModelBoard aggregates and presents results published by third-party sources. It does not create its own leaderboard, run benchmark evaluations, assign proprietary rankings, or combine different sources into a single score. Rankings, scores, benchmarks, model names, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

ModelBoard is free to download and use. No account, login, subscription, or in-app purchase is required.

name: Mood Days: Mood Journal
description:
Check in with two taps: pick how you feel, add what you did, done. Mood Days is a mood journal that keeps everything on your iPhone, shows you patterns with the numbers behind them, and costs nothing: no ads, no account, no subscription.

LOG IN TWO TAPS
• Five faces on the home screen: tap one, add activities (sport, friends, sleep …), save.
• Several entries a day, a note with a title, up to 3 photos per entry.
• Your own moods, emoji, colours and activity groups.

SEE PATTERNS, WITH THE COUNTS
• Average mood, always with the number of days and entries it is based on.
• Mood by day, week or month, by weekday and by month, a calendar and a Year in Pixels.
• For every activity: your mood with and without it, on the same day and on the next day, labelled "Clear difference", "Could be chance" or "No clear difference", with the counts. It shows what happened together, never why.
• Activities that often come together, goals such as "sport 3 times a week", days in a row.

YOUR DATA, YOUR FOLDER
• Automatic backup into a folder you choose, for example in iCloud Drive or On My iPhone, encrypted by default, at most once a day.
• A backup file, encrypted if you like, to move your journal to a new phone, iPhone or Android.
• CSV export of every entry and a PDF report for 7 days, 30 days, a month or a year.
• Switching from Daylio? Import its backup file or CSV export, with a preview and your choice of mood levels. Importing the same file again adds nothing.

QUIET BY DESIGN
• No sign-up and no questions at the first start.
• Reminders only if you turn them on. They say "How was your day?" and never show anything from your journal.
• Lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode; while locked the app is covered in the app switcher.
• Home Screen widget: tap a face to start an entry with that mood. Lock Screen widget: your streak, one tap to a new entry.
• 15 languages.

PRIVATE
Your journal stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no analytics; the app sends nothing anywhere. Backups go only where you put them. Like every app's data, it is part of your iPhone's own iCloud Backup when that is on.

Mood Days is a personal journal, not a medical device, and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. For medical advice, talk to a doctor or another healthcare professional. If you are struggling, talk to someone you trust.

name: Moonleaf: Lucid Dream Journal
description:
A dream journal for the moments before the memory fades.
Open a dim night page and write before the dream slips away.
In the morning, return to the words you kept.

Capture quietly
No questionnaire, required title, or tags before you write. The deep indigo night page keeps dim lavender ink and a dark keyboard for quiet night writing. Moonleaf adds no typing sounds or haptics and does not change your screen brightness.

One tap to the night page
Add Capture Dream to your Lock Screen or Control Center. Use a widget, Shortcuts, or the Action button on a supported iPhone. Device unlock and optional app lock still apply. The app icon opens capture from 10 p.m. to 10 a.m. by default. You can change those hours.

Keep the words you have
Write offline. Moonleaf saves each text change locally and keeps recovery drafts until a completed entry is saved. Return in the morning to add a title, tags, or more detail. Search titles, dream text, and tags. Combine tag filters to find a particular memory. Read earlier versions or restore a deleted dream without a time limit. If edits on two devices differ, both versions stay available for you to review.

Your notebook stays private
No Moonleaf account, ads, tracking, or analytics. No AI reads your dreams. Moonleaf does not interpret them. Turn on the free Face ID app lock, with device-passcode fallback. Completed entries sync through your own private iCloud database when available. Unfinished drafts stay on the device. Local saving works without iCloud.

Keep a copy, free
Export your full notebook as Markdown. Save a JSON backup with earlier versions and deleted entries. Preview and restore a Moonleaf backup at no charge. Files you share can be read by their recipients. iCloud sync does not replace a separate backup.

A quiet morning reminder
Choose one optional daily reminder. Its message contains no dream text. Leave it off whenever you prefer.

Moonleaf Pro: one-time purchase
One optional purchase adds Patterns, new custom tags, and Moss and Rose palettes. See recurring tags, people and places you have tagged, lucid streaks, and nights remembered. Counts come from your entries and tags. They are not interpretations or lucid-dream training.

Unlimited entries, editing, search, fixed tags, Face ID lock, iCloud sync, capture controls, reminders, export, backup, and restore are free. Pro has no subscription.

Support
Need help with your notebook? Email adeshpandey836@gmail.com.

name: Morse Code: Translator & Key
seller_name: ITWORKED YAZILIM IC VE DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Translate, send and learn Morse code in one calm, focused app. No ads, no account.

TRANSLATE BOTH WAYS, LIVE
Type text and see the Morse as you type. Paste dots and dashes and read the text. The app works out the direction by itself and accepts · − and the other look-alikes people paste. Copy or share the result in one tap.

PLAY IT THREE WAYS
• Sound: a clean tone with exact timing
• Vibration: feel the rhythm in your hand (Pro)
• Flashlight: flash your message with the phone's light (Pro)
Each character lights up on screen as it plays.

TAP KEY WITH LIVE DECODING
Tap for a dot, hold for a dash, and watch your Morse turn into letters, or let the key follow your own rhythm. A sidetone plays while you press. Pro adds sending drills that score every word you key.

LEARN WITH THE KOCH METHOD
Start with just two characters at full speed. Short listening rounds add a new character every time you reach 90%. Your characters, scores and daily streak are saved on your phone. Farnsworth spacing gives you time to think while each letter still sounds right.

FULL REFERENCE CHART
Letters, numbers, punctuation and prosigns such as SOS, AR and SK. Search the chart and tap any character to hear it.

FREE AND PRO
Free, for good: the translator with sound, the reference chart, the tap key with live decoding, and the first 10 Koch lessons (K M U R E S N A P T) at 10 to 25 WPM.
Morse Code Pro adds:
• The full Koch course: all 41 letters, numbers and signs
• Every speed from 5 to 40 WPM
• Flashlight and vibration playback
• Sending drills on the tap key
• Stats for every character you learn
Pro is a one-time Lifetime purchase, or a yearly subscription. The yearly plan renews automatically until you cancel; cancel anytime in your account settings at least 24 hours before the period ends. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
Light and dark mode, large text support and screen reader labels. Works offline.

Great for scouts, ham radio and CW beginners, puzzle and escape room fans, and anyone curious about the code that started it all.

Not for emergencies: in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: My Branch: Plant Care
description:
A little care, a greener home.

My Branch keeps your houseplants, photos and care reminders together. Add a plant yourself or identify it with AI. If a photo includes several plants, choose the ones to analyze and review each result before saving.

Your own garden
Give each plant a name, choose its room and add a photo. Set local reminders to check the soil or feed your plant. Record care, postpone it or pause reminders. Always check the soil before watering: reminders do not measure moisture. Your garden and history stay on your device.

Get to know your plants
Explore 42 sourced facts about six catalog species, available offline in English, Russian, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Korean. Discover their native habitats, botanical history and growing habits. Additional AI facts may be inaccurate.

Refine an identification
Does the result look wrong? Describe what you noticed and ask AI to reconsider the photo. Add another clue if needed, then decide whether to apply the result. Your plant's saved name and care schedule stay in place.

Follow their progress
Save photo health checks with dates, observations and suggested next steps. A new check can use summaries of the last three saved checks; it does not re-examine the older photos. A photo assessment cannot rule out hidden problems.

Free to start
Manual plants, local reminders and the offline catalog are free, with no plant-count limit. Each verified profile includes three successful AI identifications or corrections in total. Each selected plant uses one credit when its analysis succeeds. Finding plants in the frame and failed analyses do not use these three credits. Plus adds further identification, corrections and photo health checks.

AI allowances
All AI features, including Plus, share a limit of 10 requests per rolling hour and 100 per calendar month. Finding plants, analyzing each selected plant and each correction are separate requests. A dispatched request can count even if it fails; continuing the same interrupted request does not count twice. Remaining usage is shown in the app.

You choose what to share

name: MyCollage: Photo Collage
description:
Make collages and Instagram slices from your photos, right on your iPhone or iPad.

COLLAGES
• Pick up to 20 photos or clips. MyCollage lays them out at once.
• 90+ layouts, previewed with your own photos. Auto fit matches photo shapes.
• Drag the lines between photos to resize. Set spacing, margin, corners and a frame.
• Sizes for Instagram post, portrait 4:5, feed 3:4, Stories, and print.
• Shaped cells: circle, heart, star, hexagon, arch, or a word.
• Curved text in 18 fonts, stickers, backdrops, filters and on-device cut-outs.
• Apple Pencil drawing on iPad.

PHOTO SLICER
• Cut one photo into pieces for a swipeable carousel or a big picture on your profile grid.
• Choose pieces across and down, and the shape of each piece: 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 9:16 or your own.

name: MyK® Control Panel
description:
MyK® Control Panel is the account app for customers of SAUDI GULF HOSTiNG. Manage everything you own with us from your phone.

One menu, three parts
Account: your overview, invoices, support and profile.
Products: all your services grouped into 17 product families, from SSL certificates and email security to website hosting, cloud servers and website builders.
Hosting Tools: 48 everyday tools in seven groups, plus One-Click Install with more than 80 applications.

Live reports
See storage, bandwidth, visits, peak times and how your site served its visitors, refreshed automatically.

Support, always close
Open and follow tickets, read the knowledge base, check service status and find your support code. Our teams work 24/7, Monday to Sunday, all year round.

Secure by design
Unlock the app with Face ID or your fingerprint each time you open it. Sign out from the last section of the Account menu whenever you wish.

Your language, your look
Full English and Arabic support with a complete right to left layout. Choose a light, dark or automatic appearance.

SAUDI GULF HOSTiNG is an enterprise of Company Kanz AlKhaleej AlArabi.

name: MyPass Scanner app
description:
MyPass Scanner is the official ticket check-in app for the MyPass events platform, built for gate staff and event organisers.

Point the camera at the QR code on a ticket and, within a second, the app tells you whether it is valid, already used, or belongs to another show. No special hardware needed: your phone is enough.

Fast scanning that keeps the queue moving
• Valid tickets flash green with the seat number, and the camera is ready for the next one right away.
• Distinct vibration and sound for refused tickets, so nothing slips past.
• A shift counter: accepted, refused and total.

No ticket gets in twice
• Every ticket can be used once, even if two devices scan it at the same moment.
• Scanning a used ticket shows when it entered and which staff member checked it in.
• Clear warning when a ticket is for a different show or day.

All your events in one place
• Only the events and shows assigned to your account.
• Today's shows first, with live attendance for each show.
• "Continue scanning" takes you straight back to the last show you worked on.

Works in real conditions
• Manual ticket-number entry when a code is damaged or unreadable.
• Torch for dark venues, and front/back camera switch.
• A dark interface that is easy on the eyes at the gate.

Secure one-code sign-in
Gate staff receive a private access code from the event organiser through the MyPass dashboard. No sign-up, no passwords, and the organiser can disable any code at any time.

Note: this app is for staff authorised by event organisers on MyPass. To buy tickets, visit mypass.om.

name: Nanoq Intranet
description:
Nanoq Intranet brings your workplace's Nanoq intranet to your phone. The app requires that your employer uses Nanoq Intranet – you connect your phone by scanning a QR code on the intranet.

ALERTS THAT GET THROUGH
Storms, power cuts or a closed harbour: alerts arrive as push notifications – also through Focus on iPhone – and you acknowledge them with one tap, even offline.

EVERYTHING IMPORTANT ON YOUR PHONE
Messages and group messages, news, notifications, shifts and absence, tasks, events, knowledge base, contacts and file library – with the number of unread items on the app icon.

WORKS WITHOUT A CONNECTION
In the mountains, at sea or in a settlement: the most important content is kept on your phone, encrypted. Report an incident with photos, clock in and out and acknowledge alerts – it is sent when you are online again.

SHARE FROM OTHER APPS
Share photos, files and links straight from your phone's Share menu to messages, the wall, photos or the file library.

SECURE
Lock the app with Face ID, fingerprint or passcode. No tracking and no ads. Your data stays on your own intranet.

In Danish, Greenlandic and English.

Nanoq Intranet is made by Arctic IT in Sisimiut, Greenland.

name: Nasaq Mail | بريد نسق
description:
Nasaq Mail brings your company email into a clear, fast inbox — built for Arabic from day one.

• Outlook-style inbox with folders and fast search
• Instant notifications for new mail
• Download attachments and attach files in one tap
• Rich editor and ready-made HTML templates
• Optional read tracking for sent messages
• Multiple mailboxes on one device — switch in a tap
• Works with Nasaq Mail, Hostinger, Titan, Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and any IMAP server
• Remote images blocked by default to stop tracking
• Full Arabic (right-to-left) and English interface

By Nasaq Studio — studionasaq.com

name: Neon Arcade: Play & Earn
description:
Your arcade, wherever you play.

Neon Arcade brings 27 games together in one app, from racing and action to billiards, chess, pinball and puzzles. The games are bundled with the app, so you can enjoy guest play without an internet connection.

FIND YOUR NEXT GAME
Browse the collection, search for a favourite and keep your picks close at hand. Try Neon Racing, Neon Runner, Cyber Siege, Neon Billiards, Nova Pinball and more. Play short reflex challenges or settle into a board game.

KEEP YOUR RECORDS
Guest records, favourites and settings stay on your device. Sign in with your existing Neon Arcade account to use shared records and eligible online leaderboards. Account-linked offline results can sync after you reconnect and sign in again. Offline results do not automatically earn reward Points.

POINTS, WITH CLEAR RULES
Eligible adult players can view their confirmed Points and the available gift-card catalogue. Rewards depend on country, age, availability, Fair Play checks and manual approval. Gift cards are never guaranteed. In this release, reward requests are read-only inside the app; there is no in-app redemption action. No purchase is required, and Points cannot be purchased, transferred or cashed out. Apple is not a sponsor of Neon Arcade or its rewards.

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE AND TABLET
Use per-game portrait or landscape play, optional sound and haptics, and a clear exit control. Guest play needs no account. Online account features require internet access. The app contains no ads, in-app purchases or tracking SDKs.

Account deletion is available from Settings. Read the mobile privacy policy at https://neonarcade.gg/privacy/mobile/ and get help at https://neonarcade.gg/support/.

Made by Vortaxis Studio.

name: Nepali Unicode Keyboard
description:
Nepali Unicode Keyboard lets you type Nepali in any app on your iPhone, the way you already type.

ROMANIZED TYPING
Type Nepali with English letters and get Unicode Devanagari. "namaste" becomes नमस्ते, "dherai ramro" becomes धेरै राम्रो. Suggestions above the keys come from a built-in Nepali word list, so common words come out right even when you spell them loosely. A typing guide in the app shows what to type for each letter.

TRADITIONAL LAYOUT
Prefer the traditional Nepali Unicode layout? Switch to it once and it stays. Shift characters show as small hints on each key, and a long press types them. Vowel signs join correctly, so अ + ा gives आ, not अा.

MADE FOR NEPAL
• Dates: type "aaja", "bholi" or a date like 2026-10-21 and get the Bikram Sambat date: २०८३ कार्तिक ४, बुधबार
• Amounts: 1500000 becomes १५,००,००० or पन्ध्र लाख, and "ru 500" becomes पाँच सय रुपैयाँ मात्र for cheques
• Land and gold: "5 aana" shows (१,७११ वर्ग फिट); ropani, bigha, kattha, tola and grams too

WRITE BY HAND
Prefer writing? Tap the pen and write Nepali with your finger. Handwriting is off until you turn it on (see privacy below).

ALSO INCLUDED
• Nepali and English on one keyboard: the flag key switches between English and your Nepali style
• Nine themes, including Himalaya, Lali Gurans and Midnight, or System to follow light and dark mode; turn off key borders for flat keys
• Devanagari numbers (०–९), the danda । and ॥
• Emoji panel with your recently used emoji first
• Clipboard history: your recent copies and pinned items, kept on your iPhone
• Three key heights: Short, Normal and Tall
• VoiceOver reads out the keys and suggestions
• App in English or Nepali

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This keyboard never sends what you type anywhere, and it doesn't save your typing. Typing, suggestions and emoji work with Full Access off. Full Access is needed only for clipboard history (iOS hides the clipboard from keyboards without it) and for downloading the handwriting model. In password fields, iOS always uses Apple's keyboard. If you turn on handwriting, Google's ML Kit downloads the model and sends Google usage diagnostics (not what you write).

No ads. No sign-in. Free and open source.

Questions or a word the keyboard gets wrong? Use "Send feedback" in the app's settings.

name: NetSom Hotel
description:
NetSom Hotel is the mobile companion to the NetSom hotel management system. It gives hotel
managers and staff real-time control of daily operations from anywhere in the property.
FOR HOTEL MANAGERS
- Live dashboard: occupancy rate, in-house guests, check-ins, check-outs, revenue and
outstanding balance
- Rooms: floor-by-floor view with occupancy and cleaning status, room calendar and
categories
- Bookings: guest movements, pre-bookings, guests, companies and group invoices
- Payments: record guest payments and track balances
- Reports: ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and revenue breakdown by room, restaurant, hall and
services
- Approvals, amenities, floors and services management
FOR HOUSEKEEPERS
- Shift dashboard with today's cleaning progress
- Assigned rooms checklist with one-tap Dirty / In Progress / Clean updates
- Maintenance alerts per room
LAUNDRY
- Laundry orders, catalog, customers, payments and reports
- Order status tracking: Collected, In Progress, Ready, Delivered
Your hotel's logo and brand colors load automatically after you sign in.
NetSom Hotel requires an account provided by your hotel's NetSom administrator. For access
or support, contact info@netsom.so.

name: New Covenant Church NJ
description:
Official app of New Covenant Church, Plainfield, NJ.

New Covenant is a Spirit-filled church on East 7th Street with a family from more than twenty-five nations. This app keeps you close to that family all week, wherever you are.

HOME
- A countdown to the next service: Sundays at 9:00 and 11:00 AM. On special Sundays with one service at 10:00 AM, the app shows it with a gold star.
- The verse of the day, ready to share.
- Announcements when the church posts them, this week's gatherings and the latest message.

WATCH
- Watch Sunday services live and play recent messages right in the app.
- Allow notifications and the app tells you automatically when the service goes live.

BIBLE
- Read Scripture in the English and Spanish versions provided through the YouVersion Platform.
- Highlight in four colors, bookmark, write notes and share a verse as an image.
- Pick up where you left off.

EVENTS
- Weekly gatherings and special events from the church calendar.
- Special Sundays are starred, straight from the church's website.
- Set a reminder for any event, add it to your calendar or get directions. Works offline.

SERMON NOTES
- Follow the message with notes, scriptures that open in the Bible and blanks to fill in as you listen.
- Your answers and your own notes stay on your phone.

WELCOME ON ARRIVAL
- Turn on an optional greeting and the app says hello when you arrive at the church. Your location never leaves your phone.

GIVE
- Learn how your generosity feeds neighbors, reaches children and students and carries the Gospel. Giving opens the church's secure giving page in Safari.

MORE
- Plan your first visit, explore ministries, meet our leaders and read what we believe.
- Send a prayer request or a connect card. It goes securely to the church office through the church's own website.

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
- Every screen of the app is available in English and Spanish. Church information appears in Spanish as the church publishes it.
- NCC en Español, a Spanish-language service, is coming soon. Tap Keep me posted to hear when it starts.

ALSO
- Home Screen widgets for the verse of the day and the next service.
- Made for every iPhone, including both displays of iPhone Duo.
- No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: nextasks app
description:
nextasks for iPhone and iPad is the app for nextasks, the self-hosted task app for families and small groups. nextasks is free and open source. The app also works entirely on its own: "On this iPhone" needs no server and no account.

ORGANISE
• Spaces like "Private" or "Family", with lists in their own colour and symbol, and sections inside a list
• Show a list as rows or in columns
• Collections: Today, Scheduled, All, Marked, Assigned to me, Completed
• Search across everything, and a trash for what you deleted

TASKS
• Quick entry that understands "milk tomorrow 9am #shop !!": date, time, tags and priority in one line
• Due dates with a time, repeats, and a reminder when you arrive at or leave a place
• Subtasks, priority, marking, a link and photos
• A note with formatting: headings, lists, checkboxes, bold and italic, photos

TOGETHER, WITH A NEXTASKS SERVER
• Share a space with your family or group, and assign tasks to people
• Notifications when someone assigns you a task or a task is due
• Several servers side by side, next to the tasks on this iPhone
• Everything works without a connection on the copy on the device and syncs when you are back online

IPHONE AND IPAD
• A Today widget to tick tasks off
• Siri and Shortcuts: add a task, show today
• Share a link or text from another app, and it becomes a task
• On the iPad a sidebar, the details in a column beside the list, and drag and drop
• Lock the app with Face ID

Start without a server: your tasks stay on this iPhone. To connect a nextasks server, scan the QR code from its web app.

No account with us, no analytics, no advertising.

name: Nextslide
description:
Nextslide turns your iPhone and Apple Watch into a remote for presentations on your Mac. It controls Microsoft PowerPoint and Apple Keynote.

NEXT, BACK, JUMP
One big button moves forward, a smaller one goes back. Tap the slide number to see all slides as previews and jump straight to the one you want. Start and end the slide show from your iPhone, from the beginning or from the current slide.

NOTES YOU CAN ACTUALLY READ
Your speaker notes appear large and structured on your iPhone. Nextslide highlights timings like [2:00] and headings in capital letters. Adjust the text size with A− and A+.

A PODIUM ON YOUR IPAD
On iPad you see the current and next slide next to your full-height notes, in landscape or portrait. A keyboard or Bluetooth presenter moves through your slides with the arrow keys, space bar or Page Up and Page Down.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
The current slide, the total, a preview of the next slide and a timer that starts at zero when the slide show begins.

ON YOUR WRIST
On Apple Watch, tap or turn the Digital Crown to move through your slides. The watch connects to your Mac directly over Bluetooth or through your iPhone. Notes and timer are there too.

BLACK AND WHITE
One tap turns the screen black or white, another brings the slide back.

NO SHARED WI-FI NEEDED
Nextslide connects over Bluetooth or directly from device to device. You don't need a shared Wi-Fi network, not even in a conference room.

HOW IT WORKS
Install "Nextslide for Mac" from the Mac App Store. It sits quietly in the menu bar and shows a four-digit code. Enter it once on your iPhone, and from then on your devices connect on their own.

Nextslide is free and collects no data. No account, no ads, no server.

PowerPoint is a trademark of Microsoft. Nextslide is not affiliated with Microsoft.

name: Nightpage: Dream Journal Diary
seller_name: ITWORKED YAZILIM IC VE DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Dreams fade within minutes of waking. Nightpage is a calm, private dream journal that catches them before they go.

TELL IT, DON'T TYPE IT
One big button on the morning screen. Tap it and say what you remember, still half asleep. Your phone turns speech into text on the device itself, so your voice is never sent to a server. Prefer typing? That works too.

A JOURNAL THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Give each dream a title, a date and a mood. Mark lucid dreams. Add the people, places and symbols that keep coming back: the app suggests ones you have used before and spots common symbols in what you wrote.

SEE THE PATTERNS
Search every dream by word, person, place or symbol. Your morning streak and lucid count are always there; Pro Insights adds your last week, your moods, and your most common symbols, people and places.

A DREAM DICTIONARY, NO AI
Curious about dream interpretation the old-fashioned way? Look up more than 60 common dream images (15 free, all with Pro), from water and snakes to falling teeth and missed trains. Each entry retells, in a few lines, what folklore and old dream books have said about it. No predictions, no psychology claims, no chatbot: just the old readings, for you to make of them what you like.

A GENTLE MORNING REMINDER
Turn on a daily morning reminder (pick your own time with Pro), so writing your dreams becomes a habit. It is scheduled on your phone; no server sends it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking
• Your journal and your voice never leave your phone, and it works offline. The app only sends a random install ID and app opens to our analytics service, plus the purchase record if you buy Pro
• Back up everything as a JSON file and import it again on a new phone (readable text export with Pro)

NIGHTPAGE PRO (OPTIONAL)
Writing, dictation, the timeline and search are free, with no limits. Pro adds the full symbol dictionary, Insights (patterns, moods, recurring people, places and symbols), a Face ID lock, readable text export, color themes and a custom reminder time. Choose yearly (with a 7-day free trial), monthly, or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage them in your store account settings.

Light and dark mode, large text support, and a calm night-to-dawn look made for the first minutes of your day.

Terms: https://itworkedsystems.com/dream-journal/terms
Apple's standard license agreement applies on the App Store: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Nikkanji
description:
Nikkanji is a daily Japanese habit for people who live with the language: at home, at work and around town. Each day it puts together a short session that mixes the reviews that are due with a little new material, so you keep moving without cramming.

WHAT YOU GET
- Today: your daily set of reviews and new items, sized to the minutes you have.
- Spaced repetition for kana, kanji, words and grammar, with honest Again and Good grading and no points to chase.
- A course from kana to N5 and beyond, with lessons that check what you have learned.
- Listening with natural voices: dictation, minimal pairs, karaoke and quick gist clips.
- Speaking practice: say it out loud, shadow sentences and get feedback on what you said.
- Talk: practise real conversations, from ordering at a restaurant to a chat with neighbours.
- Missions and Tonight: prepare the phrases for something you have coming up, like a dinner or an appointment.
- Capture: photograph Japanese text or a sign and save the words you want to learn.
- Library: grammar notes, kanji with stroke order, and graded reading with furigana.

SUBSCRIPTION
Nikkanji is a subscription in the app: Nikkanji Monthly or Nikkanji Yearly, or the Gohesive Bundle Monthly or Yearly, which also includes FilmClub and Flash Cards. New subscribers start with a 1-week free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://nikkanji.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://nikkanji.com/privacy

name: North: Decide on Purpose
description:
You left work. The decision came home.

North is a private space for the decisions that shape your life and work: a bigger role, more time away, a hard conversation you keep putting off. North doesn't decide for you. It asks good questions, helps you see what really matters, and helps you follow through.

TAKE A CLARITY BREAK
Bring a decision in a sentence, or say it out loud. North asks why it matters, then what your next move is. In two minutes you have a choice you can explain, to your team and to yourself.

KEEP YOUR REASONS WITH YOUR CHOICE
Every confirmed choice is saved with the reasons behind it. When you look back, you see what you knew at the time, not just what happened.

FOLLOW THROUGH
North checks back on the day you choose. Mark it done, not yet, or change of plan, right from your lock screen. Pass a decision on to someone and North reminds you to check in.

HELP ME DO THIS
North drafts the message, the checklist or the first sentence of a hard conversation. You check it, change it, and send it yourself. North never sends, books or buys anything for you.

TALK TO NORTH
Think out loud with North. Replies come from an AI model, and you can let North use the things you've approved in My North, or not.

DECISION BRIEF
Each morning, see what's due to revisit, what's waiting on someone else, and, if you allow it, which of today's meetings hold a decision. Your calendar is read on your iPhone and stays there.

APPLE WATCH
Clarity Rings for Pause, Choose and Reflect, and your next move on your wrist.

YOUR CONTROL
• Your words first. Nothing is remembered unless you approve it.
• Voice is turned into words on your iPhone; audio isn't recorded or kept.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Export or delete everything, any time, from inside the app.

North is for reflection and planning. It does not replace professional medical, legal, financial or mental health advice.

Free during the beta. Sign in with Apple or Google.

name: Notebook War
description:
جهّز جيشك، اختر ورقتك، وهدّ بيت خصمك قبل لا يهدّ بيتك!

Notebook War لعبة استراتيجية بالأدوار مستوحاة من لعبة كنا نرسمها على الورق: خريطة بنصها نهر، جيش بكل جهة، والفايز اللي يوصل لبيت الثاني ويهدّه أول.

◆ جهّز جيشك
عندك ميزانية محددة تشتري فيها قواتك وتوزعها بمنطقتك. خصمك ما يشوف تجهيزك إلا لما تبدأ الحرب.

◆ ورقة من ثلاث
بداية كل دور تختار ورقة من ثلاث مقلوبة، فيها حركة أو حركتين أو 3 حركات… وأحياناً ورقة خاصة: غارة جوية، تصليح، تموين، هجوم خاطف، أو مظليين.

◆ 7 أنواع قوات
• المشاة: رخيصة وتسبح بالنهر، وإذا وصلت البيت تهدّ نصه بضربة
• الدبابة: تتحمل وتضرب أي شي داخل حدودها
• المدفعية: تضرب من بعيد
• الطيارة: تقصف أي مكان بالخريطة وترجع مكانها
• مضاد الطيران: يصيد الطيارات ويحمي اللي حوله
• السفينة الحربية: تقصف من النهر… بس ضربة وحدة تغرقها
• المتراس: يسد الطريق على خصمك

◆ أرض تفرق
الجسور هي الطريق الوحيد للدبابات، الغابة تحمي اللي داخلها، والصخور تسد الطريق. وكل مباراة بخريطة جديدة.

◆ الحرب تشتد
صناديق إمدادات تنزل بالنص، ضربات قوية، غنيمة على كل قطعة تدمرها، ومن الجولة العاشرة كل الضربات تصير أقوى.

◆ العب مثل ما تحب
• ضد الكمبيوتر (سهل أو عادي)، وتشوف كل حركة يسويها قبل لا يتحرك
• أو مع أخوك وربعك على نفس الجهاز
• تشتغل على الآيفون والآيباد، بالطول وبالعرض
• تشتغل بدون إنترنت

من JOOLAH STUDIO.

name: Novebar – find great espresso
description:
Novebar helps you find an espresso true to the Italian standard near you, and share your finds with the community.

A SCORE OUT OF 100, CRITERION BY CRITERION
Each review rates six observable criteria: amount, temperature, crema, aroma, balance and body. A venue's score is the average of its published reviews and becomes reliable from 3 reviews. With 80/100 and at least 3 reviews, a venue becomes a "reference espresso".

RATE IN 30 SECONDS
• Novebar lists the venues around you: tap the one you are in
• Six criteria in a few taps, plus quick tags (well balanced, proper cup, capsule machine…)
• A comment, the price you paid and, if you like, a photo of your cup
• Venue missing? Add it

FIND WHERE TO GO
• Map and list of venues around you
• Search by name or address from the very first letter
• Directions with Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze
• Optional notifications when a reference espresso appears within 30 km

A WELL-KEPT COMMUNITY
• Reviews translated in one tap into English, French or Italian
• Photos checked before they are published
• Reporting, user blocking and moderation within 24 hours

THE ESPRESSO GUIDE
Seven simple markers of what you are entitled to expect: the cup, the amount (25 to 35 ml), the crema, the heat, the aroma, the body and the balance.

YOUR PRIVACY
No ads, no ad trackers, no data resale. Sign in with a simple code sent by email, no password. Delete your account at any time from the app.

The score measures perceived compliance with the standard of an Italian espresso. Novebar is independent and is not affiliated with INEI or IEI.

name: NowThen
description:
NowThen is a rephotography camera. Place an old photo — from a family album, an archive or a postcard — over the live camera view, line up the edges of the buildings, and take the same shot today. You get a “then and now” pair that shows how the place has changed.

PRECISE ALIGNMENT
• A semi-transparent overlay across the whole preview — move, scale and rotate it with your fingers.
• A fine-tune panel for small corrections of position, scale and rotation.
• Lock: once aligned, gestures go back to the camera (zoom, focus) and the overlay stays put.
• Compare modes: blend, split (a line dividing old and new), edges of the old photo, black & white, invert.
• Level and 3×3 grid.

LENSES AND ZOOM
• Switch between the iPhone's lenses and zoom, with the equivalent focal length in mm — old photos were often taken from far away.
• Portrait and landscape, left-handed layout.

PLACES AND FRAMES
• A place (e.g. a church) holds several frames — each with its own old photo, overlay settings and zoom. Everything saves automatically.
• Photos go to the Photos app, into a separate album for each place.
• A gallery for every frame: all the “now” photos, split compare, sharing.
• Back up your places to a ZIP file when you switch phones.

BACK TO THE PHOTOGRAPHER’S VANTAGE POINT
• The app records where a photo was taken from and in which direction (position, lens bearing).
• Guide to vantage point: an arrow and the distance to the spot you shot from, with a route in Apple Maps.

FREE AND PRO

Who is it for?
Local historians, history and architecture enthusiasts, chroniclers, photographers — anyone who wants to show how their surroundings have changed.

name: ODD TAROT - Tarot Card Reading
description:
This isn't tarot you shuffle with a button. Rub the cards with your fingers, spread them in a fan, pull one up and flip it.

■ Shuffle by hand
Put a finger on the cards and rub. They slide and turn. Shake your phone and they mix too. That's where reversed cards come from.

■ Pick from the fan
Gather the cards and they open into a fan. Tap one and it rises. Drag it to its place and it flips. One card, three cards (past · present · future), or Do or Wait (one of two).

■ What the card says
A short text appears under each card. With three, one more that reads them together. Love, work, money, self: the words change with each. All the writing for the 22 cards lives inside the app, so it works offline.

■ Ask about your situation
Write a question before you draw and the first reading is written for it, with a bar showing which way the cards lean. After reading, write your situation and the same cards are read against it. No repeating, no verdicts, and the last line names what the cards can't tell you. These answers are written by AI. Three times per reading.

■ Keep it as one photo
Date, topic, cards and words on a single sheet. Save it to Photos or send it to a friend. Past readings stay in the app.

■ Lay your iPad flat
A wide table in landscape. Set it in front of a friend and shuffle. On iPhone, portrait in one hand.

■ Price
Download and one-card readings are free. Three cards, Do or Wait, Save as photo and Ask come with one pass. Buy once, no subscription.

■ Stays on your device
No account. Your cards and readings stay on your phone. Only what you write for the AI passes through our server to get an answer, and it isn't stored. No ads, no analytics.

Art by oddbbo. Meanings follow the common reading of the Waite-Smith tarot (1909). Readings are for reflection and fun, not a basis for health, money or legal decisions.

Off Hours is the live guide to Nashville's happy hours, late-night kitchens and food and drink specials.

LIVE NOW

PLAN YOUR NIGHT IN ONE LINE

TONIGHT'S CRAWL

A LIVE MAP OF EVERY NEIGHBORHOOD
See where the deals are by neighborhood, from Downtown and the Gulch to East Nashville, Germantown and 12 South. Tap Near me to sort by walking distance.

EVERY VENUE, ONE TAP AWAY
Open now or closed, the deal on today, the whole week at a glance, plus directions, reservations, a ride, or a call.

BROWSE BY CRAVING
Tacos, wings, oysters, burgers, pizza, sushi, brunch, margaritas, late night and more.

SHARE A CRAWL
Send any plan to friends or post it to your story with a ready-made image.

No account. No ads tracking you. Just the city, off the clock.

Off Hours lists bars and alcohol deals and is for adults 21 and over. Please drink responsibly. Deals change; call ahead if you're going just for the deal.

name: One or Many
description:
Is it "the cars is" or "the cars are"? One or Many is a swipe game that makes English singular and plural agreement automatic, so the right word comes out on its own when you're speaking, not just on a worksheet.

How it works
Every card is a sentence with one word missing. Swipe left for the singular form (one) or right for the plural form (many). Right answers score points, and fast right answers score the most: a speed bonus drains while you think, and streaks multiply your points up to ×3.

Learn from every miss
Miss a card and it comes back with the real subject highlighted and a one-line reason, like "The subject is the box, not the chocolates." Then you swipe it the right way, so the last thing your hands do is the correct move. Missed sentences go to the Fix-it pile and come back over the next days until they're right and fast three times in a row.

Eight levels, from easy to tricky
• One or many: the dogs are, my phone is
• The -s flip: she walks, they walk; has and have; was and were
• Irregular plurals: children, people, feet, mice
• Each, every and both: everyone is, both are
• Words in the way: the box of chocolates is
• Uncountables: homework, news, advice, furniture
• There is, there are, and questions
• Tricky ones: my mom and my aunt are, one of my friends is, ten dollars is
Beat four rounds and the level's Boss round to open the next one.

Modes for every day
• Journey: learn new patterns, with stars for each round
• Daily 20: a two-minute daily mission that mixes in the cards you missed
• Shot Clock: every card on a clock that gets faster as you go
• Sprint 60: as many as you can in a minute
• Fix-it: a calm round with just your missed sentences

See the progress
Stats show accuracy and answer time over the weeks, which patterns still need work, your practice streak and how many sentences you've mastered. Scores keep your best Shot Clock and Sprint runs.

For parents and teachers
The Parent corner (behind a PIN) shows the weakest patterns and most-missed sentences, lets you turn topics on or off, and lets you add sentences you heard your child say, so they get practiced too.

No account, no ads, no tracking
Everything stays on the iPhone. The app never connects to the internet and collects no data.

Astrology for the people on your mind.

YOUR REAL CHART, NOT A SUN SIGN HOROSCOPE
We calculate your birth chart from your date, time and place, right on your phone: Sun, Moon, Rising, every planet and house. Your three daily cards (Love, Mood, Luck) are drawn from today's actual planetary transits to your chart.

COMPATIBILITY FOR ANY TWO PEOPLE

ASK VEGA, YOUR AI ASTROLOGER
"Will she text back?" "Why do I attract avoidants?" Vega reads your actual placements and your synastry, remembers what you told it, and answers like a friend who happens to know the sky. Honest about what the stars can and cannot tell you. Free to try every day.

ALSO INSIDE
Tarot with an illustrated deck. A moon calendar with rituals. Your month and your year, read from real transits. Numerology. A soulmate sketch drawn from your 7th house. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. Streaks and collectible constellation badges.

An optional Premium section about desire and chemistry, frank but never explicit. Adults only.

HONEST BILLING
Free to use every day. Premium is $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. We remind you 2 days before the trial ends. No weekly plans. No surprise charges. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID subscriptions.

For entertainment and self-reflection. Made by Hive Asset Group, LLC.

name: Overlay Bench
description:
Overlay Bench is a workshop log for inspecting cased glass. Record the thickness of each glass layer, mark defects where you find them, and return to the same points during your next inspection.

Set up a piece
Name your piece, record its material or batch, and add the base layer and colored overlays. Use a reference photo or a round or rectangular guide to map the surface. Set a target thickness range for any layer you want to check.

Record measurements and defects
Enter thickness readings in millimeters and place them on the surface map. See the minimum, average, and maximum readings and check how many fall outside your target ranges. Mark chips, cracks, bubbles between layers, base damage, and uneven thickness. Attach an observation photo or add notes to explain what you found.

Pick up where you left off
Journal keeps your drafts and dated inspections together. Search your records or filter them by piece. Start a follow up to carry over your measurement locations and compare new readings with the previous inspection. Use Review to find defects you are watching and mark them resolved after checking them again.

Share an inspection
Export a PNG report with the marked surface map, layer details, and inspection notes. Save or share the report through your iPhone.

Overlay Bench works offline and saves your workshop records on your iPhone. No account is required.

name: PaceBib: Marathon Pace

PLAN YOUR RACE

CHECK YOUR BOSTON MARGIN

CONVERT PACE AND SPEED
Move between min/km, min/mi, km/h and mph. Check estimated finish times and an optional treadmill-to-road adjustment.

description:

description:
Welcome to The Desktop Racing Club.

Paper Circuit reimagines classic graph-paper vector racing into a tactile, turn-based single-player challenge on your iOS device. Every straightaway, chicane, and bend requires careful line planning and momentum management.

DRAW YOUR LINE. RACE YOUR TURN.

KEY RACING FEATURES:
• Tactile Papercraft Aesthetic: Warm cream paper grid, crisp ink lines, and gentle paper shadows crafted for a calming yet competitive desktop atmosphere.

description:
ParcoCue è un assistente digitale progettato per i coltivatori e i trasformatori di capperi, come quelli di Pantelleria. I capperi vengono raccolti non da frutti maturi, ma da boccioli non ancora aperti: la tempistica della raccolta, la dimensione dei boccioli e il processo di conservazione sono cruciali per la qualità.

Con ParcoCue, puoi gestire ogni terrazzamento vulcanico, pianificare le raccolte mattutine e monitorare l'avanzamento della conservazione di ogni lotto, assicurandoti il ​​controllo in ogni fase.

Funzionalità principali

• Gestione dello stato del terrazzamento: Registra varietà, numero di piante, data dell'ultima raccolta, stato di osservazione dei boccioli, dimensione e maturazione. Puoi visualizzare profili dettagliati per ogni terrazzamento, inclusi una panoramica, un valore stimato e opzioni di intervento rapido.

• Raccomandazioni intelligenti per la tempistica della raccolta: Non esiste un calendario di raccolta fisso. ParcoCue fornisce raccomandazioni di ispezione e raccolta basate sulla data dell'ultima raccolta e sull'attuale stadio di crescita dei boccioli: seguendo la tradizione locale, il momento ottimale per la raccolta è solitamente la mattina presto.


• Prioritizzazione basata sul valore
Il sistema calcola il peso stimato, la percentuale di cime di alto valore e stima il ricavo previsto in base al prezzo impostato. Valuta inoltre la vicinanza al periodo di raccolta ottimale, tenendo conto della capacità di raccolta giornaliera.

• Gestione della salatura e della lavorazione
Per ogni lotto: innanzitutto, salare circa il 40% del peso e lasciare in salatura per 10 giorni; dopo lo sgocciolamento, salare circa il 20% del peso e lasciare in salatura per altri 10 giorni; infine, selezionare e confezionare. Ogni lotto ha un proprio timer.

• Avvisi di capacità
Se il raccolto previsto per la giornata supera la capacità dei contenitori esistenti, l'applicazione vi avviserà tempestivamente, suggerendovi di ridurre il raccolto o di preparare contenitori aggiuntivi.

Questa applicazione è pensata per i coltivatori e i piccoli impianti di trasformazione di Pantelleria: un'interfaccia chiara, funzioni pratiche e un perfetto allineamento con il ritmo naturale di crescita dei capperi.

Contatti: contact-pantelleriait8@gmail.com

name: Passbay
description:
Offline bookkeeping for independent restaurants and cafés — cash drawers, food cost, waste, and vendor bills in one place. No account wall. No network required for core use.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Watch a Service Pulse for sales, food-cost %, labor %, and covers across today, 7 days, or 30 days, with a dial that marks your house food-cost target.
• Keep a kitchen-aware Ledger for food and beverage sales, COGS, labor, occupancy, and other house expenses — searchable and filterable on device.
• Run a Shift Close ritual: opening float, cash and card sales, tips, paid-outs, counted drawer, covers, and live variance before you walk out.
• Log a Waste Rail for spoilage, comps, staff meals, prep errors, and 86 drops with cost impact by shift.
• Split tip pools by role weight and headcount; see per-person shares instantly.
• Track a Vendor Dock of invoices with due aging and paid/unpaid toggles.
• Copy a plain-text period summary for your own notes. Everything stays in local storage.

WHO IT IS FOR
Owners, chefs, and shift leads who want practical house numbers without a POS cloud subscription — prep walk-throughs, closing rituals, and weekly cost checks.

name: PassCheck Photo
description:
Will your passport photo be rejected? Bad photos are the #1 reason US passport applications are put on hold — and most photo apps make it worse: filters, AI edits and background removal are all banned by the Department of State.

PassCheck Photo checks first and edits never. Head size, eye position, background and shadows are checked as you shoot, for US passports, renewals, visas and IDs. Export a print-ready 2x2, a 4x6 print sheet, or a digital renewal file.

100% on-device. Nothing uploaded. Free to check, pay once to export.

PassCheck Photo is a pre-check tool, not a government service, and is not affiliated with the US Department of State. Only the Department of State can accept your photo.

name: Pawlegends
description:
Pawlegends is a fast 3v3 arena battler: a team of cat heroes against a pack of dogs, in seven-minute matches that never run past eleven.

Pick a hero, push your lane, and knock down the dog towers before they reach yours. Every hero has a passive, three skills and an ultimate that unlocks mid-match, plus a talent to choose as they level up. Learn when to strike, when to fall back, and when to ping your team for a push.

PLAY ANYWHERE
- Plays offline against bots from the first launch. No account, no sign-up, no ads.
- Built for touch in landscape: one thumb moves, the other casts.
