- Easy, Normal and Hard bots, with tips in your first matches.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
- Make a party, share the 6-letter code, and take on the dogs together: up to three players on one team.
- Bots fill any empty seat.
- Quick-chat phrases and pings to plan the next push.

HEROES WITH CHARACTER
- Ten cat heroes, each with their own look, role and way to win a lane.
- Get a grade from C to S after every match and chase your best.

Pawlegends is made by Token Tails, a small game studio from Vilnius, Lithuania.

name: Pearlbox: Private Photo Vault
description:
Pearlbox keeps your private photos and videos sealed like a pearl. Everything is encrypted on your iPhone with AES-256 before it is saved. There is no account to create, no ads and no tracking, and nobody, not even us, can look inside.

DRAW A PATTERN, OPEN A VAULT
Connect dots on a 5×5 grid to unlock. Every pattern opens its own vault, so you can keep a harmless vault for prying eyes and a private one only you know about. Pearlbox never shows how many vaults you have.

REAL ENCRYPTION, NOT JUST A PIN SCREEN
Many vault apps only hide files behind a passcode. Pearlbox encrypts every photo, video and thumbnail with AES-256-GCM, using a key that only your pattern (or your recovery phrase) can unlock, tied to a secret that never leaves your iPhone.

NEVER LOCKED OUT
When you create a vault you get a 12-word recovery phrase. If you forget your pattern, or restore your iPhone backup onto a new iPhone, those words bring your vault back.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED
• Import photos and videos from your library, then remove the originals in one tap
• Take photos and videos straight into the vault. They never touch your camera roll
• Smooth video playback, decrypted on the fly and never written to disk unencrypted
• Albums, multi-select, move and delete
• Face ID or Touch ID for the vault you choose
• Locks automatically when you leave the app, and hides its content in the app switcher
• Export anything back, any time

FREE AND PRO
Each free vault holds up to 100 photos and 10 videos. Pearlbox Pro removes the limits and adds the Midnight app icon. Choose a one-time Lifetime purchase, or a yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or monthly subscription. Your photos are never held hostage: even if Pro ends, you can always open and export everything.

PRIVACY
Pearlbox collects no data at all. Your vaults stay on your iPhone, and in your own iPhone backups, still encrypted.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Pelican Connect Support
description:
Pelican Connect Support is the field app for Pelican Broadband technicians, supervisors and admins. It connects to the same Pelican Connect system as the Support portal, so every update shows up on the ticket right away.

MY WORK
See the open tickets assigned to you, sorted by priority, and your project tasks. The Queue shows unassigned tickets so you can take one with Assign to me.

FIELD WORK
- Mark En Route, I've Arrived and Leaving Site; the time and location are recorded on each step
- An on-site timer runs while you work
- When you leave, pick the ticket status and your on-site and drive time are logged automatically

ON EVERY TICKET
- Resolution, internal notes and photos
- Change status (Waiting on Customer, Pending, Scheduled, Resolved, Closed)
- Escalate to the next tier with notes on what you tried
- Close the ticket with the same checks as the portal

TIME AND TRAVEL
Start and stop a timer, add time with start and end, and log travel with miles.

MATERIALS AND EQUIPMENT
Add materials from truck inventory and log phones and equipment added, replaced, removed or audited.

CUSTOMER SIGNATURE
Hand the phone to the customer to sign with a finger.

PROJECT TASKS
Update status, mark each customer location En Route / Arrived / Complete, and log time and notes.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
Everything is saved on the device first and sent automatically when the connection returns.

For Pelican Broadband staff only. Accounts are created by our administrators.

name: Penalty Bluff
description:
The shooter picks a corner. The keeper picks a corner. Nobody sees the other's pick — then both are revealed. Same corner: saved. Different corners: GOAL.

Penalty Bluff is the penalty shootout as a pure mind game. No swipe physics, no reflexes — just you, your rival and the question: where will they go this time?

• READ YOUR RIVAL — every computer opponent has a habit you can find. Beat them one by one in the career and unlock their dossier.
• THE AI LEARNS YOU — the stronger opponents remember how you play. Stay unpredictable, or get read.
• SCOUT REPORT — after each match, see your own habits: "You shoot left 62% of the time."
• TWO PLAYERS, ONE PHONE — pick in secret, pass the phone, reveal together. Perfect for a table full of friends.
• ONLINE — play a random opponent, or send a friend a code or a link that opens right in the browser, no install needed.
• TRICKS — a power shot beats a long-reach dive. Once per match each. Use it wisely.
• MADE FOR VIDEOS — put your front camera behind the goal, record the match and save the clip. Slow-motion reveals, a clean frame without buttons, and a result card to share.
• YOUR KIT — earn coins, dress your keeper and your shooter, pick your ball. Your rival sees it too.

Cut-paper art, a crowd that loses its mind on every goal, and matches that take two minutes.

Fake left. Shoot right.

name: Pennyplum
description:
Pennyplum gathers this week's sale prices from Asian supermarkets in Los Angeles and Orange County, so you can plan one trip instead of checking a dozen flyers.

• Weekly ads in one place — H Mart, 99 Ranch, Tokyo Central, Mitsuwa, Galleria, Zion, Hannam Chain, California Market, Little Tokyo Marketplace, Mega Mart, Greenland and Arirang.
• Deals near you — choose a ZIP code or an area, or use your current location, and see what is on sale at the stores close by.
• Same item, different prices — hand-checked matches show which store has the lowest price, with per-pound prices where it helps.
• Flyers you can tap — open a store's weekly ad, tap an item for its price, dates and terms, and add it to your list.
• Shopping list — type what you need; Pennyplum shows the matching deals and remembers what you added.

Prices and dates are copied from each store's own weekly ad and checked every week. Pennyplum is not affiliated with any store; shelf prices and stock can differ, so check with the store before you go.

No account, no ads. Your location, stores and list stay on your device.

name: Peptiking
description: Browse the PeptiKing catalog of peptides for in vitro laboratory research. View product details and available lab reports, place orders, and manage your account and order history. You can also opt in to order-status notifications. Products are for laboratory research only. Ingestion, injection, and use in humans or animals are prohibited.

name: Petalia-Floral Bouquet Studio
description:
Petalia is a floral studio for arranging bouquets by hand. Start from a blank canvas, or open a random bouquet.
Choose a vase, then place flowers, leaves, and branches. Drag a stem, bring it forward, resize it, rotate it, or tint it. Palettes can recolor the whole bouquet. Backgrounds come with the app. Undo and redo sit beside the canvas, and removing a stem asks you to confirm.
Sway, falling petals, butterflies, sunlight, bloom, glow, sparkle, and vignette can be turned on while you work. A saved picture keeps butterflies, sunlight, sparkle, and vignette.
Templates include Minimal, Classic, and Artistic arrangements, plus seasonal challenges. Gallery keeps your saved pieces. Browse all of them, or narrow the shelf to favorites and to Spring, Romantic, Calm, and Warm. Open a piece, save it to Photos, or share it. Deleting asks you to confirm.
Saving a new arrangement can use coins. An active membership covers that save.


Subscription Plans:
Week Pass, Price: $2.99 / 1 week,
Month Pass, Price: $4.99 / 1 month,
Half Year, Price: $10.99 / 6 months,
Year Pass, Price: $13.99 / 1 year

User Agreement
https://petaliae.com/vocoid/vocular/PetaliaUserAgreement.html

Privacy Policy
https://petaliae.com/vocification/vocimotor/PetaliaPrivacyPolicy.html

SubscriptionTerms
https://petaliae.com/vocoder/vocoders/PetaliaSubscriptionAgreement.html

name: PETRA - Messenger
description:
Petra is a messenger that protects your conversations. Messages, voice notes, photos and files are encrypted on your device. Only you and the person you talk to can read them, we cannot. One-to-one chats and groups, voice notes, photos and files, replies, reactions and notes, self-destructing messages, notifications without content, block and report, support right in the app. No ads, no selling data, no tracking. Servers are in Germany (EU). Terms: https://getpetra.io/terms

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Phasnex
description:
Phasnex is an interactive binary alloy phase diagram workbench for students, educators, and materials enthusiasts.
Explore composition–temperature space with a live probe. Drag isotherms and tie lines, read phase compositions and lever-rule fractions, and reshape liquidus, solidus, and solvus boundaries with editable control points.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Work with solid-solution, eutectic, and peritectic topologies
• Load teaching specimens (Pb–Sn, Cu–Ni, Ag–Cu, Au–Ag, and more) or create custom systems
• Visualize phase fields with clear region fills and overlay tools
• Run a slow-cooling path at fixed composition
• Save local sessions with notes and share text reports
• Study illustrated primers on the lever rule and invariant reactions
BUILT FOR LEARNING
Diagrams are didactic sketches designed for intuition on iPhone—not a substitute for handbook or CALPHAD data. Scope and limitations are stated clearly in the Field Primer.
PRIVACY
No account required. Specimens, probe settings, and journals stay on your device. No ads. No tracking SDKs.
Phasnex — a focused local lab for binary phase equilibria.

name: Phetcha
description:
Phetcha คู่มือเที่ยวเพชรบุรีฉบับพกพา รวมร้านอาหาร คาเฟ่ ที่พัก นวดสปา วัด ธรรมชาติ สวนสัตว์ ร้านค้าและบริการ กว่า 500 แห่งทั่วจังหวัด ไว้ในแอปเดียว

• ครบทุกหมวด แต่ละหมวดมีหมวดย่อยพร้อมไอคอน กรองตามอำเภอและร้านที่เปิดอยู่ตอนนี้ได้
• ใกล้ฉัน เรียงตามระยะทางจากที่คุณอยู่ และดูทุกที่บนแผนที่
• ทริป 1 วัน แผนเที่ยวจากเช้าถึงค่ำที่จัดให้ใหม่ทุกวัน
• วางแผนไหว้พระ เส้นทางสำเร็จรูป เช่น ไหว้พระ 9 วัด พร้อมระยะทางและเวลาเดินทางจริง
• การเดินทาง ตารางรถไฟทุกสถานีในจังหวัด รถตู้ รถบัส และรถในเมืองพร้อมราคา
• งานและเทศกาล ดูรายละเอียดและเพิ่มลงปฏิทินได้ทันที
• ถาม phetcha AI หาร้าน ที่พัก และที่เที่ยวแบบคุยกัน วันละ 5 คำถาม
• บันทึกร้านโปรดไว้ในเครื่อง ไม่ต้องสมัครสมาชิก

เข้าสู่ระบบด้วย Apple หรือ Google เพื่อใช้บัญชีเดียวกับเว็บไซต์ phetcha.com และลบบัญชีได้เองจากในแอป

name: Philamentos
description:
Philamentos connects you with 3D printing makers in your own city, so a part you need this week doesn't have to travel across the country to reach you.

Browse ready-to-print designs or upload your own STL file. We match you with a verified maker nearby who has the right printer and the colour you want. You pay securely online, the maker prints it, and you collect it in person.

ORDER A PRINT
• Browse a catalogue of designs with prices shown up front
• Or upload your own STL and get an instant estimate
• Choose colour and quantity
• See exactly who is printing it and where you'll collect it

COLLECT IT NEARBY
• No shipping costs and no delivery windows
• Pick up from a maker in your city
• Confirm collection with a one-time pickup code, so prints only go to the person who ordered them

FOR MAKERS
If you own a 3D printer, Philamentos turns idle print hours into income.
• Receive job offers from buyers near you
• Accept the work that fits your printer and your schedule
• Photograph the finished print as proof of completion
• Verify handover with the buyer's pickup code

HOW YOUR ORDER IS PROTECTED
Payment is held until the print is finished and collected. Makers upload photo proof before a job can be marked ready, and every handover is confirmed with a code only the buyer has.

Philamentos is currently live in New York, Washington DC, San Francisco, Dallas, Austin and Seattle. Not in a launch city yet? Join the waitlist and we'll expand where demand shows up.

name: PicoStep: Micro Task Slicer
description:
Procrastination is not a character flaw. It is an emotional friction response triggered when the human brain confronts an overwhelming, amorphous macro task.

Enter PicoStep — the cognitive micro-step slicer engineered to dismantle resistance before hesitation begins.

Grounded in the psychological "2-Minute Activation Principle", PicoStep transforms cognitive paralysis into effortless momentum. By breaking giant projects into frictionless physical micro-actions, you sidestep executive dysfunction and achieve instant flow.

HEURISTIC TASK BREAKDOWN ENGINE
Type in any daunting goal — "Write Quarter Review", "Organize Workspace", "Debug Memory Leak" — and PicoStep's cognitive slicer automatically fragments it into 3 to 5 bite-sized, 2-minute physical actions. No overwhelming lists; just the immediate next step.

120-SECOND SPRINT IMMERSION
Tap Start to trigger a zero-cognitive-load 2-minute focus countdown. A clear circular visual timer helps overcome starting friction without the dread of endless hour-long timers.

BIOMIMETIC BENTO MOMENTUM GRID
Every conquered micro-step earns real momentum points. Track your cognitive velocity, daily streaks, friction points broken, and dopamine rewards within an exquisite Obsidian Bento Grid.

ALGORITHMIC PINK NOISE (DEFAULT MUTED)
Access deeply relaxing, procedurally generated acoustic soundscapes (Deep Space and Alpine Rain) filtered via real-time biquad audio curves. Background audio is strictly muted by default, respecting your sensory environment.

SENSORY HAPTICS & CELEBRATION CONFETTI
Celebrate every completed micro-action with crisp physical Taptic Engine clicks and vibrant confetti bursts. Positive behavioral reinforcement wired directly into your neuro-pathways.

LOCAL ON-DEVICE SANDBOX ARCHITECTURE
Your thoughts, workflows, and tasks stay on your device. PicoStep operates within the local on-device iOS sandbox. Designed with privacy in mind: no mandatory account creation and local data processing.

Stop waiting for motivation. Build activation momentum with PicoStep.

name: Pipgrove: Quit Sugar Coach
description:
Cravings pass. Pipgrove helps you get through them, one calm minute at a time, and grows a little garden for every win.

Pipgrove is a gentle 28-day coach for cutting added sugar. No calorie counting, no shame, no scale. Just a kind buddy named Pip, a craving SOS that works in the moment, and a garden that shows how far you've come.

CRAVING SOS, ANY TIME
• Tap SOS when a craving hits: notice it, breathe through the wave, then choose what to do instead
• Natural sweet swaps (berries, frozen grapes, dates with nuts) and mini challenges (a 15-minute walk, a warm shower)
• Always free, always one tap away, also from your widget and Lock Screen

A GARDEN THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• Every sugar-free day lights up your garden: fireflies, the moon, lanterns, shooting stars
• Every craving you beat plants a glowing flower
• Garden visitors arrive as you build habits: a night moth, a hedgehog, a fox and more

A 28-DAY PROGRAM THAT FITS YOUR DAY
• A 1-minute lesson each morning on why cravings happen and how to outsmart them
• Morning intention and a 30-second evening check-in
• A short letter from Pip every morning

SEE YOUR OWN PATTERN
• Learn when cravings hit and what sets them off
• Craving forecast: a heads-up before your usual craving time (Pro)
• Hidden-sugar scanner for packaged food

KIND BY DESIGN
• A slip never erases your progress. Shields protect your garden on hard days
• Buddy streak: invite one friend and keep a streak together
• Badges, weekly challenges and Pip's level, without pressure or guilt

PRIVATE
Your check-ins stay on your iPhone. No account needed.

PIPGROVE PRO
Pro unlocks the full 28-day program and garden, craving forecast, a note to your future self in SOS, extra shields and full reports. Start with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. SOS help, check-ins and your first week are always free.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pipgrove.com/privacy.html

Pipgrove is a habit coach, not medical advice. If you have diabetes or another health condition, talk to your doctor before changing your diet.

name: Pitlane Prism MotoPro
description:
Pitlane Prism MotoPro packs three handcrafted motorsport arcade games into a single, offline-first experience — all wrapped in a dark "Night Garage" aesthetic with neon accents and instrument-cluster typography.

▸ THROTTLE LANES — Reflex Run
Tear down a three-lane night highway. Swipe or tap to switch lanes, grab fuel cans to keep your engine alive, and collect hex bolts for points. Nitro doubles your score, a helmet blocks one crash, and a magnet pulls pickups toward you. Dodge cones, oil slicks, and barriers — three crashes or an empty tank ends the ride.

▸ CHROME RICOCHET — Trick Shot
Drag, aim, and release chrome bearings to smash every target gear on the stage. Bearings bounce off walls and steel posts — master the rebounds to chain multi-gear combos. Armored gears take extra hits. Run out of bearings and the stage fails.

▸ PIT CREW SORT — Speed Sort
Parts drop from an overhead hoist: Engine, Wheels, Fluids, Brakes, Electric. Tap the matching color crate before the part hits the red line. Build streak multipliers with consecutive correct sorts. Later stages add shuffling crates, gold rush orders worth triple points, and rusty scrap you must let fall.

THE GARAGE
Earn bolts from every ride and spend them on paint jobs, rim styles, liveries, headlights, and helmets for your motorcycle — all rendered in real time with code-drawn vector art.

PROGRESSION
- Rider rank from Rookie Rider to Throttle Legend
- 3 rotating daily missions with bolt rewards
- 16 collectible patches (achievements) — from "First Kickstart" to "Throttle Legend"
- Ride streak tracking and weekly activity charts
- Per-game best scores, levels, and stats

DESIGNED FOR PLAYERS
- Entirely offline — no account, no internet, no ads
- All sound effects are procedurally synthesized — zero audio files shipped
- All artwork drawn in code — crisp at every screen size
- Full haptic feedback support
- Accessibility: Reduce Motion, adjustable difficulty, VoiceOver labels
- Landscape-optimized for immersive play on iPhone

name: Pitstop Express Rewards
description:
Pitstop Express Rewards is the loyalty program for Pitstop Express, with 60+ locations across Greater Houston.

• Earn points on every in-store purchase: 10 points for every $1.
• Get something free every week, just for being a member. Claim it in the app, pick it up at the register.
• Redeem points for coffee, fountain drinks, snacks and money off.
• Find the nearest Pitstop Express and get directions.
• Join in under a minute with your mobile number. No passwords.

Good fuel. Good food. Good to go.

name: Plaincard: Business Card Scan
description:
Back from a conference with a stack of business cards? Plaincard reads them on your iPhone, shows every card next to its photo so you can check the fields, and saves each one to Contacts or to a vCard/CSV file. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account, and everything is free: unlimited cards, unlimited export. Works on every iPhone from iOS 16.4.

SCAN A STACK
• The iPhone's document scanner captures one card after another; both sides if you like.
• Or pick the photos from your library, or paste an e-mail signature.
• QR codes on cards (vCard, MECARD) fill the fields directly.

CHECK, THEN SAVE
• Name, company, title, phone numbers, e-mail, website, address and social profiles are read from the card. Fields the app is not sure about are marked "Check" — you see every field next to the card image and fix it with a tap.
• Text that could not be placed stays visible as "Text on the card". Nothing you scanned is thrown away.
• Nothing reaches Contacts or an export until you tap "Looks right".
• One card: the iPhone's own "New Contact" form opens, prefilled — no Contacts permission needed.
• Many cards: "Add all to Contacts" checks for people who are already in your Contacts (also with limited access, your choice of contacts), adds only what you choose, and never overwrites a contact. The summary is exact: "21 added, 2 added to existing contacts, 1 skipped".

A LIBRARY THAT REMEMBERS WHERE YOU MET
• Every card keeps its photo, the event, where and when you met, tags and notes.
• Search finds any word on any card.
• Duplicates are recognised and can be merged.
• Follow-up reminders: "tomorrow", "in 3 days", "next Monday". The reminder opens the card.

EXPORT AND SHARE
• vCard (.vcf) and CSV export of any selection, event or tag — AirDrop, Mail, Files, your CRM import.
• Your own card as a QR code: the other person's camera reads it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Nothing leaves your iPhone: no account, no upload, no ads, no tracking. The app makes no network requests.
• Text recognition runs on the iPhone (Apple's Vision framework).
• Contacts access is asked only when you add several cards at once or look for people already in your contacts — and only after the app has told you what it will do.

15 languages. Text recognition for the languages your iPhone's Vision framework supports (listed in Settings).

Not included: sync between devices, cloud backup, CRM push — export a file instead.

name: plak.com: Vinyl Price Tracker
description:
Holding a record? See where it's cheapest in Turkey, at a glance.

plak.com puts the vinyl prices of 11 shops in Turkey in one table. Scan or search a record and see every shop's price in Turkish lira, cheapest first, with stock, then open that shop's page with "Go to shop".

SCAN IN THE SHOP
- Show the barcode on the back to the camera and the record opens
- No barcode? Read the text on the cover and find it in the catalog
- No camera? Type the barcode's digits, or scan a photo

TARGET PRICE
- Set your own target price on any record
- Get a notification when it reaches your target, drops, or is back in stock
- Prices are checked in the background, on your phone; no account or email

MY LIST AND COLLECTION
- See how close each record on your list is to its target
- Your collection's value today, from the shops' current prices
- Removed a record by mistake? Undo
- Your lists stay on this iPhone

DISCOVER
- Search a catalog of more than 23,000 records by artist, album or barcode
- Records whose price dropped in the last 7 days
- Each record's price history
- plak.com guides (in Turkish)

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
- Small and medium widgets: the lowest price of a record on your list, or today's biggest drop

Prices are collected from the shops daily; check the final price and stock on the shop's page. No ads, no purchases, no account.

plak.com is the iPhone app of the website that compares vinyl prices in Turkey. The app is in Turkish and English.

name: Planar: PDF Document Scanner
description:
Planar is a document scanner that turns paper into clean, searchable PDFs with on-device OCR, and keeps every scan on your phone.

Point the camera at a page. Planar finds the edges, straightens the scan and removes shadows, then reads the text so you can search it, copy it or export a searchable PDF. No upload, no cloud account: scans, recognized text and signatures never leave the device unless you share them.

SCAN TO PDF
• Automatic edge detection and perspective correction for any document
• Magic mode cleans shadows and sharpens text; B&W, Gray and Vivid filters
• Multi-page PDF scanner: add, reorder and retake pages
• Import photos or an existing PDF from any app

OCR TEXT RECOGNITION
• On-device OCR in your languages, nothing sent to a server
• Search inside a document, or across your whole library by the words on the page
• Copy a page or the full text; key details pulled from business cards

EXPORT AND SHARE
• Export a PDF with an invisible text layer, or JPG, PNG and TXT
• Choose page size and quality, print, or share to any app

RECEIPTS, ID CARDS AND MORE
• Receipt scanner, book scanner and whiteboard modes
• ID card scanner for cards and passports
• QR code reader built into the camera

PLANAR PRO
• Unlimited documents with no watermark
• Password-protected PDF export (AES-256)
• Sign PDF documents with saved signatures
• ID card, book and receipt modes
Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase; prices are shown in the app. Subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends and can be managed in your store account settings.

Privacy policy: https://planarpro.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://planarpro.com/terms

name: PlantPlek
description:
PlantPlek helpt je twee plekken voor een kamerplant te vergelijken, op 0,5 meter en 2 meter van hetzelfde raam. Leg je eigen metingen en omstandigheden vast en volg wat er bij een nieuwe meetronde verandert.

• **Leg beide meetpunten vast.** Maak een kamer- en plantenprofiel met namen, foto’s of markeringen op een eenvoudige schets. Noteer de afstand tot het raam en de meethoogte. Je kunt ook eigen afstanden instellen.

• **Meet met een externe luxmeter.** Voer per plek drie lichtmetingen handmatig in en registreer het tijdstip en de meetomstandigheden. Alle oorspronkelijke waarden blijven zichtbaar, samen met de mediaan en het verschil tussen de hoogste en laagste waarde.

• **Controleer je vergelijking.** Bekijk het verschil in lux tussen beide plekken zodra de meetgegevens compleet en voldoende stabiel zijn. Ontbrekende waarden, te grote schommelingen en onvolledige meetvoorwaarden worden duidelijk aangegeven.

• **Bewaar de context.** Registreer per plek de afstand tot een ventilatieopening en of de plant de looproute blokkeert. Noteer ook de stand van de gordijnen, de airconditioning en recent verplaatste meubels.

• **Beslis en meet opnieuw.** Leg vast of je de opstelling wilt behouden, aanpassen of de vergelijking wilt stoppen, met je eigen reden. Plan een herhaalmeting na een week en gebruik dezelfde meetopzet. Eerdere meetrondes en resultaten blijven bewaard.

PlantPlek werkt offline en bewaart je gegevens lokaal op je apparaat. Zoek metingen per kamer of plant en exporteer de oorspronkelijke waarden, tijdstippen en omstandigheden als CSV, met uitleg over de berekeningen.

name: Plastab
description:
Plastab is a local blotter for plastic-friend tabs — roommates, dinners, and shared costs without cloud accounts.

Circles — Create a flat or a night-out group. Keep notes, switch the active circle, and manage members on device.

Expenses — Log who paid, how much, and who shares the cost. Equal splits update instantly in local storage.

Settle — See net balances and suggested pays (who should send what to whom). Figures stay on this iPhone.

Transfer — Export a circle to CSV and hand it off by AirDrop, Files, or cable. Import merges the blotter on another device. No registration. No share links.

Guide — Demo data for review, privacy policy, and a one-tap erase of the local blotter.

Plastab does not process payments or sync to a server. It is intentionally offline-first.

name: PlatePortion
description:
When two people share a pizza and only one orders a drink, their shares should look different. PlatePortion lets you settle a restaurant bill one dish at a time, on one iPhone.

Add the diners at your table. Enter the receipt price for each dish and select everyone who shared it. A dish for one person goes on that person’s share. A shared dish is divided equally among the selected diners.

Enter a discount, tax or tip as a fixed amount or a percentage. Percentage tax and tip use the discounted food subtotal. If the receipt already includes tax, enter only any additional amount due. PlatePortion balances rounding to the cent so individual shares add up to the table total.

Open a name to see its dishes and adjustments. Share the itemized split as text through the iOS share sheet. The current table stays saved on your iPhone when you close the app.

Choose USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD or CNY before adding dishes. No account or internet connection is needed to calculate a split.

name: Playlist Alarm: Wake to Music
description:
Wake up to your favorite playlist or music, not a ringtone.

Playlist Alarm starts the Apple Music playlist, album, song or station you choose at alarm time. No tap needed: it plays on its own, even with your iPhone locked and Silent mode on, and the volume rises gently so you wake up calm.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick a playlist, album, song or station from Apple Music
- Set the time and days, just like the Clock app
- Lock your phone and go to sleep. Your music starts right on time and fades in

WAKE UP GENTLY
- A soft fade-in from quiet to the volume you choose
- Play once or on repeat, with shuffle for playlists
- Snooze with one tap, on the alarm screen or right from the Lock Screen

A BACKUP ALARM, JUST IN CASE
If your music can't start for any reason, a built-in alarm tone rings instead, so you never oversleep.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
A Live Activity shows your next alarm and its countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with Snooze and Stop right there when it rings.

BEDSIDE CLOCK AND NIGHT SOUNDS
Leave the app open on the charger and it dims to a quiet clock with your next alarm. Optional night sounds (brown noise, soft rain or ocean) play softly until morning.

LOOKS GREAT ON IPHONE DUO
Every screen adapts to iPhone Duo, folded or unfolded.

FREE, WITH A ONE-TIME PRO
Free: one music alarm that fully works, with fade-in, snooze, the backup alarm and the bedside clock.
Playlist Alarm Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription: unlimited alarms, bedside clock themes, fade-ins up to 5 minutes, any snooze length and a choice of backup tones. Family Sharing is on.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no account, no tracking. Playlist Alarm collects no data, and your alarms stay on your iPhone.

Good to know: waking up to music needs an Apple Music subscription. Keep the app in the background overnight (locking your phone is fine). If it was swiped away, the backup alarm rings instead, about a minute and a half after your alarm time.

name: Pocket Claw: Plush Arcade
description:
A tiny arcade. A whole pile of friends.

Pocket Claw brings the suspense of a claw machine to iPhone and iPad. Drag to aim, tap DROP, and hold SQUEEZE through the lift and carry. Watch your plush friend nestle into the claw—or slip away for another try.

YOUR LITTLE ARCADE
• Twelve original plush friends in the included Starter Garden collection
• Random toy drops and a new pile each round
• Touch controls, raised arcade buttons, and an optional tap-to-toggle grip
• Portrait and landscape layouts for iPhone and iPad
• Fold-aware machine and control placement on supported devices
• Local catch counts, collection stamps, and optional share cards
• Unlimited plays, with no ads, tokens, energy, or subscriptions

CHRISTMAS FRIENDS
An optional one-time In-App Purchase unlocks all twelve familiar plush friends wearing Santa hats. See every included character before you buy. Switch between owned packs for themed play; purchased packs never expire after the holidays.

Buying a pack unlocks its full roster for viewing and play. Catching earns stamps; it does not determine which purchased toys you own. All packs use the same claw mechanics.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Turn sound, haptics, and the aim timer on or off. Use touch-and-hold or tap-to-toggle grip. Play installed, owned content offline; buying and restoring packs may require an internet connection and an Apple Account.

Your catches stay on your device. Restore Purchases restores pack ownership, not local catch history. No account, advertising, or tracking is required by Pocket Claw.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Pofu: Tilt & Hug Puzzle
description:
Tilt the world. Watch every fluffy Pofu slide. Hug, merge, smile.

Pofu is a cozy, clever brain puzzle you play with one finger. Swipe, and the whole world tilts: all the Pofus slide at once until something stops them. When Pofus of the same colour come to rest side by side, they hug and merge. Leave one Pofu of each colour to win.

You learn it in a minute, and a few levels later you are plotting three moves ahead and feeling very smart. Perfect for a calm break, a commute, or a quiet evening.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One finger is all you need. Swipe, slide, done.
• Relaxing to play, satisfying to solve.
• Plush stitched quilt art that looks like a soft handmade blanket.
• 1000 levels, with more coming. Every level is checked by a solver, so every puzzle can really be solved.
• Play offline, on the bus, on a plane, anywhere.

THE CHALLENGE GROWS WITH YOU
• Cushions block the way, so find another route.
• Sleepy Pofus won't budge until a friend's hug wakes them up.
• Honey stops whatever slides into it.
• Grumpy Rocks slide along with you, but they never hug.
• Holes swallow any Pofu that falls in, unless a rock fills them.
• Swirls carry you in one side and out the other.
Travel through Cotton Meadow, Honey Valley, Velvet Night, Mint Bay and Candy Hill.

BOOSTERS WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• Scissors: snip away a cushion.
• Magnet: tap a Pofu to gather its friends.

REASONS TO COME BACK
• Daily Puzzle: a fresh puzzle every day that costs no hearts. Grow your streak.
• Daily Gift: log in every day for a reward.
• Hug Chain: clear 7 levels without losing a heart to win a big prize.
• Quilt Road: a monthly reward track with free and premium rewards. Collect buttons as you play.
• Leaderboard: see how you rank.
• Pofu Family: collect six friends, Cherry, Cloud, Lemon, Mint, Plum and Tangerine.

GOOD TO KNOW
Pofu has in-app purchases (coin packs, a one-time Remove Ads and the monthly Pofu Pro subscription). It also shows ads, and you can watch some for extra coins, moves or a heart. Downloading new levels and the leaderboard need an internet connection.

Tilt. Slide. Hug. Download Pofu and let the fluffiness begin.

Pofu Pro is a monthly auto-renewing subscription. It renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage it in your store account settings.
Privacy: https://basaapps.com/app/pofu/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://basaapps.com/app/pofu/terms/

name: Pool AI — Ask Blue
description:
Pool trouble? Ask Blue.

Blue is the pool AI from Miami Pool Consultants. Tell it what's wrong in your own words, say it out loud, or send a photo of the water or your test strip. Blue asks a couple of quick questions and gives you clear, step-by-step fixes — green water, cloudy water, algae, chlorine, pH, salt systems, pumps and filters.

• Type, talk or send a photo
• Answers you can listen to, in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Haitian Creole, French and Russian
• Doses sized to your pool when you save its gallons and sanitizer
• Already have a pool company on Pool AI? See your visit reports, messages, quotes and invoices in one place, and pay online

Free for homeowners. Blue is an AI and can make mistakes — always test your water and follow the product label before adding any chemical.

name: Pool AI Pro
description:
Pool AI Pro is the app for pool service companies, their techs and their office — from Miami Pool Consultants.

FOR TECHS
• Today's route in order, with gate codes, notes and directions
• Visit reports with readings, photos, checklist and parts & chemicals used — works with no signal and sends when you're back online
• Time clock, time-off requests and your certifications (CPO and more)
• Ask Blue for pro answers on chemistry, equipment and pool codes

FOR OWNERS AND OFFICE
• Drag-and-drop schedule, route optimizing and late or not-moving alerts
• Quotes customers sign online, monthly billing, invoices and AutoPay
• Customer messages that translate between 6 languages
• Payroll export, supplier price lists and orders, certification tracking
• QuickBooks connection

Your customers see their visit reports, messages, quotes and invoices in the free Pool AI app.
Pool AI Pro needs a company account. Companies sign up at mpcpoolai.com.

name: Porchlight: Family Journal
description:
How was your day? Answer with the weather.

Porchlight is a tiny journal for busy people. Each evening, a gentle reminder asks how your day went. Pick Stormy, Cloudy, Okay, Sunny or Glowing, add a line, a few photos and the people you were with. That's it. Over weeks and months, it becomes a quiet record of your everyday life and your family's small moments.

ONE TAP FROM YOUR LOCK SCREEN
- Rate your day right from the reminder, without opening the app
- Jot down a moment anytime with the + button, then reflect on the whole day at night
- Today's photos are lined up for you, so adding them takes a tap
- Widgets, Shortcuts and Siri: "Rate my day" and "New moment"
- Share photos, text or links to Porchlight from any app

LOOK BACK ON WHAT MATTERS
- A timeline of your days, a calendar, and search across notes, places, tags and people
- "One year ago" brings back the same day last year
- People pages show the days you spent with each person
- Steps and sleep from Apple Health appear next to your day (optional)
- A Sunday recap of your week

YOURS, AND ONLY YOURS
- No account. No ads. No tracking. Porchlight has no servers.
- Your journal stays on your iPhone and syncs through your own private iCloud
- Lock the app with Face ID
- Export anytime as JSON, Markdown or CSV, and turn on monthly backups to iCloud Drive

PORCHLIGHT PLUS
Everything you need to build the habit is free. Porchlight Plus adds unlimited photos per entry and your full history on people pages. Choose monthly, yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bqgf7vw5qk-star.github.io/porchlight-site/privacy/

name: Posecard: Pose Guide Camera
description:
Not sure how to pose? Pick a pose card.

Posecard lays the answer right on your viewfinder: where to stand, what to do with your hands, and which lens to use. Whether you're shooting a friend, your partner, or your own travel photos, you'll never stare at the screen wondering what to do again.

POSE CARDS ON YOUR VIEWFINDER
Pick a card and the viewfinder highlights where the person should stand, with short cues like "arms open" or "look into the distance". The photographer follows the frame, the subject follows the pose, and the composition just works.

THE RIGHT LENS, AUTOMATICALLY
Need 0.5x ultra wide for longer-looking legs? Selecting a card switches the lens for you and tells you how low to go and which angle to shoot from.

SHOW THEM THE POSE
The person in the photo can't see your screen. Tap "Show them" to flip the pose card to full screen with big, simple cues.

40+ POSE CARDS, 7 POPULAR SCENES
Fields, beaches, cafés, city streets, flower gardens, old towns, and cozy rooms, with new cards added over time. Save your favorites and pull them up on the spot.

BEFORE & AFTER IN ONE TAP
Turn any shot into a side-by-side "pose card vs. my shot" image, sized for sharing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads. The camera feed is processed on your iPhone and photos are saved only to your own library.

PRICING
Every scene has free pose cards to try. A one-time purchase unlocks every card, including future ones. No subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://posecard.portrays.app/privacy

name: Premiso: Law School Prep
description:
Practice logical reasoning the way the test asks for it: read a short argument, find what it concludes, and spot what it takes for granted.

Premiso gives you 320 original practice questions across 16 question types, from Flaw and Weaken to Parallel reasoning and Principle. Every answer is explained, including why each wrong choice is wrong.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
- Argument X-ray: tap the sentence you think is the conclusion. After you answer, each sentence is marked as conclusion, premise, context or opposing view.
- Trap labels: every wrong choice is tagged with the trap it uses (too strong, out of scope, reversal, half right and more). Your Trap profile shows which traps catch you most.
- Blind review: after a 25 question timed section, retry the questions you flagged without seeing the answers, then compare your two scores.
- Conditional trainer: turn "only if", "unless" and "no A are B" into arrows and contrapositives, with new sentences every time.

EVERY DAY
- Daily 5: five questions picked from your weakest types.
- Exam countdown: set your test date and see how many questions a day keep you on track.
- Spaced review: questions you missed come back at the right time.
- Strike out choices, highlight sentences, flag questions and keep notes on the ones you miss.
- Cato the crow levels up from student book bag to judge's robe as you answer correctly. Earn badges, change outfits and share your level.
- Home screen widget with today's progress.

FREE AND PRO
- Free to download, no ads, no account.
- Free: Daily 5 from four question types (Main point, Role, Flaw, Weaken), all 16 Type guides, and Conditional trainer level 1.
- Premiso Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks all 16 types and 320 questions, timed sections with Blind review, the full Trap profile and every trainer level. No subscription. Family Sharing is on.

PRIVATE
Works offline. Your progress stays on your device and in your own iCloud (you can turn sync off). We do not collect your data.

Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo.

All questions are original practice material written for this app; they are not past test questions. LSAT is a registered trademark of LSAC, which is not affiliated with Premiso.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Price Book: Unit Prices
description:
At the shelf, Price Book shows which pack is really cheaper after the deal, and it remembers what you paid so you can tell a usual price from a good one next time.

No account. No ads. No subscription. The app makes no network requests: it works fully offline and your prices stay on your iPhone.

COMPARE
Open the app and type the price and size of two to five products. The keypad is ready, with no sign-up and no tutorial. You see the price per kilo, litre, ounce or piece, which product is cheaper and how much you save. Mixed units (grams and ounces, millilitres and fluid ounces) are converted exactly. A warning appears when something looks wrong, for example sizes that differ by a factor of ten or two different kinds of unit.

REAL DEALS
Add a deal in two taps: 3 for 2, buy one get one free, second at half price, percent off, N for a price, coupon, spend and save, cashback, deposit. Prices can include tax, or tax is added at the till; you choose, with an optional rate. "Show the maths" lists every step, so you can check it against the receipt.

PRICE MEMORY
Save a price from a Compare card in three taps, or add one from your Price Book. For each product you see the latest, lowest, usual and highest unit price, a gauge that shows how the latest price sits against your usual one, the store where you last saw it cheapest, a chart of the unit price over time, and a note when a pack got smaller, based on the pack sizes you saved (shrinkflation). Everything comes from your own records. Price Book does not know shop prices and does not look anything up.

YOUR DATA
Back up everything to one file and restore it from a file; the app shows what the file contains and asks once before it replaces anything. Export your prices as a CSV file for a spreadsheet. Backup and CSV files are plain, not encrypted: you choose where to keep them (Files, iCloud Drive, mail), and nothing leaves your iPhone unless you share a file yourself. Tested with a price book of 5,000 saved prices.

SETTINGS
Currency, number format (1,234.56 or 1.234,56), units (metric, US or UK), the "per ..." unit for unit prices, tax, an optional key tick (vibration), light, dark or system appearance. Currency, number format, units and tax wording start from your iPhone's region.

GOOD TO KNOW
- The app is in English for now.
- "Last seen cheapest" and "usual price" are worked out from the prices you saved, not from live shop prices.
- Tax, deposit and deal rules differ by shop and country. Price Book calculates what you type; the till has the last word.
- Barcode scan finds the products you saved; there is no online product database. Receipt and shelf-tag scanning are not in this version.
- If you use iCloud Backup, it includes this app's data.

name: Prism: News Perspectives
description:
What if you could see how the other side reports the same story with just one swipe?

Introducing Prism, a new way to experience the news. Explore the day's biggest stories from multiple news outlets and discover how reporting changes across the political spectrum.

ONE STORY. EVERY ANGLE.

Different news outlets can tell very different stories about the same event. With Prism, you don't have to jump between apps or search through dozens of websites to see those differences.

Simply move the perspective slider to explore coverage from left, center, and right-leaning news sources. The topic stays the same while the headlines, publishers, and available reporting change.

YOUR NEWS. YOUR PERSPECTIVE.

Already have a preferred way of getting your news? Keep it.

Prism remembers your selected perspective, giving you a familiar reading experience every time you open the app. When you're curious about how another outlet is covering a story, simply move the slider.

No switching apps. No complicated comparisons. Just a different perspective in seconds.

THE STORIES THAT MATTER.

Forget endlessly scrolling through hundreds of headlines. Prism organizes major news events into a focused, easy-to-explore feed.

See how multiple publishers report on the same topic, discover different angles, and spend more time understanding the news.

REAL SOURCES. DIFFERENT VIEWPOINTS.

Prism brings reporting from established news organizations together in one place, with clear publisher attribution and links to original sources.

We don't pretend their journalism is ours. We make it easier to discover and compare.

BUILT FOR CURIOSITY.

Prism isn't here to tell you what to believe, change your political opinions, or replace your favorite news app.

We believe everyone should have an easier way to explore reporting beyond the sources they normally read.

Whether you lean left, right, or somewhere in between, there's value in understanding how others see the same events.

WHAT MAKES PRISM DIFFERENT?

• Explore news from across the political spectrum
• Switch perspectives with one simple slider
• Compare actual publisher headlines on the same topic
• Keep your preferred perspective across the app
• Discover a curated selection of major news stories
• Explore original reporting from multiple sources
• Enjoy a clean, modern reading experience

Start reading for free, or upgrade to Prism Premium for more daily topic reads.

You don't have to change your perspective to understand another one.

Prism. News from every angle.

name: Prometheus by Insight Bay
description:
Prometheus is the parent app for Insight Bay, a STEM education company teaching live one-to-one classes from kindergarten to grade 12. Sign in with your Insight Bay account to see how your child is doing, without waiting for a message.

• Home: your child's next class, homework due, latest test and Black Hole practice at a glance.
• Homework: what was given, what has been handed in and the mark and feedback once it is reviewed.
• Topics and plan: the topics covered, what is still to come, and how many classes remain on the plan.
• Calendar: every class, past and upcoming, in your own time zone, with reminders on your phone.
• Scores and punctuality: test marks and attendance over time.
• Messages and meetings: write to Insight Bay and follow parent-teacher meetings.
• Plan renewal: renew your plan of live one-to-one classes with a teacher.

Prometheus is for parents and guardians of students enrolled with Insight Bay; accounts are set up by Insight Bay. Face ID can keep the app private on your device. No ads, no tracking.

name: ProofPair
description:
Was it the meeting time, the room, or both? Give ProofPair two versions of a notice and read exactly what changed.

Type or paste the original and revision. If either version is a screenshot, read the image on your iPhone and correct the recognized text before saving the draft. Screenshot recognition supports English and Simplified Chinese.

Compare drafts to see removed and added lines. Character marks help pinpoint smaller edits. Step between change groups, show only differences, or ignore inline spaces when comparing. Each draft supports up to 20,000 characters and 1,000 lines.

Copy a report or share a TXT file. Choose whether the report includes the full drafts. Drafts are kept in the current session; export a report if you want to keep it. No account is needed.

name: Pryzora Shard Keeper
description:
Pryzora Shard Keeper packs two short arcade games around a single hoard. Your shards, your evolving core, and your aura glyphs carry across both modes, so every 30 to 90 second round feeds the same growing vault.

Shard Tycoon is the greedy run. Tap shards as they appear, then tap Vault to bank what you have before the clock ends the round. Banked shards survive a loss. Held shards don't. Clear the target and you can spend the vault on Evolve to push your shard value up to five times.

Vault Defender is the survival run. Drag your core along the floor to catch friendly shards and dodge the hazards falling with them. Hold on to all three lives until the timer runs out and you keep the whole haul plus a bonus for every life left.

Aura Forge is the room between runs. Attune one of fifteen glyphs to retune both games, swap it whenever a round feels stuck, and build the style that fits you.

What you get beyond the two modes:

A dashboard with charts, streaks, and earned achievements
Full run history that you can filter by game
A built-in walkthrough you can replay any time
Hand painted art, portrait, one handed play
No ads of any kind
A round can really be lost, so every tap on Vault is a real choice: cash in now, or push for one more shard.

name: Qandil
description:
Qandil, « la lanterne des mosquées », est un compagnon musulman gratuit, sans publicité et sans compte, pensé pour accompagner votre journée.

HORAIRES DE PRIÈRE
Les cinq prières sont calculées sur votre téléphone d'après votre position, avec un rappel à l'heure exacte. Choisissez votre appel à la prière : trois enregistrements d'adhan (La Mecque, Al-Aqsa, Le Caire), le son par défaut, le vibreur seul ou le silence.

QIBLA
Une boussole indique la direction de La Mecque depuis votre position.

LE CORAN AU QUOTIDIEN
Chaque jour, un verset ou un passage est présenté en arabe avec sa traduction française, accompagné de la récitation audio du cheikh Mishary Alafasy. Les 6 236 versets défilent dans un ordre varié, sans répétition avant d'avoir tout parcouru, et plus de mille d'entre eux sont accompagnés d'une courte explication. Recherchez un mot dans le Coran, enregistrez vos versets favoris.

AU FIL DE LA VIE
• Calendrier hégirien avec les dates religieuses marquantes
• Suivi des jeûnes, avec les jours recommandés
• Chapelet numérique (dhikr) avec vibration
• Journal de gratitude et d'intentions
• Mosquées proches de vous, d'après les données OpenStreetMap
• Présentation neutre des courants de pensée de l'islam
• Mode clair, sombre ou automatique

RESPECT DE VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucun outil de suivi. Votre journal, vos favoris et vos jeûnes restent sur votre téléphone.

SOURCES
Traduction française : Muhammad Hamidullah (via Tanzil.net et alquran.cloud). Texte arabe : Tanzil.net. Récitation : Mishary Alafasy. Adhan : enregistrements du domaine public (Archive.org). Les horaires sont calculés par la méthode de la Ligue islamique mondiale et peuvent différer de quelques minutes de ceux de votre mosquée.

name: QPortal
description:
The official app of Shifa Al-Sudor Quran Academy: where knowledge purifies the chest.

Students, parents and teachers use QPortal to keep every part of Quran learning in one place: live classes, Hifz and lessons, homework and progress.

LIVE CLASSES THAT KEEP GOING
• Join your class with one tap and talk with your teacher.
• Lock your phone or switch apps: your microphone and your teacher's voice keep going.
• Mute, unmute or leave the class right from the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island, with the class name and a running timer.

HIFZ & LESSONS
• See new memorization, review and Qaida lessons as soon as your teacher assigns them.
• Follow attendance, grades and reports for each class.

NEVER MISS A CLASS
• Reminders before each class, and a notification the moment your class goes live.
• Notifications for new messages, grades, lessons, and classes that are scheduled or cancelled. Tap one to go straight to it.

FOR FAMILIES AND TEACHERS
• Parents can follow their children's classes and progress.
• Teachers can run classes, take attendance and message their students.
• English and Arabic.

QPortal is for enrolled students, families and teachers of Shifa Al-Sudor Quran Academy. You need an account from the academy to sign in.

name: Quastri
description:
Choose where each piece belongs. Complete rows and columns, clear space and plan your next move.

START FOR FREE
Play Classic and Zen, today's challenge and the first 6 Precision levels. Undo, redo and hints are free. Learn through guided exercises or skip the tutorial.

UNLOCK PRO WITH ONE PURCHASE
Expert on an 8×8 grid, Sprint with 180 seconds of active play, Rotation, all 60 Precision levels, the challenge archive, and 6 palettes with 4 surfaces. No subscription.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Drag pieces or use guided controls. Adjustable text and options for contrast and motion. Resume games saved on your device and share game codes: the same starting point, separate progress.

Play offline, with no ads or game account. Progress stays on this device. Pro purchases and restores use Apple services.

name: Quote Desk by Newgenix
description:
Keep your quote book organized on one device. Add a customer label, quote amount, due date and next step. Prepare a message draft, record contact you made yourself and mark the outcome.

See overdue follow-ups, pause a quote and record a do-not-contact preference. Six currencies are displayed explicitly, with totals kept separate by currency. Export CSV records or a JSON backup when you need a copy.

Quote Desk does not send messages, create invoices, process payments or guarantee sales. Follow-up counts and do-not-contact choices are tracked per record. Works on one device, with no account or cloud sync. Save text edits before closing, and keep your own backups.

name: Quran & Duas
description:
Quran & Duas is a complete daily companion for Shia Ithna Ashari Muslims: the Holy Quran, duas and ziyarat, prayer times with azan alerts, the Qibla and the Islamic calendar, in one simple app.

THE HOLY QURAN
• All 114 surahs in clear Indo-Pak or Uthmani script
• English translations: Ali Quli Qarai or Saheeh International
• Urdu translations: Allama Zeeshan Haider Jawadi, Shaykh Muhammad Hussain Najafi or Maulana Junagarhi
• Transliteration, switch translations on or off at any time
• Recitation by Mishary Alafasy or Abdur Rahman As-Sudais, with the verse highlighted as it is recited
• Bookmarks and Continue reading

DUAS & ZIYARAT
• Duas: Ayat ul Kursi, Dua e Ahad, Dua e Kumayl, Dua Tawassul, Dua Nudba, Dua e Faraj, Hadees e Kisa, Dua e Mujeer, Dua e Alqamah
• Ziyarat: Ashura, Waritha, Arbaeen, Nahiya, Aal e Yasin, Jamia Kabeera, Jamia Sagheera and more
• Arabic with English and Urdu, line by line
• Search in English or Urdu

PRAYER TIMES & AZAN ALERTS
• Shia Ithna Ashari calculation: Fajr 16°, Maghrib 4°, Isha 14°
• Finds your location automatically and follows you when you travel
• Azan at the exact time of every salah, even when the app is closed
• On iOS 26 the azan rings like an alarm, even when your iPhone is on silent
• Choose a different azan for each prayer: Azan, Mecca or Medina
• Sound and vibrate switches

QIBLA
• Live compass that turns with your phone and tells you when you face the Kaaba

CALENDAR
• Hijri date on every screen, with a moon-sighting adjustment
• Month calendar with wiladat, shahadat and other occasions of the Ahlul Bayt (a.s.)

TODAY
• Next prayer, Ayah of the Day, today's duas and the month at a glance
• Home-screen and lock-screen widgets for the next prayer and the Ayah of the Day

MAKE IT YOURS
• 12 themes: Sky, Cream, White, Sepia, Dark, Black, Lavender, Emerald, Navy, Violet, Royal and Maroon
• The app icon changes to match your theme
• Adjustable Arabic and translation text size

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location and settings stay on your phone. Everything except recitation works offline.

Dedicated to Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.). Please pray for his reappearance.

name: Race to the pool
description:
Windy Croc and Hippo: Race to the Pool is a hilarious board game packed with surprises, crazy attacks, and plenty of laughs.

Instructions:

Aim of the game: Be the first player to reach the pool and win.

At the start of each game, 6 Mystery Spaces and 10 Weapon Spaces are randomly placed on the board. Their positions change every game, so no two races are ever the same. Each player takes turns spinning the Main Spinner and moving 1 to 6 spaces along the board.

Mystery:

If you land on a Mystery Space, spin the Mystery Spinner to decide your fate:

• Miss a turn

• Move back 2 spaces

• Move forward 2 spaces

Weapon:

If you land on a Weapon Space, spin the Weapon Spinner to see which weapon you will use against your opponent.

Spring Attack: Launches your opponent back 10 spaces.

Steal Weapon: Removes a weapon space from your opponent's board and places it on your own.

Special Move: Launches a gas bubble at your opponent, sending them back 1 to 6 spaces.

Bomb Attack: Place a bomb trap on your opponent's board. Slide the bomb selector to the space where you want to place the bomb and press Select. If your opponent lands on that space, they will be blasted back to the Start.

name: Rail Desk
description:
Plan a railway that works for every service.

Rail Desk is an offline railway logic game about track layouts, directional rules and shared routes. Place pieces from a limited inventory, assign switch exits for different services, then dispatch your plan. Follow each train's actual journey to check station calls, platform approaches and loops.

BUILD FROM A SINGLE LINE TO A SHARED NETWORK
Start with 30 campaign puzzles covering straights, bends, one-way rails, splits, merges and interchanges. Take on 24 network operations where several services must complete their own itineraries on the same board. Eight port-planning studies add separate overpass lanes, platform directions and service-specific restrictions.

KEEP ONE BLUEPRINT WORKING THROUGH MAINTENANCE
Service Windows asks a common layout to satisfy several declared track closures. Keep your rails and inventory shared, but program each window's signals separately. Complete every service in every window to finish the assignment.

COORDINATE CARGO CONNECTIONS
Freight Exchange adds pickups, handovers and deliveries. Choose the departure order and account for train capacity and exchange storage. Arriving at the destination is only part of completing a shipment's service chain.

INVESTIGATE SIGNAL FAULTS
Signal Lab contains six investigations across three fixed yards. Choose a diagnostic service, compare detector sequences and arrival receipts, and narrow down the possible faults. The optional probe planner groups predicted receipts to help you choose a useful next run. Isolate the supported fault, repair the yard and verify every service before closing the case.

COMPARE PLANS AND REFINE YOUR WORK
Keep alternatives in Plan A and Plan B. Step through dispatch records, locate a failed service or tile, and return to the board to make changes. After a successful dispatch, pursue personal targets for fewer materials, travel moves or switch instructions. Your logbook keeps progress, investigation files and personal records.

EXPLORE NEW RULES ON FAMILIAR YARDS
An additional 72 contracts and 12 infrastructure works briefs adapt existing operation yards. Material caps, rail-use requirements and fixed infrastructure change the planning problem on those familiar maps.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
All content is included offline, with progress and plans saved on your device. Undo and redo edits, place track by dragging or tapping, and choose your train animation, sound and music settings.

Designed for iPhone and iPad. Requires iOS 15.0 or later. The in-app interface is in English.

name: Reda AI
description:
Reda AI corrige redações no modelo do ENEM com inteligência artificial e mostra onde melhorar.

COMO FUNCIONA
• Fotografe a folha da redação (ou envie uma imagem ou PDF de uma página) e informe o tema.
• A IA transcreve o manuscrito sem alterar o seu texto e avalia as 5 competências do ENEM.
• Você recebe uma estimativa de nota de 0 a 1000, a nota de cada competência, os trechos que justificam a avaliação e os pontos para focar agora.

ACOMPANHE SUA EVOLUÇÃO
• Meu desempenho mostra a sua última nota, a média, a melhor nota e a evolução em cada competência.
• Baixe a correção em PDF ou compartilhe pelo WhatsApp e por e-mail.

PARA ESTUDANTES DE ESCOLAS
• Vincule sua conta à escola com o código e a matrícula e veja as correções que a escola publicar, com a sua posição na turma naquele tema.
• Receba um aviso quando uma correção for publicada.

FASE PILOTO
Durante o piloto, cada conta recebe correções gratuitas para experimentar. Não há compras no aplicativo.

IMPORTANTE
A nota é uma estimativa para treino, gerada por inteligência artificial, e não substitui a correção oficial do INEP. A transcrição reproduz fielmente o que foi escrito; o texto do estudante nunca é "melhorado". Menores de 18 anos usam o serviço com a concordância de um responsável.

Privacidade: https://www.redaai.app.br/privacidade
Termos de uso: https://www.redaai.app.br/termos
Suporte: https://www.redaai.app.br/suporte

name: ReptiMate
description:
ReptiMate is a simple, private care log for snakes, lizards and geckos.

FEEDING & REMINDERS
• Log each feed: food type, size, quantity, and whether it was eaten or refused
• Set a feeding interval per reptile and get a reminder on feeding day
• See at a glance who's due today or overdue

WEIGHT
• Record weigh-ins and see a weight chart over time
• Spot gains and losses since the last weigh-in

SHEDS
• Log each shed and note stuck shed or retained eye caps
• See the average time between sheds

ENCLOSURE
• Record hot side, cool side and humidity
• Readings are checked against typical ranges for popular species, so problems stand out

CARE REMINDERS
• Repeating reminders for water changes, cleaning, supplements, UVB bulb swaps and vet checks
• Choose the time of day your reminders arrive

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• All your data stays on your iPhone and is never uploaded

Species care ranges are general guidance, not veterinary advice.

name: RepUp - 자동 세트 코치
description:
RepUp은 헬스장에서 휴대폰을 만지지 않고 운동할 수 있게 돕는 앱입니다.

운동 시작을 누르면 앱이 음성으로 진행합니다.
- 10초 카운트 뒤에 세트가 시작됩니다.
- 애플워치를 바나 손목에 두면 모션 센서로 횟수를 셉니다.
- 세트가 끝나면 휴식 시간을 재고, 다음 세트를 알려 줍니다.
- 워치가 없어도 음성 안내는 그대로 되고, 횟수는 화면에서 입력합니다.

루틴
- 가슴, 어깨, 삼두처럼 부위별로 루틴을 만듭니다.
- 운동마다 세트별 무게와 횟수를 정할 수 있습니다.
- 프로필을 바탕으로 기기 안의 AI가 주간 루틴을 추천합니다. (Apple Intelligence 지원 기기)

목표와 기록
- 이번 주에 한 운동과 목표 달성 여부를 봅니다.
- 달력에서 지난 운동을 다시 보고, 운동 기록을 이미지로 저장할 수 있습니다.
- 애플워치와 함께 운동하면 건강 앱에도 기록됩니다.

모든 데이터는 기기 안에만 저장되며 외부 서버로 보내지 않습니다.

name: ResetCalendar
description:
ResetCalendar keeps track of your AI service quotas so a limit never catches you mid-task.

Your Mac reads your usage from the services you use, and ResetCalendar on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch shows what's left, when each limit resets, and how fast you're using it.

• Remaining quota and reset countdowns for each account
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen, and Apple Watch complications
• Reset reminders and low-quota alerts, with quiet hours
• Reset events your Mac adds to your calendar, readable on iPhone when the Mac is away
• Usage history and pace for each reset cycle
• Service status for the providers you use
• A built-in authenticator for TOTP and Steam Guard codes
• Optional private iCloud sync

Requires the free ResetCalendar app for Mac, which collects your usage: github.com/gmkbenjamin/downloads. Works with services including Claude, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Gemini. ResetCalendar is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them; their names are trademarks of their respective owners.

ResetCalendar collects no data: no account, no analytics, no tracking.

name: Revolta
description:
Não vás dar uma volta em vão.

A Revolta ajuda-te a encontrar máquinas de devolução de garrafas e latas perto de ti. Abre a app, permite a localização e percebe imediatamente qual é a melhor opção.

• Mapa simples com pontos de devolução próximos
• 2.747 localizações oficiais de máquinas e quiosques Volta
• Horário publicado para cada ponto
• Distância em linha reta
• Filtros por tipo de ponto
• Direções no Apple Maps
• Reporte de máquina operacional, cheia ou com problema
• Sem registo obrigatório

As localizações e horários provêm do diretório público oficial da Volta. Quando não existe telemetria autorizada nem reporte recente, o estado aparece como desconhecido. Nesta versão, o reporte fica guardado apenas no dispositivo e é identificado pela hora e origem.

name: Rhema: Private Messaging
description:
Rhema is a messaging app made by SiliconBlast. Everything you send is end-to-end encrypted on your phone before it leaves, and the Rhema server cannot read it or listen to your calls.

Rhema keeps an encrypted backup of your message keys so you can recover your history on a new phone with your backup PIN. If you lose every device and forget your PIN, Rhema support can help you recover your history after confirming who you are. You can turn that off with Advanced protection in Settings.

What you can do in Rhema:

- Chat with one person or with a group.
- Make voice and video calls, which are encrypted end to end as well.
- Calls ring on your lock screen and keep going when you switch apps.
- Send photos, videos, files and voice messages.
- Share your location in a chat when you choose to.
- Turn on disappearing messages for a chat.
- Compare safety numbers with a contact to check that nobody is listening in.
- Share into Rhema from Photos, Malakh and Penielly.
- Ask Queravel, SiliconBlast's assistant, about a chat when you want help with it.

Your account and your keys:

- Sign in with your SiliconBlast account, or with Google, Apple or Microsoft.
- Your encryption keys are made on your phone and kept in its secure storage.
- Block or report anyone from their profile or from the chat.
- Delete your account in Settings whenever you want.

Rhema has no ads and no trackers.

name: Riichi Helper
description:
At a real riichi mahjong table, the hardest part for many players isn’t playing — it’s scoring. Riichi Helper puts scoring, wait checking and scorekeeping in one app, built for beginners playing in person. Everything works offline.

SNAP TO SCORE
Take a photo of your hand and the app recognizes the tiles, then works out the yaku, fu and points. Recognition runs on your phone; photos are never uploaded. Fix a misread tile with a tap, or enter tiles with the tile keyboard.

WINNING HANDS
• Every yaku with its han, with dora, red dora and ura dora counted separately
• “Why 30 fu?” explains the fu, item by item
• Ron or tsumo, dealer or not, honba and riichi sticks — see exactly who pays what

WAITS AND DISCARDS
• 13 tiles: which tiles you’re waiting on, how many are left, what each win pays, and whether you have a yaku
• 14 tiles: shanten and number of outs for every discard, with backward discards flagged
• With called melds, enter just the tiles in your hand

HAN AND FU TO POINTS
• Pick han and fu to see ron and tsumo payments side by side
• Score table with a dealer / non-dealer switch
• Haneman and above grouped by tier, or hidden once you know them

MATCH SCOREKEEPING
• Four players’ points, riichi sticks, honba and draw payments settled automatically, including dealer repeats
• Final scores with uma and oka
• Same-table sync: nearby phones connect directly to share scores, no internet needed
• Table mode: lay the phone in the middle so every player sees their own score facing them

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
Use the cover screen one-handed when folded; unfold to see input and results side by side without scrolling. Works great on every iPhone.

YOUR TABLE’S RULES
Open tanyao, red fives, kiriage mangan, kazoe yakuman, 4-fu double wind pairs and double yakuman can all be set to match your table.

Available in English, Japanese and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional). No sign-up, no ads, no data collected.

name: Ripple Garden
description:
Place a stone, and a wave rises in the sand.
Where two waves meet, they fall still.

Ripple Garden is a logic puzzle played in a Japanese dry-stone garden (karesansui). Every stone sends a circular ripple through the raked sand, and wherever two ripples overlap they cancel out, leaving the sand calm again.

■ How to play
• Cover every black dot with a wave
• A wave where there is no dot leaves a red mark
• A pebble's ripple reaches the neighbouring dots; a large stone's reaches one ring further
• Stones can't be placed on moss

■ Features
• The gardens, from small pebble gardens to eight-by-eight gardens of moss and stone
• Every garden has exactly one solution
• Stuck? A hint gently lights the next place
• Up to 100 points per garden, with an optional Game Center ranking
• A quiet garden drawn down to the grains of sand and the cracks in the stone
• No sign-in needed — just play
• Optional offerings: receive a Zen-phrase omikuji and a monthly goshuin. Every garden stays free

■ Origins
Sand scattered on a vibrating plate gathers where waves cancel, drawing patterns known as Chladni figures. Quantum things such as light and electrons behave as waves and interfere in the same way. The ripples in this garden follow the same rule.

name: Rivet Works: Factory Idle
description:
Rivet Works is a factory optimization game built around one satisfying question: what is slowing your line down right now?

Build a production chain in a living 3D factory. Watch raw ore become parts, crates and finished products as drills spin, presses stamp, robot arms assemble and the delivery truck rolls out. Spot the bottleneck, tune the machine that actually matters, and feel the whole line speed up.

WHAT YOU DO
• Run a multi-stage production line you can watch work
• Find starved, blocked and overloaded machines at a glance
• Upgrade speed, value, capacity and automation
• Trigger Overdrive and chase Perfect Flow
• Complete Contracts, Daily objectives and 26 achievements
• Rebuild for Blueprints and permanent Research across five Workshops
• Choose Shift Brief directives with real trade-offs
• Earn offline production while you are away

MADE FOR IPHONE
Haptic feedback and an adaptive soundtrack that follows your factory's flow.

FAIR, OPTIONAL MONETIZATION
Rewarded ads are always optional. A one-time Remove Ads purchase removes forced ads. The one-time Supporter pack includes Remove Ads plus a Supporter badge. No loot boxes, no gambling, no pay-to-win.

Tune the line. Find the constraint. Rebuild smarter.

name: Roll Paint: Cube Puzzle
description:
One cube. One wet face. Paint every tile.

Roll Paint is a calm, clever puzzle about thinking a few rolls ahead. Your cube has a single pink face. Every time that face lands down, it splats paint on the tile beneath. Paint every marked tile before you run out of moves, and earn three stars by matching the best solution.

15 WORLDS, 180 PUZZLES, A NEW TWIST EVERY TIME
• Stone Garden: pillars and gaps to work around
• Glass House: roll over glass, but never paint it
• Portal Park: in one side, out the other
• Frozen Lake: slide on ice and smear a whole row
• Twin Tones: two colors on one cube
• Arrow Alley, Paint Wells, Turntable Town, Crumble Cliffs, Gatekeeper, Spike Rhythm, Last Drop, Color Lab and the Grand Gallery

Every world ends in a MASTERPIECE: a bigger board whose tiles reveal a hidden picture.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily Puzzle: one fresh puzzle a day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak!
• Endless mode: puzzles that never run out
• Hints show your next three rolls from wherever you are
• Undo, restart and skip whenever you need

MAKE IT YOURS
Collect cubes (dice, galaxy, kitty, disco, golden...), paint palettes and splat shapes.

Tactile rolls, juicy splats, a little melody as you paint, and a satisfying final chord. No timers, no rush. Just you, a cube and a good "aha".

name: Roomtake
description:
Roomtake turns a room into a paint and flooring estimate. Scan the room with LiDAR, or type the sizes on any iPhone. Then read the numbers you need to order materials and quote the job.

WHAT YOU GET
- Floor area, wall area for each wall with doors and windows deducted, perimeter and baseboard length
- Paint in gallons or liters, by number of coats and coverage, with the mix of containers to buy
- Flooring boxes, with waste added
- Multi-room projects, each room with a status
- Units in feet and inches or in meters

TWO WAYS TO ADD A ROOM
- Scan: walk around the room with a LiDAR iPhone or iPad Pro (iPhone Pro, iPad Pro) and Roomtake builds the room for you
- Add by hand: pick a rectangle, an L-shape or a list of walls and type the sizes. Works on every iPhone

CHECK AND EDIT
Measurements can be checked and edited by hand, so you stay in control of every number before you buy or quote.

PDF AND CSV ESTIMATE (PRO)
Send a clean estimate as a PDF or a CSV file, with labor and material prices.

FREE AND PRO
- Free covers 1 project, with scanning, areas and paint and flooring amounts
- Pro is a one-time purchase (no subscription): unlimited projects, PDF and CSV estimates, and labor and material prices

PRIVATE
Your projects stay on your device. No account, no sign-up, no ads.

Roomtake is made for painters, floor installers, contractors and anyone fixing up a home.

name: Rosqa: Handball Game
description:
3D handball, 7 v 7, in a night-time arena with the crowd on its feet. You lead your team: run, pass, shoot and defend with one finger.

ATTACK WITH YOUR FINGER
• Stick on the left to move with the ball.
• Tap a team-mate to pass.
• Swipe towards the goal to shoot: direction picks the side, length the height and speed the power. Curve the swipe for a spin shot, go slow for a lob or low for a bounce shot.

DEFEND AS A TEAM
• Pick a 6-0 or 5-1 defence.
• STEAL from the ball carrier, BLOCK the shot and SWITCH player.
• On 7-metre throws and fast breaks you are the keeper: swipe to where the ball goes.

REAL HANDBALL RULES
Goal area, steps, double dribble, 3 seconds, free throws, 7-metre throws and 2-minute suspensions. Every change of possession is shown calmly: who attacks and why.

WINTER WORLD CUP
24 invented nations, 6 groups, last 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals and the final. In knockout games a draw goes to a 7-metre shoot-out.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Quick match: pick your team, opponent, difficulty, length and men's or women's teams.
• 7-metre duel: challenge a friend with a code, 5 shots and 5 saves each.
• Daily challenge: the same one for everybody.

YOUR LOCKER ROOM
Shirts, shoes and balls you try on in 3D before choosing. All cosmetic: nothing makes you play better.

In 12 languages. Plays offline (the duel and the daily challenge use the internet).
Free to play with ads between matches. Optional purchases: "No ads", the Club Pack and a bag of coins.

name: Rosterleaf
description:
Give every sports card a place, a version and a history.

Rosterleaf is a personal archive for physical sports card collections. Build parallel checklists, file cards into binder pockets, preserve condition observations, and keep track of grading submissions, completed movements and protection supplies.

RECORD THE DETAILS THAT DISTINGUISH YOUR CARDS
Save the player, team, league, set, year, card number and type. Add the parallel, serial number, print run, color and printing version, along with front, back and detail photos and your own custom notes.

BUILD YOUR RAINBOW
Group the parallel versions of the same card and see which versions are held or missing. Multiple copies of one version count once toward progress. Choose two cards to compare photos, numbering, colors, personal condition notes and recorded grades side by side. Keep dated collection-plan reviews as your set develops.

KEEP A CONDITION HISTORY
Record observations of corners, edges, surfaces, creases and printing flaws. Each review preserves its notes and photos, so later updates do not replace earlier snapshots. Choose a next review date and return to it from the Workbench.

FILE, FIND AND CHECK YOUR CARDS
Organize binders, pages and pockets, with a visual binder map and location history. Preview available pockets before filing a batch of cards, optionally assigning sleeves and holders where needed. Resume an unfinished inventory check, then reconcile discrepancies while retaining the original snapshot.

FOLLOW YOUR OWN SUBMISSIONS AND MOVEMENTS
Keep grading companies, fees, stages, results, holder details and photos together. Log purchases, sales, exchanges, gifts, loans and returns after they happen. Create or link received card entries from a completed exchange and follow each card's movement history. Keep expected return dates for loans.

CARE FOR THE PROTECTION TOO
Track sleeve, top loader, magnetic holder and other supply specifications, purchases and remaining stock. Link protection use to individual cards. Record wear, retire damaged items and replace them with fresh stock while retaining assignment history. Set low-stock thresholds and optionally enable local stock notifications.

KEEP YOUR RECORDS PORTABLE
Preview card CSV imports and review errors or duplicates before adding entries. Export tables or save a full backup containing records and photos through Apple's Files picker. Choose iCloud Drive if you want a cloud copy. Backups are manual, with no automatic cloud synchronization.

RECOVER AN ACCIDENTAL REMOVAL
Removed cards stay in Recently deleted until restored or permanently deleted. Recover the original entry with its photos, condition history and grading records. Recovery checks changed storage, occupied pockets and surviving movement history.
