No account is required. Core collection tools work offline and records are stored on your device. Explore an optional fictional example archive in a separate workspace.

Rosterleaf is a personal record-keeping tool. It offers no marketplace, exchange matching, public listings, collector social network, market pricing, valuation or authenticity assessment.

The app interface is in English. Available for iPhone and iPad running iOS 15.0 or later.

name: Roughly: Currency Converter
description:
Ever looked at a price on a foreign website and wondered what it really costs? Roughly answers that for you, right on the page.

Roughly is a Safari extension. Set your home currency once, and prices on the websites you visit appear in money you think in. A price of ¥8,690 can show as ~$54.84, or stay where it is with your currency beside it: ¥8,690 (~$54.84).

SHOP ANYWHERE
• Works on the websites you already use, with no copying numbers into a converter
• More than 150 currencies
• Handles the many ways prices get written, like 1.234,56 €, 8,690円 and 1.5万円

YOUR CHOICE OF DISPLAY
• Show your currency next to the original price, or instead of it
• Turn Roughly off on any website, straight from Safari's toolbar
• Fields you type in are left alone, so converted prices don't end up in your forms

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT KNOWS
• The ~ is a promise: these are close estimates for getting a feel for a price, and what you pay depends on your bank or card
• When a symbol could mean several currencies and the page doesn't settle it, Roughly leaves that price alone rather than guess

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in
• No analytics or tracking
• Prices are converted on your device. Roughly downloads exchange rates about twice a day, and those requests contain nothing about what you browse

GETTING STARTED
Open Roughly and pick your currency, then turn the extension on in Safari and allow it on the websites you'd like. Roughly works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

TERMS OF USE
Roughly is licensed under Apple's standard licence agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: RowLoom
description:
RowLoom är ett offlineverktyg för dig som stickar eller virkar. Håll reda på aktuellt varv, din plats i rapporten, återstående varv och nästa planerade steg på en och samma skärm. Tryck för att avsluta ett varv och ångra om du råkar trycka två gånger.

Funktioner:
• Projektbibliotek: spara diagram, totalt antal varv, rapportens längd och antal upplagda maskor för varje projekt och växla mellan projekt.
• Varvräknare: se aktuellt varv, avklarade och kommande varv, rapportens förlopp och nästa steg. Håll ned knappen för avslutat varv för att lägga till en markering.
• Diagram: importera ett eget diagram från Bilder och zooma med fingrarna. Markeringsbandet placeras proportionellt efter aktuellt varv och diagrammets varvantal som ett visuellt stöd; appen läser inte av enskilda varv.
• Tre beräkningsverktyg: beräkna uppläggning, planera jämnt fördelade ökningar eller minskningar och uppskatta garnåtgång. Lägg till planen i projektets befintliga plan eller ersätt den efter bekräftelse.
• Maskordlista: 20 vanliga stick- och virkmaskor och diagramsymboler, med namn på kinesiska och engelska, kategorifilter och sökning.
• Utseende och data: välj ljust, mörkt eller systemets utseende. Gränssnittet följer systemets språk och finns på engelska och förenklad kinesiska. Projekt, diagram och markeringar lagras på enheten.

Observera:
• Appen fungerar offline. Inget konto behövs, och appen innehåller inga annonser eller analys- eller spårningsverktyg. Inga data samlas in eller laddas upp. Diagram importeras via systemets bildväljare utan att appen begär åtkomst till bildbiblioteket.
• Beräkningarna är uppskattningar. Använd en egen provlapp för att bedöma masktäthet och garnåtgång. Följ alltid symbolförklaringen i ditt diagram.
• Endast iPhone i stående läge; kräver iOS 17.0 eller senare.

name: RRR Video: Film Look Grading
description:
A film video editor made by a brand marketer who shoots for fun.

RRR Video brings the color of the RRR photo app to video. The same filters and tools now run on every frame of your clip.

Start with a filter
Daily, Portrait, Landscape, Cinematic, Vintage, Mood, Black & White. Pick one of 136 filters, then set how strong it should be. Save looks you like as My Filters and reuse them on other clips.

Works with Log footage
Clips shot in Apple Log or HDR on iPhone are converted when you import them, so you can skip the flat gray step and pick a filter right away.

Film light and grain
Red halation around bright lights, soft bloom, grain that changes every frame. You can also add vignette, film flicker and gate weave, dust and scratches.

Fine control
Exposure, contrast, tone curve, HSL, color wheels and print tone. Check your work on a waveform or vectorscope, and use keyframes to change the grade from shot to shot.

Crop to any ratio
9:16 for Reels up to 2.39:1 scope, or crop freely.

Export
Save in 1080p or 4K as HEVC 10-bit without banding. Turn on HDR and highlights look brighter on HDR iPhones. ProRes is available on supported devices. Batch export saves several clips at once.

Privacy
All editing happens on your device. Your videos are never uploaded or collected.

Pricing
- All features are free for the first 3 days. You are never charged automatically when the trial ends.
- After the trial you can keep editing and previewing. Saving videos requires the Lifetime Unlock, a one-time purchase.
- The Lifetime Unlock is not a subscription. No auto-renewal, no extra fees.
- New phone or reinstall? Use Restore Purchases.

Terms: https://leerowoonsaenghwal.github.io/rrr-legal/video-terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://leerowoonsaenghwal.github.io/rrr-legal/video-privacy.html

name: RSM Metronome
description:
Make a little practice part of your day with RSM Metronome from Rob’s School of Music.

Choose a tempo, tap Start and follow the beat. Whether you’re working on piano scales, drum rudiments or guitar chord changes, the controls keep your practice setup simple.

• Set a tempo from 30 to 300 BPM with the slider or one-BPM adjustments.
• Tap a rhythm to find your tempo.
• Choose 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8 or 12/8.
• Hear one, two, three or four evenly spaced clicks per beat.
• Switch the first-beat accent on or off.
• Follow the beat numbers and subdivision indicators on screen.
• See how long you’ve practiced during the current app session.
• Return to your saved tempo and rhythm settings next time.
• Find short practice tips for piano, drums and guitar.

Metronome playback works offline, with no account, ads or in-app purchases.

BPM follows the written beat unit: quarter notes in /4 meters and eighth notes in /8 meters. In 6/8, for example, the app counts six eighth-note beats rather than two dotted-quarter beats.

A little practice. A lot of progress.

name: Sadouak
description:
Sadouak connects you with trusted local service providers across Laos — cleaners, plumbers, electricians, carpenters, beauty professionals and more.

Find the right person for the job, see their rating and distance, and book in a few taps. Chat in the app, track your booking, and pay the provider when the work is done.

WHY SADOUAK
• Real local providers — browse by category, rating or distance
• Flexible pricing — fixed price, hourly, or per-day bookings
• Recurring bookings and multi-service packages
• Urgent help — tell us what you need and we find a vetted provider
• Door identity check — confirm the person at your door matches their photo before the job starts
• In-app chat, booking history and PDF invoices
• Wallet and cash payment options
• Available in English, Lao and Chinese

SAFETY
Providers are reviewed before they can take jobs, and complaints require evidence so every case can be handled fairly. You can report a problem from any booking.

Sadouak is built for Laos, with prices in Lao Kip, local support and support for the languages people actually use every day.

name: Safe Share: Metadata Cleaner
description:
Before you send a photo, a video or a PDF, Safe Share shows you what the file secretly says about you, removes it, and reads the copy again to check. Then it hands the clean copy to the app you wanted to send it with.

No account. No ads. No subscription. Works offline: the app makes no network requests.

HOW IT WORKS
1. In Photos or another app, tap Share and choose Safe Share, or pick photos, videos and PDFs inside Safe Share. One file or many.
2. See what it says about you: exact location, phone model and serial number, when it was taken, your name or copyright, the editing app, hidden preview images. Plain names, technical names underneath.
3. Tap "Clean & share". Safe Share writes a new copy, checks it and, if the checks pass, opens the share sheet.
Your original is never changed. Safe Share only reads it and writes a new copy.

WHAT IT HANDLES
Photos: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF and AVIF. Videos: MP4, M4V and MOV. Documents: PDF. Anything else is listed as "Not supported yet — not changed" and is never called clean.
The picture, the video and sound, and the PDF pages are copied as they were: nothing is recompressed, resized or redrawn. Three profiles: "Remove everything" (default), "Location only" and "Keep camera settings".

CHECKED, NOT JUST CLAIMED
After cleaning, Safe Share reads the copy again, up to four ways: it reads the file structure, searches the copy byte by byte for every value it removed, runs a separate scan for known kinds of hidden data, and asks the iPhone's own reader (ImageIO, AVFoundation, PDFKit). The result says "Verified clean" only when none of the checks found anything left. If something is left it says "Not fully clean" and names it. If a check cannot run it says "Could not verify". Nothing is called clean without proof.

MANY FILES AT ONCE
Clean a whole batch with a progress bar and a Cancel button. One bad file never stops the rest, and a summary tells you how many were verified clean, not fully clean or not supported.

SAVE OR SHARE
Share the clean copy straight from the result, or save it: photos and videos to Photos (add-only access, asked the first time you save), anything to Files through the share sheet. By default copies get a neutral name (photo-4K7Q.jpg) because camera file names contain the date and time; Settings can keep the original names.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Safe Share cleans what is stored next to the picture. It cannot change what the picture shows: faces, house numbers, number plates, reflections. It does not look for invisible watermarks.
- An iPhone HDR photo may look slightly different afterwards: Apple's HDR headroom note is removed, and the result says so. The picture, depth and HDR images that are part of the HEIC picture stay and are listed.
- In videos, hidden data is overwritten with zeros and the file keeps its size. Data inside the video and sound streams themselves, such as a time code, is not inspected.
- In PDFs, earlier saved versions of the file can stay inside; the result says so. Comment authors, attached files, form fields and signatures are reported, not removed, so such a file is shown as "Not fully clean".
- The clean copy is a new file with today's date.
- Some apps remove some hidden data themselves when you send a picture, but you cannot rely on it. Settings explains what to expect.

PRIVACY
Files are read, cleaned and checked on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded. No account, no ads, no analytics, no crash reports, no tracking. Clean copies are temporary: they are deleted when you leave the result and every time the app starts. Files you share into Safe Share wait in its shared folder until you open the app. Safe Share keeps no history of your files, only your settings. "Show on map" opens Apple Maps with the coordinates when you tap it; Share hands the copy to the app you choose, which then follows its own rules.

Needs iOS 16.4 or later. The app is in English.

name: SafeGo GPS
description:
SafeGo is the companion app for SafeGo GPS trackers installed in vehicles. A compatible physical tracker must be installed and connected to your account. Without this hardware, the app cannot show your vehicle’s location or tracking data.

With a connected tracker, you can:
• View tracker-reported vehicle locations on a map
• Review journeys, stops and route history
• Create geofences and receive entry and exit alerts
• Get notifications for movement, speeding and other tracker events
• Use a 40 m SafeZone around a parked vehicle
• View available mileage, fuel, parking and voltage statistics
• Manage your vehicles, devices and account

The subscription is tied to the physical tracker and covers the mobile connectivity and infrastructure needed to transmit and store vehicle data. It does not provide digital content independently of the hardware. Tracking requires a compatible device installed in a vehicle and linked to your account.

SafeGo also offers a web platform with additional fleet management and reporting features. Features may differ between the web platform and this app.

name: Salah Point
description:
Salah Point shows the prayer times of your own mosque. Each mosque enters its times or has them calculated for its location with its own settings. Choose your mosque once and the app opens on its times.

PRAYER TIMES
- Adhan and iqama for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha, then the Friday prayers, up to four times
- Sunrise and sunset shown apart from the prayers
- A countdown to the next time and the date in both calendars
- Times are saved on your phone for at least 60 days, so the app also opens without internet

REMINDERS
- Switch on an adhan reminder for each prayer
- Your phone reminds you even without internet. Open the app at least every two weeks so that the next times are scheduled

FIND A MOSQUE
- Search by name, city or postcode
- See mosques near you, or browse them on a map
- See a mosque's address, Friday prayers, facilities and contact details, and get directions in your maps app

NEWS FROM MOSQUES
- Read what mosques publish, for all mosques or only yours
- Report a post, or hide all posts from a mosque on your phone. You can undo that in the settings

TEXT OF THE DAY
- If your mosque turned them on: a Quran verse, a hadith, a dua or a reminder each day
- Verses and hadith come from published sources, named under each text, and are shown whole

DONATE TO YOUR MOSQUE
- Your mosque's donation link opens in your browser and goes directly to the mosque
- Bank details can be copied with one tap
- Salah Point handles no payments

ADS WITHOUT TRACKING
- Ads are checked by hand and booked per mosque
- They are always labelled, can be reported, and use no personal data

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account needed. Only mosque staff sign in, to manage their mosque
- Your location is only used to find mosques near you, and only if you allow it

Available in German, English, Arabic, French and Swedish.

Do you run a mosque? Register it at salahpoint.com, then manage times, posts and donation links there or in the app under More > Manage mosque.

name: Sales Setu
description:
**Sales Setu – Smart Sales & Lead Management**

Sales Setu is a business CRM application designed to simplify sales operations, customer management, and team productivity.

**Key Features:**

- Lead Management – Create, assign, and manage sales leads.
- Customer Management – Organize customer information and communication details.
- Follow-up Tracking – Schedule and manage customer follow-ups.
- Sales Activity Management – Record calls, customer visits, and sales activities.
- Voice-to-Text – Enter descriptions and notes using voice input.
- Team Collaboration – Help sales teams coordinate their daily activities.
- Sales Dashboard – Monitor leads, customers, and sales performance.

Sales Setu helps businesses streamline their sales processes and manage customer relationships efficiently.

Developed by Tirupati Digitalworks Private Limited.

name: SBITON
description:
SBITON is the companion app for compatible SBITON HUB lighting controllers.

YOUR LIGHTS, YOUR COLORS
Adjust power and brightness, choose pure red, green and blue or pick your own color. Static colors transition smoothly using the controller's transition setting. Save favorite colors and create your own looks.

SCENES AND MUSIC
Explore editable scenes, supported lighting effects and DIY designs. Choose audio from a supported controller microphone or your phone. Beat Flash, Pixel Strobe, Power Bars and Spectrum Burst offer different sound-reactive looks. Microphone permission is needed for phone audio features.

CONTROL YOUR SETUP
Set LED counts, segments and supported output options. Organize compatible devices into groups and set supported schedules. Configure compatible controllers as Master and Secondary devices for synchronization; independent controllers remain separately controlled.

LAYOUTS AND STUDIO
Create wiring layouts and manage compatible effect files. After Wi-Fi setup, open the controller's local controls from Studio while your phone and controller are on the same network.

TRY THE INTERFACE
Explore the HUB feature preview before connecting hardware. Demo previews do not control physical lights or perform real Wi-Fi setup.

Compatible hardware is sold separately. Features depend on controller model, firmware, connections and permissions. Bluetooth is used to discover and configure supported controllers; local network control requires a network connection to the controller. Community and online content require internet access.

Support: support@sbiton.com
Website: https://sbiton.com

name: ScanApp
description:
ScanApp은 아이폰의 LiDAR 센서와 TrueDepth 카메라로 주변의 물체와 공간을 3D로 스캔하는 앱입니다.

■ LiDAR 모드
• 물체나 방 주위를 천천히 움직이면 실시간으로 3D 메쉬가 만들어집니다.
• 화면의 격자 무늬로 스캔되는 영역을 바로 확인할 수 있습니다.
• 스캔을 마치면 손가락으로 돌려 보고 확대해 볼 수 있습니다.
• LiDAR 센서가 탑재된 iPhone Pro 모델에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

■ TrueDepth 모드
• 전면 TrueDepth 카메라로 15~80cm 거리의 물체를 컬러 3D 메쉬로 촬영합니다.
• 촬영 전에 깊이 격자가 화면에 표시되어 촬영될 영역을 미리 확인할 수 있습니다.
• Face ID를 지원하는 iPhone에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

■ 내보내기
• OBJ, PLY, USDZ 형식으로 저장하고 공유할 수 있습니다.
• AirDrop이나 파일 앱으로 Mac, Blender, MeshLab 등에 옮겨 사용할 수 있습니다.

■ 개인정보
• 카메라 영상과 스캔 데이터는 기기 안에서만 처리되며 서버로 전송되지 않습니다.
• 가입이나 로그인이 필요 없습니다.

참고
• LiDAR 모드는 LiDAR 센서가 있는 기기에서만 동작합니다.
• TrueDepth 모드는 카메라를 향한 한쪽 면만 촬영됩니다. 물체 전체를 스캔하려면 LiDAR 모드를 사용하세요.
• 반사가 심하거나 투명한 물체는 스캔 품질이 떨어질 수 있습니다.

name: SCDO Glow Jungle
description:
SCDO Glow Jungle is a top-down bioluminescent jungle arcade shooter featuring both an 8-Player Simultaneous Online Arena and a separate Offline Single-Player Practice Mode.

8-PLAYER ONLINE ARENA (SERVER-AUTHORITATIVE)
- Up to 8 Real Simultaneous Players: Use Quick Match, Create Room, or enter a 6-digit Room Code to join up to 8 human players around the same jungle arena. Occupied turrets show live human players (Human · Seat 1–8), while unoccupied positions remain visibly marked as Empty Seat — bots are never disguised as human players.
- Authoritative Scoring & Reconnect: All projectile trajectories, enemy health, boss phases, and scores are calculated authoritatively on the server. If your connection drops briefly, the server holds your seat and score for up to 45 seconds so you can reconnect automatically.

OFFLINE PRACTICE MODE (SEPARATE FROM ONLINE MATCHES)
- Whenever you are offline or the online server is unavailable, tap Offline Practice (1P + 7 Sim Bots) in the lobby to play locally on your device alongside 7 clearly labelled simulated AI turrets (Sim Bot · Seat 1–8), scored separately from online matches.

TACTICAL JUNGLE COMBAT
- Crystal Beetles: Crawl along sine waves with 70% frontal armor mitigation — flank them for full damage.
- Glow Butterflies & Storm Dragonflies: Evasive butterflies dodge incoming fire and conduct chain lightning across nearby swarm members.
- Gorilla King Boss & Capture Net: Survive telegraphed ground-pound shockwaves. Below 50% HP, the Gorilla King raises a bullet-proof Thorn Shield — launch your Capture Net to shatter the shield and trigger a 5-second stun & 2x-damage burst window!

FREE VIRTUAL DEMO DISCLOSURE
- Requires no user account, no sign-in, and no chat. Every score and Demo Coin is a session-only, non-redeemable virtual point using fixed deterministic enemy HP and reward tables (no random capture rolls or gambling mechanics). Free +200 supply drops replenish your Demo Coins automatically whenever they run low. Contains no in-app purchases, no wallets, no payments, and no advertisements.

name: Scent Price Finder
description:
Scent Price Finder searches 38 fragrance discounters in the US, UK and Canada at once and sorts the results by the lowest price.

Features
• Search 38 fragrance discounters at once, and add your own stores
• Suggestions as you type: about 1,900 houses and 45,000 fragrances that the stores actually sell, refreshed daily
• Accurate matching: flankers (Elixir, Intense, …) kept apart, strength filter (Extrait, Parfum, EDP, EDT), older/newer version labels
• Boxed, tester, unboxed, mini/sample and gift-set filters; compare by size and price per ml
• Prices in USD, GBP, EUR, CAD or KRW (daily exchange rates), with each store's free-shipping threshold
• Discount codes and sign-up offers that stores publish, plus an "Open in Shop" button
• Search history with the lowest price found, and a quick guide for first-time users
• Restock alerts: stock is checked every minute and you are notified on Telegram
• Tap a result to open it in Safari and buy with your own account
• Includes a Safari extension to search right inside Safari
• English and Korean

Good to know
• Prices are item prices only; shipping, duties and taxes are not included.
• This app sells nothing and is not affiliated with any store. Prices and stock can change, so confirm on the store's website before buying.
• Searches and settings stay on your device. Restock alert details are stored on our server only if you use alerts, and you can delete them anytime in the app. A Korean name that isn't in the built-in lists is sent (just the name) to our server to find its English name.

name: Sensei Time
description:
Sensei Time is a library of short, friendly lessons about the Japanese you actually see and hear: anime lines, travel phrases, everyday expressions, and the grammar behind them.

READ AND LISTEN
• Short articles with furigana and natural audio recorded for each sentence
• Dialogues you can play line by line
• A few quick practice questions with pictures

FIND WHAT FITS YOU
• Pick your level and interests, and get articles that match
• Save articles to come back to later

ASK A REAL TEACHER (Standard & Premium)
• Send a question about any Japanese you're curious about
• Record your pronunciation and get personal feedback
• A real Japanese teacher reads and replies to every request

PLANS
Articles are free to read. Standard and Premium include weekly questions and pronunciation checks for Ask Sensei.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Service: https://senseitime.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://senseitime.com/privacy

name: Shadow of Neverhill
description:
Condemned for a crime you did not commit, you are lowered into the Oubliette, the sealed prison beneath Neverhill, the mountain no one walks back down. The Magistrate has sworn a pardon to whoever returns with the Sunstone. In eleven years, no one has.

Shadow of Neverhill is a classic roguelike with one rule at its heart: you only see what is lit. Your torch burns oil, and when it goes out the world turns cold and blue, your own glow shrinks to a glimmer, and the things in the dark can still see you.

• Twenty-five hand-shaped floors across five regions: the gaol, the catacombs, a buried street, the forge halls and the abyss. Each floor adds a page to the story of the colony that dug too deep and the thing it woke.
• Turn-based or realtime. Play it as a roguelike where nothing moves until you do, or in realtime with a joystick and a guard circle: time slows in a fight, blows come in as red shields, and your timing decides how much gets through.
• Four of the condemned: a knight who braces when he holds his ground, a sorcerer who reads pages from memory, a cutpurse who hoods the torch to vanish, a ranger who senses what walks behind the wall.
• Dread. The dark gathers on you: faster deep down, with the torch out, surrounded, beside graves. Past a point your aim suffers, and at the top you break and run. Fires, altars and company bring it down.
• The Boneyard: an optional field of graves behind a lych gate, where the stones can be read and some of them answer.
• Unknown draughts and pages learned by use, gear you can merge and improve, prisoners with errands, vaults, altars and a peddler.
• Recorded sound and a piano and cello score that follows you from place to place. No account, no connection needed, no ads, no purchases. Your run is saved on the device.
• Full game controller support, haptics, and a layout that works in portrait and landscape.

name: Shikaku - Brain Workout Game
description:
Shikaku - Brain Workout Game
Challenge your mind with Shikaku - Brain Workout, a relaxing Japanese logic puzzle game where numbers guide you to the perfect solution!
Enjoy colorful number grids, satisfying rectangle puzzles, and engaging brain teasers designed for players who love logical thinking. Whether you're new to Shikaku or an experienced puzzle solver, there's always another challenge waiting.

HOW TO PLAY SHIKAKU
Shikaku is a classic Japanese number puzzle with simple rules and rewarding challenges.
Divide the entire grid into rectangles.
- Each rectangle must contain exactly one number.
- The number tells you how many cells the rectangle must cover.
- Rectangles cannot overlap, and every cell must be filled.
- Use logic, planning, and careful thinking to solve each number grid puzzle!

GAME FEATURES

Multiple Difficulty Levels
Start with Easy puzzles and progress through Medium, Hard, and Master challenges. Improve your puzzle-solving skills as you tackle increasingly complex grids.

Daily Challenges
Enjoy daily Shikaku puzzles, maintain your streak, and build a regular puzzle-solving habit.

Colorful Logic Puzzles
Explore a clean, minimalist interface with colorful rectangles and easy-to-follow number grids.

Hints & Helpful Controls
Need a little help? Use hints when you're stuck. Undo, redo, and restart puzzles as you explore different solutions.

Track Your Progress
Review your completed puzzles, playtime, and daily streaks to see how far you've progressed.

Achievements & Rewards
Complete puzzle milestones, unlock achievements, and earn rewards as you continue playing.

Personalize Your Experience
Explore available visual themes and enjoy a puzzle-solving experience that suits your style.

A RELAXING BRAIN WORKOUT
Shikaku combines number puzzles, rectangle puzzles, and logic grid challenges into one engaging experience. Take your time, think through each move, and enjoy the satisfaction of finding the right solution.
From beginner-friendly puzzles to challenging Master grids, Shikaku - Brain Workout offers a thoughtful way to enjoy your puzzle time.

READY TO SOLVE?
Download Shikaku - Brain Workout and start solving colorful Japanese logic puzzles today!

name: ShiorWhee
description:
• Save a bike with bead-seat diameter, tire width, one or two chainrings, and the small and large cassette cogs
• Approximate rollout as pi times (bead-seat diameter + 2 × tire width)
• Show high and low development in meters and in gear inches
• Turn a cadence you type into an estimated speed in km/h
• Run rollout, development, and cadence-to-speed without saving a bike
• Keep ride notes: a route nickname, a gear, a cadence, and the speed estimate at save time
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: Shooty Hoops: Courtside
description:
Your college basketball season, courtside.

Shooty Hoops brings scores, ratings and bracket simulations together in a retro pixel style.

• Find your next game. Browse compact or standard scoreboards, check the TV guide and sort by time, Watchability or Tune In priority.
• Follow the action. Open Game Center for scores, play-by-play, box scores, game flow and player game grades when available.
• Know the teams. Explore team hubs, depth charts, player cards, schedules and ratings. Follow favorites and keep a history of games you've watched.
• See the race change. Browse conference standings, tournament brackets, seed lists and the Living Top 25. Use As It Stands to see projections based on current game leaders.
• Run your own season. Simulate regular-season games, conference tournaments and national brackets, or pick winners yourself. Personal what-if results stay separate from real results.
• Talk hoops. Join game chats with community rules, reporting and account-blocking controls.

Public basketball browsing is available without signing in. An account lets you sync favorites, watched history and chat with the Shooty Hoops website.

Scores and play-by-play data are supplied by Sportradar. Live coverage, statistics and player grades vary by game; missing data is not presented as a result. Internet access is required for current information.

Shooty Hoops is an independent college basketball app. Team names, logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: Sideline: Game Day Mix
description:
Get your team’s game-day music ready. Sideline brings warmup playlists, walk-up songs, and celebration sounds together on iPhone and iPad. Import songs from Files for offline playback, or connect Apple Music with a compatible subscription.

- Create up to five boards for different teams or events. Organize cues into Pregame, In Game, Timeouts, and Postgame.
- Import audio from Files for offline playback. Set cue points, fade local audio, and adjust levels.
- Add multiple songs to a cue and move through them from the playback deck.
- Keep game-day scripts handy in a full-screen reader while music plays.
- Set and display a kickoff countdown on iPad.
- Run Pregame sound check to verify your audio output and find missing files.
- Use optional private iCloud sync to keep your primary board available on your other devices. Additional boards are stored locally.

Apple Music is optional and requires a compatible subscription for catalog playback. Use audio you are authorized to play in your setting.

name: Sierra Worker
description:
Sierra Worker is the free app for people who work for businesses that use Sierra Stitch.

One Sierra Number for your working life. Share it with a business you trust, and it can connect with you. Every business you work with keeps its records with you in one place.

• See the machines you work on and your daily rate
• Accept or decline a new daily rate before it applies
• Ask for leave, and confirm absences a business records
• Follow your pay: days worked, bonuses, deductions and payments, and confirm what you received
• Get a notification when a business sends you something
• Keep working without internet: what you do is sent when you are back online
• Use it in English, Gujarati or Hindi

Sierra Worker keeps records; it does not employ you, set your pay or move money. Your work and pay are between you and each business.

For people aged 18 and over. Sign in with email, Google or Apple.

name: Signal Tempo
description: Signal Tempo is a Morse code practice app for beginners who want to learn how to send Morse code by hand. Tap the on screen telegraph key, watch every press and pause appear on a timeline, and see your message decode as you go. Then use Echo Practice to find out exactly where your rhythm drifts.

name: Signature Maker: Sign PDFs
seller_name: ITWORKED YAZILIM IC VE DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:

name: Sipumo: Water Reminder
description:
Sipumo is your friendly companion for every drink. One tap and your glass is logged. Sipumo knows your daily goal, gives you a gentle nudge while you're awake and adds a new sea creature to your aquarium for every day you make it.

ONE TAP IS ENOUGH
Three quick buttons with your favorite amounts. Water, tea, juice, milk, cocoa or something else: every drink counts fully toward your goal. Forgot one? Add it later with the time you had it, and undo any slip with a single tap.

A GOAL THAT FITS YOU
Sipumo suggests a daily goal based on the reference values of the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA), matched to age, sex and exercise, for kids too. You can set your own goal at any time, in fl oz or ml.

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT TIME
Reminders only come between getting up and going to bed, at the interval you choose after your last glass. Log right from the notification. Once you reach your goal, Sipumo stays quiet.

YOUR AQUARIUM GROWS WITH YOU
Every day you reach your goal brings a sea creature to your tank. There are fourteen to discover. Keep a streak going and every week adds a rare one, every 30 days a very rare one and every 100 days a legendary one. If your streak ever breaks, every creature stays where it is.

FAMILY DUEL
Start groups with family, friends or coworkers and invite them with a link. Every group has its own ranking for today and a weekly contest. What counts is how close everyone gets to their own goal, not who drinks the most. Only name, picture, goal, streak and daily totals are shared through iCloud, never individual drinks.

YOUR HISTORY
Streak, week and month at a glance, compared with the period before.

WHEREVER YOU ARE
• Apple Watch: log with one tap or the Digital Crown, a complication on your watch face and your family duel on your wrist
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• A control in Control Center and Siri shortcuts
• Apple Health: if you like, Sipumo writes water and tea, it reads nothing
• iPhone Duo: a large history when unfolded, the cover screen when folded

YOUR DRINKS STAY WITH YOU
Sipumo stores your entries on your iPhone. We run no servers, there is no account with us, no ads and no tracking.

PLEASE NOTE
Goals are reference values for healthy people, not medical advice. If you have a medical condition, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or your doctor has advised otherwise, please talk to your doctor.

Sipumo is made by Cyntro Systems GmbH, Austria.

name: Siyam: Ramadan & Sunnah Fasts
description:
Siyam helps you plan, keep and track your fasts all year, from Ramadan to the sunnah fasts to the days you need to make up.

EVERY FAST IN ONE PLACE
• Ramadan, with suhoor and iftar times for each day
• Mondays and Thursdays
• The White Days, the 13th to 15th of each Hijri month
• Arafah, Ashura and the six days of Shawwal
• Make-up (qada) fasts, with a count of the days you owe

SUHOOR AND IFTAR, WHEREVER YOU ARE
Times are worked out on your iPhone for your location, with the calculation method and Asr setting your mosque uses. Travel, and Siyam can follow you.

A CALENDAR THAT KNOWS THE HIJRI DATE
See Gregorian and Hijri dates side by side, with every fast marked. If your community starts the month a day earlier or later, adjust it in a tap.

REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
A reminder the evening before, one before suhoor ends, and one at iftar. Mark a fast as kept straight from the iftar notification.

YOUR MAKE-UP FASTS
Add the days you owe, log each one as you make it up, and watch the night sky turn to morning as the count goes down.

YOUR PROGRESS
Your streak, this month's fasts, and milestones along the way.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. Your fasts and settings stay on your iPhone, or in your own iCloud if you turn on sync, and you can export or delete them at any time. Lock Siyam with Face ID if you like. Siyam collects no data.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Open your iPhone Duo and the day spreads across both halves: today's sky beside your plan, the month beside the day you tap, and the light rising as you open it.

SIYAM PREMIUM
Ramadan, reminders and your make-up count are always free. Premium adds:
• An iftar countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Siyam on your Apple Watch: the day's sky, the countdown and Mark fasted
• A suhoor alarm that rings even in silent mode (iOS 26 or later)
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with upcoming fasts
• Planners: Ashura with the 9th or 11th, the first nine days of Dhul Hijjah, the Fast of Dawud, chosen days of Shawwal, and your own custom fasts
• A plan to make up your fasts before next Ramadan
• Your full history, a year view, stats for each fast and a Year in Review
• Alternate app icons

Premium is available yearly (with a free week for new subscribers), monthly, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase you can share with your family. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.

Siyam doesn't give religious rulings, and it isn't medical advice: if you have a health condition, ask your doctor before fasting.

name: Skysoon
description:
See what the sky is doing soon.

Skysoon is a weather app built around one question: how long until things change? Instead of a wall of numbers, it tells you in plain words. "12 min till it rains." "~3 hours till the rain stops." "7h 59m till the sun sets."

COUNTDOWNS TO WHAT MATTERS
• Rain starting and stopping, with the chance when it's uncertain
• Storms and strong gusts rolling in
• Snow, and fog rolling in or lifting
• Sunrise and sunset
• When it starts warming up or cooling down

ONE CLEAR TIMELINE
A glowing temperature ribbon with clouds, rain, snow and fog drawn right where they happen, and the sun's path underneath. Switch between the next hour, 12 hours, 24 hours and the week. Slide a finger across the chart to read any moment: the time, the temperature and the conditions.

WIDGETS
Countdowns on your Home Screen in small, medium and large sizes, plus Lock Screen widgets. Pick a different place and theme for each widget.

YOUR PLACES
Use your current location, or search for and save the places you care about. Switch between them from the place name.

MADE TO FEEL CALM
Three themes: Neon Dusk, Nature Sage and True Dark. Subtle haptics as you scrub through the forecast.

GREAT ON IPHONE DUO
Folded, the chart uses the full width of the cover screen. Open, the forecast and the countdowns sit side by side, and you can expand the chart to full screen. Fold it into book mode and the layout follows.

ACCESSIBLE
VoiceOver can step through the charts hour by hour, text grows with your text size, and Reduce Motion is respected.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location is used only to fetch the forecast, and your places stay on your device.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

name: Slabhold
description:
Slabhold is the social app for sports card collectors. Show off your collection, see what cards are really selling for, and talk cards with people who get it.

YOUR COLLECTION, ORGANIZED
• Add raw or graded cards with your own photos: player, year, set, parallel, serial number and grade
• Watch your collection's value over time with clean, simple charts
• Keep any card private, or show it on your public profile
• Track what you paid. Only you see it unless you choose to share it
• Sort your PC from your flips

COMPS FROM REAL SALES
• Quick Comp: type a card and see recent sold prices, the median and the range
• Real completed sales with photos, not asking prices
• Every card page shows its sales history on a chart

A TIMELINE THAT'S ALL CARDS
• Post pickups, mail days, pulls and grading returns
• Like, reply, repost and quote
• No politics, no noise. Just the hobby
• Share any card or post with a clean preview image

FIND YOUR PEOPLE
• Follow collectors who chase the same players and sets
• Direct messages for talking cards one on one

LEADERBOARDS AND BADGES
• Weekly leaderboards for most cards added, new followers and posts
• Moving: see which cards' prices are going up or down
• Earn badges for collecting, posting and keeping a streak

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Report a post, reply or collector, or block anyone, from the More menu
• Posts, replies and messages are filtered for abuse, and reports are reviewed within 24 hours
• Delete your account and your data anytime from Privacy & safety

MADE FOR iPHONE
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email
• Take card photos with your camera or pick them from your library
• Share to any app with the iPhone share sheet

Built by a collector, for collectors. Questions or ideas? Email slabholdapp@gmail.com or visit slabhold.app/support.

name: SlabPour: Site Cubic Yards
description:
SlabPour is an offline takeoff tool for homeowners and site helpers pouring a shed pad, patio, walkway, or equipment base.

On the Pour tab, enter length, width, and thickness in one horizontal row. SlabPour returns cubic yards immediately so you can order ready-mix or bags with a waste buffer in mind. Save a pour to Jobs, then open Yardage for a quick volume cheat sheet.

Unlike generic construction mega-calculators, SlabPour only does rectangular slab pours: site-first chrome, saved jobs, and a yardage reference. No account. No ads. Works offline.

name: Slate - Notes Made Free
description:
Slate is a calm place for your notes. It feels like Notion — type / for headings, to-dos, toggles, callouts, tables and code; drag blocks around; select text to format it — but every page is a plain Markdown file you own, just like Obsidian.

NO ACCOUNT, NO SERVER, NO TRACKING
Slate has no sign-up and no analytics. Your notes stay on your device. If you want them on all your devices, Slate syncs with a free private GitHub repository that you own — nobody else can see them, including us.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED
• A Notion-style block editor with slash commands and drag handles
• Tasks from every page in one list: Overdue, Today, Upcoming
• Templates, properties, and any folder as a table
• [[Links]] between pages, backlinks, and a graph of how your notes connect
• Encrypted pages, unlocked with Face ID or Touch ID
• Version history when sync is on
• Your own icons: emoji, or make one from shapes, colours and pixel art
• Light and dark themes, six palettes, any accent colour, four fonts
• An optional AI assistant: bring your own key for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more, and ask about your notes or have it tidy up your writing

YOURS FOR GOOD
Every page is a normal Markdown file, so your notes also open in Obsidian or any text editor. Slate is free and open source under the MIT license.

name: SlideClick
description:
SlideClick transforma o seu iPhone em um passador de slides sem fio para o Mac, com tudo o que você precisa para apresentar com calma.

ANTES DE COMEÇAR
• Veja qual arquivo vai abrir, em qual app e quantos slides ele tem.
• Escolha o tempo previsto e toque em Iniciar: o Mac abre a apresentação e já entra em tela cheia.

DURANTE A APRESENTAÇÃO
• Botões grandes de avançar e voltar, ou deslize na tela.
• Prévia do próximo slide e faixa de miniaturas: toque em uma para pular direto.
• "Slide 3 de 12" com barra de progresso.
• Notas do apresentador.
• Desenhe por cima dos slides: caneta, marca-texto, caixas, setas e textos, ao vivo na tela do Mac.
• Laser no ar e holofote: segure o botão e mova o iPhone para apontar.
• Cronômetro com meta de tempo e vibrações faltando 5 minutos, 1 minuto e no fim.
• Botões de volume passam os slides (opcional), para apresentar com o iPhone no bolso ou na mão sem olhar.
• Ir para o slide N, tela preta e modo trackpad.
• Roteiro (teleprompter) para ler o seu texto.

FUNCIONA COM
Keynote, PowerPoint, Google Slides no navegador e PDF no Pré-visualização. O app detecta qual está na frente.

PRIVADO E SEGURO
A conexão é direta pela rede Wi-Fi local, criptografada de ponta a ponta e pareada com um código de 6 dígitos. Nada passa por servidores. Sem contas, sem anúncios, sem coleta de dados.

COMO USAR
1. Instale o SlideClick para Mac, gratuito, em slideclick.vercel.app.
2. Pareie o iPhone com o código que aparece no Mac.
3. Apresente.

Quer conhecer antes? Toque em "Experimentar sem Mac" para usar o modo de demonstração.

O SlideClick é independente e não é afiliado à Apple, à Microsoft ou ao Google. Keynote é marca da Apple Inc., PowerPoint é marca da Microsoft e Google Slides é marca do Google LLC.

name: SmartGig Companion
description:
SmartGig is for event organisers who'd rather not wait until they're back at a laptop. Sign in with your SmartGig account and everything you've set up on the website is already here.

What needs you
Today shows what's coming up and what's waiting on you: applications to review, documents to check and payments that are overdue. The Inbox puts them in one list, along with messages from the people you've booked.

Applications and documents
Read an application, see what they've asked for and approve it. The approval email and invoice go out for you. Check public liability, food hygiene and gas safety certificates, and ask for changes when something's not right.

Payments
Took cash on the gate or spotted a bank transfer? Record it there and then, and the balance updates for everyone on your team. See who still owes what, and confirm payments people tell you they've made.

Ticket sales
See how tickets are selling day by day, and which ticket types are close to selling out.

Site plan
Find a pitch or a business on your site plan, along with power, water and emergency points.

Event day
See who's in, who's still due and anyone held at the gate, with the forecast for your site on the same screen.

Bookings
Every booking for an event with its status, payment and pitch. Their phone number is one tap away.

Notifications
Hear about new applications, documents waiting to be checked and problems on event day. You choose which ones you get.

The bigger set-up jobs, like application forms, prices and drawing the site plan, stay on the website, where there's room to do them properly.

New to SmartGig? You can create your account in the app.

description:
• Save a quilt with finished width and height, a block grid, seam allowance, and a waste factor
• See the cut size: finished block plus seam allowance on both sides

name: Snakeroo: Snake Puzzle
description:
Tap a snake and it slides straight out of the board, but only if nothing is in its way. Find the right order, free every snake and clear the level!

Snakeroo is a cute 3D snake escape puzzle that starts easy and gets truly tricky. One tap at a time, untangle the board and set the snakes free.

HOW TO PLAY
• Each snake moves in the direction its head is facing.
• Tap a snake whose way out is clear and it leaves the board.
• Tap a blocked snake and you lose a heart.
• Free all the snakes before the clock runs out to win.

400 LEVELS IN 10 WORLDS
Meadow, Sunny Beach, Snow Peaks, Candy Land, Outer Space, Autumn Forest, Desert Dunes, Coral Reef, Volcano and Crystal Cave. Every world is harder than the one before and brings its own twist: rocks, padlocks and keys, frozen snakes, bomb snakes with a countdown, and portals.

NEW RULES KEEP IT FRESH
Walls with gates, arrows on the floor, hidden snakes, sleepy snakes, chained snakes, colour gates, fog, numbered snakes, buttons and doors, and gems to collect.

SUPER HARD AND BOSS LEVELS
Only one heart: no mistakes allowed. Can you beat the giant crowned snake?

MORE TO ENJOY
• Daily puzzle and daily rewards
• Weekly race with chests to open
• Build your own island with the stars you earn
• Collect rare snakes in your album
• Fun snake skins
• Boosters when you are stuck: Undo, Hint and Remove
• Play offline, no account needed
• In English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Turkish and Arabic

Snakeroo is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases. Remove Ads removes the banner and the full-screen ads; reward videos stay optional.

name: Snapshelf: Screenshot Search
description:
Your screenshots are full of things you meant to keep: order numbers, Wi-Fi passwords, boarding passes, recipes, addresses, coupons. Snapshelf makes every one of them findable.

SEARCH INSIDE EVERY SCREENSHOT
Snapshelf reads the text in your screenshots right on your iPhone, in English and Japanese. Type any word you remember — a street, a name, an order number — and see every match, highlighted. Filter by folder to narrow it down.

SMART FOLDERS, AUTOMATICALLY
Screenshots sort themselves into Receipts & Orders, Chats, Codes & Tickets, Cards, Recipes, Shopping, Notes, Places, Animals and Other. Snapshelf looks at the words, the layout and the picture itself, so a chat about an order stays a chat and a photo of your dog lands in Animals. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, sorting uses Apple's on-device model. Move anything by hand and Snapshelf remembers.

NEVER MISS AN EXPIRY DATE
Tickets, boarding passes and coupons with dates are spotted automatically and shown under Expiring Soon. With Pro, you get a reminder before they run out.

CLEAN UP IN SECONDS
Swipe through old screenshots: right to keep, left to delete. Deletes are batched and confirmed by iOS, and pinned or unexpired items are never suggested.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your device with Apple's Vision framework. No accounts, no servers, no ads, no tracking. Nothing ever leaves your iPhone. Works with Full or Limited Photos access.

FREE
• Auto-sort and search your latest 300 screenshots
• Expiring Soon list
• Swipe clean-up
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widget with your clean-up count
• "Search Screenshots" in Shortcuts, Siri and Spotlight

SNAPSHELF PRO
• Your whole library, however many screenshots you have
• Your own smart folders with keyword and pattern rules
• Expiry reminders for tickets and coupons
• A weekly clean-up reminder
• Pins and searchable notes
• Export any folder as a PDF
• Add images from other apps with the Share menu

Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (yearly starts with a 7-day free trial) or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings.

name: Snooker & Pool Guide: Lessons
description:
Learn snooker and pool the right way. Snooker & Pool Guide is a complete billiards academy in your pocket: step-by-step lessons, an interactive shot trainer with real table physics, scored practice drills and clear rules for snooker, 8-ball and 9-ball.

MASTER THE FUNDAMENTALS
• Stance, cue grip, open and closed bridges, and a smooth pendulum cue action
• Learn how aiming really works: line of centres, contact point and ghost-ball aiming
• Straight pots, cut shots, cushion shots and long pots explained with clear diagrams

PRACTISE REAL SHOTS
• Shot trainer built on real 9-ft pool and 12-ft snooker table dimensions
• Drag to aim, set power and choose topspin, backspin (draw) or side spin
• Ghost-ball guide, contact point and object-ball path help you see the shot
• Training modes: straight pot, cut shot, long pot, cushion shot, cue-ball positioning, break-building and a random pool aiming drill

SCORED DRILLS & CHALLENGES
• Pool drills: Pot 5 Balls, Straight Pot, Cut Shot, Long Pot, Cue Ball Control, Clear the Table, Position Play
• Snooker drills: Straight Black, Pot 5 Reds, Long Pot, Blue Stun Control, Break Building, Clear the Colours
• Earn up to 3 stars per drill — results are judged from what actually happens on the table

RULES & SCORING MADE SIMPLE
• Snooker (based on the WPBSA rules), 8-ball and 9-ball (based on WPA World Standardized Rules)
• Ball values, legal shots, fouls, turn changes, scoring examples and beginner FAQs

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Levels and XP, daily streaks and a weekly activity chart
• Skill bars for fundamentals, aiming, cue-ball control, position play, safety and rules
• 11 achievements to unlock as you improve

FREE TO START
All beginner lessons, the full rules section, core trainer modes and selected drills are free. Optional short reward videos can unlock a Premium lesson or drill for 24 hours.

LIFETIME PREMIUM — PAY ONCE
One payment unlocks every lesson, advanced training drills, unlimited challenges, detailed progress analytics and all future Premium content, and removes ads completely. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Restore it any time on your other devices.

No account needed. Your progress stays on your device and works offline.

Snooker & Pool Guide is an educational and practice app. It does not offer real-money games or gambling.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Snowveil Flurix
description:
Snowveil Flurix is a cozy winter arcade with three distinct short-session games, built for quick breaks that still feel like a real round.

Crystal Drift is a reflex challenge: steer a sled across a snowy field, catch snowflakes and golden bells for combos up to x4, and dodge falling icicles that break the chain. Each attempt escalates in speed so improvement is immediate and measurable.

Frostbound Path is a planning puzzle. Guide a snowman through ten village mazes that grow from 5x5 to 9x9. Every layout is verified solvable. A Thaw ability lets you melt a single obstacle when planning fails. Clearing with fewer moves earns more stars, with three possible per level.

Rime Echo is an observation game. Match winter keepsakes to their frozen silhouettes before time runs out. Frost Shift rotates the silhouettes mid-round so later matches cannot be memorized blindly.

Progress is tracked across sessions. Shards accumulate in every mode and unlock milestone badges in the Frost Vault. A daily visit streak grows each day you return, encouraging short, regular play rather than long sittings.

The UI sticks to a frosted-glass aesthetic with Dynamic Type support and large, legible controls suitable for brief sessions on a crowded commute or a quiet evening at home.

name: Snyansiake – Ridsleksikon
description:
Snyansiake er et semantisk leksikon over nordiske før-runiske rids – ikke runemagi eller mytologisk illustration.

Appen samler enkle rids på helleristninger, grænsesten, agersten og kystblokke fra bronze- og jernalderen: ejendomsgrænser, kvægdrift, tidevand og fangst, høstoffer, himmeltegn og flodvarsler. Mange af disse ridser er blevet kaldt “runemagi”, men her sættes de tilbage i landbrug, græsning, ejendomsforhold og lokal sædvane.

Funktioner:

- Søg, filtrér og sammenlign rids efter seks distrikter og syv formål
- Seksdelt dokumentation: stendatering, udgravningsrapporter, samisk/nordisk mundtlig tradition, sædvaneret, replikforsøg og kontrol af nyere falsknerier
- Feltstemmer: knyt fortæller, sted, optagelsestid og tekst til et bestemt rids
- Eget arkiv: gem poster, vedhæft feltfotos, ret ældre tolkninger, skriv noter og eksportér
- Læsetræning: øv læsning gennem formål, distrikt, seksdelt dokumentation og fejllæsninger
- Arkiver er tomt ved første start; begynd med dit første rids
- Data lagres lokalt; der kræves ingen konto, og der er ikke behov for at uploade data.

Appen henvender sig til arkæologiinteresserede, etnologer, museumsformidlere og feltregistratorer.

name: SockMatch AI
description:
**SockMatch – Find Matching Socks with AI**

Say goodbye to the never-ending sock matching struggle!

SockMatch makes sorting laundry easier. Instead of spending time searching through piles of socks, simply snap a photo and let SockMatch help identify matching pairs.

**HOW IT WORKS**

1. SCAN YOUR SOCKS
Take one photo of your pile of socks.

2. FIND MATCHING PAIRS
SockMatch analyzes your photo to identify socks that look alike and suggests potential matches.

3. REVIEW YOUR RESULTS
See which socks have been matched and review any socks that still need attention.

4. TRACK SINGLE SOCKS
Keep track of unmatched socks so you can check for their partners in future laundry loads.

**FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE**

• AI-powered sock matching assistance

• Scan multiple socks in one photo

• Identify potential matching pairs

• Review socks that need attention

• Keep track of unmatched socks

• View previous laundry batches

• Spend less time sorting laundry

**PERFECT FOR**

• Busy parents managing family laundry

• Large households with lots of socks

• Anyone tired of sorting laundry

• People who love simple, time-saving tools

**ONE PHOTO. LESS SORTING. MORE MATCHING.**

Laundry is enough work already. Let SockMatch make one part of it easier.

Download SockMatch and give your socks a better chance of finding their match!

**SOCKMATCH PLUS**

The free version includes 3 scans every 7 days. SockMatch Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a free trial. It adds unlimited scans, a history for each family member, and the lost-sock tracker, which tells you when a lost sock's partner turns up in a new scan.

The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your account settings, and restore an earlier purchase from the SockMatch Plus screen.
