name: Solitaire Unbound
description:
A little time with the cards, without interruptions. Play draw-1 or draw-3 Klondike with no ads, IFG account or subscription.

UNDO AND TRY AGAIN
Undo, redo and legal-move hints are free. Drag cards or tap a card and its destination. Choose Relax to hide the clock, or Classic to see time and moves.

A GAME TO COME BACK TO
Saves and statistics stay on your device. Choose a random deal or a starting layout with a verified solution, and return for the daily challenge. Random deals are not always winnable; your choices can also leave a verified deal blocked.

MORE VARIANTS WITH PRO
One purchase adds FreeCell, 1-, 2- and 4-suit Spider, the challenge archive and more customisation: six tables, six card backs and three card-face styles in total. No hints to buy or use up.

The game works offline. Buying or restoring Pro may require internet and an Apple Account. Progress does not sync between devices and may be removed when you uninstall the app. Restoring Pro does not recover deleted progress.

name: Sort Them All: Category Puzzle
description:
Sort Them All is a picture puzzle about finding what things have in common.

Every board hides a few themes. Spot the link, put the cards that belong together in the row, and clear the board one theme at a time. A cactus, a frog and broccoli? All green. The moon, a planet and a kite? All up in the sky. But look closely: some cards fit more than one theme, and only one way sorts the whole board.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag or tap cards into the row. A full row is checked straight away.
• "So close!" tells you when only one card is wrong.
• No timers. Think as long as you like.

1,000 LEVELS THAT GROW WITH YOU
• Start with small 3x3 boards and work up to big 6x6 boards with 36 cards.
• A boss level every 10 levels, with an easy breather after each one.
• Every level has exactly one solution.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• A fresh Daily Challenge every day, the same for everyone.
• Keep your streak going. Every 7 days earns a streak freeze that saves it if you miss a day.
• Finish the week for bonus hints, and share your result without giving away the answer.
• An optional daily reminder, at a time you choose.

THEMES TO UNLOCK
• Nature, Animals, Food, Travel, Space, Music, Holidays and more.
• Earn stars to open new themes, each with its own run of levels.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• 3 free hints every day, plus undo and shuffle on every level.
• Finish every Daily Challenge in a week for bonus hints.

SORT THEM ALL PLUS
• A one-time purchase: every theme open, unlimited undo and shuffle, and 5 free hints a day.
• Hint packs are also available.

GAME CENTER
• Daily Challenge leaderboard, total stars and achievements.

MADE TO RELAX
• Plays offline. No account, no sign-up.
• No ads.
• Soft clay-style pictures, light and dark mode, and sound and haptics you can turn off.
• Made for iPhone and iPad.

name: Sortience
description: Sortience — ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਚਾਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਕੀਮਤ ਅਤੇ ਲੋੜ ਦੇ ਅੰਕਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਮਬੱਧ ਕਰੋ। ਠੰਡੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਖਰੀਦ-ਰ ECord ਅਤੇ ਅੰਦਿਮ ਖਰੀਦਦਾਰੀ ਦੇ ਅੰਕ ਇੱਕ ਥਾਂ; ਮਹੀਨਾਵਾਰ ਬਜਟ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜ ਕੇ ਸਮਝਦਾਰੀ ਨਾਲ ਫੈਸਲਾ ਲਵੋ। ਸਾਰਾ ਡਾਟਾ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਫੋਨ ’ਤੇ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

name: Sound Eye: Text & Color Reader
description:
Sound Eye helps blind and low-vision people hear the world around them. Point your iPhone's camera and it speaks.

READ TEXT
• Text is read aloud as soon as it appears in view: labels, letters, signs, menus, medicine boxes
• "Read all" gives a careful, complete reading in natural order and shows it in very large, high-contrast text you can copy
• Korean and English text are recognised and spoken in the right voice automatically

COLOUR
• Hear the name of the colour at the centre of the view, such as "dark blue" or "beige", to match clothes or check fruit

LIGHT
• Brighter light makes a higher tone, so you can check whether a light is on or find a window

DESIGNED FOR ACCESSIBILITY
• Every control works with VoiceOver, with large buttons and clear labels
• Gentle haptics when text or a new colour is found
• Adjustable speaking rate, text size and a yellow-on-black high-contrast display
• Flashlight button for dark places

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• All recognition happens on your device. Nothing is recorded, stored or sent, and the app works without internet
• No ads, no account, no tracking

Sound Eye is an aid. For critical details such as medication doses, double-check when you can.

name: Sourdough Starter Tracker Log
description:
Know when your starter is ready, without watching the jar. Log a feeding and Sourdough Starter Tracker Log estimates when your starter will peak, the window around it, and when it is ready to use. Then get exact grams for bread or pizza from whatever you have, and fresh bread out of the oven right when you want it.

STOP GUESSING WHEN IT'S READY
Tap "Fed it", pick your ratio (1:1:1, 1:2:2, 1:5:5 or your own grams), your flour and your kitchen temperature. The jar on the Today screen rises toward the estimated peak, with a line like "Peaks around 2:40 AM" and the window around it. Tap "It peaked" when your starter tops out, and the estimates learn your starter's pace. Starter in the fridge? The app shows it resting instead of guessing a peak.

EXACT GRAMS, NO MATH
A country loaf and a Neapolitan pizza recipe are ready in grams. With Pro, start from whatever you have: the dough weight you want, the flour in your bag, a number of loaves, or a number of pizza balls. The app works out flour, water, starter, salt and yeast in grams, with baker's percentages beside each. Your levain's own flour and water are counted in the hydration. Pizza styles: Neapolitan, New York, Detroit and Roman al taglio. Leaven with sourdough starter or instant yeast. Grams or ounces, Celsius or Fahrenheit.

BREAD ON YOUR SCHEDULE
Choose when you want bread out of the oven. The plan works back from that time: feed the starter, mix, stretch and folds, bulk, shape, cold retard or final proof, preheat, bake and cool, each with a start time. A step that lands in the middle of the night is flagged, with a suggested shift. Start the plan to get a reminder for every step.

REMEMBER EVERY BAKE
Keep each bake with a photo, crumb and taste notes, and a rating, so you can see what worked.

NEW TO SOURDOUGH? START HERE
If you have no starter yet, a 7-day guide walks you through making one from flour and water.

ABOUT THE ESTIMATES
Peak times, windows, bulk times and plan times are estimates from a simple fermentation model based on your feed ratio, flour and temperature. Every starter is different, so watch your starter and dough as well as the clock. The estimates get closer as you log when your starter actually peaks.

FREE
- One starter, its feeding log and peak estimate
- The first peak you log, to start learning your starter
- A ready-made bread recipe (2 loaves) and a Neapolitan pizza recipe (6 balls), in grams
- Bake plan preview, with the full timeline
- Bake journal: log every bake, see your last 3

PRO
- Scale and edit any recipe, from the flour you have, loaves, balls or dough weight
- New York, Detroit and Roman al taglio pizza
- Save recipes and share a recipe card
- Start a plan, with a reminder for every step
- Feeding and peak reminders, and reminders for the 7-day starter guide
- Learns your starter from every peak you log
- A second starter
- Bake photos and your full journal history

YOUR BAKES STAY ON YOUR PHONE
No account, no ads, no analytics. What you log, and the photos you add, stay on your phone. Reminders are scheduled on your phone.

SUBSCRIPTION AND PURCHASE TERMS
Sourdough Pro is available as:
- Sourdough Pro Weekly: $4.99 per week, auto-renewing subscription
- Sourdough Pro Yearly: $29.99 per year, auto-renewing subscription
- Sourdough Pro Lifetime: $49.99, one-time purchase that does not renew
Prices are in US dollars and may differ in other countries. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically at the same length and price unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in the Settings app: tap your name, then Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://swapnil-jain.github.io/sourdough/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://swapnil-jain.github.io/sourdough/privacy.html

name: Spectherm
description:
Spectherm is an offline blackbody radiance workbench for plotting Planck spectral exitance, comparing temperatures, and reading Wien and Stefan–Boltzmann results—without accounts or network access.
WORKSPACE
• Enter or slide temperature (K / °C / °F)
• Plot spectral radiance Bλ across a custom wavelength window
• Overlay Wien displacement (λmax), visible band (380–750 nm), and σT⁴ badge
• Switch linear / log radiance and linear / log wavelength axes
• Drag the plot probe to read Bλ at any wavelength
• Add comparison traces and source presets
• Save sessions locally and export CSV via the share sheet
COMPARE
• Overlay multiple temperature traces on one chart
• Review UV / visible / IR band-power mix
• Inspect pairwise σT⁴ exitance ratios
METRICS
• Live Wien peak, sampled curve peak, Stefan–Boltzmann exitance, and window integral
• Band fractions for the current wavelength range
• CODATA-aligned constants used in calculations
LIBRARY & SETTINGS
• Store and reopen sessions on this device only
• Units, default overlays, haptics, and keep-screen-awake
• Privacy-first: no sign-in, no tracking, no cloud sync
Designed for engineers, researchers, and technical workflows that need fast, local spectral curves—not a substitute for calibrated laboratory instruments.

name: Spelling Cards
description:
Spelling Cards turns spelling practice into a quick, calm daily habit for children.

Each card shows a word. When your child is ready, they tap to flip it. The word disappears and a row of boxes shows how many letters it has. They type the spelling from memory and find out straight away whether it's right.

LEARN FROM MISTAKES
If a spelling is wrong, the correct version appears with the wrong letters highlighted. Your child then copies it out once before moving on.

PRACTICE THAT ADAPTS
Spelling Cards uses spaced repetition (the Leitner box system). Words your child finds hard come back in the very next session. Words they know well come back less and less often, until they're mastered.

BUILT FOR CHILDREN
• One card at a time, with big letters and big buttons
• The keyboard never suggests, predicts or autocorrects the word
• Hear any word read aloud in a British English voice
• Challenge mode: hide the word and spell it from listening alone
• Clear ticks and crosses, not just colours

READY TO GO
Includes the Year 3 and 4 statutory spelling list from the English National Curriculum, with British spellings, from "accident" to "women". Add your own words, paste in this week's spelling list, or edit the list at any time.

SEE PROGRESS
• Words mastered, learning and not yet seen
• Accuracy for every session
• Daily streak
• A tricky words list, with each word's full history

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking and no internet connection needed. Everything stays on the device.

Choose 5 to 30 words per session. Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: Spin Sprout
description:
Open the app and spin, or edit the ready-made wheel with your own choices.

Create a wheel by typing or pasting choices, one per line. Save it for another day. Spin for a one-off choice, or run a group round that removes each picked choice. See what has been picked and what is still in the round, undo the last pick, and resume after closing the app. Optional weights show the probability of each remaining choice. Share results and export or import JSON backups. Wheels are saved on your device. Your device backup may include app data. You choose when to share or export. No account, ads, subscription, backend or runtime AI.

name: SseukGarim
description:
Hide just what you need before you share.

Choose a photo or screenshot, tap text regions, or draw rectangles over the parts you want hidden. Zoom in to review your work, then save or share a new PNG with opaque black redactions.

TEXT RECOGNITION ON YOUR DEVICE
Find text regions in Korean, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese on your iPhone. Tap a region to cover it, then tap again to remove the cover. You choose what to hide.

KEEP YOUR ORIGINAL
Redactions are flattened into a new PNG as opaque black shapes. Your original photo stays unchanged. Original metadata, such as GPS location and capture details, is not copied to the new image.

FEATURES
• Korean, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese interfaces
• On-device text recognition in all four languages
• Tap to select or deselect text regions
• Draw rectangles to redact areas manually
• Use two fingers to zoom and move
• Undo edits
• Save or share a new PNG

Photos and text are processed on your device. No accounts, ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Automatic recognition may miss information. Before saving or sharing, review the entire photo and manually cover anything that should remain private. Edits are held in memory and cannot be restored after the app closes.

Support and privacy policy pages are provided in Korean.

name: Stampport: Travel Stamp Book
description:
Entry stamps are the best souvenir of a trip, but pages fill up, passports get renewed and the stamps are gone. Stampport gives you your own stamp book: pick the country you visited, press its stamp anywhere on the page at any angle, and flip the pages like a real notebook.

PRESS YOUR STAMP
• 249 countries and territories, searchable in English or Turkish
• Round, rectangle, oval and double-frame stamps in five ink colors
• Add a city or region and the visit date
• Drag, rotate and resize with two fingers, then press; the stamp settles onto the paper like ink
• Move, edit or delete a stamp any time

FLIP THROUGH YOUR BOOK
• Pages that curl and turn like paper
• A separate book for every trip, with cream, kraft, grid, dotted and lined paper
• Optional ink aging effect and haptic feedback

REMEMBER THE JOURNEY
• Timeline: your stamps in date order; tap Play to watch your journey being stamped again
• Bucket list: list the countries you dream of, checked off when you stamp them
• Share a page of your book as an image

BACK UP AND SYNC
No account required. Optionally sign in with email or Google to back up your books and sync them across your phones.

PRIVACY FIRST
• A memory book, not proof: you say where you have been, no location permission
• No ads, no advertising ID, no analytics
• Without an account everything stays on your phone
• With an account, data is stored in Europe and only you can access it
• Delete your account yourself, right in the app

Available in English and Turkish.

Privacy Policy: https://nodabasi.github.io/stampport-app/en/privacy/

name: Startide-Isles
description:
Follow the stars across the rising tide.

Startide Isles is an offline, single-player, top-down survival action game. Choose the Navigator, Tideweaver or Sunblade, enter an island arena and survive approaching waves of abyssal creatures.

Your hero attacks automatically. You control movement, dodge incoming threats and choose when to unleash your active skill. Collect experience and select one of three upgrades to shape your build.

• Three playable heroes with different stats and active attacks
• Three island settings and three difficulty choices
• Level-up choices covering damage, speed, health, armor and more
• Boss encounters with visible attack warnings
• Touch controls, pause and local progress records
• 30 or 60 FPS frame-rate limit options
• 24 interface languages and localized app names
• Offline play without accounts, advertisements or in-app purchases

The frame-rate option sets a limit; actual performance depends on the device.

name: Sternenecho
description:
Autumn 1989. On a cold night, Mira, Jonas and Tarek sneak into the abandoned observatory at the edge of the forest. Twenty years ago, the astronomer Ida Kessler vanished there without a trace – on the night a comet last lit up the sky. Tonight it returns.

STERNENECHO is a classic point-and-click adventure in the style of the 8-bit home computers of the 1980s: hand-pixelled rooms, chiptune music and a picture like on an old CRT television.

• Three kids, three skills: switch between Mira, Jonas and Tarek at any time. Only together can they solve the puzzles.
• Walk to, Pick up, Use, Look at – the classic verb interface, made for the touchscreen: the pointer follows your finger, lifting it is a click.
• Widescreen in landscape: the verbs sit next to the room, so the picture gets bigger.
• Progress is saved automatically.
• In English and German.

CHAPTER 1: THE OLD OBSERVATORY – free
Gate, hall, library, cellar and the great dome: find out what happened to Ida.

CHAPTER 2: THE ECHO OF VEGA – in-app purchase
Ida is back. But what did she discover next to Vega in 1969? The darkroom, the garden and the radio hut hold the answer.

More chapters are in the works. Each chapter is a one-time purchase – no subscription, no ads, no data collection.

name: StitchAnchor: Knit Counter
description:
Return to the right part, row and repeat.

StitchAnchor keeps separate progress for the body, sleeves, borders or other parts of your knitting project. Count completed rows and see the next row to work, its position in the repeat and the number of complete repeats.

- Set up projects with needle, yarn and project notes.
- Give each part its own repeat length and optional row target.
- Count one row or record several rows you have already finished.
- Undo the last count without losing the earlier position.
- Save a dated pause point with a note and a frozen copy of every part's position.
- Resume when you are ready; paused projects keep their counting controls locked until you resume.
- Reopen earlier pause points without changing their saved title, needle, yarn or row positions.
- Preview and share a useful PDF pause card or current progress sheet.

Your projects stay available offline. No account, subscription or internet connection is needed to use the local workflow.

name: StitchCue: Row Counter
description:
Never miss the row where something changes.

StitchCue is a big, reliable row counter for knitting and crochet, with reminders that do the repeat math. Tell it "decrease every 6 rows from row 10, 8 times" and it reminds you on rows 10, 16, 22 and onward. The next reminder is always on screen.

COUNT WITH ONE TAP
Tap anywhere on the lower part of the screen to count a row. The row number is huge and easy to read. Lock the counter so a stray tap does nothing, and use −1 to step back.

REMINDERS ON THE RIGHT ROW
Add a reminder for one row ("start the ribbing on row 40") or a repeat ("every 6 rows, 8 times"). When you reach that row, StitchCue shows it with a gentle buzz, then tells you what comes next.

READY WHEN YOU ARE
Counting starts the moment you open the app. No account, no setup. The screen stays awake while you count.

FEATURES
- One-tap row counter with −1 and lock
- One-row and repeating reminders with a preview of the next rows
- "Next: row 22" so nothing is missed
- Keeps the screen awake while counting
- Backup export and import

PRO (one purchase, no subscription)
- Unlimited projects
- Paste several reminders at once

PRIVACY
No account, no analytics, no tracking. Your projects stay on your iPhone.

name: STMP: Stereo Tower Player
description:
STMP turns the music on your home server into a hi-fi system you can hold. Point it at an SMB share on your NAS, router or computer, and it reads your folders and tags into a library you can play on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.

PLAYS YOUR FILES AS THEY ARE
• MP3, FLAC, AAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, Ogg Vorbis, Opus and more
• M3U, M3U8 and PLS playlists, including the internet radio streams inside them
• ID3, MP4, Vorbis and RIFF tags, embedded and folder cover art
• Read-only: nothing is uploaded and nothing on your server is changed

A LIBRARY BUILT FROM YOUR FOLDERS
• Browse folder by folder, with album artwork
• Tags: pick any two of Artist, Album, Genre and Year and narrow down
• Search titles, artists, albums, genres and file names
• Quick refresh reads only the folders that changed

A PLAYER THAT LOOKS THE PART
• Mac and Apple TV: a matrix screen with spectrum, waveform, VU bars and a frequency curve
• A queue with Repeat, Single, Random and crossfade
• Mac: a full rack with VU meters, a five-band equalizer and an amplifier with bass, treble and balance
• Apple TV: a couch-sized player built for the Siri Remote
• iPhone and iPad: a spectrum display, widgets, lock screen controls, background playback and offline downloads

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. STMP talks only to the shares you add and the streams you play, and your passwords stay in your keychain.

TRY IT RIGHT AWAY
Two short demo albums are built in, so you can try every screen before you connect your server.

name: Strata Expedition
description:
One more layer. One more decision.

Venture into a quiet world of mineral seams and carefully calculated risks. Roll three dice, then decide how to spend them: dig for a new specimen, brace the mine, or hoist a precious find to safety.

The dice are uncertain. The consequences are clear. Preview your pressure before every confirmed action, learn the character of each mineral field, and decide when it is time to return.

- Explore three geological fields with different rules.
- Refine your approach through eighteen fixed-seed field contracts.
- Discover twenty-four specimens for your personal field journal.
- Pack two of nine tools to find a different way through familiar strata.
- Keep expedition records and celebrate twelve local milestones.
- Enjoy single-player offline exploration with no required account registration.

Chalk Hollow and its first two contracts are free. An optional one-time Full Expedition purchase unlocks Crystal Fault, Shale Steps, and the remaining sixteen contracts. Tools are earned by completing contracts. Purchases and restores require an App Store connection.

Small expeditions. Deliberate decisions. Something beautiful to bring home.

name: StringDesk
description:
Less paperwork between rackets.

StringDesk helps independent racket stringers keep clients, rackets, string setups, and jobs together. Find the last setup, make the changes you need, and create the next job without starting over.

KEEP SIMILAR RACKETS STRAIGHT
Give each racket its own name or number, even when a client brings several of the same model. Keep optional contact details and notes alongside the client.

RECORD THE WHOLE SETUP
Save mains and crosses separately, including hybrid strings, tension, pounds or kilograms, pre-stretch, and work notes. Changing tension units converts the values. Add an optional collection target and price per racket.

MOVE JOBS THROUGH YOUR WORKBENCH
See what's To string, Ready, or Collected. Search by client, racket, or string. Correct a queued job without using another free job, and share a readable setup card when you choose.

REPEAT WITHOUT RETYPING
Start from an earlier job's setup, adjust it, and save a new job. Select several rackets belonging to one client to create separate jobs with a shared setup.

KEEP YOUR RECORDS WITH YOU
Workshop records are stored on your device and work offline. No StringDesk account is required. Export jobs as CSV, save a complete JSON backup, or restore a backup when moving to another device. Export and backup tools are always free. StringDesk does not automatically sync your workshop between devices.

START WITH 5 FREE JOBS
Your first 5 jobs are free. Each racket in a batch counts as one job. StringDesk Pro is an optional one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited new and repeat jobs—no subscription. Viewing and completing existing jobs, exports, and backups remain available after your free jobs are used. The purchase screen shows the current local App Store price.

Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a wider list-and-detail view when space allows. Requires iOS 17 or later. An internet connection is needed for purchase and restore operations; restoring Pro does not restore workshop records.

name: Stud Finder Pro Metal Detector
seller_name: ITWORKED YAZILIM IC VE DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Find the screws and nails that hold drywall to the studs, check for metal pipes before you drill, and hang shelves straight. Stud Finder Pro uses your phone's magnetometer, the sensor behind its compass, to turn it into a simple metal detector.

AN HONEST NOTE FIRST
Phones have no sensor that can see wood. This app finds METAL: steel screws and nails, iron pipes, rebar and magnets. Because drywall is screwed or nailed to the studs, finding a column of screws finds the stud. Copper, aluminium, plastic and wood don't show up.

METAL DETECTOR (FREE)
• Big live gauge with the magnetic field change in microtesla (µT), like a simple gauss meter
• Automatic zero, or precision calibration with Pro
• Sensitivity from 1 to 10 (Pro)
• Beeps faster and vibrates harder as you get closer
• Clear visual alert you can see across the room

STUD FINDER MODE
• Step-by-step guide: slide the phone flat along the wall
• Live scan trace that marks every screw or nail it passes (Pro)
• Tips on typical stud spacing (16 or 24 inches, 40 or 60 cm)

BUBBLE AND SPIRIT LEVEL (PRO)
• Lay it flat for a round bubble, or stand it on an edge for a bar level
• Angle to a tenth of a degree, with a tap when it is level

RULER (PRO)
• On-screen ruler in centimetres or inches
• Calibrate it once with any bank card for real-size accuracy

FREE AND PRO
The live metal detector, its gauge and its sound, vibration and visual alerts are free, with the stud-finding guide. Stud Finder Pro adds precision calibration that the app remembers, sensitivity from 1 to 10, the stud scan trace that marks every screw, the bubble level, the calibrated ruler and the sensor mode.
Pro is available as a weekly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in your account settings at least 24 hours before the period ends.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your readings never leave your phone. Purchases are checked through Adapty with an anonymous ID.

TIPS
• Calibrate with the phone at least 30 cm (1 ft) from metal, laptops and speakers.
• Remove magnetic phone cases and wallets; they swamp the sensor.
• The sensor is usually near the top of the phone. Lead with the top edge.
• Always check for live wires and pipes with the right tool before drilling. This app is a helper, not a guarantee.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://itworkedsystems.com/stud-finder/privacy

name: Sumo Bump: 2 Player Sumo Duel
description:
Sumo Bump is a fast, funny sumo duel for two players on one phone, or for you against the computer.

Each player owns half of the screen. Drag anywhere on your half to push your wrestler, tap to dash, and shove your rival out of the ring. First to three rounds wins.

• TWO PLAYERS, ONE DEVICE: sit across from each other; every control and score faces its player
• ONE-FINGER CONTROLS: drag to move, tap to dash, easy for anyone to pick up
• SIX ORIGINAL WRESTLERS with real differences in weight, speed and dash power, from heavy Boulder to quick Zippy
• THREE COMPUTER RIVALS: Rookie, Veteran and Yokozuna, for when you play alone
• POWER-UPS: grab the heavy charm to become hard to move, or turbo for rapid dashes
• SUDDEN DEATH: after 20 seconds the ring starts to shrink
• Satisfying physics, dust bursts, synthesized drums and crowd sounds, and punchy haptics
• Works offline, on iPhone and iPad, in Korean and English

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No tracking.

name: Sunava: Virtual Temple
description:
Step into a quiet 3D Buddhist temple in the forest, from anywhere.

Walk the courtyard, bow in the main hall, offer a candle or incense, and light a lantern with your wish. Offerings burn for 24 hours, and people in other rooms see them too.

Every evening at 6 on your device's clock, the lights go down and people sit together for 20 minutes. The app can remind you 10 minutes before. There is also a meditation timer, a moktak and prayer beads, and meditation sound keeps playing with the screen off.

No account needed, no chat and no ads.

Sunava Pro (optional)
- Your candle, incense and lanterns stay lit for 30 days (free: 24 hours)
- Up to 3 of each at once (free: 1)
- Write a wish with any offering, kept in a record only you can read
- Choose from 5 colours for your clothes
- Use it on a computer with no time limit

Pro is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. It renews unless you cancel in your store account settings before the current period ends. Bowing, sitting and the evening gathering stay free.

Privacy policy: https://sunava.app/en/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Sunava is an original virtual temple. It is not affiliated with any temple or Buddhist order and makes no claim of spiritual benefit.

name: SuperExp - AI Powered ERP
description:
SuperExp Notes helps teams write, review and approve business notes without chasing people. Open a note, read it as a clean PDF, discuss it with comments, and keep every decision on record, from your phone or tablet.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Notes dashboard
• See your notes at a glance with status, department and external party summaries
• Tap any number or chart to open the matching list of notes
• Filter by approval status and find a note quickly

Review and approve
• Open the full note with all its details in one screen
• Read the note as a PDF inside the app
• Follow the approval history and see who acted and when
• Check attachments, cost centre and financial breakdown linked to the note

Comment right where it matters
• Add comments on the note, then reply, resolve or reopen them
• Comment on selected text in the note document so feedback is specific
• Mention teammates so the right person sees your comment
• Dictate comments with voice typing instead of typing

Built for mobile
• Quick sign-in with Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint
• Notifications when a note needs your attention
• Designed for phone and tablet, in portrait and landscape

GETTING STARTED
SuperExp is a business workspace. Sign in with your SuperExp account, or contact us to set up access for your team.

name: Surahs – Qur'an Made Simple
description:
Understand the Qur'an one verse at a time, with clear explanations, trusted sources, and a gentle daily routine that fits your life.

Surahs is made for Muslims at every stage of learning, from those opening the Qur'an for the first time to lifelong students who want to go deeper. The language is simple and warm, and it is written to be easy to follow even if English is not your first language.

AUTHENTIC TEXT, NEVER ALTERED
Read all 114 surahs in Uthmani Arabic, beautifully set in the Amiri Quran font. Each verse comes with the Saheeh International translation, transliteration, and verse-by-verse recitation audio. The Qur'anic text is never changed, and every explanation clearly shows its source.

LEARN EVERY VERSE WITH TRUSTED TAFSIR
For every verse in all 114 surahs, read labelled tafsir from recognized scholars such as Ibn Kathir and As-Sa'di, so you always know where the meaning comes from.

GUIDED LEARNING FOR 17 SURAHS
In-depth learning guides for 17 surahs, including Al-Fatihah and many short surahs of Juz Amma, share the background of each surah, its main themes, and reflection prompts. In these guided surahs, choose Essence for a short, simple explanation of each verse, or Deep Dive when you want more detail, and explore key Arabic words. More guided surahs are on the way.

ASK NOOR
Noor is an AI learning assistant that explains the verse you are reading in simple language. Noor keeps established tafsir separate from personal reflection, so you can learn with clarity and care.

A GENTLE DAILY ROUTINE
Daily Light lessons give you something meaningful to learn each day. Short quizzes help you remember, and the Heart Journal gives you a quiet place to write your own reflections.

SEE YOUR JOURNEY GROW
Build a streak, set a daily goal, and watch verses move from Planted to Growing to Rooted. Activity charts show your progress over time, encouraging steady learning without pressure.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
Use the app in English, Arabic, Urdu, Indonesian, Turkish, or French. Turn on optional daily reminders if you would like a gentle nudge. An account is optional; sign in with Apple, email, or phone to sync your progress across iPhone and iPad.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
Surahs is completely free. There are no ads and no purchases, only a calm space to learn.

Begin today with a single verse. Download Surahs and let your understanding of the Qur'an grow, one ayah at a time.

name: Surprise Box: Gift Reveal
description:
Turn your iPhone into a gift box.

Choose a box, write the card, add a photo, a voice note and music, then close your iPhone and hand it over. When they open it, the lid lifts, the gift glows, confetti flies and your card slides into view.

Made for iPhone Duo: the box opens the moment they unfold the phone. On every other iPhone, a tap or a shake opens it.

SEVEN BOXES
• I Love You: a jewelled heart in rose, ruby or sapphire
• Anniversary: a heart necklace engraved with your years together
• Birthday: a cake with their age in candles
• Graduation: a cap and diploma with their class year
• New Baby: a swaddled newborn with the baby's name
• Thank You: hands holding a ruby heart, signed by you
• Gender Reveal: girl or boy, hidden until it opens

MAKE IT PERSONAL
• Write your own headline and message on an ivory card
• Tuck in a photo
• Record a voice note that plays as it opens
• Pick music composed for each occasion, from a classic Happy Birthday to a love theme
• Film their reaction with the front camera, only if you turn it on. The video stays on your iPhone and is never uploaded

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

The Thank You box is free. Unlock every box with one purchase, no subscription.

name: Swatchmark
description:
The swatch is flat on the table. The width of the piece is already chosen.

Photograph the cloth. Mark each stitch and each row yourself. The span starts at 10 cm, and you can change it. Unwashed and washed stay on the same project. When a washed swatch is there, the piece uses that count. Until then the unwashed count stays, and the screen says so.

Sixteen stitches in 10 cm, across 48 cm, casts on 77 stitches. The count rounds up, so the piece is not short.

The needle is required. Yarn is optional. Photos and marks stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. Share sends one line: the project name, the stitch count, and whether the washed swatch was used.

name: Swing Sword
description:
Swing it like a sword. Instead of tapping the screen, you swing your phone to fight.

Every swing slashes a monster. Defeat it and gold pours out. Spend that gold to enhance your sword: succeed and it goes up one level, keep and nothing changes, fail and it drops one level. Swords never break. The success, keep and fail odds are shown right on the enhance screen.

name: TACIT Agent
description:
A TACIT Agent iPhone-alkalmazás a gépeden futó TACIT Agent asztali alkalmazás társa. Egyszer párosítod QR-kóddal, és utána a telefonodról is beszélgethetsz az ügynököddel, jóváhagyhatod a lépéseit és követheted a rutinjait.

Mire jó:
• Csevegés: folytasd a gépeden futó beszélgetéseket, vagy indíts újat. A válasz élőben érkezik.
• Jóváhagyások: ha az ügynök engedélyt kér egy művelethez, Face ID-val vagy jelkóddal döntesz.
• Értesítések: rutineredmények, jóváhagyási kérések és hibák push értesítésként is.
• Rutinok: nézd meg és indítsd el az ütemezett feladataidat.
• Ugyanazok a beállítások, mint a gépen: profilok, modellek, skillek és eszközök.
• VPS: ha az ügynököd szerveren is fut, azt is innen éred el.

Biztonság:
• Nincs külön fiók vagy jelszó: a telefon a géped QR-kódjával párosodik.
• A telefon saját kulcsa az iOS Kulcskarikában marad, minden parancs aláírva jut el a gépedhez.
• Otthoni Wi-Fi-n közvetlenül kapcsolódik, mobilneten a forgalom végponttól végpontig titkosítva halad.
• A párosítást bármikor visszavonhatod a gépedről vagy a telefonról.

A használathoz a TACIT Agent asztali alkalmazás szükséges: tacitproject.hu

name: Tagsplit
description:
Tagsplit is for yard sales shared by a few households: everyone's things on one table, one cash box, and a fair payout when the last buyer leaves.

PRICE
Photograph each item, type a price and pick whose it is. Every household gets its own color and two-letter code, and every item gets a number like OR-07. Selling a box of books at $1 each? Set a quantity and print one tag.

TAG
Print price tags on Avery 5160, Avery 5163 or A4 3 × 8 label sheets. The household code sits in a color band on each tag, so nobody has to guess whose lamp it was. Half a sheet already used? Start at any label. Changed a price later? Print only the new and repriced tags.

CHECK OUT
Tap the photos of what the buyer is holding. Agreed on a lower price? Change it on the line. For anything without a tag, type the code and the amount, like PK 3. Charge, and if you tapped the wrong thing, Undo.

SETTLE UP
See what each household sold and how much came off the tags. Add shared costs like the newspaper ad or table rental, split them by sales or evenly to the cent, and pay back whoever covered them out of pocket. Mark what's left to keep or donate, then share the payout as text.

Try a sample sale with photos before pricing your own.

No account and no sign-in. Sales and photos stay on this iPhone.

name: Tailbook: Pet Health Records
description:
Tailbook is the beautiful, private health record book for your dog, cat, rabbit, bird or any pet. Keep vaccines, medications, flea & tick and deworming, vet visits, weight and documents in one place — and never miss a due date again.

NEVER MISS A BOOSTER
• Smart reminders before vaccines and treatments are due
• Tap “Mark as given” right on the notification — the next due date is scheduled for you
• See what's overdue and due soon for all your pets at a glance

LOG CARE IN SECONDS
• Vaccine templates for dogs (Rabies, DHPP/DA2PP, Leptospirosis, Bordetella), cats (FVRCP, FeLV) and rabbits
• Next due date calculated automatically — edit it any time to follow your vet's schedule
• Medications with dose, frequency and reminder times
• Flea, tick & worm preventives, grooming, vet visits with diagnosis notes and cost
• Attach photos and PDFs of lab results and vet papers

ONE-TAP HEALTH PASSPORT
• A clean PDF with your pet's photo, microchip, vaccine table, current medications, allergies and vet contacts
• Send it to a new vet, pet sitter or boarding kennel by Messages, Mail, LINE or AirDrop
• Includes an offline QR code summary

EMERGENCY CARD
• A lock-screen image with your phone number, microchip and allergies — perfect while your pet is boarding or travelling

WEIGHT & TIMELINE
• Weight chart with your vet's healthy target range
• A searchable timeline of every record, filtered by type

TAILBOOK PRO
• Unlimited pets and Health Passports
• Share pets with your family through iCloud
• Scan vet documents and auto-fill dates and vaccine names
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with the next due date
• Vet expense totals per pet, per year

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your records stay on your device and sync privately through your own iCloud.

Free plan: 1 pet, unlimited records, reminders and 1 Health Passport per month.
Tailbook Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (yearly includes a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Tailbook is a record keeper, not medical advice. Always follow your veterinarian's guidance.

Privacy Policy: https://spdevsolution.github.io/tailbook/privacy.html

name: Tailorleaf
description:
Keep one profile. Make a tailored resume for every job. Export a PDF with real, selectable text, and see what the app read back from it. Everything stays on your phone: no account, no ads, no watermark, no subscription, no limit on resumes or exports.

ONE PROFILE, MANY RESUMES
Type your details, jobs, education, skills and languages once. For each job, make a resume from your profile: show or hide entries and bullet points, change their order, and re-word a bullet for that one resume only. A new job added to your profile shows up in every resume, marked as new. If you like a change, apply it back to the profile.

PASTE THE JOB AD
Paste the text of an ad. The app lists words and phrases from it, with counts and a snippet, and shows which of them your resume has, has in other words, or lacks. For a missing one it tells you which hidden entries of your profile contain it, and you can include them with one tap. There is no score and no percentage: you see every word and why it is listed. The list is a starting point: it can miss important words and list everyday ones, so read the ad yourself. Nothing leaves your phone.

A PDF WITH A READ-BACK
Every PDF is made on your phone with real text, not a picture of text. Right after the export, the app reads the file back with an open-source PDF reader and shows the result in plain words: how many words and lines it found, whether the lines came back in the right order, the page count and the file size. That is what one reader found: it shows that the words are real text in a sensible order. It compares words, not every punctuation mark, so check your e-mail address and links in the PDF yourself. How a particular employer's system sorts a file into fields is not known, and the app does not claim to know. If the read-back cannot run on your phone, the app says "not checked" instead of a pass.

STRUCTURE CHECKS WITH SOURCES
Fifteen checks look at name and contact details, section titles, dates, bullet points, photo, symbols, links, file size and more. Each one says what it looked at and where the rule comes from (a recruiting-software vendor's help page, or common advice, labelled as such), and takes you to the place to fix it. They are hints from help pages and common advice; passing them is not a promise about any employer's system. Only a missing name stops an export.

TEMPLATES AND LAYOUT
Six single-column templates (Classic, Modern, Compact, Executive, Lebenslauf, Plain) with no tables and nothing in headers or footers. A4 or Letter, text size, margins and spacing, "fit to one page" in one tap, an optional photo for German-style CVs, and English or German dates and headings per resume.

COVER LETTERS
Write a cover letter in the same style for a company and a contact person, and export it through the same PDF and read-back path.

HELP
Action verbs and bullet-point examples in English and German, a plain explanation of what ATS means, and an explanation of how the checks and the word list from the ad are made.

YOUR DATA
Make a backup file and restore it on another phone, copy your resume as plain text for application forms, share an earlier export again, or delete all data. The backup file is readable text, not encrypted, and contains your personal details: keep it somewhere safe. The app has no network code. Data leaves your phone only when you share or print a file yourself. As for every app, its files are part of your normal iPhone backup.

LANGUAGES
The app is in English and German and follows your phone. Each resume can be in English or German.

NOT IN THIS VERSION
- No AI writing and no cloud: the app does not rewrite your text.
- No import of an existing resume (PDF, Word or LinkedIn) and no Word export.
- No job tracker, no score, and no promise that an employer's system will read your file: nobody outside the vendor can know how it is set up.

name: Tailpaw
description:
Tailpaw is an SSH terminal, file browser and web viewer for your own devices.

Run the open-source tailcat server on a computer or Raspberry Pi, scan the QR code it shows, and Tailpaw connects to it — end-to-end encrypted, with no account and nothing to configure.

• Terminal — a full SSH terminal, signed in with a key made on your iPhone, an imported key, or a password.
• Files — browse, download and upload over SFTP.
• Web pages — open the web server running on your device in a browser inside Tailpaw.
• Send files — share files straight between two devices, with your consent before anything is saved.
• Port forwarding — reach a port on your device from localhost, for an app running alongside Tailpaw.

Tailpaw works only with devices you set up and connect to yourself. It does not change your iPhone's network settings or carry the traffic of other apps. It collects no data: no account, no analytics, no tracking.

Tailpaw is built on the open-source tailcat engine. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Tailscale Inc.

name: takt - Metronome
description:
Big number, one button, nothing in the way.

FEEL
• A strong pulse on the one, lighter on the other beats
• Haptics timed to the very moment you hear the click
• Feel-only mode: no sound, just the pulse and the light

APPLE WATCH
• The pulse on your wrist, even with your arm down
• Turn the Digital Crown for the tempo
• Tempo, time signature and setlist song stay in sync with your iPhone

TIME
• 30 to 300 BPM: drag the number, tap the tempo, or use − and +
• Time signatures from 1 to 12 beats, in quarters or eighths
• 6/8, 9/8 and 12/8 felt in groups of three
• Subdivisions: eighths, triplets, sixteenths
• Four sounds: click, wood, beep, drums

PRACTICE
• Speed trainer: start slow, takt raises the tempo every few bars until your goal
• Plays along with your music app, so you can practise to a song
• Keeps clicking with the screen locked

STAGE
• Setlists with the tempo and time signature of every song
• Step through the set with one tap

Light and dark mode, seven accent colors. No account, no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchase. takt works completely offline.

From the makers of kasten, the sampler.

name: Talabati طلباتي
description:
طلباتي هو تطبيق التوصيل الأسهل بعمّان وحواليها لجرار الغاز وقوارير المياه وتنكات المياه. اطلب بضغطة زر، وأقرب سائق بيقبل طلبك وبيوصلك لباب البيت.

خدماتنا
• جرار الغاز
• قوارير مياه الشرب
• تنكات المياه (صهاريج)
• طلبات المحلات والمطاعم (حسب توفرها بمنطقتك)

طلب غاز أو قوارير
• اختار النوع والعدد.
• حدّد موقعك على الخريطة أو اكبس «موقعي».
• اكتب تفاصيل العنوان: الشارع، البناية، الطابق، وعلامة مميزة.
• اطلب الآن أو جدول الطلب لوقت لاحق.
• استخدم كود خصم إذا عندك.
• الدفع كاش للسائق عند الاستلام.

طلب تنك مياه
• التطبيق بيعرف منطقتك تلقائيًا من موقعك.
• شوف قائمة سواقين التنك اللي بيخدموا منطقتك، مع تقييم كل سائق وأسعاره.
• اختار حجم التنك ونوع المي، ومكان الخزان (أرض أو سطح) وطول الخرطوم.
• بتشوف السعر النهائي قبل ما تطلب، بدون مفاجآت.

تابع طلبك
• مراحل واضحة: قيد الانتظار، تم القبول، في الطريق، تم التوصيل.
• شوف مكان السائق على الخريطة وهو جاي.
• إشعارات فورية بكل تحديث على طلبك.
• قيّم السائق بعد التوصيل.

سجل طلباتك
• كل طلباتك بمكان واحد، مع فلاتر وزر «إعادة الطلب» بضغطة وحدة.
• تذكير لما يقرّب موعد طلبك الجاي.

الدعم
• تواصل معنا مباشرة على واتساب، أو ابعث رسالة للدعم وتابع الرد.

للسائقين
• بدك تصير سائق معنا؟ قدّم طلب انضمام من التطبيق، وبعد الموافقة بتستقبل الطلبات القريبة منك.

خصوصيتك مهمة: رقم هاتفك وعنوانك الدقيق ما بيوصلوا للسائق إلا بعد ما يقبل طلبك.

التطبيق بالعربي والإنجليزي، مع وضع فاتح ووضع ليلي.

طلباتي: غازك ومايك لباب بيتك.

name: Tallyball: Pickleball Score
description:
Keep pickleball score from your wrist, and never lose it. Tap the side that won the rally and Tallyball moves the score, shows who serves and from which side, and keeps your iPhone showing the same score, live. Works with Apple Watch, and on iPhone on its own.

ONE TAP PER RALLY
Tap the top or bottom half of the screen for the team that won the rally. Tallyball works out the serve, the server number and the score for you, and shows the call ("4-2-1") after every rally, so nobody has to remember it. Singles or doubles, side-out scoring, games to 11, played as one game or a match of 3 (first to win 2).

ALWAYS KNOW WHO SERVES
A ball marks the serving team, a 1 or 2 badge shows which partner serves, and a small court shows where each player stands and which side the serve comes from. No more "wait, who's serving?"

NEVER LOSE THE SCORE
Every rally is saved the moment you tap it, on your Watch and on your iPhone. Close the app, let your Watch sleep, restart your phone: the match comes back where you left it. Each match on your Watch runs as a pickleball workout, so raising your wrist shows the score instead of the clock, and Apple Health logs your play (only if you allow it; Tallyball saves workouts and reads nothing from Health).

FIX A MIS-TAP AT ONCE
Undo takes back the last rally, even the point that ended a game or the match. The crown does nothing during a match, so a bent wrist cannot change the score.

SWITCH ENDS ON TIME
A reminder after each game and at the midpoint of the deciding game, with a tap on your wrist.

A SCOREBOARD FOR THE COURT
Your iPhone follows the match on your Watch live, so your partner and the players waiting their turn can see the score. No Watch? Keep score on the iPhone itself: every free feature works there too.

HEAR THE SCORE (PRO)
Tallyball can say the call out loud after every rally, so nobody has to ask. The voice is made on your device.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY (PRO)
Rally scoring, games to 15 or 21, and matches of 5 games (first to win 3).

EVERY MATCH, KEPT (PRO)
Your full match history, stats for each match (points won, points won on serve, side-outs, longest run, biggest lead, game scores and time played), and a picture of the result to send to friends.

FREE
- Unlimited matches on Apple Watch and iPhone
- Side-out scoring, singles and doubles
- Games to 11, as one game or a match of 3
- Undo
- Serve and side shown after every rally
- Switch-ends reminders
- Every rally saved as you play
- Live score on your iPhone while you score on your Watch
- Team and player names
- Your 3 most recent matches

PRO
- Rally scoring
- Games to 15 and 21
- Matches of 5 games
- The score said out loud after every rally
- Full match history
- Match stats
- A result card to share

YOUR MATCHES STAY WITH YOU
No account, no ads, no analytics. Matches and settings are stored on your iPhone and Apple Watch, which send them to each other directly. Nothing is sent to us.

SUBSCRIPTION AND PURCHASE TERMS
Tallyball Pro is available as:
- Tallyball Pro Weekly: $3.99 per week, auto-renewing subscription
- Tallyball Pro Yearly: $29.99 per year, auto-renewing subscription
- Tallyball Pro Lifetime: $49.99, one-time purchase that does not renew
Prices are in US dollars and may differ in other countries. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically at the same length and price unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in the Settings app: tap your name, then Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://swapnil-jain.github.io/tallyball/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://swapnil-jain.github.io/tallyball/privacy.html

name: Tambola Party: Offline Housie

Tambola Party turns any gathering into game night. Play Tambola (Housie) completely offline, with no internet connection or account required.

HOW IT WORKS

name: TAMS Studio - Aide Memoire
description:
Design your own organiser pages, fill them in on screen and print them at true size.

TAMS Studio turns your iPhone or iPad into a page designer for ring-bound organisers and printed reference cards. Build a page from ready-made blocks, reorder it as a book, then export a print-ready PDF that keeps its exact dimensions.

Create TAM inserts, Flight Reference Cards or Filofax organisers. Useful for security, health and safety, organisations that want a useful crib card.

BUILD PAGES THAT FIT THE JOB
• Tables, checklists, tick boxes, writing boxes and text
• Flowcharts, sketch grids and photos
• Groups, headings and your own colours
• Page numbering, sections and custom footers

FILL IN AND KEEP
• Turn any design into a fillable form
• Save drafts and return to them later
• Mark a form complete and share it as a PDF
• Sketch answers on iPad with Apple Pencil

PRINT AT TRUE SIZE
• Personal, Pocket, A5 and A4 sizes
• Actual size, on A4 sheets, or two-up for folding
• Cutting guides and extra binding space
• Text flows on to the next page, so nothing is cut off

START WITH A TEMPLATE
• Warning Order, a planning template for orders preparation
• Drone flight reference cards for planning, checks, emergencies and logs
• Security, fire safety and health and safety packs
• Calendars, diaries, goals, contacts and more planner inserts

CREATE WITH APPLE INTELLIGENCE
On supported devices, describe what you need and get an editable pack of up to 10 pages. It runs on your device.

YOUR WORK STAYS YOURS
No account, no adverts and no tracking. Your library stays on your device unless you choose to sync with your private iCloud or export it.

FREE TO START
The free version includes the Warning Order and drone flight reference card templates, up to 3 of your own designs with up to 5 pages each, and PDF export with a watermark.

FULL VERSION: ONE-TIME PURCHASE
No subscription. Unlocks:
• Unlimited designs and pages
• PDFs with no watermark
• All templates and industry packs
• Planner inserts
• Pack creation with Apple Intelligence
• iCloud sync across your devices
• Pack file import and export

IMPORTANT
Templates are aide-memoires for planning and note-taking. Always work from your current authoritative sources, including regulations, manufacturer manuals and your organisation's procedures. TAMS Studio is an independent app. It is not produced by, endorsed by or affiliated with any government department, armed force, aviation authority or manufacturer.

Terms and privacy: https://www.magnusnorth.com/privacy.html#tams-studio

Built by one person in the UK. If you have a request or hit a problem, email admin@magnusnorth.com.

name: Tellune: Voice Tarot Readings
description:
A reading app where you talk out loud, any time, with no waiting.
Just say what is on your mind. Your reader listens, draws the cards, and answers.

■ Talk by voice, right away
No sign-up. Open the app, tap, and your reader starts talking. No typing needed: say it the way you feel it.

■ Remembers what you said
No need to explain again who they are or what happened. Your past readings are shared among the readers, so whoever you talk to picks up where you left off.

■ 12 readers
Tarot, numerology, Four Pillars, astrology, birth chart, palm reading, Nine Star Ki, I Ching, runes, Lenormand, and dream reading. Pick the way of reading that fits your question. Palm readings use a photo of your palm.

■ For matters of the heart
A crush, what they really feel, getting back together, waiting for a text, a love you cannot tell anyone about. Things that are hard to say to a friend, you can ask quietly at night.

■ Your reading and today's card
After each talk, you get Your reading: what you talked about and what the cards said. Draw today's card every day.

■ Pricing
Your first 3 minutes are free. To keep talking, buy a pack of time (10, 20, 55, or 110 minutes). Time only counts down while you talk, and it never expires. To avoid overuse, you can talk up to 2 hours a day.

■ Please note
・The readers are not people. They are characters played by generative AI.

TenniStrike turns your iPhone into the umpire's scoreboard. Keep score point by point, share a link, and family, friends and coaches follow the match live in any browser, with nothing to install. When it ends you get full match stats, a picture to share, and a career that grows with every match.

A tennis score keeper, live scoreboard and match tracker in one app, built for everyone around the court: the parent behind the fence at a junior tournament, the coach watching three courts at once, the club running a league night or a tournament.

SCORE LIKE AN UMPIRE
• Every format: best of 3 or 5, pro set, no-ad, tiebreak and match tiebreak. Singles and doubles.

MATCH STATS AND REPLAY

SCOUT YOUR OPPONENT

ALERTS

name: Thermal Lab Pro
description:
Thermal Lab Pro combines wind and thermals to show where your scent is going.

Wind is only half of it. As the sun hits one slope and leaves another in shade, air moves uphill or drains downhill on its own. Thermal Lab Pro puts that together with forecast wind on real terrain and draws one scent plume on the map, so you see it instead of guessing.

Gusts matter too. In calm air, cool thermals pool in drainages and low ground. A strong enough gust breaks that up and pushes your scent with the wind. Thermal Lab Pro shows you when a gust is strong enough to take over and when it's too light.

Drop a pin on the ground you hunt, mark your stand, blind or glassing spot, and watch the scent plume and air flow move across the ridges, benches and drainages around you. Slide through the day minute by minute to see when the morning thermals switch and where your scent ends up by evening.

What you get:
- Live thermal and air-flow animation on 3D terrain
- A scent plume for each Spot, with stand height for tree stands and saddles
- Forecast wind, gusts and temperature, with rain and storm warnings
- A time slider to plan your sit before you walk in
- Saved properties and Spots with notes and photos
- Light and dark themes

Built for whitetail and elk hunters, from the back forty to big public ground.

Results are estimates built from terrain, timber, water and weather data. Use them to plan, then trust what you see and feel in the field.

Try 1 Spot a day free, or start a 7-day free trial of Pro for unlimited Spots. After the trial, Pro renews yearly at the price shown in the app, billed to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

name: Tilewren: American Mahjong
description:
Tilewren teaches you American mahjong from zero, one small step at a time. Pip, a little wren, sits next to your tile rack and shows you what to do, so you can walk into your first game at the table with confidence.

LEARN ON A REAL TILE RACK
Every lesson is hands on. Drag tiles, sort your rack, pick up and discard, call a tile. Pip points to the right spot and explains why. Meet the suits (Bam, Crak, Dot), winds, dragons, flowers and Jokers, then build up to full hands.

A COACH FOR THE CHARLESTON
The Charleston is the part that scares most beginners. Tilewren walks you through every pass and suggests three tiles to send along, with the reason in plain words. Your card stays one tap away the whole time.

PRACTICE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Sit down at a practice table with three computer players: Rose, Hal and June. Play as many games as you like, pause any time and come back later. Your game is saved.

A PRACTICE CARD OF OUR OWN

DAILY DEAL
A new deal every day, the same for everyone, made on your device from the date. No account and no internet needed.

BIG AND CLEAR
Large tiles, large text and Dynamic Type, made to be easy to read. VoiceOver is supported.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Works offline. No account, no ads, no data collected.

FREE TO START
Chapters 1 to 3, unlimited games on the whole practice card and the Daily deal are free.

TILEWREN PRO
Tilewren Pro is a one-time purchase. It unlocks chapters 4 to 10, unlimited hints with reasons, full stats and the Sharp player level. No subscription.

Tilewren uses American-style rules. Tilewren is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Mah Jongg League.

name: Tillcard: Loyalty Card Wallet
description:
Tillcard keeps your loyalty, membership, library and customer cards in one wallet on your iPhone. Open it, tap a card, and the code is on the screen. No account, no ads, no analytics, no network code: your cards stay on the phone.

ADD A CARD
• Scan the barcode with the camera, type the number, or read it from a photo or screenshot of the card. Screenshots help when you move your cards over from another app.
• A number read from a photo is shown next to the card to compare before you save, because a reader can mistake a small or damaged code.
• The number is checked against the barcode type (for example the check digit of an EAN-13). Tillcard tells you what does not fit and never changes a number silently.
• 13 barcode types: Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF, Codabar, Code 39, Code 93, QR, Aztec, PDF417 and Data Matrix. Or keep a card as a number only.
• Pick a well-known shop name for a colour and the usual barcode type, or type your own. No logos.

AT THE TILL
• The card screen shows the code, the number in large type with a Copy button, and the barcode type.
• The screen is brightened while a card is open and set back when you leave, and it stays on. Both can be switched off in Settings.
• Tap the code for full screen. A wide code turns sideways to get bigger.
• Some scanners, mostly older laser ones, cannot read a phone screen. Tillcard cannot change that, which is why the number is always shown: a cashier can type it.

ORGANISE
• Categories, favourites, search, and sort by name, most used or recent. Archive a card instead of deleting it; a deleted card can be brought back for a few seconds.
• Photos of the front and back, a note, a balance you keep yourself (points or money), valid-from and expiry dates.

TAKE YOUR CARDS WITH YOU
• Import Catima files (zip or CSV), Tillcard backups, or any spreadsheet with name and number columns. A summary says how many cards were added, skipped or already there.
• Export a Catima file, a backup with photos, or a CSV, and use them whenever you like. Not affiliated with Catima.
• Share a card with family: a QR code the other iPhone scans, a file, or a Catima link.

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
• Home-screen and Lock Screen widgets for your favourite cards, and a long press on the app icon for the ones you use most.

PRIVATE
There is no account and no server. Cards, photos and notes stay on this iPhone unless you export or share them. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. The camera is used only when you scan a card; nothing is recorded or sent. Backups of your iPhone (iCloud or computer) do not include your cards, on purpose; to move them to a new phone, use Settings > Import and export to save a backup file. Open source under GPL-3.0.

name: TimeTrove

COMPARE CIVILIZATIONS • Government, architecture, technology, culture, trade and achievements, side by side • See when two civilizations overlapped in time

AN AI HISTORY TUTOR • Ask any history question and get an answer at your level, with key dates and links to the library • Explanations of events, civilizations and historical figures, based on the app's verified records • A concept explainer, an AI quiz generator and a personal learning report you can export as PDF • AI only runs when you ask, and you always see what will be sent

KEEP YOUR FILM STOCK ORGANIZED
Give each roll or offcut a unique label. Record its film specification, usable dimensions and storage location so the plan points back to material you can find in the workshop.

PLAN WITH THE STOCK YOU HAVE
Enter glass sizes, quantities, edge allowances, cutting gaps and rotation restrictions. Compare layouts across matching stock, with compatible offcuts considered first. See which pieces do not fit before reserving a job.

RESERVE FIRST, DEDUCT AFTER CUTTING
Reserve material for a complete plan without deducting physical stock. Other jobs see the remaining available material. Confirm the cut once to update stock and save reusable rectangular offcuts. Undo checks later changes to avoid breaking dependent jobs.

TAKE THE PLAN TO THE BENCH
Preview and share PDF cut sheets with dimensions and positions. Export CSV records and full workshop backups. Choose inches or millimetres.

START FREE
Save up to 3 jobs and manually add up to 10 stock items. Automatically created offcuts do not count toward the manual-stock allowance. Your existing records, PDF and CSV exports, and backup tools remain available.

A single optional Full Unlock purchase removes these free-tier limits. It is not a subscription. Technical capacity limits still apply.

LOCAL WORKSPACE
No account is required. Workshop planning and records work offline. Buying or restoring the optional unlock requires an App Store connection. Your workshop data stays on your device unless you choose to export or share it. There is no automatic cross-device sync, so keep backups.

CHECK BEFORE YOU CUT
Layouts are planning suggestions, not a guarantee of the best possible fit. Confirm physical measurements, film direction, defects and installation allowances. PDF diagrams are not scale templates. Rectangular pieces only. Material values use USD and are not final job costs or profit calculations.

GEOGRAPHY ON A REAL MAP
Roads, bridges and tunnels drawn from NYC Open Data and U.S. Census data and stored in the app, so it works with no connection. All six kinds of geography question: best route, compass direction, points of interest, connections, where a road starts and ends, and reading a map.

EXAMS THAT FEEL LIKE THE EXAM

YOUR LANGUAGE, ALL OF IT
Questions, answers, explanations, lessons and buttons in English, Spanish, Russian or Bengali. English is one tap away on every question.

YOUR 90-DAY CLOCK

A PLAN IF YOU DO NOT PASS

ALL TEN TOPICS
Government, Licensing, Vehicle Requirements, Passenger Solicitation, Customer Service and Service Refusal, Accessible Dispatch, Proper Conduct, Vision Zero and Safety, Penalties and Driver Programs, and NYC Geography. 24 lessons and 360 original questions, each with an explanation.

CURRENT NUMBERS, WITH THEIR SOURCE
Fares, fines and deadlines come from current TLC pages and rules. Where the 2019 study guide is out of date, the app follows the newer source and each question shows which one it used.

FREE AND PRO

name: ToneTrail-Live Spectrum Sound
description:

name: Total Physics
description:
Total Physics is a physics study app for the MCAT and AP Physics C: Mechanics, with a stage magic game built in.

STUDY

The app has two courses. The MCAT course goes from units and graphs all the way to nuclear decay, and the AP Physics C course covers mechanics with calculus, one unit at a time.

• 5,600+ practice items across 65 topics. Some drills have you draw the diagram yourself, like the forces on a block or the path of light through a lens. If you get a question wrong, the app walks you through how to solve it.
• A lesson for every topic, covering the main rule and the mistakes students usually make.
• 38 flashcard decks with spaced review, including an equation sheet, the constants and the sign conventions, plus a searchable glossary.
• Build a timed mock exam from the topics you choose. Questions you miss come back on a spaced schedule until you get them right.
• The AP course has a scientific calculator built in.

PLAY · LIMELIGHT

You've just taken over a theatre that has been closed for a year. The machines came with the building, but nobody wrote down how they work. Each illusion is a physics problem. You run rehearsals to take measurements, work out where the ball will land or how bright the lamp will glow, and then set the trick. Rehearsals cost money, and when you perform, the crowd pays at the door. The Mercury across the street puts on the same illusions, so the goal is to net more than they do on each one.

There are ten illusions on the stage, the switchboard, and with mirrors and lenses. You can play a season of three nights against the Mercury, or practice any illusion on its own. If you get stuck on a measurement, a quick drill reveals it and pays you for your time.

Works offline. No account, no ads, no subscription. Kinematics, the first AP unit and the first illusion are free to play. One purchase of $4.99 unlocks everything.

name: TraceCam: Photo to Drawing
description:
Make room for your next drawing. TraceCam helps you prepare a photo, follow its lines and keep your creative progress in one place.

START WITH YOUR PHOTO
Choose a photo or capture a new reference. Crop, rotate and adjust the outline to suit the drawing you want to make.

DRAW YOUR WAY
Use a translucent reference over the camera view while you draw on paper, or practice directly on screen with pen, marker and eraser tools. Adjust the reference, undo a stroke and return to your saved project later.

LEARN BEYOND TRACING
Explore 20 authored drawing studies across animals, anime portraits, landscapes, plants, architecture and still life. Follow a stroke demonstration, practice with a fading guide, then try drawing from memory. Shape comparisons highlight areas to practise; they are not a grade of artistic ability.

FIND YOUR NEXT SUBJECT
Browse 36 detailed templates, including original anime portraits, characters, flowers, scenery and fantasy creatures. Save favorites and organise your projects.

KEEP AND SHARE YOUR WORK
Your photos and drawings are processed and stored on your device. Save your progress and export PNG artwork. Premium unlocks the full template and study libraries, higher-resolution PNG export up to 4096 pixels and A4 PDF export. Actual image resolution depends on the source.

Free tools include photo preparation, both drawing modes, selected templates and studies, saved projects and PNG export up to 2048 pixels. Monthly and yearly Premium subscriptions offer the same benefits while active. No free trial is currently offered. Payment and subscription management use your Apple Account.

Camera tracing is a reference overlay on your device's screen. It does not project onto paper or automatically anchor the reference when you move the device. A stable phone support is recommended for drawing on paper.

name: Tribia
description:
Tribia gives you a real team of AI employees, and you can watch them work.

AT WORK — Victor, your CEO, takes your requests, splits them up and hands them to the right agents: prospecting, customer emails, social media, quotes, research. A supervisor reviews every deliverable. When it's ready, Victor knocks on your screen: knock knock!

AT HOME — Gaston, your butler, plans meals and groceries, keeps the family calendar, helps with homework and watches the budget.

NOTHING GOES OUT WITHOUT YOUR OK — Agents prepare emails, posts and appointments; you approve with one tap, after seeing the recipient and the full text.

YOUR TOOLS — Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook, Drive, your CRM and social accounts: your agents work with your real data.

THEY LEARN — Correct a deliverable once and the agent remembers. After 10 clean approvals, you can grant it an autonomy licence.

TALK TO THEM — Dictate requests, snap the fridge or a receipt, attach a file.

YOUR DATA — Hosted in Canada, encrypted, built for Québec's Law 25. Delete your account any time in the app.

14-day free trial. Made by AVA in Laval, Québec.

name: Trinity Tour
description:
Trinity Tour reinvents classic chess movements into an exhilarating, fast-paced solo challenge.

Forget about memorizing rigid openings or waiting for an opponent. In Trinity Tour, you take command of a single champion piece navigating dynamic arenas on an urgent mission: capture every enemy pawn before the clock hits zero!

A TACTICAL CHALLENGE, NOT A TRADITIONAL MATCH
Unlike standard chess, Trinity Tour focuses on fast-paced tactical mastery:
• THE TRINITY OF MOVEMENT: Master the distinct movement patterns of the Rook (straight-line dashes), the Bishop (diagonal sweeps), and the Knight (obstacle-hopping L-jumps). Each level tests your ability to calculate the most efficient capture route under time pressure.
• DYNAMIC BOARD ARENAS: Move across varied geometric layouts, including compact rectangular grids and Donut Arenas with center voids that fundamentally alter traditional pathways.
• LETHAL SKULL HAZARDS: Watch your step! Dangerous skull traps occupy strategic squares. Stepping into their path ends your run immediately.
• TIMED BONUS COINS: Spontaneously appearing gold coins reward quick thinking—if you can navigate to them within 10 seconds before they vanish.
• GAME-CHANGING JOKERS: Running low on time or cornered? Spend your earned gold to unleash the Queen Joker for all-direction supremacy, or activate the Time Joker for an instant +15 second extension.

FEATURES:
• Intuitive one-tap touch controls with crystal-clear visual attack indicators
• Step-by-step interactive tutorials introducing each piece's movement
• Procedurally generated solvable levels with escalating difficulty
• Vibrant flat design optimized for modern Retina displays
• Fluid piece animations, haptic response, and procedural audio chimes
• Fully playable offline—ideal for quick mental training anywhere

Master the Trinity, beat the clock, and conquer every tour!

name: Trippacy - おでかけと旅の地図日記
description:
撮りっぱなしの写真が、おでかけの地図日記になります。

Trippacy（トリッパシー）は、カメラロールの写真に残っている「撮影日時」と「位置情報」から、訪れた場所と移動ルートを自動でまとめるアプリです。日記を書く手間はいりません。期間を選んで、内容を確認して保存するだけです。

■ 写真から自動で記録
・日帰りや1泊2日など、期間を選ぶだけで写真を自動で検索
・訪れた場所と、時間の順につないだ推定ルートを地図に表示
・場所の名前は自動で付き、あとから自由に編集できます
・開始日を思い出せないときは、最初に撮った写真から日付を選べます
・ほかのおでかけに登録済みの写真は候補に出ないので、重複しません

■ 地図で思い出をたどる
・これまでのおでかけを、ひとつの地図にまとめて表示
・「思い出をたどる」で、訪れた順に写真をめくりながら地図を移動
・ピンをタップすると、その場所のおでかけをすぐに開けます

■ きろく
・カレンダーで、おでかけした日がひと目でわかります
・まだ記録していない写真がある日もカレンダーに表示され、そこから記録を始められます
・おでかけ回数のグラフ、訪れた都道府県や国のまとめ（表示は設定で切り替えできます）

■ プライバシーを大切に
・写真の解析はすべて端末の中で行います
・写真や記録を開発者のサーバーへ送ることはありません
・アカウント登録は不要です
・写真そのものはアプリにコピーせず、写真アプリの写真を参照します

■ 写真がない場所も
写真がない場所は、地図を長押しして手動で追加できます。

■ 広告について
本アプリは広告を表示します。アプリ内課金（月額・年額・買い切り）で広告を非表示にできます。

【自動更新サブスクリプションについて】
・広告非表示（月額）：月額200円
・広告非表示（年額）：年額1,980円（初回1週間無料）
・お支払いは購入の確定時に Apple ID に請求されます
・期間終了の24時間以上前に自動更新をオフにしない限り、自動で更新されます
・更新料金は、期間終了前の24時間以内に請求されます
・購入後は、App Store のアカウント設定からサブスクリプションの管理と自動更新の解除ができます
・無料お試し期間中に購入した場合、お試し期間の残りは失効します
