name: TripWing: Trip Planner
description:
Still digging through a dozen blogs to plan one trip?

TripWing turns a city, your dates and the kind of trip you want into a full hour-by-hour itinerary — from waking up to getting back to your hotel.

■ One clear timetable
Wake up → breakfast → morning stops → lunch pick → afternoon stops → dinner pick → evening → back to your stay.
Every line shows the time, how long to stay, the admission fee and the travel time to the next place. Tap any line for the full details.

■ 142 cities, 1,600+ places
Seoul, Busan, Jeju, Tokyo, Osaka, Bangkok, Da Nang, Paris, Rome, Barcelona, London, New York and many more — with real photos of restaurants, must-see sights, photo spots and museums.

■ Directions built in
Choose transit, driving, walking or cycling and go. You can also route the whole day in one tap.

■ Where to stay
Five hand-picked stays per city, from best value to luxury. See the pool, spa or ocean view at a glance, then compare live prices on Booking.com, Agoda and more.

■ Flights, stays and cars together
Skyscanner, Booking.com, Agoda, Klook, Rentalcars — opened with your dates and travellers already filled in.

■ Share your plan
Turn your finished itinerary into a card image and post it straight to Stories or send it to a friend.

■ Help in an emergency
Call local police and ambulance numbers in 52 countries with one tap. Show phrases like "Please help me" in the local language in large text — and have them read aloud. Works offline.

■ Get a ride
Jump straight to the ride-hailing app people actually use there — Uber, Grab, DiDi, Kakao T and more.

■ Send my location
"Where are you?" at the airport, or lost each other on the street — send your friends a map link with one button.

■ Split expenses
Note who paid what and TripWing works out who owes whom, ready to send to your group chat.

■ Sunrise, sunset and golden hour
See when the sun rises and sets on each day of your trip, and the best light for photos.

■ Five languages
English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese and Spanish — switch any time from the top of the screen.

■ No sign-up
No account, no login. Your trips stay on your phone and are never sent anywhere.

※ Hours, fees and prices can change — please confirm before you go.
※ Bookings and payments happen on the partner sites.

name: Truckside: Job Estimates
description:
Quote at the door, invoice from the truck. Your prices, your customers, your data.

Truckside is a quoting and invoicing app for handymen and small repair pros. Build a quote from your own price list and job templates, get the customer's signature, send a clean PDF, and turn it into an invoice with your own payment link. It works offline, so a bad signal at the job site never stops you.

AI drafts line items from a photo and a few words about the job. Quantities and prices are always yours; the AI never does the math.
AI quote drafts from a photo need an iPhone with Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or later). Everything else works on any iPhone running iOS 17.

KEY FEATURES
• Quote in minutes: pick job templates, set quantities, add your tax rate and discount. Totals are exact to the cent.
• Your own prices: edit the price list and templates so every quote starts from your numbers.
• Before and after photos: keep time-stamped photos for each job, with notes on damage that was already there.
• Location stamp and markup: turn on the location stamp to print where and when each camera photo was taken, and circle or point at damage with a finger. Both show in the job report.
• Customer signature: the customer signs on your screen and the signature goes into the PDF.
• Invoice in one tap: turn an approved quote into an invoice, add your own Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, PayPal or Stripe link or QR code, and record deposits and payments. Truckside never handles the money.
• Unpaid at a glance: see what you are still owed and which invoices are late.
• Customers and job history in one place.
• Back up and export everything any time, even after you cancel.

HOW THE FREE PLAN WORKS
Free covers 5 jobs a month. A job is counted the first time you send its PDF or get the customer's signature. Drafts, edits and previews never count, the invoice for a counted job is free, and the counter resets on the 1st of each month. Your old jobs and customers are never locked or hidden. Our promises: nothing that is free today moves behind Pro, limits never change for people who have paid, and exporting your data is always free.

TRUCKSIDE PRO
• Unlimited jobs
• Your logo, color and terms on every PDF, with no footer
• Job report PDF with photos, damage notes and the customer's signature
• Reminders at 9 AM for quotes with no answer and overdue invoices, with a message ready to send
• Unpaid total widget on your Home Screen and Lock Screen
Truckside Pro is $8.99 a month or $59.99 a year, and the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Keep your sign-up price as long as your plan stays active. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. Restore Purchases is built in.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your customers, quotes, invoices and photos stay on your iPhone. The location stamp is off until you turn it on, uses your location only while you take a photo, and is never sent to us. AI drafts run on your iPhone with Apple's on-device model, so your photo is not sent to us. There is no sync between devices in 1.0, so back up from Settings.

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone running iOS 17 or later. English (U.S.).

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.getshipkits.com/apps/truckside/privacy/

name: Turnwick: Encounter Tracker
description:
Turnwick is a game master's companion for the moments when everyone talks at once. It keeps the order of play, the damage, the conditions and the dice in one calm, candle-lit screen, so you can keep your eyes on the story.

THE TABLE
Add your players, allies and foes, give each an initiative number (or let Turnwick roll it for them) and press Next turn. A flame marks whoever acts, the round counter ticks over by itself, and ties can be nudged either way.

HIT POINTS WITHOUT THE ARITHMETIC
Tap a combatant, type the number, choose Damage or Heal. Temporary buffer points are tracked separately, health bars turn red when someone is in trouble, and defence numbers sit on the card where you need them.

EFFECTS THAT COUNT THEMSELVES
Burning, frozen, slowed, hidden, blessed and more, or invent your own. Give an effect a number of rounds and Turnwick removes it when time is up.

A DICE TRAY THAT READS YOUR HANDWRITING
Type 2d6+3, 2d20kh1 (keep highest), 2d20kl1 (keep lowest), 4d6kh3, d% and the roll shows each die as well as the total. Save the rolls you repeat, and scroll back through recent results.

UNDO THAT ACTUALLY UNDOES
Every change is recorded in a log you can read like a story, and Undo walks it backwards one step at a time, from a mistyped number to a whole round.

YOUR CAST AND YOUR JOURNAL
Keep recurring heroes and favourite monsters in the Cast and seat them with one tap, copies included. Write session notes, pin the important ones and search them later. Several encounters can be kept side by side.

BUILT FOR BOTH SIZES
On iPhone the Table, Dice, Cast and Journal are a thumb-reach away. On iPad the order of play stays beside a dice tray and your notes.

Everything you create stays on your device. There is no account and no sign-in.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL AD-FREE
Turnwick is free and shows ads. Quiet them in either of two ways: subscribe to the Ad-free month ($2.99 per month, auto-renewing, billed to your Apple account, cancel any time in Settings), or earn a month of quiet by watching short optional videos from the More tab.

Turnwick is an independent tool by Equal Information. It works with any tabletop role-playing system and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game publisher.

Privacy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-turnwick.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-turnwick.html

name: TV Deck - Mobile TV Manager
description:
Install apps on your TV, organize its files and free up space from your iPhone or iPad. TV Deck brings everyday TV management to your phone.

Install apps: choose an APK from Files or iCloud and send it to your TV. Follow progress, cancel, retry or open the app after installation.

APK library: browse, save, favorite and download packages. Paste a direct APK URL to download to your phone, then confirm installation on your TV.

File management: see file sizes, search, filter, upload, download, rename and organize TV files.

Storage cleanup: inspect storage usage, find large files and installation packages, then confirm what to remove.

Remote control: use buttons, swipes, volume and media controls, plus your phone keyboard.

Connection and tools: local network discovery, guided setup, device history, screenshots and screen recording.

For Android TV, Google TV and Android TV boxes with network ADB enabled. Your phone and TV must be reachable on the network; authorize the first connection on the TV. Features depend on the device, permissions and processor compatibility. APKs install on the Android TV, not on iPhone or iPad. Apple TV is not supported. Third-party apps have their own content, service and account requirements.

name: Twelve Brotherhood
description:
A private app for Christian entrepreneurs to connect.

PEOPLE
A directory of members: city, work, church, interests. Filter by any of them.
Your own Circles — group people however you want and invite a whole Circle at once.
A friendship CRM — private notes and labels on anyone you meet. Only you see them.
A helpful map — see members near you. Share your exact location with specific people if you want; off by default.

EVENTS
Designed for hosting. Make an event, pick who to invite, write them a note, see who's coming and who hasn't answered. List what you need — speaker, side dishes, cooler — and people claim it. Send a link to someone without the app and they RSVP from a web page.
Automatic shared photo albums for attendees, for every event. You choose who sees each photo you add.

BIBLE STUDIES
Find a Bible study to attend, or start one. Weekly meetings land on everyone's calendar automatically.

BROTHERHOOD
Post when you need something — a truck, a referral, prayer — and members respond.

Members only. No feed.

name: Twicetold: Time Loop Puzzle
description:
When a loop ends, time rewinds, and your earlier moves play again as an echo.

Twicetold is a calm, clever puzzle game about teamwork with your own past. Send one self to stand on a plate, walk through the door it opens, and never step where an echo needs to be: a single collision is a paradox.

SIMPLE RULES, DEEP PUZZLES
  • Swipe to move, tap to wait, hold to rewind time
  • Each loop leaves an echo that repeats exactly what you did
  • Plates open doors, cracked floors collapse, reverse doors close, boxes slide, arrows only go one way

90 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
  • 8 chapters, each with a new idea and a gentle tutorial
  • An "Against the Clock" chapter for players who like to think fast
  • Every level is checked by a solver: it always has a real solution and no cheap shortcut

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
  • The same daily puzzle for everyone, with a streak to keep
  • Fair leaderboards for today, all time and the campaign: every result is replayed and verified on our server

FAIR HINTS
  • Stuck? Get a strategy tip or have the way shown, step by step
  • Earn hints by solving the daily puzzle, or pick up a hint pack

MADE FOR EVERYONE
  • Play offline, no account needed
  • Optional Sign in with Apple or Google keeps your hints and progress when you change phones, even between iPhone and Android
  • 9 languages: English, Türkçe, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Русский, Bahasa Indonesia

A one-person studio, Golunex Games, made Twicetold with care for every move, every sound and every hint. We hope you enjoy solving it together with your past.

name: UCD Manager
description:
UCD Manager helps owners and installers configure compatible UCD and GPS devices directly over local Wi-Fi.

Find nearby supported devices and connect to your device's Wi-Fi access point. UCD controllers provide Wi-Fi setup, Profiles, Calendar, Remote control, Direct Commands and View Config tabs. Compact navigation keeps full tab names in one scrolling row; Menu shows every available screen with a short description. GPS devices have dedicated Wi-Fi setup and live GPS status screens. Connect manually when needed and remember access-point passwords securely on your phone.

On UCD controllers, program input profiles, choose supported actions and outputs, and set durations with hours, minutes and seconds. Create and edit calendar events, keep local drafts, export calendar CSV files and upload them to a selected device calendar. In View Config, independently enable Audio, Pulse and Clock to display supported actions. Customize the device name, output icons and labels, default output selections, duration, melody, volume and simulation time. Settings are saved locally per device; existing drafts retain their values. Enable Audio to manage melody names and import/export melody lists.

View UCD network and cloud connection status alongside the device's own time. GPS status shows firmware version, device time, last GPS synchronization, signal strength, router connection and NTP server state.

On supported devices, configure the clock mechanism and shift, time zone and daylight saving. Set GPS and NTP synchronization on/off, configure NTP servers and control motor support separately from increased torque. Read device status and error counters, and send remote commands for supported outputs and audio functions. The app remembers your last active tab for the next connection.

The app works without an Internet connection while configuring hardware. It has no user accounts, ads, analytics or cloud synchronization. Polish and English are selected from your phone's language.

Compatible UCD or GPS hardware with supported firmware is required. The app uses the UCD HTTP/AT interface and the GPS HTTP configuration API. Wi-Fi, nearby-device and foreground location permissions may be required by Android for device discovery and connection. GPS coordinates and background location are not requested. Use the app only on a trusted device network; firmware communication uses local HTTP.

Features available on a particular device depend on its firmware. UCD Manager does not provide new firmware features or control unrelated Wi-Fi devices.

Publisher: Covitech Andrzej Aksenczuk
Support: andrzej.aksenczuk@gmail.com
Website: https://elemik.pl

name: UiltraMintraFX
description:
UiltraMintraFX is a trivia game you play by drawing. No multiple choice, no buttons to tap: read the prompt, then swipe one unbroken chain through a honeycomb of 19 tiles, linking every answer you know fits. Lift your finger to cast it at the guardian.

Damage grows with the square of your chain. A chain of 3 hits for 90. A chain of 8 hits for 640. But one wrong tile fizzles the whole cast, burns the tile, and costs you a ward. How far do you trust what you know?

DAILY RITE
Seven boards, one attempt a day, and the same boards for every player in the world. Compare your score on the leaderboard and keep your streak alive.

THE ASCENT
An endless climb against the fuse. Every guardian is different and every fifth floor brings a Warden. Break one to choose a boon, then see how high you can go.

THE CODEX
85 trials across six schools: Sky, Wilds, Matter, Ages, Realms, and Lore. Study any of them with no timer and no risk, read the fact behind each one, and master them all.

• Chain-casting trivia played entirely by swipe
• Spent tiles block your path, so each cast reshapes the board
• Works offline; the leaderboards are the only part that needs a connection
• An original soundtrack, with its own theme for Warden floors
• No ads and no purchases

name: Umpcount: Umpire Indicator
description:
Umpcount is an umpire indicator that knows the rules. After each pitch, tap Ball, Strike, Foul or Out. The count, outs and innings move the way your league plays.

■ A rules engine, not a tap counter
• Pick Baseball, Little League baseball, Fastpitch softball or Slow-pitch softball before the first pitch
• Ball four is a walk and strike three is a strikeout: the count resets and the out is added for you
• A foul with 2 strikes keeps the count in baseball and fastpitch. In slow-pitch it is an out, with an optional courtesy foul
• Slow-pitch batters start at 1-1
• Three outs switch the half inning. After the last regular inning, Umpcount asks "Game over after 6?" and you choose End game or Extra inning
• Out covers the batter or a runner. After a runner out you can keep the batter's count
• Every automatic step says what happened, with Undo right there
• Change the rules for a game from the next call on, or start mid-game with the count you take over

■ The count on your Lock Screen
Start a game and the inning, balls, strikes and outs show on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. With Pro, the Lock Screen card also has Ball, Strike and Foul buttons. Like other Lock Screen controls, your iPhone may ask you to unlock it first.

■ More
• Feel the count: hold anywhere on the game screen and your iPhone plays the count as vibrations. Haptics work while Umpcount is open on screen
• Speak the count reads it aloud when you hold, best with earphones
• Game history with date, league, innings and length

■ Free
The four league presets, the rules engine, Undo, courtesy foul, Feel the count, Speak the count, rule changes during a game, game history and the Lock Screen count. A banner ad appears on the Home game list only. The game screen has no ads.

■ Umpcount Pro (one-time purchase)
• Ball, Strike and Foul buttons on the Lock Screen card
• Custom rules: start count, balls for a walk, strikes for a strikeout, foul with 2 strikes, and number of innings
• No ads

Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription. You can restore it on other devices signed in with the same Apple Account.

■ Just the count
No score, pitch count or lineups. No account and no sign-in. Games are stored on your iPhone only.
A phone has limits: gloves or a wet screen may not register a tap, and keeping the screen on for a full game uses battery.

name: Un jour une recette
description:
Finis le casse tête du repas. Chaque jour, une idée de recette SIMPLE, RAPIDE et VALIDEE par la communauté avec notes et commentaires.
Le widget recette du jour vous la donne sans effort.

Mode anti-gaspi vide frigo : une photo du frigo et des placards et hop, des tonnes de recettes délicieuses utilisant vos ingrédients.

LA RECETTE DU JOUR : recevez-la à l'heure de votre choix et retrouvez-la sur votre écran d'accueil grâce au widget.

CUISINER SANS STRESS : le mode préparation affiche une étape à la fois, en grand, garde l'écran allumé et lance les minuteurs pour vous, même téléphone verrouillé. Avancez à la voix, les mains dans la farine.

UNE QUESTION EN CUISINANT ? Demandez à l'assistant, à l'écrit ou à la voix : il connaît la recette ouverte.

QUOI FAIRE AVEC CE QUE J'AI ? Prenez votre frigo en photo : l'app propose des recettes avec ce que vous avez.

ANTI-GASPI : choisissez vos ingrédients à finir et trouvez des idées pour tout utiliser.

J'AI FAIT : photographiez votre plat et partagez-le avec la communauté ; votre avis apparaît aussi sur le site.

VOTRE CARNET : retrouvez toutes les recettes sauvegardées sur le site, même sans connexion.

name: Unitile - Sliding Tile Game
description:
Unitile is an abstract strategy game by Mark Steere, played on a 5x5 board with twelve red tiles, twelve blue tiles and one empty cell, the bubble.

On your turn, you slide a tile of either color that is next to the bubble into the bubble. A color is united when all of its tiles form a single connected group. The first move that unites a color ends the game, and the player of that color wins, even if the opponent made the move.

Not every slide is allowed: each move must bring the position closer to a united color, by a measure the app works out for you. The tiles that can legally slide are marked on the board, so there is nothing to compute, only a position to read. The rule guarantees that there is always a legal move, that no position repeats, and that every game ends with a winner.

FEATURES
- Six computer levels, from Very easy to Unbeatable. The top level plays perfectly.
- Each color can be a human or a computer level: play either color, play a friend on one iPhone or iPad, or watch two computer levels play each other.
- Legal moves marked on the board. A confirm step guards against mistaken taps.
- Undo and a hint are one tap away. A level can be changed in the middle of a game.
- A copyable record of the game.
- The complete rules with diagrams, inside the app. The rules text can be copied and pasted into a translator.
- No ads, no accounts, no internet connection needed, nothing collected.

Unitile was designed by Mark Steere in October 2026. More of his games can be found at marksteeregames.com.

name: Unki – POST Family Resort
description:
Unki & Unkine are coming on holiday with you! The Unki song to sing along to, picture books that read themselves aloud and games that work without internet – for the journey, your days at the POST Family Resort and the time after.

The official app of the POST Family Resort in Unken, Salzburger Land, Austria.

FOR THE KIDS
• The Unki song: sing and dance along, keeps playing in the background
• Unki x Kekz: three songs from the Kekz audio story "Unki & Unkine und das verschwundene Pony". The full story is available on our own Unki Kekz chip
• Three picture books "Die Abenteuer von Unki & Unkine": every page is read aloud, with automatic page turning and a bedtime mode
• Colouring: colouring-book motifs from the POST with three brush sizes – send the finished picture to grandma & grandpa via WhatsApp
• Picture puzzles in three difficulty levels
• "Ab auf die Piste!": the ski race with Unki and Unkine

All games work offline – perfect for the car, the plane or waiting at the restaurant.

FOR PARENTS
• Today at the POST: what's open now, what's closing soon and what opens later
• Hotel news right in the app
• Explore: day trips around Unken on the map, with navigation via Apple or Google Maps
• Weather for Unken: current, next 24 hours and 7 days

ON THE IPAD
A playroom of its own with large tiles, books in landscape like an open book and full-screen games.

SAFE FOR KIDS
Free, no account, no ads, no location tracking. The app does not collect any personal data.

Please note: songs, stories and read-aloud books are in German.

DOWNLOAD BEFORE YOU ARRIVE
Let the excitement travel with you – and know from day one what's open at the family resort.

Unki & Unkine are looking forward to seeing you!

name: Unlinked: Ring Puzzle
description:
A heap of rings, all clipped together. Turn them one by one until every last ring flies free.

Drag a ring round to turn it. When its gap passes a clip, the clip lets go, and a ring with nothing left holding it pops off the board. But a ring that still grips a neighbour can't turn at all, so look closely and work out which one to free first. Grabbing a stuck ring costs one of your three hearts.

THREE WORKSHOPS TO CHOOSE FROM
Every look has its own room, rings, music and little friend. Change whenever you like in Settings.
• Workbench: brass and painted rings on a watchmaker's bench with Tick the hedgehog
• Velvet: jewel-bright rings on midnight velvet with Bijou the raccoon
• Clay: soft pastel clay rings in a garden with Mallow the bunny

A FRIEND WHO'S ALWAYS ON YOUR SIDE
Your friend waves hello, nods and claps as rings come free, dances when several go at once, and shows you a ring that turns when you're stuck.

FEATURES
• Levels that start gently and grow into bigger and bigger tangles
• No timer and no rush
• Free hints whenever you need one
• Original art, animation and music
• Your progress is saved automatically
• Plays offline, with no account, no ads and no purchases

Pick up a ring and give it a turn.

name: UO XR
description:
UO XR is the immersive learning platform of the Living Lab VR@UO at the University of Oradea, Romania.

Lessons you can step inside:
• Interactive 3D lessons — rotate, take apart and explore real lab equipment, piece by piece
• Augmented reality — place a lesson on your desk through the camera and walk around it
• 360° tours of the university's laboratories and spaces
• Tasks, quizzes and exams inside the lessons, with certificates anyone can verify
• Narration that reads the explanations aloud

Learn at your own pace:
• XP, levels, badges, streaks and a leaderboard
• Save lessons and download them to use offline
• Pick up where you left off — your progress follows you on every device
• Join your class or study group with a team code

The same account works on virtual.uoradea.ro, so everything you earn in the app is also on the web.

Made by the Living Lab VR@UO team, University of Oradea.

name: Usable Tab
description:
Usable Tab opens your Guitar Pro tabs and plays them back with a realistic band, so you can read along and practise with the whole song, offline.

OPEN YOUR SCORES
• Opens .gp, .gpx, .gp5, .gp4 and .gp3 files, from the Files app, the share sheet or the in-app import
• Standard notation, TAB, or both, page by page or in one long line
• Focus mode hides everything but the score and the play button
• Follows light and dark mode for comfortable reading

A BAND THAT SOUNDS LIKE ONE
• Built-in electric guitar, bass and drum sounds play every track at once
• Built-in amp models give guitars and bass their tone, with no extra apps or downloads
• Choose a sound and an amp for each track; your choices stay with the score
• Mixer with volume, mute and solo for every track

PRACTISE YOUR WAY
• Slow a song down or speed it up without changing its pitch
• Transpose
• Loop any range of bars, or jump between sections
• Metronome and count-in
• The score follows the music, and one tap brings you back after you scroll away

WORKS OFFLINE
Everything runs on your device. No account, no sign-in, no internet connection, no tracking.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
The free version keeps up to 3 songs in your library, with every built-in sound and effect.
A one-time Full Version purchase adds:
• Unlimited songs
• Your own AUv3 audio effects on any track
• Custom themes and score paper textures
No subscription.

Guitar Pro is a trademark of Arobas Music. Usable Tab is not affiliated with or endorsed by Arobas Music.

name: Vaktinde: Namaz Vakti ve Ezan
description:
Vaktinde, namaz vakitlerinden Kur'an-ı Kerim'e, kıbleden zikre kadar günlük ibadetin için ihtiyaç duyduğun her şeyi tek uygulamada toplar. Hesap açmadan kullanılır; namaz takibin, zikirlerin ve ayarların yalnızca telefonunda durur.

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ VE EZAN
• Diyanet yöntemiyle, ilçene özel namaz vakitleri; internet olmadan da çalışır
• Sıradaki vakte saniyelik geri sayım, miladi ve hicri tarih
• Her vakit için ezanlı ya da kısa uyarılı bildirim, istersen vakitten önce hatırlatma
• Kolay mod: tek dokunuşla büyük yazı ve geniş düğmeler

WIDGET'LAR
• Ana ekran: sıradaki vakit, günün bütün vakitleri ve günün hadisi
• Kilit ekranı: günde iki kez yenilenen kısa hadis
• Zikirmatik widget'ı: uygulamayı açmadan widget'a dokunarak say
• Farklı renk ve desen tasarımları arasından seçim

KUR'AN-I KERİM
• Medine mushafı düzeninde 604 sayfa, kaldığın sayfadan devam
• Arapça metnin altında Türkçe okunuş ve meal
• Sure listesi, cüz ve sayfaya hızlı geçiş, yazı boyutu ayarı
• Kur'an radyo: ekran kapalıyken de dinlemeye devam

KIBLE
• Pusulayla kıble yönü ve açısı
• Pusula şaşırırsa güneşle kıble bulma

ZİKİRMATİK
• Hazır zikirler ve kendi eklediğin zikirler, hedef ve tur sayacı
• Tesbih, el zikirmatiği ve nur halkası görünümleri
• Sesle sayma ve ekranın her yerinin saydığı kilit modu

NAMAZ TAKİBİ
• Kılındı, camide kılındı, kaza gereken, kazası kılındı ve özel hal işaretleri
• Kaza borcu sayacı ve hesaplayıcısı
• Haftalık tablo, istatistik ve günlük hatırlatma; kayıtlarını yedekleyip geri yükleme

DAHA FAZLASI
• Adım adım namaz öğrenme rehberi
• Yakındaki camiler: uzaklık, yön ve yol tarifi; liste uygulamanın içinde, internet gerekmez
• Dini günler ve kandiller, hicri takvim
• Esmaül Hüsna: 99 isim, Arapçası ve anlamıyla
• Günün hadisi
• Zekat hesaplama
• Cuma, kandil ve bayram tebrik mesajları; görsel olarak paylaşma
• Vefa dosyası: bir yakının vefatından sonra yapılacak resmî işler ve son günleri

VEFAT HALKASI
Bir yakınını kaybettiğinde sevdiklerinle birlikte hatim, Yasin, tevhid ve salavat oku. Halkayı aç, linki WhatsApp'ta paylaş; herkes bir cüz alsın, okuyunca işaretlesin. Katılanların uygulamayı indirmesi gerekmez. Halkada bağış ya da ödeme yoktur.

PREMIUM (isteğe bağlı abonelik)
• Ek ana ekran ve zikirmatik widget tasarımları, kilit ekranında zikir sayacı
• Apple Watch'ta zikirmatik
• Namaz öğren ve Sure öğren'in bütün dersleri, 7 özel tema
• Reklamsız kullanım
Aylık ve yıllık, otomatik yenilenen abonelik. Ücret Apple hesabından alınır; dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse aynı ücretle yenilenir. Abonelikler App Store hesap ayarlarından yönetilir ve iptal edilir.
Kullanım koşulları: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Gizlilik politikası: https://vefat.halka-tr.workers.dev/gizlilik

GİZLİLİK
Konumun yalnızca vakitleri bulunduğun ilçeye göre göstermek ve yakındaki camileri sıralamak için, uygulama açıkken kullanılır; koordinatlar kaydedilmez, Vaktinde sunucularına gönderilmez. İstersen konum izni vermeden ilçeni kendin seçebilirsin. Kişisel bilgilerin satılmaz. Uygulamada ekranın altında küçük bir reklam bandı gösterilir; Premium'da reklam yoktur. Vaktinde sunucularına bilgi gönderen tek bölüm Vefat Halkası'dır.

Görüş ve önerilerin için: vaktindeappp@gmail.com

name: Vardo Play
description:
Your playlists. A clearer place to play.

Vardo Play brings your own media into an organized library for iPhone and iPad. Import playlists, browse channel groups, save favorites, and return to what you were watching-all in a clean, native interface.

IMPORT AND ORGANIZE
Add an HTTPS playlist link or import an M3U, M3U8, or TXT playlist through Files. Keep multiple playlists, rename them, and refresh online playlists whenever you choose.

BROWSE WITH EASE
Explore channel cards, browse groups, search channel names, and sort alphabetically. Save frequently watched channels for quick access from the Saved tab.

PLAY WITH NATIVE CONTROLS
Play supported direct HTTPS media, including HLS and MP4. Use native playback and fullscreen controls, choose between sources supplied by your playlist, and resume supported on-demand media from a saved position.

UNDERSTAND YOUR PLAYLISTS
Inspect channel and source counts, review import issues, and share a summary report without including private media URLs. View schedule entries supplied by compatible structured playlists.

TRY THE ORIGINAL SAMPLES
Explore four original motion clips included with the app. These local samples let you try browsing, saving, and playback without an external media account or internet connection.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA
Your playlists, saved channels, recent activity, and playback positions are stored locally. No Vardo Play account is required. Remote artwork is optional and disabled by default. Manage your library, clear viewing history, or reset local app data in Settings.

IMPORTANT
Vardo Play is a media player, not a content provider. It does not include a third-party television catalogue or channel subscriptions. Use only playlists and media you own or have permission to access. Online playback contacts external media services and depends on your connection, source availability, and device-supported formats. Not all media formats or protected services are supported.

name: VDJ Controller
description:
VDJ Controller turns your iPad or iPhone into a MIDI control surface for the software you already run.

The layout:
A 5 × 3 pad grid across six switchable layers, 90 pads in all, plus five fixed pads, eleven faders with a master, and four knobs on every layer. Rename any pad and colour any layer, so the surface reads like your show rather than a grid of numbers.

Connecting:
On iPhone and iPad, VDJ Controller talks to a Mac over the USB cable using Apple's Inter-Device Audio & MIDI. Enable the device once in Audio MIDI Setup on the Mac, then pick it as a MIDI input in your software. Windows hosts are not supported on iOS.

It remembers each machine:
Every computer you connect to gets its own profile: pad names, layer colours, MIDI numbering and the last fader positions. Plug into a different machine and nothing bleeds across.

Plain MIDI:
Notes and control changes on a channel you choose, with numbering you can edit. Works with Resolume, ProPresenter, VirtualDJ and anything that accepts MIDI learn.

Try it for a week:
Every feature is on for 7 days. If it earns a place in your setup, one payment keeps it - no subscription, no account, no ads. Nothing is charged automatically when the trial ends.

name: Vectraflux
description:
Vectraflux is an interactive physics visualization studio for learners who want to see concepts move—not memorize flashcards.

Six fully interactive labs:
• Total Internal Reflection — tune incidence angle and refractive indices; critical angle, reflected and refracted rays update live
• Double-Slit Interference — reshape fringe spacing and intensity with wavelength, slit distance, and screen distance
• Charged Particle in Combined Fields — combine E and B to form straight, circular, and cycloidal paths
• Simple Harmonic Motion — mass, spring constant, amplitude, and damping with synced displacement and energy readouts
• Ideal Gas Thermodynamics — explore PV relationships with animated molecular motion
• Photoelectric Effect — sweep frequency, intensity, and work function to reveal threshold behavior and kinetic energy

What you get:
• Real-time animation, formula panel, and graph linked to the same parameters
• Play / Pause / Reset time control
• On-device saved slider values and favorites
• English and Finnish interface strings
• Color-coded topic tabs: Studio, Optics, Kinetics, Energy, Console
• Help, About, and Privacy pages—no account, no tracking SDKs

Vectraflux is built for classroom demos, self-study, and curious exploration. Everything runs locally on your iPhone.

name: VedVerse
description:
VedVerse brings the Hindu scriptures together in one calm, free app: the Bhagavad Gita, Vedas, Upanishads, Ramayana, Mahabharata, the Puranas, stotras and mantras.

• Read every verse in its original Sanskrit, with transliteration and translations in English, Hindi, Gujarati and other Indian languages.
• Hear verses chanted in Sanskrit by an AI voice that runs on your phone and works offline, including Vedic verses.
• Listen to translations read aloud.
• Download chants for a whole section, such as a Rigveda Mandala, to listen offline.
• Copy any verse or translation, bookmark favourites, and pick up where you left off.
• Learn with structured paths, stotras and mantras, a mala counter for chanting, and short explanations of any verse.
• No ads and no tracking.

The chanting, voices and explanations are AI-generated and can contain mistakes. For study, ritual or recitation, please learn from a traditional source or a qualified teacher.

name: Vee: Personal AI Assistant
description:
Vee is a personal AI assistant that works inside the tools you already use: WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Sheets, LINE, Telegram and Stripe. Tell Vee what you need in plain language and it gets it done, asking you first before anything that matters.

WHAT VEE DOES
• Reads what comes in on WhatsApp, LINE and email, and drafts the reply in your voice.
• Books meetings, sends reminders and keeps the follow-ups moving.
• Looks things up, fills in sheets and keeps your records straight.
• Runs routines you set once ("every weekday at 8am, summarise my unread mail").

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Nothing is sent without your say-so. Vee shows you the message, the recipient and the reason, and waits.
• "Needs you" is your inbox of pending approvals: approve, skip or batch them in one tap.
• Standing permissions let you tell Vee what it may do on its own, with limits you set. Pause or revoke them any time.

CONNECT WHAT YOU USE
• Link WhatsApp in the app with a QR code or a pairing code.
• Gmail, Google Sheets, LINE, Telegram, Notion and Stripe connect from the Vee web app with the same account.

YOUR DATA
• Your conversations and connections are stored on the Vee server and used only to do what you asked.
• Export or delete everything from the Account screen whenever you like.

Vee needs a Vee account (free to start). Create one in the app with your email, or sign in with the account you already use on the web.

name: Veilattice: Layer Riddles
description:
A little paper. A hidden pattern. A new way to think.

Veilattice: Layer Riddles is a paper-folding puzzle game where every fold changes what you see—and what lies underneath.

Study the target, choose a crease, and fold your paper into place. Pay attention to both sides: a pattern that disappears from the surface may become the clue you need next.

40 HANDCRAFTED PUZZLES
Explore four chapters of carefully designed challenges. Start with simple folds, then work through puzzles involving overlapping layers, hidden patterns, and the order of your moves.

LEARN BY FOLDING
A guided first puzzle takes you from reading the target to making a fold and checking your answer. Return to the practice tutorial whenever you want a refresher.

LOOK BENEATH THE SURFACE
Inspect the front and back of the paper, examine its layers, and use viewing windows to uncover details hidden inside the stack.

EXPERIMENT AND DISCOVER
Preview your next fold before applying it. Undo a move, try another approach, or use a hint when you need a little help.

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
Enjoy a focused portrait layout, tactile paper-inspired visuals, and clear folding animations. Your progress is saved as you play.

Can you work out what the layers are hiding?

name: VeilFrame
description:
Keep the receipt. Share only the part someone needs to see.

Choose a screenshot or photo. VeilFrame finds printed text on your iPhone and outlines the lines you can cover. Tap one, search for repeated words, or draw a box over a face, code or other detail by hand. Move or resize a box and undo a change while you work.

Review image shows the flattened copy. Zoom in and check the whole image before you save a new PNG to Photos or send it through the share sheet. The original stays in your library.

Text recognition supports English and Simplified Chinese. Suggestions can miss private details, including text in unfamiliar layouts. Use the draw tool for anything that was missed. No account is needed.

name: Velvetkista
description:
Velvetkista är ett verktyg för hantering av rekvisita och förberedelser, särskilt utformat för magiker som arbetar med närbildsmagi (close-up) eller i mindre format (parlormagi). Fokus ligger på att organisera rekvisita, placeringar i fickor eller väskor, rutiner och specifika föreställningar – det är alltså inte ett socialt nätverk eller en molnbaserad samarbetsplattform.

Det mest kaotiska inslaget i en föreställning är ofta inte själva maginumret, utan snarare frågor som: vilken rekvisita ligger i vilken ficka? Saknas något? Finns det tillräckligt med förbrukningsmaterial? Vad är nästa steg när jag väl står på scenen? Velvetkista samlar all denna information på ett ställe och skapar ett effektivt arbetsflöde.

1. Håll koll på enskild rekvisita: namn, kategori, antal, enhet, status (tillgänglig/trasig/på reparation/utrangerad), förvaringsplats, förberedelseinstruktioner, status för förbrukningsmaterial och miniminivåer i lager – med möjlighet att lägga till referensbilder.

2. Planera förvaring och utrymme genom att definiera "fickor i kläder" eller "fack i väskor", och tilldela rekvisita till dessa platser så att allt ligger rätt innan du går upp på scenen.

3. Bygg upp rutiner som tidslinjer: ange tidsåtgång, miljö och förberedelseuppgifter. För varje rekvisita anger du startposition, handlingsförlopp, slutposition, instruktioner för återställning, förbrukning per föreställning samt reservplaner.

4. Skapa och hantera föreställningar: ange datum, tid, specifika avsnitt samt vilka rutiner eller uppsättningar som ska användas. Processen följer en strukturerad ordning: planering → packning → förberedelser på plats → föreställning → återställning → undanplockning → avslut. Under en föreställning kan du bekräfta eller hoppa över rutiner, hålla koll på övergångar, hantera trasig eller utbytt rekvisita och logga förbrukningen av material.

5. Inför en föreställning kan du kontrollera varningar om saknade föremål, se hur fickor är fyllda, kontrollera var rekvisitan ska placeras från början och se beräknad förbrukning för kvällen – allt innan du påbörjar de sista förberedelserna eller kliver upp på scenen.

6. Övervaka lagernivåer för förbrukningsmaterial (med varningar när de understiger en viss miniminivå), justera lagersaldot manuellt med anteckningar om orsaken, och se en historik över tillägg och uttag. Appen stöder även export och import av lokala säkerhetskopior i JSON-format. 7. Ta emot lokala notiser cirka 60 minuter före ett framträdande, som påminner dig om att kontrollera dina fickor och rekvisita (kräver behörighet för systemnotiser; kan stängas av när som helst).

- Utformat specifikt för trolleri: fokus ligger på fickor, start- och slutpositioner, återställningar och förbrukning per omgång – långt mer än bara en vanlig att göra-lista. - Processorienterat arbetsflöde: Varje pass följer en tydlig, strukturerad gång, vilket gör det enkelt att hålla koll på allt från inledande förberedelser till slutlig avrundning.
- Lokalt fokus: Data lagras lokalt på din enhet; säkerhetskopior hanteras via export och import av filer, utan molnbaserad synkronisering av konton.
- Gränssnittet är på svenska och präglas av en återhållsam, nischad estetik som för tankarna till en professionell teatermiljö bakom kulisserna.

name: Veyzor
description:
Explore the unseen world around you with three scientific observation modes.

SKY — Follow satellites above you.
Calculate satellite directions and elevations from public orbital elements and your location. Identify navigation, weather, communication and research objects by color and shape. See predicted positions at +10, +30 and +60 minutes, play the next hour, and explore positions on a simplified 3D Earth.

EARTH — Explore Earth's past events.
Browse USGS earthquake records within 500–5,000 km. Filter the past 24 hours or 7 days, inspect magnitude, time, depth and epicenter, and locate events on a simplified globe.

FIELD — Discover changes in nearby magnetic fields.
Use your device's magnetic sensor to compare readings with a baseline. Explore how cases, desks and speakers affect measurements, using response rings and a history graph.

Start with a demo without location or network requests. Real feeds and sensor readings start on your action. Preview a discovery card and share it through the iOS share menu. Cards omit your observer location.

Please note:
• Satellite positions are calculated, do not guarantee naked-eye visibility and do not cover every satellite.
• Earthquake records are historical, not predictions, early warnings or evacuation advice. Events absent from USGS are not shown.
• FIELD does not locate objects or measure their distance, and is not calibrated precision equipment. A compatible device is required.
• Real feeds require network access and location. Provider changes or outages can affect availability.

This initial version is free with no ads. Ads and an optional purchase to remove ads may be introduced later to help sustain development.

Support: KI App Studio / support@kiappstudio.com (subject: Veyzor).

name: ViatraMindX
description:
ViatraMindX is a quiz you drive.

Every question is a night-time crossroads with four roads. Each road is one answer, but the signs are in the dark. You can only read the first letters.

Know it? Swipe your car down the road and take full points.
Not sure? Spend a headlight charge to light a sign and read it. Each sign you light lowers what the junction pays.
Wrong road? That is a dead end, and a burst tyre.

Fuel burns while you think and refills with every right turn. Lose all three tyres and the route ends.

DAILY ROUTE
12 junctions, one try, and the same route for every driver. See how the traffic went at each junction, and where you land on the Driver Board.

THE ATLAS
6 regions and 30 legs, playable offline:
• Star Basin: space and science
• Old Stone Road: history
• Atlas Coast: geography
• Wild Reserve: animals and nature
• Story Harbor: words, books and art
• Cog Valley: inventions and numbers
Earn up to three stars on each leg.

GARAGE
Unlock six cars with the stars you win.

ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK
Three synthwave tracks made for the night road, with their own switch in Settings.

No ads. No purchases. No account needed. A name is only used if you choose to join the Driver Board.

name: VoiceTag Studio
description:
The picture shows you how they looked. The voice brings back how it felt.

VoiceTag Studio pairs your photos with the sounds that go with them. Pick a photo, and your little one, your pet, or anyone you love lifts right out of the background as a die-cut sticker. Hold the mic, record a few seconds, and it's a keepsake that talks. Tap the sticker and it hops while the voice plays.

MAKE A VOICETAG IN SECONDS
- Choose any photo. The subject is cut out automatically, right on your iPhone.
- Hold to record, and let go when you're done. Up to 30 seconds.
- Give it a title like First Steps or Giggle Time.

YOUR SCRAPBOOK OF VOICES
- A warm sticker page of everything you've saved
- Tap any sticker to hear it again
- A waveform and date on every memory

SEND IT TO THE PEOPLE WHO'D LOVE IT
Turn any VoiceTag into a short video, with the sticker hopping along to the voice. Send it to Grandma by text or save it to Photos. Whoever gets it can just press play.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Cutouts, recordings, and videos are all made on your iPhone
- No account to create
- No ads, and no tracking
- Nothing is uploaded unless you choose to share it

Little voices change faster than you think. Keep them.

name: Vota: Who's Right?
description:
Stuck in the same argument? Let other people decide who's right.

Vota is a friendly reality check for everyday arguments. You and the other person each write your side, without seeing what the other wrote. Once you both approve, people read both sides and vote.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start a case and invite the other person
• You each write your side privately
• People vote: one of you, both, or "you're arguing about different things"
• See the verdict, then make up

JUDGE OTHER PEOPLE'S CASES
• Read both sides and give your verdict
• Guess what the crowd will say, and earn points when you call it
• Climb the leaderboard

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your side stays hidden until you both approve
• Voters see nicknames, never your email
• Votes are anonymous
• Finished cases are deleted for good after 7 days

Vota is for people 18 and older. If an argument involves fear or harm, it's not a debate: the app points you to free, confidential help instead.

name: Vox Memos: AI Meeting Notes
description:
Vox Memos is a voice recorder for meetings, lectures and interviews, with AI that runs entirely on your iPhone. Recording, transcription and speaker recognition all happen on the device. Your memos never leave it unless you share them. No account, no server, no cloud, no tracking.

RECORD FOR HOURS
• One tap starts a recording that keeps going with the screen locked or another app open.
• One file per recording, however long. Pause and resume in the same file.
• A live waveform shows the microphone is picking you up.
• Calls pause the recording; it continues when the microphone is free again.
• Crash-safe: if the app or phone stops unexpectedly, the recording is kept and repaired at the next launch.

VOX MEMOS AI (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• Transcripts with speakers: Speaker 1, 2, 3 … told apart on the device.
• Live transcript while you record, in large text that follows the conversation.
• Every language Apple's on-device speech recognition supports.
• Transcribe with one tap, or automatically while your iPhone charges.
• Tap any line to jump there; the line being played is highlighted.
• Share the transcript as plain text.
• Live Activity on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island: the recording time and a stop button.
• Compress memos to a fraction of their size, on the device.
• Pay once, keep it forever. No subscription.

PLAY BACK QUICKLY
• Player right in the list, with a waveform that scrolls as it plays.
• 0.5× to 2× speed and 15-second jumps.
• Skip silences while listening, and share the audio without them.
• Rename, duplicate, share as standard audio files, delete and restore. Shared memos are marked.

SHORTCUTS AND SIRI
• Start, stop, pause or toggle a recording from Shortcuts, Siri, automations or Back Tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Processed locally, stored locally. Recordings and transcripts leave your iPhone only if you share them.
• Optional Face ID lock.
• Import recordings from other apps through the share sheet.

Recording, playback and skipping silences are free. Transcripts, speakers, the live transcript, compression and the Live Activity are the Vox Memos AI upgrade, a one-time in-app purchase.

Please record responsibly: in many places, recording a conversation requires the consent of everyone taking part. Use Vox Memos in line with the laws where you are.

name: VRO
description:
VRO giúp bạn đặt chuyến thuận tiện ngay trên điện thoại.

Với VRO, bạn có thể:
- Chọn điểm đón và điểm đến trên bản đồ.
- Xem thông tin chuyến đi và theo dõi trạng thái hành trình.
- Lưu các địa điểm thường dùng để đặt chuyến nhanh hơn.
- Quản lý thông tin tài khoản và lịch sử chuyến đi.
- Nhận thông báo về chuyến đi và các cập nhật liên quan.

VRO liên tục cải thiện trải nghiệm để việc di chuyển của bạn đơn giản và thuận tiện hơn.

name: VRO Driver
description:
VRO Driver là ứng dụng hỗ trợ tài xế quản lý công việc và chuyến đi trên nền tảng VRO.

Với VRO Driver, bạn có thể:
- Hoàn tất hồ sơ đăng ký tài xế và gửi thông tin xác minh cần thiết.
- Bật trạng thái sẵn sàng để nhận chuyến phù hợp.
- Xem chi tiết điểm đón, điểm đến và cập nhật trạng thái chuyến đi.
- Theo dõi lịch sử hoạt động, thông báo và thông tin thu nhập.
- Quản lý thông tin cá nhân, phương tiện và tài khoản nhận thanh toán.

VRO Driver được xây dựng để giúp tài xế chủ động hơn trong công việc hằng ngày.

name: VynqaroMeldith
description: Scissor lift design: scissor arm geometry, hydraulic cylinder force and pressure, load stability, lift platform and pump unit. Calculate platform height, cylinder pull and lifting time in real time.

name: Wadachi: Drive Tracker
description:
Wadachi records your drives and shows you how you really drive. Tap Start, put your phone away, and every trip lands in your journal with its route, distance and time.

EVERY DRIVE, MAPPED
• One tap to start, recording continues with the screen locked
• Route, distance, duration, average and top speed
• Departure and arrival places named automatically
• A journal of every drive, month by month

DRIVE SMOOTHER
• A smoothness score for every drive, out of 100
• Harsh braking, quick starts and sharp turns, placed on the map
• Peak braking and cornering forces in g
• Climb, stops and moving time

SHARE YOUR ROAD TRIPS
• Beautiful drive cards for your stories
• Your start and end points stay hidden, so your address is never shared
• Hide your top speed if you prefer

KEEP A LOG
• Tag drives as personal or business
• Several vehicles in your garage
• Export your trips to CSV for a spreadsheet

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your routes are stored only on your iPhone, never on a server. Location is used only while a drive is recording.

SAFETY FIRST
Wadachi works on its own while you drive: there is nothing to tap until you park. It rewards smooth driving, never speed. Never handle your phone while driving.

WADACHI PREMIUM
Free: unlimited recording, map, distance, time and speeds, journal and drive cards.
Premium: smoothness score and driving analysis, map colored by speed, speed chart, weekly and monthly stats, records, all your roads on one map, CSV export.
Yearly subscription with a 1-week free trial, or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store settings.

Wadachi (轍) means the tracks left by wheels on the road.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://karnisalaheddine-hue.github.io/wadachi/privacy.html

name: WaveMemo – Write & Let Go
description:
Words fade with the waves.

WaveMemo is a little writing space by the sea, where your words are carried away by the tide.

Write a passing thought on the shore, and every now and then, a larger wave will roll in and gently sweep your words away.

A fleeting idea.
An unspoken feeling.
A thought you don't need to keep.

Just write, and watch the waves.

【Features】

• Words washed away by waves
Occasional larger waves reach the shore and gradually erase your writing, starting from the top line.

• Send your words to the sea
Tap a button to send your words flying toward the horizon.

• A changing seaside landscape
Choose between morning, daytime, evening, and night, with animated transitions from sunset to moonrise.

• Four illustration styles
Personalize the scenery with vintage, colorful, painted, or outlined pop illustrations.

• Nothing to save
Your writing isn't stored. There is no history or undo function. If you want to keep something, simply take a screenshot.

Not every word needs to last forever.

Write for a moment.
Watch the waves.
Let your words drift away.

name: WeekendSeam
description:
Suunnittele viikonloppu suomalaisella järvimökillä oman mökkisi ehdoilla. Kirjaa juomaveden lähde, kiuas, hyttysverkot, sähkö ja puhelimen kuuluvuus. Syötä sitten sääennuste, järviveden lämpötila ja seurueen koko. WeekendSeam kokoaa arvion järviveden tuntumasta ja hyttyssuojasta, laatii pakkauslistan ja ajoittaa kiukaan lämmityksen, ensimmäisen löylyn, jäähdyttelyn ja valinnaisen toisen kierroksen.

Kirjaa palattuasi mitattu veden lämpötila ja oma tuntumasi, niin seuraava arvio mukautuu kokemukseesi. Täydennä järvialueen hyttyskauden arviota eri vuosien havainnoilla ja ota halutessasi käyttöön paikallinen muistutus ennen valittua käyntiä. Merkitse tuodut, käytetyt, jäljelle jääneet ja hukkaan menneet tarvikkeet, jotta seuraava pakkauslista vastaa omaa kulutustanne. Mökkikalenteriin voi merkitä vierailut ja täydennystarpeet sekä jakaa käyntitiedoston seuraavalle seurueelle tuotavaksi. Sää ja veden lämpötila syötetään käsin. Suunnitelmat ja merkinnät säilyvät laitteella.

Arviot pohjautuvat suomalaisiin mökki- ja järvikokemuksiin. Ne on tarkoitettu lomailun tueksi eivätkä korvaa ammattimaista turvallisuus- tai lääketieteellistä neuvontaa.

name: Whammy - Guitar Tabs to Video
description:
Every song. Played in 3D.

Whammy turns guitar tabs into a 3D guitar that plays every note in perfect time. Search a song, hit play, and watch the notes light up on the neck exactly where your fingers go: bends, slides, hammer-ons and all.

FIND ANY SONG
• Type a song and start playing in seconds
• Real rhythm and exact timing, not guesswork
• Switch between lead, rhythm and bass parts
• Import your own Guitar Pro and MIDI files

PLAY WITH THE FULL BAND
• Hear the drums, bass and other guitars behind you
• Or switch to guitar only and hear just your part
• Pick the guitar tone that fits the song

PRACTICE SMARTER
• Slow it down without losing the groove
• Loop the hard bars until your fingers know them
• Show the scrolling tab, fret numbers or finger numbers
• Flip the strings to match how you see the neck

MAKE IT LOOK INSANE
• Four guitars with custom finishes
• Stage looks, backdrops and your own photos
• Storms, sparks and effects that react to the music
• Cinematic camera angles, including the player's-eye view

POST IT
• Export vertical, square or widescreen videos in one tap
• Smooth 60 fps, with the scrolling tab on or off
• Keep using the app while your video renders
• Save to Photos or share anywhere

WHAMMY PRO
Whammy requires a subscription. Choose a yearly plan with a 3-day free trial, or a weekly plan.

• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.bestdaylabs.com/whammy/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.bestdaylabs.com/whammy/privacy.html
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Whataa
description:
Vous êtes patron et vous ne pouvez pas rester derrière le comptoir toute la journée ? Avec Whataa Réseau, votre commerce vous suit partout.

Supermarché, supérette, boutique, magasin ou quincaillerie : l’application est reliée à votre logiciel de caisse Whataa Gro et vous montre ce qui se passe chez vous, depuis votre téléphone.

Vos ventes en un coup d’œil
Chiffre du jour, de la semaine ou du mois, nombre de ventes, panier moyen et bénéfice estimé. Vous voyez aussi ce qui est encaissé en espèces, par MTN Money ou par Wave.

Vos caisses sous contrôle
Pour chaque caisse ouverte, vous voyez les ventes de la session et l’argent qui doit être dans le tiroir. À la clôture, chaque manque ou excédent est signalé, avec le nom du caissier. Vous savez tout de suite si la caisse est juste.

Votre stock surveillé
Les articles presque épuisés sont affichés en premier, pour que vous commandiez à temps. Vous retrouvez n’importe quel article par son nom ou son code-barres.

Vos crédits clairs
Qui vous doit de l’argent, combien et depuis quand. Et ce qu’il vous reste à payer à chaque fournisseur.

Plusieurs boutiques ? Pas de problème
Passez d’un point de vente à l’autre, ou regardez tous vos magasins réunis.

Arrêtez d’appeler la boutique pour savoir comment s’est passée la journée. Ouvrez Whataa Réseau, et vous le saurez.

name: Whenlet
description:
Whenlet helps you remember when you last did the everyday things: watering the plants, changing the bedsheets, checking the tires, renewing a passport.

It's a calm place for your last times. No streaks to protect. No catching up.

• Tap Done and it's noted. Slipped? Undo straight away.
• Don't know when you last did something? Choose "I don't know" — Whenlet never invents a date.
• One-time things, with an optional deadline, or repeating things with a gentle interval.
• Up next shows what still needs doing; finished things step aside until they're due again.
• Categories you shape yourself, with icons.
• A full history you can correct: log an earlier time, edit a date or note, remove a mistake.
• Search, archive and restore.
• Export your data as a readable backup and restore it on any device.

Private by design: no account, no analytics, no network access. Everything stays on your iPhone or iPad unless you export it.

Intervals and deadlines are visual check-ins. Whenlet does not send notifications or reminders. It is not intended for medical, medication or other safety-critical tracking.

name: Whistlr Tv
description:
Whistlr, made for your TV.

Sit back and watch everything happening on Whistlr from the couch. Whistlr Tv puts Minis, live streams and creator channels on the big screen, laid out for the Siri Remote.

• A fresh home every time you open it: a billboard of picks, For You, Creators for You, Top 10 Minis on Whistlr Today, Live now, Stories and more.
• Minis, full screen. Like, comment, save and repost without picking up your phone.
• Live streams, VODs and clips, with streamer profiles and Subscribe.
• Creator channels: every creator's Latest and Popular, and Add Friend right from the TV.
• Search accounts and videos.
• Up to 5 profiles per TV. Pick who's watching, give each profile a TV-only nickname and avatar.
• Sign in by scanning a QR code with the Whistlr app on your iPhone. No passwords typed on the TV.

Whistlr Tv is for watching. Posting, messaging and everything else still happen in the Whistlr app on your phone.

name: Wicksettle: Candle Costs
description:
Track what went into every pour, what came out, and the cost of each good candle.

Wicksettle is an offline production ledger for independent candle makers. The app interface is available in English, Traditional Chinese and Japanese.

FREE TO TRY, ONE-TIME UNLOCK
Keep up to 5 active settled batches for free. Drafts and voided batches do not count toward this limit. Materials, drafts, viewing existing records, JSON backup and restore, and CSV export remain free. A single non-consumable in-app purchase unlocks unlimited settled batches. No subscription. Apple handles purchases and purchase restoration; these require an Apple account and an internet connection.

MATERIAL LOTS AND STOCK
Record wax, fragrance, additives and counted components by supplier lot. Enter the quantity received and total purchase cost. Record stock corrections with a date and reason.

ACTUAL BATCH INPUTS
Use multiple supplier lots in the same batch. Save a draft while you work. Drafts do not reserve or deduct stock.

COSTS AND YIELD
Record planned, good and rejected candles, poured weight, recovered mixture and additional costs. Review and finalize a batch to deduct its materials once. Finalized costs stay frozen, including the cost per good candle.

TRACEABILITY
See which lots went into a batch and which batches used a lot. Void an incorrect finalized batch with a reason and recorded stock-restoration entries.

YOUR RECORDS, ON YOUR DEVICE
No Wicksettle account, ads or analytics. Export a full JSON backup, restore a validated backup or export batch summaries as CSV. Explore an example workspace without mixing sample data into your real ledger.

For iPhone and iPad. One currency per ledger, fixed after the first record. Material purchases accept grams or mass ounces; actual batch weights use grams. Recovered mixture is tracked but is not automatically returned to raw-material inventory or credited against cost.

Wicksettle does not include sales, invoicing, automatic cloud sync or fragrance recommendations. It is a recordkeeping tool, not accounting, tax, safety or burn-test certification advice. Keep backups outside your device.

name: WiseMind Kids: Calm & Focus
description:
Real skills for big feelings, scattered focus, and too much screen time — taught the way kids actually learn: through play.

WiseMind Kids is social-emotional learning (SEL) made playable: the everyday life skills for handling feelings, focus and friendships — drawing on the well-known DBT skills curriculum — turned into 19 games, daily rituals, and real-world quests for three age groups: Sprouts (6–9), Explorers (10–13), and Navigators (14–17).

Your child raises Lumo, a glowing creature that grows one way only: real skill practice. Rare Lumo forms (Aurora, Ember, Tidepool) can ONLY be earned through real-world habits like a week of phone-free bedrooms — never bought.

THE DAILY RITUAL
• MoodMoji Daily — one national emotion riddle a day, three clues, three tries, a spoiler-free grid to share. Feelings vocabulary, gamified.
• 30-second check-in — name today's inside weather, feed the streak
• Body Base — sleep, movement, real food charge a shield that can SAVE a missed streak day

19 SKILL GAMES (every one names the skill it builds)
Breathing Buddy · Focus Grove (grow a tree with phone-down attention) · STOP Sign Reflex (catch the impulse before it fires) · TIPP 90-Second Reset · Urge Surfer (ride the wave instead of obeying it) · Wise Mind Duel · Opposite Day Arcade · Thought Court (fact… or story?) · Emotion Detective · Validation Station · Ask-It-Right Builder (DEAR MAN) · Choice Quest · My Skill Deck · Let-It-Be Garden · Cope-Ahead Studio · 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding · Bubble Calm · Half-Smile & Willing Hands · Breath-Sync Duel (two players, one device!)

REAL-WORLD QUESTS + SEASONAL EVENTS
Stars are earned OFF the screen: phone swaps, sleep shields, brave asks, kindness missions — plus limited-time quests for Screen-Free Summer, Back-to-School Reset, Gratitude November, and New Year Wise Mind.

FOR FAMILIES
Family Mode: up to 4 profiles on one device — parents included, because kids copy what we do. A parental-gated grown-ups area shows mood trends, a family Weather Wall, evidence-informed coaching tips, and Lumo Postcards: shareable milestone cards for wins earned off-screen. Journal notes are never shown to parents.

PRIVACY LIKE IT SHOULD BE
No ads. No trackers. No account. No feeds, friends, or messaging. Nothing your child does in this app ever leaves the device — export or erase everything in two taps. The only "sharing" is a share button YOU tap, opening your own device's share sheet.

100% FREE
Every game, every level, every quest and Family Mode are free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions. Crisis helplines are always one tap away.

WiseMind Kids is social-emotional learning — education and practice, not a medical or healthcare product. It does not diagnose or treat any condition, does not replace professional care, and is not a crisis service. If your child is struggling, please talk to a qualified professional.

name: Wobblade
description:
Somebody has to cut the cake, and everybody is watching.

Wobblade turns a swipe into a blade. Drag across a glazed pastel jelly and it parts along the exact line you drew, the pieces wobble, settle and show their share as a percentage. Cut one portion too fat and you will see it at once: the score is the smallest piece divided by the largest, so only a truly even split earns three stars.

THE JELLIES FIGHT BACK
- Plain Cakes: round and oval jellies teach the swipe.
- Odd Moulds: hearts, crosses, crescents and peanuts, where one wrong angle leaves a stray crumb.
- Fruit Tarts: whole strawberries sleep inside. Slice through one and the plate loses a star.
- Sliding Slabs: every cut pushes the pieces apart, so the next cut has to be planned.
- Windy Table: the plate sways, and the blade lands where the jelly is when you lift your finger.
- Banquet Hall: five and six portions, fruit and wobble together.

MORE TO SERVE
- 108 hand-checked plates. Every one has a known perfect cut, found by the game's own solver.
- A Daily Cake that is the same jelly for everybody, with a streak.
- Banquet, an endless service that ends after three dropped plates.
- A Cabinet of 24 garnishes bought with coins you earn by playing. Coins cannot be bought, and the draw odds are printed on the screen.
- A free-slice table on the home screen: touch the jelly and just cut.

LOOK AND FEEL
Bright patisserie light, mirror-glaze jelly, a marble table, a music-box tune and soft wet slicing sounds. Landscape and portrait, iPhone and iPad.

ADS AND AD-FREE PLAY
Wobblade is free and shows ads. Watch short optional videos to fill a monthly bar; at 100 videos, ads stay off until the date shown. Or choose Ad-free Monthly, an auto-renewing subscription (price shown in the app), billed to your Apple Account and renewing until cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage it in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. Nothing in the game is locked behind it.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-wobblade.html

name: Wordtick: English Vocabulary
description:
Wordtick, İngilizce kelimeleri kalıcı olarak öğrenmen için tasarlandı. Kelimeyi iPhone'da öğrenirsin, tekrarlar ise günün boş anlarında Apple Watch'ına gelir.

ÖNCE HATIRLA, SONRA AÇ
Kartta önce yalnızca İngilizce kelime görünür. Anlamını aklından bulursun, sonra açarsın ve Bilemedim, Zordu ya da Bildim diye işaretlersin. Bu aktif hatırlama, kelimeyi sadece görmekten çok daha kalıcıdır.

TAM ZAMANINDA TEKRAR
Aralıklı tekrar algoritması (FSRS) her kelimenin ne zaman yeniden sorulacağını senin cevaplarına göre hesaplar. Bildiğin kelimeler seyrekleşir, zorlandıkların daha sık gelir.

APPLE WATCH'TA SANİYELER İÇİNDE
Tekrar kartları saatinde de var. Kelimeyi gör, anlamını aç, tek dokunuşla cevapla. Telefonu çıkarmana gerek yok.

TÜRKÇE KONUŞANLAR İÇİN
Her kelimede doğal Türkçe karşılık ve örnek cümle var. Türklerin sık karıştırdığı kelimelerde, örneğin actually, sensible ya da bored, kısa bir dikkat notu seni uyarır.

SEVİYENE GÖRE
A2 ve B1 seviyesinde, günlük hayat, iş, seyahat ve duygular gibi temalara ayrılmış kelimeler.

GİZLİLİĞİNE SAYGILI
Hesap açman gerekmez. İlerlemen yalnızca cihazında saklanır. Reklam yok.

name: World Trails: Hiking Simulator
description:
Walk 30 real hiking trails across six continents, from the Dolomites to Everest Base Camp. Scramble up steep slopes, camp in huts and tents, survive snow, fog and thin air, and photograph the world's great peaks.

30 REAL TRAILS, SIX CONTINENTS
Pick a trail, pack your bag and set off. Routes adapt OpenStreetMap paths and elevation data into compact, playable landscapes inspired by real places. Walk the Annapurna Circuit over Thorong La, circle sacred Mount Kailash, cross Torres del Paine, climb Half Dome by its cables, and finish the loop at Tre Cime di Lavaredo. Trails come in four tiers (Beginner, Intermediate, Challenging, Extreme); finish two trails of a tier to unlock the next.

WEATHER, COLD AND THIN AIR
Snow, fog, rain and wind roll in as the day goes on. Cold drains your warmth, climbing faster than your body can acclimatize brings altitude sickness, wet clothes make everything worse, and falling rock and gusty ridges are real dangers. Watch your stamina, energy, hydration, warmth and health, and decide when to push on and when to turn back.

SCRAMBLE, CLIMB AND VAULT
When the slope is too steep to walk, you go hands-and-feet. Low boulders can be stepped over and taller ones climbed. Stairs, cables and rock steps are all there. Every footstep, hand and knee is animated live, so the hiker's feet land where the ground really is.

CAMP, EAT AND SURVIVE
Huts sell hot meals and a bed; on trails without huts you pitch a tent. Ration water, food, energy gels, hand warmers, first aid and oxygen over several days. The outfitter sells 26 pieces of gear and 14 kinds of supplies: boots, shells, down jackets, packs, poles, headlamps, tents, crampons, GPS units, water filters and more. Every piece changes how you cope.

CAPTURE THE SUMMIT
Every trail has three or four photo spots. Frame Mount Kailash, K2, Everest, Mont Blanc, Fitz Roy or Half Dome, press the shutter and keep the best shots in your album. Dawn and golden hour pay better than noon.

FEATURES
• 30 real trails: Annapurna Circuit, Everest Base Camp, K2 Base Camp, Kilimanjaro, Mount Kailash Kora, Tour du Mont Blanc, Inca Trail, Torres del Paine, Mount Fuji, Half Dome, Fitz Roy, Tongariro, Huangshan, Huashan, Mount Tai and more
• Landscapes and trail layouts based on geographic data
• Walk, run, scramble up steep slopes, vault boulders, sit, drink and take photos
• Survival: stamina, energy, hydration, warmth, health and altitude sickness
• Weather, day and night, headlamp, huts and camping
• 26 pieces of gear, 14 supplies and four stats that grow as you finish trails
• Photo album and 30 achievements
• Eight hikers of different ages and backgrounds, in a realistic or a cartoon look
• On-screen stick and buttons made for iPhone and iPad
• Free to try: 7 Beginner trails. The Full Game makes all 30 available with a single purchase; tier progression still applies
• Optional purchases: gear kits, emergency airdrops, revival kits, Double Rewards and funds. No ads or account. Gameplay works offline; purchases and restoration require internet
• English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Follows your device language, or pick one in Settings

A hiking simulation for entertainment, not a navigation tool or outdoor safety guide.

name: Wortdrop
description:
Wortdrop puts one German word where you already look a hundred times a day: the Lock Screen.

Read the word, guess the meaning, tap to check, say whether you knew it. Five seconds. The word comes back later, exactly when you are about to forget it (spaced repetition, the method behind Anki).

ON THE LOCK SCREEN
• Widget with a new word every few minutes, buttons to reveal, answer and skip
• Live Activity: a big card at the bottom of the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with Again / Hard / Good / Easy
• Home Screen widgets in three sizes, three colour styles
• Word drops: a quiet notification with one word; long-press to answer
• Lock Screen button (iOS 18+): replace the flashlight with "Show a word" or "Next word"

REMEMBERS THE GENDER FOR YOU
Every noun is coloured by its gender, everywhere in the app: blue der / le / il, red die / la, green das. After a while the colour sticks to the word and the article comes with it.

GRAMMAR FROM YOUR OWN WORDS
• Article drill: der / die / das on the nouns you already know
• Cases: ich sehe den…, ich helfe dem…, wegen des… (Nominativ, Akkusativ, Dativ, Genitiv)
• Adjective endings: ein neuer, den neuen, mit dem neuen
• Plurals, verb forms (fährt, fuhr, ist gefahren) and gender by ending (-ung → die)
• French and Italian: au / du, al / della contracted prepositions
• Grammar guide: every case and adjective table, tap to reveal, with memory tricks
Every drill is generated from your decks, so the sentences change as your vocabulary grows.

YOUR WORDS, YOUR WAY
• 50 starter words per language to begin right away
• A built-in library of 46 ready-made decks: A1 to B2, travel, food, work, home, health, shopping, verbs and more; for German also separable verbs, verbs with prepositions, false friends, spoken German and Berlin admin words
• Every library word has an example sentence and a memory hook
• Import an Anki deck (.apkg) with your progress and recordings
• Paste a list from a spreadsheet or a message
• Photograph a textbook page or your notes and the words are read on your iPhone
• Let Claude write a themed deck for your level, then paste it in
• Say "Add a word to Wortdrop" to Siri, or add from any app with a Shortcut

LEARNING THAT ADAPTS
• Four answers like Anki, or just Know it / Again
• Meaning first: see "fox", type "der Fuchs"
• Daily limits for new words and reviews, per language
• Undo, skip, pause and "bury until tomorrow"
• Pronunciation with the iPhone voices, example sentences, grammar notes and memory tips
• Progress: streak, retention, forecast, tricky words in one list

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No analytics. No ads. Everything stays on your iPhone; one tap backs it all up to a file you own.

GERMAN FIRST
Wortdrop is built for German first: all grammar drills, the grammar guide and the biggest deck library are German. French and Italian are included with decks, widgets and spaced repetition, but have fewer features for now. More is coming.

name: XCLDPT
description: This APP features an intuitive interface, well-organized content and practical tools for daily use. Users can easily explore available functions, perform calculations, and manage related activities within the application. The design focus of this application is simplicity, accessibility and reliable performance, and it is suitable for all supported devices.

name: XUBO IPTV Player
description:
XUBO IPTV Player is a state-of-the-art media player tailored for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac, enabling users to play their own IPTV playlists, M3U/M3U8 streams, and Xtream Codes accounts with remarkable speed and stability.

Key Features:
• Multi-Platform Harmony: Native, responsive interface designed specifically for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and macOS.
• Comprehensive Stream Support: Full compatibility with Xtream Codes API, M3U/M3U8 playlists, and MAC Portal (Stalker).
• Dual Playback Engines: Choose between Apple's native AVPlayer and the VLC playback engine for maximum codec compatibility.
• EPG Electronic Program Guide: View comprehensive program guides and track ongoing broadcasts in real-time.
• VOD & TV Series Hub: Effortless movie and series browsing with season/episode navigation, multi-track audio, and subtitles.
• Multi-Profile & Parental Control: Manage separate family profiles and secure sensitive categories with a 4-digit PIN lock.
• Local QR Playlist Sharing: Instantly transfer playlists and backups between devices over your local Wi-Fi network.
• Privacy-Centric Architecture: Zero telemetry and no remote tracking; all credentials remain strictly stored on your device.

IMPORTANT LEGAL NOTICE & DISCLAIMER:
- XUBO IPTV Player DOES NOT provide, host, include, or sell any media content, TV channels, streams, or IPTV subscriptions.
- The app functions strictly as a multimedia player software designed for playing user-supplied content.
- Users are solely responsible for ensuring they possess legal rights to view all media streams added to the application.
- XUBO IPTV has no affiliation or relationship with any third-party IPTV service provider.
- We do not endorse or support unauthorized playback of copyright-protected materials.

name: Yetto: Legendary Readers
description:
Across eras and lands, legendary readers each left one ledger behind — Pansu, who counted fortunes in market squares; Sowol, who reckoned whether two threads still hold; others who read the moment in cards, dice and hanafuda. In every ledger, the last page is blank.

Choose a reader and take the empty seat. Your birth date and hour go into the ledger the way that reader counted. Some draw cards, some throw dice, some cut hanafuda. Your first page opens: this year's verdict and what is caught now. The sealed volumes open when you choose.

· A different reckoning for each reader: Saju, tarot, dice, hanafuda, Nine Star Ki
· First page: the verdict, what is caught, the first line of each sealed volume
· Opened ledgers stay in My books
· After opening a ledger, ask its reader more
· Today's count: the reader drawn for the day reads your day in one line

Readings are for entertainment and self-reflection, not medical, legal or financial advice.

name: YolkPay
description:
YolkPay brings your YolkPay Cloud workspace to your phone and tablet.

For approved merchants, business teams and Agents:
• View the merchants and markets authorized for your account.
• Check merchant summaries and transaction history.
• Track Agent commission activity and monthly settlement invoices.
• View CAD and USD amounts and settlement records separately.
• Review invoice payment status and commission details.

Sign in with your organization-provided YolkPay Cloud account. Features and information are limited by your assigned role and merchant access. Payment collection and other management actions are available through your secure YolkPay Cloud workspace.
